GOV :

Our Global Government & Public Sector (GPS) is a network of highly skilled professionals dedicated to serving our clients by bringing best-in-class international experience and insight combined with local knowledge to solve the most critical problems facing governments today. We actively focus on building solutions that help public sector entities face the challenges of the future and reinvent themselves.

Digital transformation is not just about new technologies; it involves an overhaul of organizational structures, governance, work processes, culture and mindset. It also means realizing a wider vision of relationships and business models that will redesign how public services function.

To achieve this vision, we help clients balance strategic choices to re-ignite performance. We have developed a suite of cross-service line strategic solutions that align with our client priorities.

We have a proud record of helping governments meet their challenges head-on, and we work closely with them to build a world that works better for all citizens.

CNS - BC - Transformation Delivery :

EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client-centric approach focuses on driving long-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.

Business Consulting works with clients to reimagine or transform their business purpose and model; create growth; manage cost and efficiency; respond to market pressures and regulation; and resolve operational challenges. The scope of this team encompasses innovation, strategy and purpose, through deep functional experience in business transformation, finance, supply chain and operations, providing support for the complex and large-scale program and portfolio management.

It has multiple fields of play such as:

Finance Consulting - helps assess and transform our clients' finance function to improve performance and effectiveness. We help organizations implement service and cost improvement initiatives, and embed a performance management process and culture that unites the business around its core objectives.

Business Transformation - a m?ultidisciplinary competency, gathering capabilities in transformation architecture, experience design, business design and transformation execution to problem-solve, design and deliver large scale, multi-year, multi-stakeholder transformation programs.

Supply Chain and Operations - we provide a unique combination of industry-specific, strategic, operational and financial insights, digital technology advances and strategic alliance partners to deliver better outcomes and also help clients effect fundamental change in their operations’ performance to support sales growth, become more cost competitive, minimize risk and ensure operational resilience.

Your key responsibilities

Technical Excellence

- Project Delivery Lead day-to-day execution of consulting assignments in CSR and social impact. Manage workstreams across CSR strategy development, portfolio reviews, programme design, governance reviews, impact assessments and due diligence engagements. Conduct qualitative and quantitative research, stakeholder consultations and secondary analysis. Develop frameworks, strategic recommendations, implementation roadmaps and monitoring mechanisms. Support design and facilitation of leadership workshops, focus group discussions and stakeholder consultations. Review and synthesize large volumes of information into clear and actionable insights. Client Management Coordinate directly with client teams and implementation partners. Prepare meeting agendas, discussion materials and presentations. Present findings and recommendations to clients and senior stakeholders. Build and maintain strong client relationships throughout project execution. Team Management Guide and mentor analysts on research, analysis and deliverable development. Review outputs produced by junior team members and provide constructive feedback. Support project planning, timeline management and quality assurance. Business Development & Knowledge Management Contribute to proposal development, opportunity pursuits and market research. Develop case studies, credentials and knowledge products. Track developments in CSR regulations, ESG, social impact and sustainability trends. Contribute to practice initiatives, thought leadership and sector research.

Skills and attributes

To qualify for the role you must have
Qualification

- "Masters degree in Social Sciences, Public Policy, Development Studies, Rural Management, Sustainability, MBA or related fields"

Experience

- 3-4 years of experience in CSR consulting, development consulting, social impact, sustainability advisory or programme management

What we look for

People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

What we offer

Fuelled by the brilliance of our people, EY has emerged as the strongest brand and the most attractive employer in our field, with market-leading growth over competitors. Our people work side-by-side with market-leading entrepreneurs, game-changers, disruptors, and visionaries. As an organization, we are investing more time, technology, and money than ever before in skills and learning for our people. At EY, you will have a personalized Career Journey and also the chance to tap into the resources of our career frameworks to better know about your roles, skills, and opportunities.

EY is equally committed to being an inclusive employer, and we strive to achieve the right balance for our people—enabling us to deliver excellent client service while allowing our people to build their careers as well as focus on their wellbeing.

If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.

Join us in shaping the future with confidence. Apply Now

jobs.title: GDS Consulting | UKG/Kronos Manager
jobs.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

EY- GDS – Consulting- People Consulting (PC), UKG/Kronos Manager

Managing global workforce in today’s fast changing and highly disrupted environment is becoming increasingly complex. As member of our PC practice, you’ll be part of a team that support clients in aligning their HR function with the Organizational plans while keeping employee experience as one of the core considerations.  When you join us, you will gain cross functional, multi industry and a truly global work experience to take your career in the right direction.

The opportunity
We are looking for Managers with expertise in UKG/Kronos to join the PC team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be a part of a leading global professional services organisation whilst being instrumental in the growth of the People Consulting team.

Your key responsibilities:
•    Manage and grow payroll consulting and Workforce management services capability within the business, develop strong relations with global practices. Achieve metrics on productivity, utilization, head count growth and penetration
•    Contribute to the firm’s growth and development in a variety of ways, including successfully delivering on project engagements, leading and facilitating client working sessions, provide expertise and leadership in knowledge area, support sales and business development pursuits and assist in framing and positioning extension and project expansion work at existing clients
•    Focus on delivering client expectations while also identifying areas of opportunities for the client and engagement teams to further expand the relationship
•    Serve different roles as per project scope and requirements such as Engagement Manager, Application Architect, Process & Best Practice Consultant and Application Consultant
•    When performing role of Application Consultant, the Workforce Management Manager will be responsible for:
o    Participating in full life cycle activities
o    Ensure the product is designed to meet the business requirements
•    Serve as Functional or Technical lead depending on project size and skill set
•    Collaborate with Process Specialist during discovery workshops
•    Advise project delivery team during Build and Test activities
•    When performing the role of Process / Best Practice Consultant the Workforce Management Manager will be responsible for facilitating the end-state visioning sessions working under the guidance of the Application Specialist
•    Ensure quality of delivery and all aspects of operational management.
•    Manage engagement risk, project economics, manage escalations and ensure effective planning and budgeting
•    Develop thought leadership, collateral, tools, techniques, methodologies to build and enhance payroll offering within the practice
•    Perform role of counsellor and coach, define and set goals, conduct performance reviews and ensure ongoing learning and development of the team

Skills and attributes for success:

•    High integrity and commitment to work in a new and challenging environment
•    Ability to manage ambiguity and be proactive
•    Strong communication and presentation skills
•    Cross cultural awareness and sensitivity
•    High energy levels, agility and adaptability
•    Open to travel nationally and internationally for client projects that are approved as per EY and country specific travel advisory guidelines

To qualify for the role, you must have
•    Minimum 8 – 10 years of experience in Workforce management (Time management, attendance, scheduling, etc.) and Payroll consulting
•    Experience of working in a consulting environment on global client projects in areas of time & attendance, work force management transformation and shared services advisory.
•    Experience in team management; providing advice and guidance on client projects related with Workforce management processes and systems

•    Must have end-to-end implementation of UKG/Kronos, or Dayforce WFM Tools

Ideally, you’ll also have
•    Demonstrated technical proficiencies in Work Force Management; take a practical/business driven approach to solving complex global payroll client challenges
•    Led Work Force Management project work streams from planning through to implementation – managing project resources and budgets effectively
•    Designed payroll delivery options (consolidation of multiple payrolls, vendor advisory, shared service centre development, use of technology to generate efficiencies), and payroll transition management
•    Supported other regions in client pursuit activities in the payroll and WFM space by developing proposals and presentations
•    Ability to review current processes to identify key metrics to evaluate operational performance compared to internal performance objectives and Payroll industry leading practices benchmarks
•    Facilitate and support the client in movement of the payroll delivery to a 3rd party outsource provider - developing a strong governance model to drive the vendor performance and delivery of services
•    Project management experience
•    FPC, CPP or PMP certification
•    Experience of working with a Big 4 consulting firm

What we look for

•    Professionals who are independent, self-motivated, proactive, results-oriented and able to provide a high level of customer satisfaction through the delivery of world-class support services. Apart from day-to-day activities, the candidate is expected to be involved in strategic planning to grow the team.
•    Technical experts with commercial acumen, relevant experiences and high degree of enthusiasm to adapt and learn in a fast-moving environment
•    Professionals who are willing to work in an environment of continual professional development, drive to take on new responsibilities and projects and work experiences with clients across geographies

What working at EY offers

At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:

•    Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
•    Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
•    The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

About EY

As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we’re using the finance products, expertise and systems we’ve developed to build a better working world. That starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom to make things better. Whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime. And with a commitment to hiring and developing the most passionate people, we’ll make our ambition to be the best employer by 2020 a reality.

If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.

Join us in building a better working world.

Apply now

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Business Transformation, Health
jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Senior Manager, Health

Overview:

EY is experiencing an increasing demand in its Health consulting expertise. We are seeking to increase our team of highly skilled and experienced Senior Managers who are already delivering impact and value for our health clients across the UK.

The successful candidate will work directly, and in partnership, with our clients to understand their business needs, lead the design and delivery of transformation in health and care services. We are looking in particular, for individuals who have consulted (or worked) within NHS Provider organisations or Integrated Care Systems, and who have a passion and focus on:

- Transformational Productivity and Operational Improvement

- Financial Sustainability

- Large scale national or complex Transformation and Digital enabled programmes

- Care system re-design to include Corporate Service transformation, Workforce transformation and future Operating Model development

- Digital Healthcare to include Data Analytics and AI.

Working collaboratively within multi-practice EY teams, this role will be critical to designing and delivering solution sets and helping bring the best of EY capabilities to the health sector. As a growing health practice acting as an advocate for EY’s values, promoting our high-quality brand and showcasing our capability expertise across the business.

To have immediate impact, only those with both large firm consulting and healthcare experience (from either within consulting or from working directly in the health service) should apply.

Key Responsibilities:

- Lead and oversee multiple consulting projects within the healthcare sector, ensuring successful delivery and alignment with client objectives.

- Work directly with clients and Senior Leaders to understand their business needs and design/deliver transformational solution sets, particularly focused on the productivity, cost out agenda and digitally enabled transformation.

- Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, acting as a trusted advisor providing expert guidance on healthcare transformation, productivity and the cost out agenda.

- Mentor junior team members, supporting their professional development and the growth of our UK health community, ensuring those aligned to the health practice thrive.

- Conduct comprehensive market research and analysis to identify trends, opportunities, and risks within the healthcare landscape.

- Drive business development efforts, including identifying new opportunities, preparing proposals, and delivering compelling presentations to prospective clients acting as a Bid Manager where required.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate insights and solutions that enhance client value and drive sustainable outcomes.

- Stay informed about regulatory changes, industry developments, and emerging technologies to inform strategic recommendations and consulting practices.

Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience).

- Experienced healthcare professional with consulting experience within a professional services firm OR experienced professional services consultant with experience of delivering healthcare engagements with providers or systems.

- In-depth knowledge of the UK healthcare system landscapes including at provider, regional and national level.

- Experience of acting as Bid Manager for Pursuits and Engagement Manger for large, complex, engagements.

Skills and Competencies:

- Demonstrated expertise in managing large-scale projects and leading teams to achieve successful outcomes.

- Strong understanding of the UK healthcare system, including policy, regulatory, and operational aspects.

- Strong understanding of NHS Operations and Service delivery across the healthcare landscape to include NHS Acute and Community Trusts, Integrated Care Systems, Arm’s Length Bodies and National Teams.

- Exceptional analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving skills, with a good understanding of Healthcare data and intelligence solutions.

- Proven ability to communicate effectively with clients and stakeholders at all levels, including executive, operational and clinical leadership teams.

- Experience in business development and a track record of successfully securing new consulting engagements.

- Skilled Engagement Manager able to effectively manage commercials and engagement risks.

- Strong understanding of client needs and how to translate them into solution sets.

- Strong leadership and mentoring abilities alongside excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

Location:

- This role is based in London or one our EY’s regional offices. National travel will be required as will travel to our EY Headquarters in London.

EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

jobs.title: Senior Consultant in Risk Consulting (Financial Sector - Risk Management, ALM)
jobs.description:
EY — Are you ready to shape the future with confidence?

At EY, we value open‑mindedness, curiosity, and the courage to take on new challenges.
We work with people who want to grow, create, transform, and make a meaningful impact.

Every role at EY is an opportunity to explore new ideas, help organizations evolve, and shape what comes next - for clients, for industries, and for yourself.

Will you shape the future with us - or be shaped by it?
We’re hiring a Senior Consultant in Risk Consulting.

Role Overview

- Key topics: risk management, ALM, large-scale transformations

- Clients: financial sector organizations in Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Azerbaijan

- Examples of projects for banks include (but are not limited to): Full-scale risk function transformation, Development of Asset-Liability Management (ALM) tool & framework, Construction of FTP curve, ICAAP diagnostics and development of recommendations to align with SREP recommendations, Development of climate financing strategy, Transformation of fraud risk management system, Diagnostics & transformation of corporate governance system, Climate stress-testing. Projects for financial regulators are also common, including a market-wide project on improvement of efficiency of risk management, internal audit, and internal control systems for the whole banking sector in the country

- Participation in consulting projects and support in new business development (including preparation of commercial proposals, promotion of EY expertise, development of tools and knowledge bases)

- Tasks include developing client solutions, conducting research, analytical work, creating models and tools, and preparing presentations

- The position is an excellent opportunity to implement large-scale projects on the most relevant topics for leading financial institutions in the region and to develop consulting competencies, as well as expertise on a wide range of topics in the financial industry

Candidate Requirements

- Financial, business, economic, mathematical, or technical education

- 1–3 years of experience in consulting or financial sector organizations in functions such as risk management, strategy, ALM, research & analysis, finance, etc.

- Excellent knowledge of the banking industry

- Excellent knowledge of one or more of the following topics: risk management, bank strategy, bank transformations, ALM, finance, banking / financial markets

- Excellent skills in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word

- Excellent skills in researching, analyzing, and structuring information

- Advanced understanding of business and finance

- English language skills – at least Upper-Intermediate level

- Top performer with outstanding leadership skills and strive for excellence

- Readiness to work overtime in a fast-paced environment and to travel for business purposes

- High level of interest in the financial industry, desire to develop in this direction

What you will have:

- Strong internal & external networking: industry events, meetups, communities

- Challenging projects with regional exposure (Central Asia & (the Caucasus)

- Hybrid work model & modern office space

- Well‑being support: fitness compensation, corporate activities and discounts

- Add local perks — e.g., late meals, mobile allowance, etc.

And many more…

It has multiple fields of play such as:

Finance Consulting - helps assess and transform our clients' finance function to improve performance and effectiveness. Business Transformation - a m?ultidisciplinary competency, gathering capabilities in transformation architecture, experience design, business design and transformation execution to problem-solve, design and deliver large scale, multi-year, multi-stakeholder transformation programs.

Supply Chain and Operations - we provide a unique combination of industry-specific, strategic, operational and financial insights, digital technology advances and strategic alliance partners to deliver better outcomes and also help clients effect fundamental change in their operations’ performance to support sales growth, become more cost competitive, minimize risk and ensure operational resilience.

Technical Excellence

- Strong foundation in business consulting methodologies to support transformation delivery engagements. Ability to analyze current-state processes and identify opportunities for operational and strategic improvement. Experience in developing structured business solutions aligned to client transformation objectives. Proficient in preparing high-quality consulting deliverables, including assessments, recommendations, and implementation plans. Capable of supporting project execution through data-driven analysis, documentation, and tracking of transformation initiatives.

Qualification

- Bachelor of Business Administration

- Bachelor of Architecture

- Master of Science in Data Science

- Master of Business Administration

- Master of Architecture

People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. jobs.description:
Requisition id: 1742145

The opportunity  : Senior Consultant-AMI-Business Consulting Risk-CNS - Risk - Process & Controls - New Delhi

AMI :

The Advanced Manufacturing, Mobility & Infrastructure (AMI) Industry Market contains the following industries: Aerospace and Defence, Chemicals, Infrastructure, Industrial Products, Automotive, and Transportation that includes Mobility-as-a-Service. We help our clients to address the rapidly changing needs of our business world on not only how goods and services are bought and sold, but also on how they are designed and created. AMI builds and shares resources across sectors facing common challenges and aims to drive more effective cross-sector collaboration while enabling greater resource-pooling and developing more cohesive market responses. AMI also presents an opportunity to connect regional sector communities with a more robust, global priority sector infrastructure.

CNS - Risk - Process & Controls :

EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client-centric approach focuses on driving long-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.

We help our clients in identifying and managing the interplay between upside and downside risk in order to make the long-term decisions to prevent risk and impact on their organization's ability to meet its future business strategy and objectives. The 3 key fields of play are :

Enterprise Risk - helps clients identify and address key risk areas, while building the agility to respond quickly. The areas of focus include Enterprise risk and resilience, Internal audit, Compliance and Internal controls

Technology Risk - helps clients to achieve sustainable growth by supporting their efforts to protect their business performance and by providing trusted communications on internal control and regulatory compliance to investors, management, regulators, customers and other stakeholders. EY teams accomplish this by assessing the technology risks that are introduced to businesses.

Financial Services Risk - helps clients in the financial sector to identify, manage and monitor the risks in their business. It is done through a transformative and agile approach including process and procedures, risk, data modeling and analytics, reporting to stakeholders and third parties, business requirements (for software selection and IT implementation), analysis of assets and liabilities, and capital and liquidity management.

Your key responsibilities

Technical Excellence

- Lead and execute internal audit, risk advisory, and process review engagements across business functions to evaluate the effectiveness of governance, risk management, and internal control frameworks. Perform risk assessments, develop audit plans and testing strategies, identify control gaps, and provide practical recommendations to improve operational efficiency and regulatory compliance. Conduct walkthroughs, interviews, data analysis, and control testing to evaluate key business processes, including procurement, sales, inventory management, finance, and information technology controls. Prepare high-quality audit workpapers, observations, reports, and executive presentations, clearly communicating risks, root causes, business impacts, and actionable recommendations. Manage client relationships and coordinate with process owners, senior management, and cross-functional teams to discuss findings, track remediation plans, and drive timely closure of audit issues. Mentor and supervise junior team members, review their work, support business development initiatives, and contribute to the enhancement of audit methodologies, tools, and industry best practices.

Skills and attributes

To qualify for the role you must have
Qualification

- Chartered Accountant

Experience

- Internal Audit

What we look for

People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

What we offer

Fuelled by the brilliance of our people, EY has emerged as the strongest brand and the most attractive employer in our field, with market-leading growth over competitors. Our people work side-by-side with market-leading entrepreneurs, game-changers, disruptors, and visionaries. As an organization, we are investing more time, technology, and money than ever before in skills and learning for our people. At EY, you will have a personalized Career Journey and also the chance to tap into the resources of our career frameworks to better know about your roles, skills, and opportunities.

EY is equally committed to being an inclusive employer, and we strive to achieve the right balance for our people—enabling us to deliver excellent client service while allowing our people to build their careers as well as focus on their wellbeing.

Requisition Id: 1745500

As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom. At EY, we don't just focus on who you are now, but who you can become. We believe that it’s your career and ‘It’s yours to build’ which means potential here is limitless and we'll provide you with motivating and fulfilling experiences throughout your career to help you on the path to becoming your best professional self.

The opportunity : Senior Consultant-FS-Business Consulting Risk-CNS - Risk - Process & Controls - Mumbai

FS :

Finance fuels our lives. Banking, Insurance and Wealth management, create the foundations for growth, prosperity and peace of mind. No other Industry touches so many people or shapes so many lives.

Amid sweeping regulatory change, today’s financial services institutions are focusing on digital transformation, convergence and disruption from an array of nontraditional competitors — all while meeting greater demands for trust and transparency.

To address this delicate balance of issues, our competent team of business strategists, technologists and industry leaders bring fresh thinking and sector knowledge across banking and capital markets, insurance, and wealth and asset management. The results are seamless collaboration, innovative problem solving, breakthrough performance gains and sustainable value creation.

We recruit, train and nurture a diverse set of people who dedicate their minds to building the future of financial services. Together, we explore new perspectives with innovative and entrepreneurial thinking to deliver exceptional client service and ensure that what we do today, counts for tomorrow.

CNS - Risk - Process & Controls :

EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client-centric approach focuses on driving long-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.

We help our clients in identifying and managing the interplay between upside and downside risk in order to make the long-term decisions to prevent risk and impact on their organization's ability to meet its future business strategy and objectives. The 3 key fields of play are :

Enterprise Risk - helps clients identify and address key risk areas, while building the agility to respond quickly. The areas of focus include Enterprise risk and resilience, Internal audit, Compliance and Internal controls

Technology Risk - helps clients to achieve sustainable growth by supporting their efforts to protect their business performance and by providing trusted communications on internal control and regulatory compliance to investors, management, regulators, customers and other stakeholders. EY teams accomplish this by assessing the technology risks that are introduced to businesses.

Financial Services Risk - helps clients in the financial sector to identify, manage and monitor the risks in their business. It is done through a transformative and agile approach including process and procedures, risk, data modeling and analytics, reporting to stakeholders and third parties, business requirements (for software selection and IT implementation), analysis of assets and liabilities, and capital and liquidity management.

Your key responsibilities

Technical Excellence

- Strong experience in internal audit, risk assessment, and controls testing within banking environments. Proficient in evaluating business processes and control frameworks across corporate banking, trade finance, and treasury functions. Hands-on expertise in identifying control gaps, assessing risk exposure, and recommending process improvements. Solid understanding of financial services operations with exposure to risk and controls assignments. Ability to lead engagements, manage client deliverables, and drive high-quality execution of consulting projects.

Skills and attributes

To qualify for the role you must have
Qualification

- Bachelor of Commerce

- Bachelor of Business Administration

- Master of Commerce

- Master of Business Administration

Experience

- Quality Assurance & Testing (3+ years)

- Business Analysis (3+ years)

What we look for

People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

What we offer

Fuelled by the brilliance of our people, EY has emerged as the strongest brand and the most attractive employer in our field, with market-leading growth over competitors. Our people work side-by-side with market-leading entrepreneurs, game-changers, disruptors, and visionaries. As an organization, we are investing more time, technology, and money than ever before in skills and learning for our people. At EY, you will have a personalized Career Journey and also the chance to tap into the resources of our career frameworks to better know about your roles, skills, and opportunities.

EY is equally committed to being an inclusive employer, and we strive to achieve the right balance for our people—enabling us to deliver excellent client service while allowing our people to build their careers as well as focus on their wellbeing.

If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.

Join us in shaping the future with confidence. Apply Now

FS :

Finance fuels our lives. Banking, Insurance and Wealth management, create the foundations for growth, prosperity and peace of mind. No other Industry touches so many people or shapes so many lives.

Amid sweeping regulatory change, today’s financial services institutions are focusing on digital transformation, convergence and disruption from an array of nontraditional competitors — all while meeting greater demands for trust and transparency.

To address this delicate balance of issues, our competent team of business strategists, technologists and industry leaders bring fresh thinking and sector knowledge across banking and capital markets, insurance, and wealth and asset management. CNS - Risk - Process & Controls :

EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client-centric approach focuses on driving long-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.

We help our clients in identifying and managing the interplay between upside and downside risk in order to make the long-term decisions to prevent risk and impact on their organization's ability to meet its future business strategy and objectives. The 3 key fields of play are :

Enterprise Risk - helps clients identify and address key risk areas, while building the agility to respond quickly. The areas of focus include Enterprise risk and resilience, Internal audit, Compliance and Internal controls

Technology Risk - helps clients to achieve sustainable growth by supporting their efforts to protect their business performance and by providing trusted communications on internal control and regulatory compliance to investors, management, regulators, customers and other stakeholders. EY teams accomplish this by assessing the technology risks that are introduced to businesses.

Financial Services Risk - helps clients in the financial sector to identify, manage and monitor the risks in their business. It is done through a transformative and agile approach including process and procedures, risk, data modeling and analytics, reporting to stakeholders and third parties, business requirements (for software selection and IT implementation), analysis of assets and liabilities, and capital and liquidity management.

Your key responsibilities

Technical Excellence

- Strong experience in internal audit, risk assessment, and controls testing within banking environments. Proficient in evaluating business processes and control frameworks across corporate banking, trade finance, and treasury functions. Hands-on expertise in identifying control gaps, assessing risk exposure, and recommending process improvements. Solid understanding of financial services operations with exposure to risk and controls assignments. Ability to lead engagements, manage client deliverables, and drive high-quality execution of consulting projects.

Skills and attributes

To qualify for the role you must have
Qualification

- Bachelor of Commerce

- Bachelor of Business Administration

- Master of Commerce

- Master of Business Administration

Experience

- Quality Assurance & Testing (3+ years)

- Business Analysis (3+ years)

What we look for

People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

EY is equally committed to being an inclusive employer, and we strive to achieve the right balance for our people—enabling us to deliver excellent client service while allowing our people to build their careers as well as focus on their wellbeing.

jobs.title: Senior Consultant - Learning Transformation - Financial Services, People Consulting
jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Senior Consultant, Learning Transformation | Financial Services

Help Shape the Future of Learning in Financial Services

At EY People Consulting, we help leading banking, insurance, and wealth and asset management organisations transform how their people learn, grow and perform.

As organisations navigate regulatory change, digital transformation and evolving workforce expectations, learning is increasingly becoming a strategic driver of business success. We're looking for a Senior Consultant to join our growing Financial Services Learning team and help clients build the skills, capabilities and behaviours needed for the future.

This is an exciting opportunity to work alongside experienced consultants and industry specialists, delivering innovative learning and transformation solutions for some of the world's most recognised financial services organisations.

What You'll Do

As a Senior Consultant, you'll play a key role in delivering complex client engagements while building trusted stakeholder relationships and contributing to the growth of our practice.

You will:

- Lead the delivery of workstreams across learning transformation and capability development programmes within financial services.

- Partner with clients to develop innovative learning strategies and capability solutions.

- Support the design and delivery of innovative learning and capability solutions tailored to client needs.

- Support the development of strong client relationships, working closely with stakeholders to understand business priorities.

- Contribute to business development activities, including proposal and proposition development and client pursuits.

- Contribute to engagement delivery, operations and risk management activities.

- Support wider People Consulting initiatives through knowledge sharing and practice growth activities.

With a specific focus on Learning & Development, you will:

- Support development of learning strategies aligned to workforce capability needs and learning technologies.

- Design, develop and deploy impactful learning solutions across digital and non-digital formats.

- Contribute to the design of learning strategies, capability frameworks, curricula and learning journeys that address current and future workforce needs.

- Support organisational transformation and behavioural change through learning initiatives and analytics.

- Contribute to proposal development, solution design and client presentations.

- Help develop EY's learning offerings and contribute to the ongoing growth of the practice.

- Drive innovation and bring fresh thinking to create market-leading learning solutions and thought leadership.

What We're Looking For

Essential Experience

- Consulting experience gained within professional services, consulting, or large-scale in-house transformation environments.

- Experience supporting change and transformation programmes, ideally with a learning or capability focus.

- Strong stakeholder management skills with experience working across diverse groups to deliver successful outcomes.

- Strong project management, communication and presentation skills.

- Experience producing high-quality analysis, reports and client-ready deliverables.

- Experience working within financial services, including banking, insurance, and/or wealth and asset management.

Skills & Attributes

- Strong consulting and influencing skills with the ability to build credibility with stakeholders.

- Passion for learning, capability development and helping organisations perform at their best.

- Entrepreneurial mindset with a proactive, solutions-focused approach.

- Curiosity, innovation and a desire to challenge the status quo.

- Resilience and adaptability in fast-paced environments.

- Creative problem-solving skills with a focus on practical, sustainable outcomes.

Ideally, You'll Also Have

- A relevant degree and/or professional qualification.

Why EY?

You'll join a fast-growing, collaborative team that combines learning expertise, behavioural science and deep financial services knowledge to solve complex people challenges.

In return, you'll have the opportunity to:

- Work with some of the world's leading financial services organisations.

- Deliver high-profile transformation and learning programmes.

- Develop consulting, client leadership and business development skills.

- Collaborate with experts across EY's global network.

- Accelerate your career in a supportive, high-performing team.

- Benefit from flexible working, continuous development and a competitive rewards package.

At EY, we're building a better working world by putting people at the heart of transformation. Join us and help shape the future of learning in financial services.

EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

jobs.title: Senior Consultant(Manager) - EY-Parthenon - Life Sciences Pricing and Market Access Strategy, London
jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Senior Consultant (Manager) - EY-Parthenon - Life Sciences Pricing and Market Access Strategy, London .

The opportunity

At EY-Parthenon, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture, and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help us become even better. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

EY-Parthenon is a global strategy consultancy. We challenge assumptions to design and deliver strategies that help improve profitability and long-term value. We have more than 9,000 professionals around the globe, working across three areas of focus:

- Corporate & Growth Strategy:  Developing growth strategies by providing in-depth market, competitor and customer insights.

- Transaction Strategy & Execution (TSE):  Developing, evaluating and executing transaction strategies across the whole M&A and investment lifecycle.

- Turnaround & Restructuring Strategy : Rapidly creating, preserving and recovering value in urgent and complex situations.

This job opportunity relates to  Corporate & growth strategy UK only.   In the UK, we are also recruiting for roles in our Transaction strategy & execution team, please refer to separate opportunities listed for details of roles also available. Please note you will only be able to apply to one role at EY-Parthenon, so please ensure you are clear on where you want to apply before submitting your application.

About EY-Parthenon Corporate & Growth Strategy

At EY-P Strategy, we put our purpose — Building a better working world — at the heart of everything we do. We are committed to using unconventional yet pragmatic thinking to deliver actionable strategies to help our clients navigate the ever-changing business landscape.

You’ll be part of a collaborative team that helps transform client businesses using cutting-edge research, analytics and AI-powered tools. The London office focuses on Education, Industrials & Energy, Health Sciences & Wellness, Retail & Consumer Goods, and Technology, Media & Telecom.

This role sits within our Health Sciences & Wellness team and focuses on Life Sciences pricing and market access strategy. We work collaboratively to tackle complex challenges and deliver exceptional results for our clients.

We advise on a broad range of strategic issues, including core value propositions, competitive positioning and growth strategies. Within Life Sciences, we help pharmaceutical, biotech and medtech clients navigate pricing, reimbursement and market access challenges so that innovative products can reach the patients who need them. EY-Parthenon Strategy employees work closely with influential and highly experienced professionals within the firm and at clients’ organisations.

Our work applies deep Life Sciences, health system and strategy knowledge across projects such as:

- Pricing, reimbursement and market access strategy, including price potential, payer strategy and product launch sequencing

- Value proposition, value communication strategy, payer objection handler development and negotiation strategy

- HTA, evidence and launch readiness strategy, including evidence-gap assessment and implications for HEOR and real-world evidence planning

- Disease area strategy, patient journey assessment, stakeholder mapping, and funding landscape assessments

- Portfolio, indication and market prioritisation, opportunity assessment, and innovative access and contracting models

You’ll lead high-performing, integrated teams supporting global and local pharmaceutical, biotech and medtech clients. The variety of therapeutic areas, markets and product lifecycle stages will provide continuous learning and development opportunities.

We are expanding our Life Sciences team with Senior Consultants at Manager level to lead pricing and market access strategy engagements. You will help clients understand payer and health-system needs, demonstrate product value, make pricing and access decisions, and prepare for successful launches.

You will lead the day-to-day delivery of multiple engagements or major workstreams, serving as a primary client contact and managing teams to deliver high-quality work on time and within scope. You will structure complex questions, set the analytical direction, review outputs and translate evidence into clear, implementable recommendations.

The role combines deep pricing and market access expertise with strong consulting leadership. You will manage senior stakeholders, lead payer and expert research, facilitate workshops, and bring together perspectives from strategy, HEOR, evidence generation, medical affairs and wider commercial teams. You will also help grow the practice by identifying opportunities, developing proposals and pitches, building intellectual capital, and supporting recruitment, learning and professional development. You will coach and mentor junior colleagues while fostering an inclusive, high-performing team environment.

Your Key Responsibilities

You will lead your teams in:

- Lead the day-to-day delivery of multiple engagements or major workstreams, establishing clear scopes, work plans, governance, timelines and quality standards

- Structure complex pricing and market access questions, set the analytical approach, and oversee rigorous primary research, secondary research and quantitative analysis

- Direct work across pricing and reimbursement strategy, payer strategy, value proposition, HTA and evidence strategy, launch readiness, and innovative access models

- Design and lead payer and expert interviews, advisory boards, client workshops and working sessions

- Synthesize evidence into clear recommendations and compelling client-ready storylines, and present confidently to senior stakeholders

- Build trusted client relationships, identify follow-on opportunities, and lead or contribute to proposals, pitches and business development

- Manage, coach and provide actionable feedback to team members while contributing to thought leadership, capability building and an inclusive culture

Skills and attributes for success

Successful candidates combine pricing and market access expertise with strong consulting judgement and team leadership. You will be intellectually curious, commercially minded and able to turn complex evidence and stakeholder perspectives into practical recommendations, while building trusted relationships with clients and colleagues.

What we look for

- Be educated to bachelor’s degree level or equivalent and have a minimum of 4 years’ relevant experience in strategy consulting, market access consulting or a combination of consulting and pharmaceutical, biotech or medtech industry roles

- Have a strong track record of leading multiple projects or major workstreams, managing teams and delivering high-quality work to scope, timeline and budget

- Demonstrate substantial experience across pricing, reimbursement and market access, with expertise in areas such as payer strategy, value proposition, HTA and evidence strategy, launch readiness or innovative contracting

- Have experience managing senior client stakeholders, leading workshops and primary research, and developing and presenting strategic recommendations

- Demonstrate strong qualitative and quantitative problem-solving, clear written and verbal communication, and sound commercial judgement

Ideally, you will also

- Bring knowledge of payer, HTA, pricing and reimbursement systems across multiple major markets

- Have experience working with global and local market access teams across therapeutic areas and product lifecycle stages

- Have contributed to business development, proposal leadership, client account growth or market access thought leadership

- Hold a relevant postgraduate qualification such as an MBA, MSc, MPH, PhD, or degree in Health Economics, Health Policy or Pharmaceutical Sciences

- Speak an additional major language and be willing to travel internationally when required

What we offer

We offer an attractive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions.

Plus, we offer:

- Continuous learning: Through advanced market access training, coaching and mentorship, you’ll strengthen your leadership and client advisory capabilities

- Deep Life Sciences leadership experience: Opportunities to lead work across therapeutic areas, product lifecycle stages, geographies and complex pricing and access questions

- Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

- Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.

If you can demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.

The exceptional EY experience. It’s yours to build.

Apply now.

EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

jobs.title: Associate Director, AI Strategy, EY-Parthenon
jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Associate Director – AI Strategy

Key responsibilities

Lead engagement execution

- Lead sizeable workstreams and selected end-to-end AI strategy engagements, acting as the primary day-to-day client lead and ensuring delivery of commercially impactful outcomes, with oversight and support from Directors and Partners

- Convert broad client questions into clear hypotheses, issue trees, workplans, analytical requirements, stakeholder plans and decision points

- Own the day-to-day management of engagements, including team deployment, timelines, dependencies, deliverable quality, client governance, scope management and engagement economics

Deliver enterprise AI strategies

- Assess an organisation’s AI maturity, strategic ambition, business priorities, technology landscape, data readiness, talent base and governance capabilities and translate findings into clear strategic recommendations, investment priorities and executive decision points

- Identify, quantify and prioritise AI value creation opportunities across growth, productivity, cost, risk and customer outcomes, linking opportunities to measurable business impact.

- Develop and prioritise portfolios of AI use cases using commercial value, strategic relevance, feasibility, risk, data readiness and time-to-impact criteria

- Define target AI operating models, including decision rights, governance, funding, delivery structures, talent requirements and collaboration between business, technology, data and risk teams

- Evaluate build, buy and partner choices, including the implications of foundation models, cloud providers, specialist AI vendors and existing enterprise platforms

- Develop practical AI roadmaps, investment requirements, business cases, capability-building plans and implementation priorities based on the guidance from Directors, Partners and EY Experts, balancing value, feasibility, organisational readiness and implementation risk

Deliver AI-focused transaction work

- Lead or support buy-side AI due diligence for private equity and corporate investors, assessing the risks from AI to the business model / credibility and commercial relevance of a target’s AI capabilities and strategy

- Assess whether claimed AI capabilities are proprietary, defensible and material to the investment thesis, rather than superficial product features or repackaged third-party functionality

- Quantify potential AI value creation opportunities, associated execution requirements and implications for value creation thesis

- Identify material risks, capability gaps, technical debt, cost exposures and dependencies that may affect valuation, deal terms or integration planning

- For vendor due diligence, develop an evidence-backed AI equity story that clearly articulates current capabilities, competitive differentiation, value delivered to date and the future value creation opportunity

- Prepare management teams to respond credibly to investor scrutiny of the company’s AI capabilities, roadmap, economics and defensibility

- Present concise, decision-oriented findings to investment committees, deal teams, management teams and other senior stakeholders

- Support the assessment of post-deal AI value creation opportunities, integration considerations and technology-enabled synergy potential

Manage senior stakeholders

- Build trusted working relationships with C-suite executives, business-unit leaders, AI / Data- leaders, functional leaders, private equity investment professionals and portfolio management teams

- Plan and facilitate executive interviews, workshops, working sessions and steering committees

- Communicate complex AI and technology topics in clear commercial language tailored to the audience

- Serve as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders on AI strategy, investment priorities and transformation decisions

- Build long-term executive relationships and identify opportunities to expand EY-Parthenon's impact with clients

Lead and develop teams

- Lead multidisciplinary teams of consultants and specialists, typically combining strategy, commercial, data, technology, operating model, sector and transaction expertise

- Coach junior colleagues in structured problem-solving, analytics, story lining, client communication and professional judgement

- Provide apprenticeship-style coaching, helping team members develop consulting judgement, executive communication and commercial thinking

- Create an inclusive, collaborative and high-performance team environment, including during periods of significant delivery pressure

- Provide meaningful feedback and contribute to the formal and informal development of team members

Support business and proposition development

- Play a leading role in proposals, pitches and commercial discussions, owning sections of pursuits and contributing to conversion effortsHelp shape AI strategy, AI transformation and AI transaction propositions based on recurring client needs and market developments

- Identify potential follow-on opportunities arising from existing engagements and support their conversion

- Contribute to selected thought leadership, market perspectives and client events

- Build internal and external market relationships that support future business development opportunities

Build the practice

- Contribute to the development of EY-Parthenon's AI Strategy methodology, propositions, tools and intellectual property

- Support recruitment, capability building and knowledge sharing across the AI Strategy team

- Develop points of view on emerging AI trends, business implications and sector-specific opportunities

- Help strengthen EY-Parthenon's market position through thought leadership and external engagement

Skills and attributes for success

The successful candidate will demonstrate:

jobs.title: Director - Cost Transformation/Operational Restructuring - Operational Strategy - EY-Parthenon
jobs.description:
Director (Operational Strategy) – Cost Transformation & Operational Restructuring , Strategy and Execution: EY-Parthenon

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.​

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The Opportunity

At EY-Parthenon (EY-P), our unique combination of transformative strategy, transactions and corporate finance delivers real-world value – solutions that work in practice, not just on paper. Benefiting from EY’s full spectrum of services, we’ve reimagined strategic consulting to work in a world of increasing complexity. With deep functional and sector expertise, paired with innovative AI-powered technology and an investor mindset, we partner with CEOs, boards, private equity and governments every step of the way.

The Operational Strategy practice within EY-Parthenon provides clients with pragmatic, results-oriented solutions that transform cost structures and drive performance improvement, helping solve their most significant financial and operational challenges.

At the core of our value proposition are Cost Transformation and Operational Restructuring, encompassing rapid and sustained transformation of organisations requiring strategic or structural change to their cost base or business performance.

We develop strategies that enhance overall business value, leveraging deep sector and functional expertise, including:

- Cost Transformation – reimagining our clients’ cost structures across people and non-people costs, S&GA and COGS, opex and capex - including the use of ‘zero based’ approaches.

- Value Realisation – hands-on management of delivery and financial impact in value creation, cost reduction and/or turnaround programmes.

- Culture change – architecting the soft and hard measures required to instill a cost-conscious mindset in the organisation and to sustain the benefits of a cost transformation.

- Turnaround / Operational Restructuring - including accelerated cost out, crisis management.

- Fix-Sell-Close - developing and implementing strategic restructuring options for underperforming businesses (or divisions/functions of businesses).

Our teams work closely with executive leadership to identify significant improvement opportunities, develop actionable delivery plans, and lead/support implementation at pace.

Your key responsibilities

As a Director you will advise clients across a variety of sectors, supporting key decision makers (e.g. Board, C-suite, lenders, investors) to develop and implement strategic transformations and to identify and realise value. You’ll drive aspects of business origination, including pitches and presentations to potential clients to help sell work, own meaningful client relationships and lead project delivery, working with senior stakeholders for some of EY’s most demanding clients.

Given the client-facing nature of the role, strong interpersonal and communication skills are essential to effectively engage with clients and pragmatically address their needs, including the production of  concise, executive-ready reports and recommendations.

You will be expected to operate with a high degree of independence, owning programmes, workstreams end-to-end and translating operational insights into clear financial outcomes (EBITDA, cash or CAPEX improvements, risk mitigation).

We expect Directors to play a leading role in new business development efforts by leading pitches/pursuits and preparing compelling go-to-market collateral. You will also help shape the Cost Transformation and/or Operational Restructuring value propositions, contributing to thought leadership and practice growth.

We expect you to establish, maintain and strengthen internal and external relationships to help build the profile of the Operational Strategy practice. As an important member of a growing team, you will be expected to take a leading role to grow the practice and in coaching and counselling junior team members to help them develop.

Skills and attributes for success

- Project Delivery – Proven ability to lead project delivery teams, driving transformational change at pace, managing project teams, and overseeing engagement management (e.g. project commercials and risk management) with direct ownership of cost transformation and/or operational restructuring projects.

- Account / client management – Proven ability to manage key client accounts effectively, demonstrating consistent commercial success through the development and maintenance of strong client relationships.

- Financial Analysis – Excellent financial analysis and quantitative skills, including ability to review analysis of other team members, quickly identify key insights, and link operational drivers to P&L, cash and balance sheet impacts.

- Business and Commercially Driven – Demonstrable track record of working in a fast-paced environment, while leveraging strong business acumen to add value to clients.

- Value Creation – Proven ability to identify the strategic priorities / challenges facing our clients, rapidly quantify the associated potential and pragmatically develop measures to realise the value .

- Report Writing – Proven ability to produce clear, concise and client-ready reports that effectively communicate complex findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders.

- Business Development – Credibility to lead on business origination, including pitches and presentations. Lead on practice development initiatives, ensuring the continued focus on our team as a great place to work.

- Learning – Strong desire to develop technical and personal skills to support achievement of career goals, through a blend of structured learning, coaching and client experiences.

- Stakeholder management and communication – Ability to effectively engage and manage senior stakeholders by tailoring communication to influence, align, and drive outcomes. Ability to build personal relationship based on deep content, integrity and trust

- Role Model – Enthusiasm and ability to act as a role model to support the development and coaching of team members, coupled with recruitment and training responsibilities.

To qualify for the role you must have

Extensive experience in:

- Multiyear enterprise-wide / cross-functional transformation programmes with experience across 1) senior leadership alignment, 2) value identification and realisation and 3) driving organisational change

- Cost Transformation:  large scale cost reduction programmes, zero-based  budgeting / approaches and / or large-scale value creation / realisation initiatives, Operational Restructuring: experience in turnaround, strategic options assessments, crisis management, and/or exit / closure implementations (cross-sector)

We will consider relevant work experience in both consulting and industry but have a preference for experience with Tier 1 strategic consultancies

We are open to cross-industry experience but our preferred / focus sectors are:

- Consumer Goods and Retail

- Automotive, Industrials, Aerospace & Defence

- Energy (Oil & Gas) and Utilities

Additionally you must have:

- Strong analytical skills, with the ability to link operational analysis to financial statements, and the ability to understand the implications for client strategy

- Experience in building strong working relationships with senior clients, including influence, advice and support to key decision makers

- A passion for and an understanding how to drive organisational change: from drafting a ‘case for change’ and building leadership alignment to constructing change programmes and designing soft and hard measures to ensure change ‘sticks’

- Experience in leading on sales and business development processes for professional services projects in a large-scale consulting environment

- A track record of successful project delivery in corporate businesses where you are responsible for managing project team members and vendors

- Strong written and verbal communication skills and experience of producing and reviewing high calibre reports, papers, presentations and thought leadership

What we offer you

We will fuel your ambition and potential with future-focused skills development that equips you with state-of-the-art methodologies and technology-enabled solutions. With more than 15,000 people in 150 countries, you will join an inclusive and empowering culture that values your uniqueness, prioritizes your wellbeing, and immerses you in the diverse thinking and cross-cultural experiences necessary to help deliver impact to clients across the globe and to help build a better working world. Learn more about careers at EY-Parthenon.

- Experience in presenting directly to the C-Suite and explain complex concepts to anyone from an intern to a CFO, CHRO or CMO

- Experience working with IT leadership (e.g., CIO, IT Director) and business leadership (e.g., CFO, COO, BU leader, etc.) to help shape and guide the strategic and improvement agenda.

- Speaking at industry conferences, round tables, and other public forums

- Authoring articles and white papers

- Business / technology innovation experience with emerging tech solutions leveraging power of combinatorial technologies AI/ML, Data Automation, Blockchain, IoT, etc

- Exposure across key technology domains is preferred (application, data, DevOps, infrastructure, cloud, network. security etc)

- Demonstrated capability to drive sales and bring a network of client relationships to the firm

- Relevant industry certification (e.g., TOGAF Biz Architect, Business Process Framework (eTOM Practitioner of TMForum), AWS Cloud Certified etc.).

Overall Skills and attributes for success

- Understanding of the current IT environment and industry IT trends to identify the engagement and client service issues.

- Ability to act as day-to-day client contact on the project engagement; run client status and other client meetings and deliver executive-level presentations that drive actions and decisions.

- Proven delivery skills including the ability to scope/size a project; staff a team with the appropriate skill set; provide subject matter direction and guidance to a team; and manage the delivery of an engagement.

- Ability to identify opportunities and help generate sell-on work during client engagements by understanding a range services and offerings and coordinating with personnel in other service lines to help sell integrated solutions that meet client needs.

- Experience in creating points of view on relevant industry trends, solutions, methodologies, and analytical frameworks and tools to bring strategic perspectives to existing solutions.

- Experience in managing a portfolio of executive level clients and developing long-term trusted advisor relationships.

- Experience in building strong teams with a solid understanding of project management, industry content knowledge, and effective client communications.

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

jobs.title: EY-Parthenon Engagement Manager - Operational M&A
jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Engagement Manager: M&A Operational diligence and value creation

Strategy and Execution, EY-Parthenon

As you write your next chapter, what shape will it take?

Are you ready to take the next step in your M&A career and work on some of the most exciting deals in the market? We are looking for an Engagement Manager to join the Strategy and Execution team at EY-Parthenon in Copenhagen.

In this role, you will be part of a high-performing team that supports clients across the full deal lifecycle: from M&A strategy to execution. You will work closely with clients on complex, high-impact engagements, where your insights and capabilities will drive real results. At the same time, you will play an active role in shaping our team, contributing to a strong culture and supporting the development of future leaders.

Shape your future with confidence.

Skills and attributes for success

We are looking for a highly motivated and skilled Engagement Manager to join our Strategy and Execution team. The ideal candidate has 7-8+ years of experience in M&A strategy and execution across both pre- and post-deal engagements. You bring experience from client-facing or in-house roles across the M&A cycle and operational delivery, covering:

- Carve-out and operational due diligence

- Assessing standalone viability, cost structures and operational risks to inform deal decisions and separation planning

- Value creation and synergy assessment

- Identifying, quantifying and tracking revenue and cost synergies, and embedding them into value creation plans and integration and execution activities

- Deal strategy and deal management

- Leading deal strategy and execution by being the key contact for client stakeholders and driving governance, planning and milestone tracking across the transaction lifecycle

As an Engagement Manager in the team, you will lead complex M&A engagements, as well as developing our team, so that they can realize their potential.

Your main responsibilities:

- Lead and contribute to a variety of pre- and post-deal engagements, including due diligence, deal strategy, synergies and operational value creation and managing workstreams as part of integrations or carve-outs

- Assist in aspects of business origination, including pitches and presentations, and working in project teams comprising other colleagues

- Contribute to our practice development initiatives, supporting the continued focus on our team as a great place to work

- Act as a role model and support development of junior team members, coupled with the recruitment and training responsibilities

What we look for

You value collaboration and bring an inclusive approach, building strong relationships with both clients and colleagues. You are a strong communicator who can translate complex ideas into clear and actionable insights, and you take ownership of your work with a consistent focus on quality and impact.

What’s in it for you

- Accelerate your leadership journey by joining as a senior leader within the team, leveraging your transformative leadership skills externally and internally

- Broaden your horizons by working on highly integrated teams across the globe and collaborate with people of diverse backgrounds — both professionally and culturally

- Embrace flexibility with EY's hybrid work model, empowering you to find the right balance of in-office and client site collaboration with the convenience of remote work

What you can expect during the recruitment process

- Interview process will include two case interviews as well as an interview on personal fit to the team

- Your CV gives us the basics; a strong cover letter helps us understand your motivation and relevant experience beyond M&A consulting

Please submit your application no later than 1 December 2026. Selection and interviews are ongoing. If you have any questions or need more information about the role, please contact Malthe Pedersen at malthe.t.pedersen@parthenon.ey.com. For questions regarding the recruitment process, contact Jakob Damsted at Jakob.Damsted@dk.ey.com

EY | Building a better working world

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.
