jobs.title: Junior Consultant - Strategy & Execution
jobs.description:
The most important things in a few sentences

We develop strategies that move our clients' businesses forward. In our work, we combine rigorous analysis with ideas that have a real impact on how the companies you see around you operate. We will give you the chance to get to know a diverse range of industries and be a part of projects that change companies for the better.

Your role in the team

"Consider a scenario where a company sets its sights on a new foreign market. This endeavor demands a wealth of essential information — understanding the market's growth dynamics, comprehending its drivers, and dissecting the competitive landscape. Our team’s role involves assessing the viability of market entry and devising effective strategies. This encompasses addressing complex challenges collaboratively within our team. Additionally, you'll contribute to projects focused on shaping growth, formulating acquisition strategies, and aiding in seamless company integrations. Through these experiences, you'll gain insights via detailed analyses and have the guidance of experienced colleagues at your side."
- Tomas Skucek, Director, Strategy & Execution

What is important to us

We know you're just starting your career. But here are a few things that are important for this job:

Responsibilities:

- Conducting In-depth Market Analysis:  Take charge of conducting thorough and exhaustive market research, employing various analytical tools and methodologies to develop insights on different markets.

- Contributing to Strategic Projects : Actively participate in strategic initiatives aimed at market entry, growth, and expansion plans.

- Preparing Detailed Analyses: Develop detailed analytical reports and presentations encompassing findings from market analyses, feasibility studies, and strategic recommendations.

- Display Problem-Solving Thinking:  Apply a problem-solving mindset to dissect complex challenges encountered during market entry evaluations or strategic projects.

- Strategic Input and Execution:  Offer strategic input and assist in the execution of growth plans, mergers, or acquisitions.

- Continuous Learning and Team Collaboration:  Embrace a proactive approach to learning, keeping abreast of industry trends, market dynamics, and emerging technologies.

Qualifications:

- You have completed a  university degree  (or you will complete it in this academic year).

- You are  interested in strategy consulting  and, ideally, have previous experience in consulting.

- You speak and write  English  well, as we are a regional team and all communication is in English.

- You exhibit common sense and can stay level-headed during periods of complex and intense work. Often, you will need to rapidly familiarize yourself with unfamiliar topics.

- And most importantly, it must be a  good match . You will spend a lot of time with us, so you must get along with the team personally.

Preferred Qualities:

- Global Perspective:  An appreciation for diverse cultures and a global mindset that enables understanding and navigating international markets effectively. This includes sensitivity to cultural nuances and an openness to exploring opportunities beyond regional boundaries.

- Adaptability to Ambiguity:  Proven capacity to thrive in ambiguous situations or uncertain environments, showcasing resilience and adaptability while maintaining focus and clarity in complex and ever-evolving scenarios.

- Leadership Potential : Display signs of leadership potential, whether through prior leadership experiences, initiative-taking, or the ability to influence peers positively, indicating the potential to grow into leadership roles within the team.

- Client Relationship Skills:  A natural inclination or demonstrated ability to build strong interpersonal relationships, fostering trust and credibility through effective communication, understanding client needs, and delivering high-quality service.

What we offer

We offer an attractive starting salary with an annual bonus if your work goes well. Additionally, we provide benefits that will surely please you:

- Time off: 6 weeks of leave to recharge.

- Referral reward:  Earn from 10,000 to 70,000 CZK for referring a new colleague.

- Benefit points:  30,000 CZK on Benefity.cz to spend as you wish. For example, you can purchase a Multisport card, shop for gifts, or book a trip on Slevomat.

- Professional development : You will continuously learn and develop your skills with us. We offer a unique professional development program and a wide range of courses in our learning map. You can access the educational portal, and we offer language courses. Our colleagues will provide support in the form of counseling and internal coaching.

- Employee discounts : Enjoy discounted offers on a wide range of services. Discounts are available at Fruitisimo, Sushi Time, and the BodyBody fitness center, amongst others.

- Health and care:  Gain access to fast and convenient online consulting at uLékaře.cz from qualified doctors.

- Teamwork and fun:  With us, it's not just about work, but also about fun and team cooperation. We frequently organize team events such as dinner or bowling, alongside company parties and other great events that strengthen our team atmosphere. You can also participate in CSR activities.

What to expect after submitting your application

- The first step is the  entrance tests , which you will complete online. There will be three in total: English, numeracy and logical thinking, and cognitive thinking. You will have a week to complete these tests, and we appreciate timely submissions.

- The second round is an  online meeting with our recruiter  Karolina, where you will discuss all the necessary details of the position.

- Subsequent rounds are  online interviews with Strategy & Execution team members  where you will receive a brief introduction from one of our colleagues, followed by a case study. These rounds will also include questions relating to personal fit. They are a great opportunity to meet and interact with your potential future team members.

- The final part of the selection process is a short online call with the team partner.

You can join us anytime. We will arrange the start date according to your needs. We look forward to meeting you!

jobs.description:

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.  Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity

EY-Parthenon’s unique combination of transformative strategy, transactions and corporate finance delivers real-world value – solutions that work in practice, not just on paper. Benefiting from EY’s full spectrum of services, we’ve reimagined strategic consulting to work in a world of increasing complexity.

With deep functional and sector expertise, paired with innovative AI-powered technology and an investor mindset, we partner with CEOs, Boards, Private Equity and Governments every step of the way – enabling you to shape your future with confidence.

Within EY-Parthenon's Strategy and Execution sub service line, the Value Creation practice helps PE firms, their portfolio companies, and corporate companies realize better returns by unlocking value and accelerating time to money through targeted operational improvements. We rapidly define, quantify, and help realize significant incremental and sustainable value through revenue enhancement, cost and margin improvement and working capital reduction.

Our Media Value Creation team works with investors and executives across Studios, Content & IP, Sports, Live Entertainment, Streaming, Digital Media, Advertising, Rights & Licensing, Distribution, and Audience Monetization to identify, quantify, and realize value creation opportunities.

We help clients unlock value through commercial excellence, go-to-market transformation, revenue growth, pricing and monetization optimization, audience and customer expansion, operating model improvements, and transaction-related value creation initiatives. Our teams work across the transaction lifecycle and beyond, supporting management teams as they execute strategies designed to drive measurable EBITDA growth, accelerate revenue performance, and create long-term enterprise value.

Your key responsibilities

As a Senior Director with EY-Parthenon's Strategy and Execution Value Creation practice, you will be a vital member of the team leading and executing operational focused projects. You will lead projects that span the entire lifecycle of a transaction, including operational due diligence where we focus on EBITDA upside and operational risk; buy side carve out and integration planning to ensure a newly spun out business can operate by itself and potentially merge to quickly realize anticipated synergies; post-acquisition 100 day and value creation planning; ongoing performance improvement; and exit readiness planning to inform an optimal strategy for maximizing returns and ensuring the buyer is well positioned to continue to enhance value.

- Leading complex value creation engagements focused on commercial transformation, go-to-market effectiveness, pricing and monetization, audience growth, commercial operating model design, revenue operations, sales effectiveness, and marketing effectiveness.

- Contributing to account development and client relationship expansion efforts, helping identify opportunities to deepen EY-Parthenon's impact within existing client relationships.

- Helping shape Media Value Creation offerings, methodologies, thought leadership, and practice development initiatives.

- Developing Directors and junior team members while fostering high-performing, collaborative teams.

- Media Sector Expertise – deep understanding of business models, value drivers, growth opportunities, and competitive dynamics across Studios, Content & IP, Sports, Live Entertainment, Streaming, Digital Media, Advertising, Rights & Licensing, Distribution, and Audience Monetization.

- Strategic Value Creation Leadership – ability to identify, prioritize, and execute initiatives that drive revenue growth, profitability improvement, EBITDA expansion, and enterprise value creation.

- Building Relationships – establish trusted advisor relationships with client stakeholders through strategic insight, and problem solving.

- Business and Commercially Driven – leverage strong commercial acumen and strategic thinking to help clients solve their most critical growth, transformation, and value creation challenges.

- Engagement Leadership – lead complex, multi-workstream engagements while providing strategic direction, quality oversight, and executive-level guidance.

- Business Development – support account development activities, client discussions, pursuits, and practice development initiatives in partnership with leadership.

- People Development – coach, mentor, and develop Directors and broader engagement teams to support achievement of their career goals and accelerate team development.

To qualify for the role, you must have

- Experience working with one or more of the following Media sub-sectors: Studios, Content & IP, Sports, Live Entertainment, Streaming, Digital Media, Advertising, Rights & Licensing, Distribution, Audience Monetization, or related Media sectors.

- Experience in business integrations, divestitures, and/or carve-outs with a demonstrated aptitude for quantitative and qualitative analysis.

- Deep understanding of financial statements and operational performance metrics, with the ability to identify, quantify, prioritize, and communicate value creation opportunities.

- Experience leading complex, cross-functional teams and multi-workstream engagements in challenging business environments.

- Experience advising senior client stakeholders and executive leadership teams.

- The ability to prioritize effectively on projects and the skills to adapt quickly to new challenges and concepts.

- Excellent negotiation and influencing skills, and the ability to develop long-lasting relationships both internally and externally.

- You must either reside in or be in a commutable distance to your office location for this position.

- The ability and willingness to travel and work in excess of standard hours when necessary. In certain circumstances, travel may be required beyond your work location based on client and project needs.

- The expectation for this role is in person teaming, at client site or in an EY office, a minimum of 60% of the time or on average 3 days a week over the course of an engagement, project or performance year.

Ideally, you will have

- Experience serving as a trusted advisor to executive leadership teams, boards, or investors within Media sub-sectors.

- Experience leading complex value creation, growth strategy, commercial transformation, or performance improvement initiatives across Studios, Content & IP, Sports, Live Entertainment, Streaming, Digital Media, Advertising, Rights & Licensing, Distribution, and Audience Monetization.

- Experience developing and executing strategies focused on audience acquisition, customer retention, monetization, pricing, advertising, sponsorship, subscription growth, content commercialization, rights and licensing, or ticketing optimization.

- Experience leading go-to-market transformations, revenue operations redesign, sales effectiveness programs, marketing effectiveness initiatives, or commercial operating model improvements.

- Experience evaluating and capturing value creation opportunities through commercial due diligence, value creation planning, performance improvement, or transaction-related initiatives.

- Strong understanding of how Media companies create and monetize intellectual property, audiences, rights, content, experiences, and distribution channels.

- Experience translating Media industry trends, market dynamics, and emerging business models into actionable strategic, commercial, and operational recommendations.

- Experience contributing to account strategy, client relationship development, practice development initiatives, or Media sector thought leadership.

- MBA is preferred.

- Dynamic individuals who thrive in ambiguous situations to help clients solve their most critical strategic, business, and economic challenges.

- Knowledge of how to leverage firm-approved AI tools in a business setting, including Microsoft Copilot.

What we look for

We’re interested in talented professionals with the ability to visualize our clients’ goals and think creatively to facilitate them.

The ideal candidate combines deep Media sector expertise with the strategic perspective, commercial judgment, and leadership capabilities required to help investors and management teams shape and execute ambitious value creation agendas. They are energized by helping clients accelerate commercial performance, improve profitability, and create measurable enterprise value across Studios, Content & IP, Sports, Live Entertainment, Streaming, Digital Media, Advertising, Rights & Licensing, Distribution, and Audience Monetization businesses.

If you have an entrepreneurial spirit and a genuine passion for helping Media businesses navigate complex strategic, commercial, and operational challenges while developing high-performing teams, this role is for you.

Individual salaries within those ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography.  In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.

- Join us in our team-led and leader-enabled hybrid model. Our expectation is for most people in external, client serving roles to work together in person 40-60% of the time over the course of an engagement, project or year.

You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.

jobs.title: Digital Finance Transformation - Senior Consultant
jobs.description:
Shape the Future of Finance. Build Confidence. Drive Transformation.

At EY, we don’t just respond to change — we shape it.
Within Financial Accounting Advisory Services (FAAS), we help organisations reimagine their finance functions through data, technology, and innovation. As finance leaders face increasing complexity, our teams work at the intersection of accounting, analytics, automation, and emerging technology to deliver future ready solutions.
We are now seeking a Finance Transformation Senior Consultant to play a leading role in delivering high impact transformation initiatives for local and global clients.

Role Overview

EY Mauritius is looking for high-potential professionals to join its Finance Transformation team, supporting clients in reimagining and modernising their Finance function through the use of AI, automation, analytics, data platforms and emerging technologies .

The role is suited for individuals who understand the challenges faced by CFOs and Finance teams, and who are passionate about using technology to improve finance processes, enhance decision-making, reduce manual effort, and create more agile, insight-driven Finance functions.

The successful candidate will work on transformation projects covering areas such as finance process improvement, reporting and analytics, automation, digital finance tools, data management, AI-enabled use cases, performance management, and operating model redesign.

Key Duties

As a Senior Consultant, you will be expected to take a leading delivery role across finance transformation engagements. Your responsibilities will include:

- Support the design and delivery of Finance Transformation projects for clients across different industries.

- Analyse current-state finance processes, systems, reports, data flows and pain points.

- Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, automation, controls, reporting quality and decision-making.

- Translate CFO and Finance function challenges into practical digital, automation, analytics and AI-enabled use cases.

- Work with client teams to define business requirements, process improvements, data requirements and solution concepts.

- Develop dashboards, data models, automation workflows, analytical tools, prototypes and proof-of-concepts where required.

- Use tools such as Power BI, Excel, SQL, Python, Power Automate, UiPath, VBA and GenAI solutions to support project delivery.

- Contribute to project planning, workstream management, stakeholder discussions, documentation and client presentations.

- Support proposal development, diagnostic assessments, business case preparation and transformation roadmaps.

- Guide junior team members and contribute to building internal capability in AI, automation and data-driven finance transformation.

The ideal candidate should demonstrate strong technical and analytical capability, including:

- Strong experience with ETL tools, Python, Power BI, SQL and data management tools .

- Good understanding of Finance data structures, reporting requirements and data quality considerations.

- Fundamental understanding of Generative AI tools and their practical applications in business or finance contexts.

- Ability to demonstrate how GenAI is being used, or can be used, in current or previous work to improve productivity, analysis, documentation, reporting or decision-making.

- Exposure to Python / PySpark, AI/ML concepts, advanced analytics and data modelling .

- Experience with automation tools such as VBA, UiPath and Microsoft Power Automate will be a strong advantage.

- Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills, with the ability to convert analysis into clear, professional client-ready outputs.

- Ability to build or support prototypes, analytical models, dashboards or automation solutions to solve business problems.

Awareness of emerging technologies relevant to the Finance function, such as AI, machine learning, automation, blockchain, fintech and cloud-based finance platforms

Professional Experience

- Minimum 4 years of experience in finance transformation, consulting, advisory, analytics, automation, data, digital transformation or related roles.

- Experience working on business projects where technology, data or automation played a central role.

- Proven track record of delivering finance transformation, reporting, analytics, automation or technology-enabled improvement projects.

- Strong understanding of current CFO challenges, including cost pressure, faster reporting, better forecasting, process efficiency, finance talent constraints, data quality, governance and the need for real-time insights.

- Experience working with Finance functions such as Record-to-Report, Procure-to-Pay, Order-to-Cash, FP&A, budgeting, forecasting, management reporting, statutory reporting or performance management.

- Ability to work with both Finance and Technology stakeholders.

- Strong problem-solving, analytical thinking, communication and stakeholder management skills.

- Ability to manage workstreams, coordinate tasks, guide junior team members and deliver high-quality outputs within agreed timelines.

Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics, Engineering, STEM, Data Analytics, Information Systems or a related field.

- Professional qualification such as ACCA, ACA, CFA, CIMA or equivalent will be an advantage.

- Additional certifications in Power BI, data analytics, automation, AI, cloud platforms, project management or finance transformation will be considered positively.

About EY
EY is a global leader in Assurance, Consulting, Strategy & Transactions, and Tax. Our culture is built on trust, learning, and innovation—making EY more than a career, but a lifetime experience.

Why EY
At EY, you’ll be empowered to build confidence and create long term value.
✔ Work with global clients and diverse teams
✔ Access continuous learning and career development
✔ Be at the forefront of finance innovation
✔ Thrive in an inclusive, people first culture
✔ Shape your career — your way

Join Us
Shape the Future with Confidence.
Apply now to join EY Financial Accounting Advisory Services – Mauritius.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

jobs.title: Digital Finance Transformation - Consultant -EY Mauritius
jobs.description:
What if your next role wasn't about who you are today-but who you could become?
At EY, we don't just offer jobs-we help you build futures. Join a globally connected, diverse and inclusive organization where technology, innovation, and high performing teams come together to help you thrive.
We're looking for talented graduates and early career professionals to join our Finance Transformation team, part of our Financial Accounting Advisory Services (FAAS) practice within Assurance.

Role Overview

EY Mauritius is looking for high-potential professionals to join its Finance Transformation team, supporting clients in reimagining and modernising their Finance function through the use of AI, automation, analytics, data platforms and emerging technologies .

The role is suited for individuals who understand the challenges faced by CFOs and Finance teams, and who are passionate about using technology to improve finance processes, enhance decision-making, reduce manual effort, and create more agile, insight-driven Finance functions.

The successful candidate will work on transformation projects covering areas such as finance process improvement, reporting and analytics, automation, digital finance tools, data management, AI-enabled use cases, performance management, and operating model redesign.

Key Responsibilities

As a Consultant, you will support the delivery of Finance Transformation projects by combining finance understanding with strong analytical, technology and problem-solving skills. Your responsibilities will include:

- Assist in analysing current-state finance processes, systems, reports, data and pain points.

- Support the identification of improvement opportunities across finance operations, reporting, analytics, automation and controls.

- Help translate Finance function challenges into practical technology-enabled solutions.

- Support the development of dashboards, reports, analytical models, automation workflows and process documentation.

- Use tools such as Excel, Power BI, SQL, Python, Power Automate, VBA and GenAI tools to support project work.

- Assist in preparing client presentations, workshop materials, process maps, data analysis outputs, business requirements and transformation recommendations.

- Support Finance Transformation diagnostics, benchmarking, opportunity assessments and roadmap development.

- Work closely with senior team members and client stakeholders to gather information, analyse findings and develop practical recommendations.

- Contribute to internal knowledge development around AI, automation, analytics and digital finance use cases.

The ideal candidate should demonstrate strong interest and practical capability in data, analytics, automation and digital finance, including:

- Strong experience or hands-on exposure to ETL tools, Python, Power BI, SQL and data management tools .

- Fundamental understanding of Generative AI tools and their practical applications .

- Ability to demonstrate how GenAI has been used, or can be used, in current work, academic projects or previous roles.

- Exposure to Python / PySpark, AI/ML concepts and advanced analytics will be an advantage but is not mandatory.

- Experience with automation tools such as VBA, UiPath and Microsoft Power Automate will be an advantage but is not mandatory.

- Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills.

- Ability to analyse data, identify patterns, structure findings and communicate insights clearly.

Interest in emerging technologies relevant to Finance, including AI, automation, analytics, fintech, blockchain and cloud-based finance solutions.

Professional Experience

- Minimum 2 years of experience in finance transformation, consulting, advisory, analytics, automation, data, digital transformation, audit transformation, finance operations improvement or related roles.

- Experience supporting projects where technology, data, automation or analytics was an important component.

- Exposure to finance process improvement, reporting, dashboards, automation, analytics or digital transformation projects.

- Understanding of current CFO and Finance function challenges, including manual processes, fragmented data, slow reporting cycles, limited automation and the need for better insights.

- Exposure to Finance processes such as Record-to-Report, Procure-to-Pay, Order-to-Cash, FP&A, budgeting, forecasting or management reporting will be an advantage.

- Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation and communication skills.

- Ability to work effectively in teams and manage assigned tasks independently.

Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics, Engineering, STEM, Data Analytics, Information Systems or a related field.

- Professional qualification such as ACCA, ACA, CFA, CIMA or equivalent will be an advantage.

- Certifications or coursework in Power BI, SQL, Python, data analytics, automation, AI or finance transformation will be considered positively.

About EY
EY is a global leader in Assurance, Consulting, Strategy & Transactions, and Tax. Our culture is built on trust, learning, and innovation-making EY more than a career, but a lifetime experience.

Ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply now.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
Please review our https://www.ey.com/en_gl/privacy-statement before applying.

jobs.title: FP&A Senior Consultant - EY GDS 1
jobs.description:
Job purpose

The FP&A Senior Consultant plays a key role in delivering high‑quality financial planning, forecasting, and performance analysis across business units or client engagements.

The role focuses on hands‑on execution of FP&A processes, preparation of insightful analysis, and development of forward‑looking financial views to support decision‑making. The Senior Consultant applies structured analytical thinking, strong financial modelling skills, and emerging digital tools to deliver accurate, consistent, and insightful outputs.

This role supports the future‑ready FP&A model by embedding standardized processes, evolving analytical techniques, and contributing to automation and insight‑led ways of working.

Job Goals

- Deliver accurate planning and forecasting outputs

-

- Support budgets, forecasts, and long‑range plans with high‑quality analytical inputs.

- Ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency of financial data and assumptions.

- Enable performance insight and transparency

-

- Produce clear variance analysis and performance commentary across P&L, cash flow, and KPIs.

- Help explain key performance drivers, trends, and outcomes.

- Shift analysis from historical to forward‑looking

-

- Support scenario and sensitivity analysis.

- Contribute forward‑looking insights that inform business decisions.

- Support digital and efficient FP&A delivery

-

- Apply automation, standardized templates, and analytical tools to reduce manual effort.

- Improve the speed, reliability, and repeatability of FP&A deliverables.

- Build FP&A capability

-

- Strengthening analytical, commercial, and financial storytelling skills.

- Develop readiness for progression into FP&A Manager roles.

Key Responsibilities

- Support delivery of core FP&A activities, including:

-

- Annual Budgeting & Rolling Forecasts

- Strategic & Long‑Range Planning support

- Management Reporting & Performance Reviews

- Cost, Margin, and Profitability Analysis

- Cash Flow and Working Capital Analysis

- Scenario and What‑If Modeling

- Prepare detailed financial models, forecasts, and variance analysis.

- Support preparation of forecast assumptions and planning inputs.

- Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and alignment with FP&A standards.

- Develop structured performance commentary and management‑ready outputs.

Digital & Analytical & Transformation Enablement

- Use analytics and reporting tools (e.g., Excel, Power BI) to support dashboards and reports.

- Apply standardized templates, driver‑based models, and automation solutions.

- Support enhancements to planning and reporting workflows.

- Assist with testing, data validation, and adoption of new FP&A tools.

- Track and document improvements in efficiency, accuracy, and insight quality.

Business & Stakeholder Management

- Support finance and business stakeholders with performance analysis and insights.

- Prepare materials for performance reviews and planning discussions.

- Translate financial analysis into clear, concise, and decision‑relevant insights.

- Respond to ad‑hoc analytical requests in a structured and timely manner.

Collaboration & Development

- Work collaboratively with FP&A Managers and Senior Managers.

- Informally coach analysts through quality reviews and hands‑on support.

- Participate actively in knowledge sharing and best‑practice forums.

- Contribute ideas for continuous improvement and analytical innovation.

Performance and Value Creation Support

- Support tracking of KPIs related to forecast accuracy and planning effectiveness.

- Assist in evaluating cost initiatives, productivity drivers, and value‑creation opportunities.

- Help maintain alignment between financial targets, forecasts, and actual performance.

Functional & Technical Skills

- Strong experience in core FP&A activities, including:

-

- Budgeting, Forecasting, and Planning

- Financial Modeling and Variance Analysis

- Performance Reporting and KPI Analysis

- Cost and Profitability Analysis

- Cash Flow Analysis

- Solid understanding of business drivers and financial outcomes.

- Advanced Excel and financial modeling skills.

- Working knowledge of analytics and visualization tools (e.g., Power BI).

- Familiarity with planning and EPM platforms (e.g., Anaplan, SAP Analytics Cloud, Adaptive).

- Understanding data quality, internal controls, and planning processes.

Future-Ready & Behavioral Competencies

- Analytical Rigor: Applies structured thinking and attention to detail.

- Business Understanding: Understands how financial drivers impact business results.

- Insight & Storytelling: Communicates analysis clearly and effectively.

- Digital Curiosity: Embraces automation, analytics, and emerging tools.

- Collaboration: Works effectively within FP&A and broader finance teams.

- Ownership: Takes accountability for output quality and delivery timelines.

Performance Metrics / KPIs

- Accuracy and quality of forecasts and analysis

- Timeliness of FP&A deliverables

- Quality of variance explanations and insights

- Efficiency and standardization of outputs

- Stakeholder feedback on analysis quality

- Progression of technical and analytical capability

Qualifications & Experience

- Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field; CPA, CA, ACCA, or MBA (Finance) preferred.

- Experience: 4–7 years of relevant finance experience, including 2+ years in FP&A, management reporting, or analytical roles.

- Demonstrated experience in:

-

- Financial analysis, planning, and reporting.

- Supporting business stakeholders with insights.

- Using digital tools and analytics‑enabled finance solutions.

- Experience in complex or multi‑stakeholder environments preferred.

- Commercial judgement and curiosity to understand market context, Service Line priorities and the actions needed to improve performance.

- Clear and credible executive communication, with the confidence to engage senior stakeholders, challenge constructively and influence through evidence-based insight.

- Strong problem-solving, financial modelling and analytical capability, including the ability to evaluate options and develop practical recommendations.

- Proficiency in reporting, data visualization and analytical tools, with a practical approach to AI, automation, simplification and continuous improvement.

- A commitment to knowledge-sharing, coaching colleagues and contributing to an inclusive, high-performing Finance team.

·          At least 10 years of relevant experience in FP&A, business analysis, commercial finance, management reporting, strategy, analytics or finance business partnering within a complex organisation.

·          Strong knowledge of financial management, planning, forecasting, performance analysis and management reporting.

·          Proven ability to deliver financial and operational insight, modelling and stakeholder-ready recommendations that inform business decisions.

·          Experience working with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams, with evidence of influencing through commercial judgement and clear communication.

·          Strong capability in Excel, PowerPoint and relevant reporting, analytics and data visualisation tools, with the ability to learn and apply new technologies.

jobs.title: Transaction Monitoring Calibration (Financial Services) Manager, Risk Consulting
jobs.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

We are the only professional services organization with a business dedicated exclusively to the financial services marketplace. Join Financial Services (FSO) and work with multidisciplinary teams to deliver a global perspective. Aligned to key industry groups including banking and capital markets, asset management, insurance and private equity, we provide integrated consulting, assurance, tax and strategy and transactions services.

The Opportunity

As part of the Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) Financial Crime Compliance (FCC) practice, you will help financial institutions strengthen the effectiveness, efficiency and governance of their transaction monitoring frameworks. The role focuses on transaction monitoring model calibration and tuning, threshold optimisation, scenario effectiveness and data-led enhancement, while supporting broader FCC transformation and technology-enabled compliance programmes.

Your Key Responsibilities

• Lead end-to-end transaction monitoring calibration and tuning engagements, from scope and methodology design through analysis, recommendations, implementation support and governance approval.

• Assess the effectiveness and efficiency of transaction monitoring scenarios, rules, thresholds, segmentation and customer or account risk parameters.

• Apply quantitative and risk-based techniques to identify threshold changes, scenario coverage gaps, alert-volume drivers and opportunities to improve detection while managing false positives.

• Plan and oversee data extraction, data-quality assessment, profiling and analytical testing across customer, account, transaction, alert, case and reference data.

• Design and execute below-the-line and above-the-line testing, back-testing, sensitivity analysis, outcome analysis and other relevant effectiveness assessments.

• Develop defensible calibration documentation, including methodology, assumptions, limitations, results, rationale, control requirements and management recommendations.

• Translate regulatory expectations, typologies, risk assessments and business changes into practical monitoring requirements and implementation plans.

• Work with compliance, operations, data, technology, model risk, internal audit and business stakeholders to resolve issues and obtain decisions.

• Manage project scope, workplans, budgets, risks, dependencies, quality and client communications, and deliver assignments to a high level of client satisfaction.

• Lead, coach and review the work of project teams, and contribute to proposals, solution development and the continued growth of the FSRM FCC practice.

Skills and Attributes for Success

• Strong hands-on knowledge of transaction monitoring calibration, tuning, optimisation and effectiveness testing within a financial institution or consulting environment.

• Ability to interpret analytical results in the context of financial crime risk and convert findings into clear, implementable recommendations.

• Sound understanding of transaction monitoring data flows, alert generation, case management processes, model or rule governance and change controls.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess complex processes using a risk and control lens.

• Effective leadership, project management and stakeholder-management skills, including confidence engaging senior client stakeholders.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare clear methodology papers, reports and executive presentations.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint. Experience using SQL, Python, SAS or data visualisation tools for analysis is advantageous.

• Self-motivated, adaptable and able to prioritise competing demands in a fast-moving environment.

To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have

• A minimum of 6 years of relevant experience in financial crime compliance, transaction monitoring, FCC analytics, model or rule optimisation, or related regulatory technology work.

• Demonstrable experience delivering at least one end-to-end transaction monitoring calibration or tuning exercise, with clear ownership of methodology, analysis and stakeholder recommendations.

• Experience with transaction monitoring scenarios, thresholds, segmentation, alert and case data, data-quality assessment and effectiveness testing.

• Experience leading workstreams or teams and managing client or senior stakeholder expectations, timelines and deliverable quality.

• Good understanding of AML/CFT risks, typologies, controls and the broader FCC operating model within banking, insurance, asset management or other regulated financial services.

• Knowledge of regulatory expectations relevant to Singapore, including MAS requirements and guidance. Knowledge of other major ASEAN or global jurisdictions is advantageous.

• A bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline such as finance, accounting, business, economics, law, computer science, data analytics, mathematics or statistics.

Ideally, You’ll Also Have

• Experience with established transaction monitoring platforms or solutions, and an understanding of upstream data and downstream alert or case workflows.

• Experience in FCC data analytics, model validation, customer risk rating, sanctions or payments screening, or wider FCC technology transformation.

• Working knowledge of statistical approaches, scenario segmentation, data visualisation and automation used in calibration or monitoring effectiveness reviews.

• Professional qualifications such as CAMS, an ICA Diploma in AML, or relevant risk, data or technology certifications.

• Consulting experience, including proposal development, project commercial management and delivery across multiple stakeholders.

If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.

Apply now.

Your key responsibilities

Technical Excellence

- Seeking a motivated and analytically strong professional to join EY’s CCaSS team in a blended role focused on sustainable finance and ESG for financial institutions. This role combines strategic, regulatory, and financial insights to help banks, asset managers, DFIs, and insurers design and implement credible, taxonomy-aligned sustainable finance strategies, and identify investment opportunities in the green economy. The candidate will work across a range of projects involving ESG integration, regulatory readiness, deal/market landscape analysis, and sustainable capital mobilisation strategies. Key Responsibilities: a) Sustainable Finance Advisory

- Develop sustainable finance frameworks aligned with global and local taxonomies (EU Taxonomy, SEBI, ICMA/ LMA Principles)

- Support/lead the design of use-of-proceeds structures, sustainability-linked KPIs, and performance-based funding instruments

- Contribute to impact assessment and monitoring frameworks (in line with IRIS+) for funds and instruments

- Assist clients with sustainable finance strategy formulation, including target setting, governance, and transition plans

- Developed in-depth understanding of the GHG Protocol (Scope 1, 2 & 3 emissions) & applied it through the PCAF framework to calculate the climate impact of lending activities & support ESG risk assessment.

- Understanding data sets and its application for classification systems including EXIOBASE, GICS, NAICS, ISIC, & NACE (1.1 & 2)

- Experience in climate risk assessment including physical and transition risk and its impact on PD/ LGD

- Understanding of climate risk frameworks (TCFD) & NGFS climate scenarios

- Development of climate integrated ECL models and automation, process improvement initiatives using Kepler IFRS 9 b) Market Studies & Investment Landscape Mapping

- Conduct deep-dive sectoral assessments (e.g., clean energy, e-mobility, climate-smart agriculture, circular economy)

- Estimate market size (incl. TAM/SAM/SOM) and analyze investment potential in emerging green/ adaptation sectors

- Map capital flows, track deal activity (PE/VC/DFI), and identify emerging investable opportunities

- Provide actionable roadmaps and recommendations to help clients tap into investible opportunities through targeted financial, policy, or ecosystem-level interventions

- Support clients in developing investment theses and pitch notes tailored to different investor profiles c) ESG for Financial Services

- Support banks, asset managers, and insurers in developing and operationalizing ESG strategies

- Advise on ESG integration into investment/lending decisions, product design, and credit risk frameworks

- Assist in developing ESG governance structures and operating models for financial institutions

- Guide clients on regulatory disclosure requirements and frameworks (SEBI, RBI, ISSB, SFDR, etc.)

- Support financed emissions estimation, decarbonisation target setting (SBTi, NZBA), and net-zero alignment

- Support with ESG ratings questionnaires and help clients manage or improve ESG scores

- Climate risk assessments, climate modelling, integration in existing ECL / ICAAP models, calculation of financial impact of physical and transition climate risk across sectors, Climate Risk Mitigation & Adaptation, Climate scenario analysis/ TCFD/ ISSB

- Experience in calculation of Financed Emissions baselining, forecasting, target setting, SBTi, PCAF, GHG Protocol

- Experience in developing decarbonization & Net Zero strategy, alignment with SBTi Commitments, implementation of decarbonization strategy across sectors d) Business Development, Knowledge Management & Thought Leadership

- Support proposal writing, pitch material preparation, and client outreach for sustainable finance and ESG projects

- Contribute to EY’s knowledge base and maintain internal repositories of sector studies, KPIs, SF regulations, and ESG benchmarks

- Develop thought leadership articles, client alerts, and event content on emerging SF/ESG topics

- Assist in delivery of capacity-building sessions for client CXOs, boards, or internal EY teams

- Support the design, planning, and execution of internal and external sustainability-focused knowledge platforms and events (e.g., roundtables, ideation workshops, virtual forums)

- Collaborate on content development, speaker coordination, logistics, and audience engagement for thematic platforms (e.g., ESG investing, gender and sustainability, sector deep-dives)

- Help maintain and grow EY’s presence in ecosystem-wide conversations on sustainable finance and ESG through strategic outreach and positioning

- Keep abreast of ESG market development, authoring short reports and blogs on key market trends, and working to spot developments that might be relevant for our clients Core Skillsets Required

- Familiarity with IFRS S1/S2

- Python skillsets for development of models and understanding of requisite data sets and statistical models

- Familiarity with the relevant organisations and frameworks active in the sustainable finance space (Green Loan Principles, Sustainability-Linked Loan Principles, Climate Bonds Initiative, etc.)

- Strong foundation in finance concepts including understanding of various asset classes, IRR, ROI, payback period, capital structuring

- Engaged in green bonds issuance assurance/verification/evaluation/rating, has knowledge of green finance consulting; or

- Engaged in environmental & social impact assessment

- Familiarity with Indian and global ESG/sustainable finance regulations (SEBI BRSR, RBI, ICMA, SFDR, TCFD, ISSB)

- Strong research, Excel, and PowerPoint skills; ability to synthesize data into clear recommendations

- Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills

jobs.title: Senior Consultant Treasury
jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Confidence in your impact today. Freedom to build tomorrow.
At EY, you can be sure that you’re making a difference – for your client, for society, for your colleagues and for your own development. At the same time, you’ll have the freedom to work in a way that fits your life. Whether you choose to specialize, broaden your expertise or grow into leadership, you’re in the driver’s seat. Together with ambitious colleagues in an open and trusted culture, you aim for the best every day. Big on opportunity, friendly in collaboration. EY provides the resources you need to shape your career and make an impact in your field.

Your new job | About your main responsibilities
Are you ready to take your career to the next level? Join our dynamic Treasury team within EY’s Finance Advisory practice and become part of a team that focuses on the multidisciplinary aspects of the Treasury function for large (listed) corporates and financial institutions. Our team covers a wide range of disciplines, including cash management, services around financial instruments and valuations, treasury processes and control optimization, (hedge) accounting assessments, and treasury management system implementations.

At this moment, we are specifically recruiting for a Senior Consultant Treasury with 3+ years of relevant experience, ideally gained within consulting or a comparable advisory environment.

Your new team | About your colleagues and the office
Our competency team is committed to achieving the highest standards of treasury and financial risk management, hedging of interest rate, FX rate and commodity risk risks, cash management, financial instruments services, and accounting implications of the CFO’s treasury operations. Clients include large corporates, financial institutions and (governmental) authorities. We focus on various aspects of treasury and financial risk management and help our clients navigate through highly dynamic environments to manage their treasury function effectively and efficiently by addressing a wide range of challenges daily.

With the increasing variety of market dynamics impacting our clients, there are ample opportunities to specialize in areas such as cash management, financial instruments, treasury management system implementation, treasury process and control optimization, and financial reporting. We appreciate candidates with a passion for financial markets, financial risk management, treasury operating models and interest in the financial reporting implications of the treasury function. The agility to also specialize in other domains of treasury and financial risk management is appreciated, considering the anticipated volatility of client demand and the CFO’s agenda.

Other competencies within EY’s Finance Advisory practice are Finance Transformation, Regulatory Risk & ESG Compliance, Project Management, Technical Accounting, Finance Data & AI and Transactions.

Your office

Amsterdam
Our Amsterdam office is located at the Zuidas: a bustling area full of companies. In our Cross Towers, we welcome up to 1,500 people every day. For a breathtaking view of the city, head to the 22nd floor. Collaboration takes on a new meaning in our Wavespace, a high-tech environment that connects clients and colleagues virtually across the globe.

Responsibilities  –  How can you make a lasting impact in a rapidly changing world?

- Contribute to a better working world advising clients on the implementation of treasury and financial risk management strategies, including specific treasury-related domains of the CFO’s daily agenda.

- Doing project-based work in a team to advise clients on topics such as cash management, hedging of interest rate, FX rate and commodity price risks, optimizing treasury processes and controls, implementing treasury technology, managing financial instruments and valuations, and (hedge) accounting implications of treasury operations.

- Building comprehensive assessments, analysis and valuation models to support your advice provided to clients.

- Stay abreast of market dynamics and industry trends to provide informed advice to large corporate clients and financial institutions.

- Working across multiple projects with diverse EY teams and various client contacts.

- Combining various skills, both quantitative and qualitative, including executive presentation, financial modelling, storytelling, writing skills, project management and working with various cultures and backgrounds.

Your skills and strengths | About your unique contribution

- At least 3 years of prior working experience with a focus on financial services, financial risk management or finance & accounting.

- You are fluent in English and ideally Dutch, both verbal and in writing.

- You are quantitatively-strong, process-driven, and people-oriented.

- You have Excel skills and preferably also (light) programming skills.

- You have an international mind-set and are very open to work with different cultures.

- We are seeking a candidate with a proven track record of effective delivery and problem-solving abilities. We value diversity in our team, and we encourage a diverse range of personalities within our collaborative team environment.

Your benefits | About your perks and work enjoyment

- A competitive salary that reflects your role and responsibilities, depending on experience and qualifications. Plus, a solid pension plan for the future. In addition to your salary, you’ll receive holiday allowance and an annual bonus (based on performance and development).

- A laptop and phone for both work and personal use, and a monthly internet allowance.

- 29 vacation days to recharge and unwind, plus the option to buy extra days.

- With the mobility budget, you decide how you travel. Choose a lease car, a discounted public transport subscription, or arrange transport easily via our app.

- At EY, we care about a healthy work-life balance. Hybrid working makes this easier. Whether you're working from the office, at a client, or from home, we’ll make sure you have a well-equipped home office.

- The option to swap 3 national holidays for non-national ones.

- You’ll have the space to grow both personally and professionally. Whether you want to deepen your expertise, develop your personality, or improve your leadership style, we offer a broad range of trainings and courses.

- Your well-being is our priority. We believe that when you feel good, you perform better. That’s why you’ll have access to the OpenUp wellbeing platform (including for your family). You can easily connect with psychologists and lifestyle experts within 36 hours and take part in wellbeing sessions.

- A strong focus on teaming and various internal networks where you can join all kinds of social activities. A positive work atmosphere and good collaboration with colleagues contribute to your overall happiness at work.

All this within an environment where our core values of integrity, inclusiveness, and respect are central. We think it’s important that you can be yourself and fully develop into the best version of yourself. Curious about all our benefits? Click  here .

Ready to shape your future with us? | About your application process

- For this vacancy, we only ask for your CV. This way, it’s quick and easy to apply.

- Our first contact: After your application, our recruiter will call you within seven   days for a short introduction. We’ll explore whether the role could be a good match.

- First interview: Before the interview, we’ll ask you to complete an online assessment. Not a standard questionnaire, but a game-based assessment focusing on both your cognitive skills and behavioral preferences. We’ll discuss the results during the interview, which will include a colleague from the relevant department. This mutual introduction is a chance for us to get to know you, and for you to ask any questions you have.

- Second interview: If we see a match and you’re still enthusiastic, we’ll invite you for a second interview. We’ll dive deeper into the role and other relevant topics. Sometimes, a business case is part of the process. A final interview may also follow.

- We’re a match. You’ll receive an offer and we’ll perform a pre-employment screening. Then your new adventure begins. Welcome to EY!

Please feel free to apply even if you don’t meet all the requirements.

jobs.title: Digital Tax & Finance Manager
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly motivated Digital Tax & Finance Manager to join our Tax Intelligence Hub and support the design, implementation, and optimization of finance and tax processes enabled by SAP technologies. This role combines expertise in SAP Finance (FI/CO), finance transformation, tax technology, and process design to help organizations build scalable, compliant, and digitally enabled operating models.

As a trusted advisor, you will work closely with tax, finance, and technology teams to design future-state processes, implement SAP solutions, and ensure finance and tax requirements are embedded within end-to-end business processes. You will contribute to large-scale SAP transformation programs, finance modernization initiatives, and tax digitalization projects across multiple industries.

Key Responsibilities

- Process Design & Solution Architecture: Design and optimize end-to-end SAP Finance and Controlling processes aligned with business, finance, and tax requirements. Translate financial, operational, and regulatory requirements into scalable SAP solution designs. Define target operating models, process flows, and functional architecture for finance and tax transformation initiatives. Advise stakeholders on SAP Finance best practices, simplification opportunities, and process standardization. Support the development of digital finance and tax operating models that enhance efficiency, compliance, and reporting capabilities.

- SAP Finance & Controlling Implementation: Lead and support SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA Finance implementations, rollouts, and transformation programs. Configure and optimize SAP FI modules. Configure and support SAP CO modules; Ensure effective integration between Finance and other SAP modules. Support finance process redesign initiatives and finance systems optimization projects.

- Tax Technology & Compliance Enablement: Ensure finance processes and SAP configurations support tax compliance and statutory reporting requirements. Contribute to the design and implementation of tax-aware finance processes. Collaborate with tax specialists to ensure technology solutions align with local and international tax obligations. Support digital tax transformation initiatives leveraging finance data and SAP ecosystems.

- Intercompany & Operating Model Support: Support the design and implementation of intercompany finance processes. Assist in aligning finance processes across multiple legal entities, company codes, and geographic locations. Support financial reporting structures and operating model design requirements for multinational organizations.

- Testing, Validation & Deployment: Define and coordinate testing activities. Validate implemented solutions against business and functional requirements. Support cutover planning and go-live activities. Prepare and maintain functional specifications, process documentation, configuration documentation, and solution design deliverables. Ensure quality assurance and adherence to project governance standards.

- Consulting & Stakeholder Management: Act as a trusted advisor to clients and project stakeholders across finance, tax, and technology domains. Facilitate workshops, requirements gathering sessions, and design reviews. Collaborate with global and nearshore teams to deliver high-quality transformation solutions. Support business development activities, proposal development, and client presentations. Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

- Tax Intelligence Hub Contribution: Contribute to the development of innovative digital tax and finance solutions within the Tax Intelligence Hub. Support the creation of reusable methodologies, accelerators, and SAP Finance design assets. Drive knowledge sharing and capability building across the team. Mentor junior consultants and contribute to the growth of the Finance Transformation and Tax Technology practice.

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.

- 5+ years of experience in SAP Finance implementations or finance transformation projects.

- Strong hands-on experience with SAP FI and SAP CO configuration.

- Experience with SAP ECC and/or SAP S/4HANA Finance.

- Solid understanding of finance processes, accounting principles, and financial reporting.

- Understanding of tax-relevant finance processes and indirect tax requirements.

- Experience working in cross-functional project environments involving business, finance, tax, and IT teams.

- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.

- Professional proficiency in English.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in finance transformation, tax technology, or digital transformation programs.

- Exposure to SAP S/4HANA Finance migrations and redesign initiatives.

- Understanding of multinational finance operating models and intercompany processes.

- SAP certification in FI and/or CO.

- Experience working in consulting environments and international project teams.

- Familiarity with tax reporting, compliance technologies, or statutory reporting solutions.

- Exposure to global clients and cutting-edge SAP technologies.

- A collaborative environment within a growing Tax Intelligence Hub.

-
Project Management: Support the project to deliver on time, on budget and on quality. Manage the relationship with key client stakeholders

-
Business Development: Support business development activities, including preparing proposals to support the client

Skills and attributes for success

-
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

-
Dedicated, innovative, resourceful, analytical and able to work under pressure

-
Foster an efficient, innovative and team-oriented work environment

-
Ability to establish personal credibility quickly and demonstrate expertise

To qualify for the role, you must have

-
A bachelor’s degree and above in Finance, Accounting, Computer Science, MIS, or Mathematics

-
Approximately 2 years of recent relevant work experience in a leading business consulting organization or accounting organization; or

-
4 years of functional finance experience (Financial Planning, Budgeting, Forecasting & Analysis, Financial Accounting & Reporting, Management Insight Reporting, Enterprise/Business Performance Management) in any industry

Ideally, you will also have

-
Experience in delivering projects with elements of customer experience or digital tools

-
Experience in implementing Finance function (direct or indirect) initiatives in processes improvement/optimization, ERP or intelligent automation solutions

Highly motivated individuals with excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to prioritize shifting workloads in a rapidly changing industry. If you are ready to take on a wide range of responsibilities, and are committed to seeking out new ways to make a difference, this role is for you.

As a Manager in the Finance Consulting team , you will play a pivotal role in helping clients navigate complex, time‑critical finance challenges and own delivery end‑to‑end, from mobilisation through to final recommendations and outcomes. EY is helping businesses realize the value they can gain from their IT investments. We deliver exceptional client service — providing advice on how technology, finance process efficiency and enterprise intelligence contribute to performance improvement, as well as how IT can act as a multiplying effect during major program transformations.

The opportunity

The Al Finance Senior is a crucial role responsible for supporting the Finance Applications Data Lead in executing the overall data management strategy for finance applications. The successful candidate will leverage their deep expertise finance applications (planning, reporting, close/consolidation) coupled with deep skills in enterprise data management, data governance, data quality, master data management, Machine Learning, and Generative Al (Gen Al) to support key finance personas. One of the key responsibilities will focus on developing and implementing our EY Al Finance service offering, with the goal of creating an industry agnostic data model which can be utilized as a starting point and be extended ensure data consistency and interoperability across finance applications. The successful candidate will work closely with the Data Lead and the Product Owner for the EY Al Finance solution to ensure that the EY Al Finance Blueprint is designed on a foundation of accurate, consistent, and reliable finance application data architecture, enabling informed decision-making.

In this role, you will interact with business stakeholders to evaluate business models, processes, and operations.

You will gather, understand, and analyze business requirements, translating them into technical specifications. Your expertise in specific technology platforms will be crucial in providing in-depth analysis related to implementation, customization, and optimization.

Your key responsibilities

The Al Finance Senior will work closely with finance, IT, and data science teams to support the effective management and utilization of finance application data, harnessing the power of Machine Learning, Gen Al, and Azure data technologies to drive innovation and business value through the development and implementation of the EY Al Finance solution offering.

As a Senior Platform Business Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in bridging the gap between business needs and technical solutions. You will spend your time engaging with clients, analyzing their requirements, and collaborating with technical teams to design and deliver effective system architecture solutions. This role presents exciting challenges and opportunities for growth, as you will help clients maximize their investment in technology platforms through effective use and continuous improvement. Regular travel may be required to meet with clients and participate in project activities.

- Engage with business stakeholders to gather and analyze business requirements.

- Collaborate with technical teams to design and deliver system architecture solutions.

- Tailor technology platforms to align with business processes and objectives.

Skills and attributes for success

- Monitoring progress, managing risk and confirming that key stakeholders are kept informed about progress and expected outcomes.

- Managing expectations of client service delivery.

- Effectively managing and motivating client engagement teams with diverse skills and backgrounds. Providing constructive on- the- job feedback/coaching to team members.

- Fostering an innovative and inclusive team-oriented work environment. Playing an active role in the counselling and mentoring of junior consultants within the organization.

- Supporting Data Management Strategy Execution, including helping execute the overall data management strategy for finance applications

- Collaborating with cross-service line teams, including Finance, Managed Services, and Tech Consulting to ensure alignment and integration of finance application data with related data initiatives

- Defining data requirements, data architecture, and data models for finance applications, considering the potential of Machine Learning and Gen Al technologies

- Leading the design and implementation of an extensible common information model for the FDL Blueprint Developing and maintaining documentation, including data dictionaries, entity-relationship diagrams, and data lineage maps

- Leading the development and implementation of our FDL Blueprint solution offering, ensuring scalability, performance, and security

- Collaborating with data scientists and finance SMR's across service lines to identify opportunities for applying Machine Learning and Gen Al techniques to finance applications/personas and extend the FDL Supporting the establishment and maintenance of a robust data governance framework for the FDL

- Staying current with the latest advancements in Machine Learning, Gen Al, Data Management and Azure technologies and identifying and implementing innovative solutions that drive efficiency, accuracy, and insights for finance applications

To qualify for the role you must have

- A bachelor's degree and approximately three years of related work experience; or a graduate degree in the same and approximately two years of related work experience.

- Minimum of 2 years of experience in data management, with at least 1 year focused on finance application data, data modeling, financial modeling

- Strong understanding of data management principles, including data governance, data quality, and master data management

- Experience with Machine Learning techniques, Gen Al technologies, and Azure data services (e.g., Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse Analytics, MS SQL, Python)

- Knowledge of finance applications including financial modeling (PnL, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow)

- Proficiency in data integration, data transformation, and data modeling tools and techniques

- Excellent communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills

- Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, supporting the adoption and implementation of emerging technologies

Ideally, you'll also have

• Degree in Finance, Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field with relevant experience in the finance data management including data modeling and ML.

We're interested in passionate leaders with strong vision and a desire to stay on top of trends in the analytics industry. If you have a genuine passion for helping businesses achieve the full potential of their data, this role is for you.
