jobs.title: Manager Finance Transformation (financïele sector)
jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Zeker van je impact vandaag. Vrij om te bouwen aan morgen.
Bij EY weet je zeker dat je het verschil maakt: voor je klant, de samenleving, je collega én je eigen ontwikkeling. Tegelijk krijg je de vrijheid om te werken op een manier die bij jouw leven past. Of je nu kiest voor verdieping, verbreding of leiderschap: jij hebt de regie. Samen met ambitieuze collega’s in een open en vertrouwde cultuur ga je elke dag voor het hoogst haalbare. Groot in mogelijkheden, vriendelijk in samenwerking. EY zorgt voor de middelen die je nodig hebt je carrière verder vorm te geven en impact te maken binnen jouw vakgebied.

Jouw nieuwe baan | Over je belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden
Als Manager Finance Transformatie – Financiële Sector richt je je primair op banken, verzekeraars, pensioenorganisaties, vermogensbeheerders, fintechs en andere financiële instellingen.

Je maakt deel uit van de Finance Transformatie-competentie binnen CFO Consulting. Financiële dienstverlening is jouw sectorfocus. Je draagt met jouw ervaring bij aan Finance Transformatie, en verbindt sectorspecifieke vraagstukken met de expertise van collega’s uit andere finance thema’s die relevant zijn voor klanten.

Onze Finance Transformatie-competentie ondersteunt klanten over het volledige spectrum van financiële transformatie: van het definiëren van toekomstige operating modellen en governance-structuren tot het implementeren van procesverbeteringen, digitale mogelijkheden en ondersteunende technologieën.

Wij werken met CFO’s en senior finance stakeholders aan vraagstukken zoals:

- Finance strategie vertalen naar toekomstbestendige operating modellen, organisatiestructuren, governance en helder end-to-end proceseigenaarschap.

- Finance Technology inzetten als motor voor transformatie, waaronder ERP- en EPM-platformen, workflow- en automatiseringsoplossingen en digitale finance capabilities.

- Complexe finance-transformatieprogramma’s vormgeven en realiseren, van de ambitie en businesscase tot implementatie en verankering in de organisatie.

- Planning, forecasting, performance management, afsluitingsprocessen, consolidatie, rapportage en besluitvorming versterken door procesverbetering, standaardisatie en passende Finance Technology.

Belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden

- Als inhoudelijk sparringpartner optreden voor CFO’s en senior finance stakeholders binnen de financiële sector en hen adviseren over finance-strategie, operating modellen en transformatieprioriteiten.

- De verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor de scope, aanpak, planning, kwaliteit en resultaten van complexe finance-transformatietrajecten en daarbij multidisciplinaire teams en werkstromen aansturen.

- Analyses van finance processen, data, organisatiestructuren en technologie richting geven en de uitkomsten vertalen naar gedragen ontwerpen, implementatieroadmaps en concrete verbeteringen, met inzet van standaardisatie, automatisering en technologiegedreven transformatie.

- Klanten begeleiden bij het ontwerpen en implementeren van toekomstige finance operating modellen, governance-raamwerken en de transformatie van kernprocessen zoals FP&A, Record-to-Report, afsluitingsproces, consolidatie, Order-to-Cash en Procure-to-Pay, in nauwe samenwerking met technologiecollega’s en EY alliance partners.

- Duurzame relaties opbouwen en onderhouden met senior klantstakeholders, voorstellen en business development-trajecten leiden en nieuwe commerciële kansen identificeren en ontwikkelen.

- Minder ervaren consultants coachen, inhoudelijk begeleiden en actief bijdragen aan hun ontwikkeling, de teamcultuur en de verdere opbouw van competentie.

Jouw nieuwe team | Over je collega’s en het kantoor
Jouw team

Finance Transformatie is een van de kerncompetenties binnen CFO Consulting. Je wordt onderdeel van één geïntegreerd Finance Transformatie-team en werkt samen met collega’s met verschillende sector- en transformatie-expertises. Vanuit jouw financiële sector-focus bouw je mee aan relevante marktproposities en klantrelaties, terwijl je tegelijkertijd actief bijdraagt aan de bredere ontwikkeling, staffing en delivery van de competentie.

Je werkt intensief samen met andere EY-competenties, waaronder Data & AI, Treasury, Technical Accounting, Project Management, Risicomanagement & Regelgeving en Transacties. Zo combineer je diepgaande sectorkennis met de schaal en expertise van een multidisciplinair team.

Jouw kantoor

Amsterdam
Ons kantoor in Amsterdam bevindt zich op de Zuidas: een bruisende plek waar veel bedrijven zijn gevestigd. In onze Cross Towers worden dagelijks veel collega’s en bezoekers verwelkomd. Voor een bijzonder uitzicht op Amsterdam ga je naar de 22e verdieping. In de Wavespace werken klanten en collega’s in een hightechomgeving zowel fysiek als virtueel samen.

Jouw vaardigheden en skills | Over je unieke bijdrage

- Minimaal 5 tot 8 jaar relevante werkervaring in finance transformatie, finance consulting of als financial manager/controller met een sterke change mindset.

- Aantoonbare ervaring binnen de financiële sector en een goed begrip van de agenda van CFO’s en financiële functies in deze sector.

- Sterk inzicht in financiële processen, finance operating modellen, governance, performance management, afsluitingsprocessen, consolidatie en rapportagetransformatie.

- Aantoonbare ervaring met finance-transformatieprogramma’s, inclusief technologiegedreven verandering met ERP-, EPM-, workflow- en automatiseringsoplossingen zoals SAP S/4HANA, Oracle Cloud, Microsoft Dynamics of vergelijkbare platformen.

- Het vermogen om sectorspecifieke vraagstukken te verbinden met bredere Finance Transformatie-capabilities, multidisciplinaire oplossingen en commerciële kansen, en daarbij duurzame relaties op te bouwen met senior stakeholders.

- Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal, gecombineerd met een gestructureerde, analytische, resultaatgerichte en ondernemende instelling en sterke leiderschaps- en samenwerkingsvaardigheden. Beheers je de Nederlandse taal nog niet, ben je wel bereid deze onder de knie te krijgen.

Jouw arbeidsvoorwaarden | Over je voordelen en werkplezier

- Een passend salaris voor je rol en verantwoordelijkheid, afhankelijk van ervaring en kwalificaties. Plus, een goed pensioen. Fijn voor later. Boven op je salaris ontvang je ook vakantiegeld en een jaarlijkse bonus (afhankelijk van resultaten en ontwikkeling).

- Een laptop en telefoon die je ook privé mag gebruiken en een maandelijkse internetvergoeding.

- 34 vakantiedagen, om op te laden en bij te tanken.

- Met het woon-werkbudget bepaal jij zelf hoe je reist, kies bijvoorbeeld voor een voordelig OV-abonnement of regel je vervoer eenvoudig via onze app.

- Bij EY vinden we een gezonde werk-privé balans belangrijk. Hybride werken maakt dat een stuk makkelijker. Of je nu werkt op kantoor, bij de klanten of thuis; Wij zorgen ervoor dat je een goed ingerichte thuiswerkplek krijgt.

- De mogelijkheid om 3 nationale feestdagen om te ruilen voor niet-nationale feestdagen.

- Zowel persoonlijk als professioneel krijg je alle ruimte om te groeien. Of je je nu wilt ontwikkelen in je vak, als persoon of in je leiderschapsstijl, we hebben een uitgebreid aanbod aan trainingen en opleidingen.

- Jouw gezondheid staat voorop. Wij geloven dat als je goed in je vel zit, je ook beter presteert. Zo krijg je onder andere toegang tot het wellbeing platform OpenUp (en ook jouw gezin). Je kunt hier laagdrempelig en binnen 36 uur in gesprek gaan met psychologen en lifestyle experts én kun je deelnemen aan sessies op het gebied van wellbeing.

- Veel aandacht voor teaming en verschillende interne netwerken waarmee je aan allerlei sociale activiteiten kunt deelnemen. Een fijne werksfeer en goede samenwerking met collega’s dragen immers ook bij aan jouw werkgeluk.

En dat alles binnen een omgeving waar onze kernwaarden integriteit, inclusiviteit en respect centraal staan. We vinden het belangrijk dat je jezelf kunt zijn én je volop kunt ontwikkelen tot de beste versie van jezelf. Benieuwd naar al onze voorwaarden? Klik hier

Jouw toekomst samen met ons vormgeven? | Over je sollicitatieproces

- Voor deze vacature vragen we je om naast je cv ook een motivatiebrief te uploaden. Hiermee krijg je de kans om jouw drijfveren, motivatie en persoonlijkheid aan ons te laten zien. Bij EY staan wij achter het gebruik van AI-tools zoals ChatGPT, zolang jouw eigen toon en unieke persoonlijkheid zichtbaar blijven.

- Ons eerste contact: na jouw sollicitatie belt onze recruiter jou voor een korte kennismaking. We verkennen alvast kort over en weer of de functie bij jou zou passen.

- Het eerste gesprek: we vragen je om van tevoren een online assessment te maken. Geen standaard vragenlijst, maar game-based waarin zowel naar jouw cognitieve vaardigheden als je gedragsvoorkeuren wordt gekeken. In het gesprek bespreken we de uitkomsten met elkaar en is er ook een collega van de betreffende afdeling aanwezig. Tijdens deze wederzijdse kennismaking leren we jou graag kennen en heb jij gelegenheid om ook jouw vragen te stellen.

- Het tweede gesprek: Als wij na het eerste gesprek een match zien en jij ook nog enthousiast bent, volgt er een tweede kennismaking. In dit gesprek gaan we dieper in op de functie en andere relevante thema’s en soms maakt ook een businesscaseonderdeel uit van de procedure. Het kan zijn dat er nog een laatste gesprek plaatsvindt.

- We zijn een match. Je ontvangt van ons een aanbod en we doen een pre-employment screening. Daarna start jouw nieuwe uitdaging. Welkom bij EY!

Uit onderzoek blijkt dat vrouwen minder snel solliciteren wanneer ze niet aan álle criteria voldoen. Solliciteer gerust, ook als je niet aan alles voldoet.

The opportunity : Manager-TMT-Business Consulting PI-CNS - BC - FINANCE - New Delhi

TMT :

Industry convergence offers TMT (Technology, Media & Entertainment, and Telecommunications) organizations the chance to evolve and transform, but it also presents challenges around competitiveness and delivering agile corporate strategies for growth. Content distributors are transforming into content producers, service providers are becoming tech companies, technology companies are the catalyst for dramatic change in every sector, and customers want the latest innovations now.

We help TMT companies create compelling employee and customer experiences, retaining skills and talent while achieving enterprise-wide operational excellence. We help them protect their data, brand and reputation. We also enable the pursuit of M&A strategies that systematically create value, reduce risk and transform TMT companies into powerhouses that will lead the technology revolution of the future – building a better working world for all.

CNS - BC - FINANCE :

EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. jobs.title: EY-Parthenon- Investment Banking - MedTech - Managing Director
jobs.description:
Location: New York, Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dallas, Houston, Los Angeles. McLean, San Francisco, Cincinnati, Cleveland, Minneapolis, Nashville, Charlotte

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.  Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity

Ernst & Young Capital Advisors, LLC (EYCA) offers comprehensive investment banking services with access to a global network of EY mergers & acquisitions, debt capital markets and equity capital markets professionals. The global EY network offers a complete suite of investment banking services, and EY firms consistently rank among the leading financial services firms based on the number of completed transactions globally.

As a Managing Director in the Healthcare Investment Banking group, you’ll provide clients with objective advice on all aspects of M&A and capital markets alternatives through highly focused industry teams with world class, global execution capabilities. You’ll be an important part of our highly experienced, industry-focused team and work at the forefront of high-profile transactions.

You’ll be working in a team environment with corporate finance and established investment banking professionals on a variety of projects with primarily responsibility for leading the MedTech sector coverage as part of a group with broad healthcare and life sciences coverage capabilities. Our team works to initiate and execute transactions on behalf of our clients that reflect their strategy and are supported by industry trends.  You’ll be responsible for delivering investment banking solutions, M&A, debt and equity transaction execution to the broad universe of companies in the MedTech and related sectors.

Your key responsibilities

As a Managing Director, you will be a vital member of the team responsible for initiating and leading the execution of investment banking engagements in the MedTech sector. You will be responsible for covering the MedTech sectors and related subsectors, with duties encompassing the origination and execution of both buy-side and sell-side M&A transactions as well as capital markets transactions. Your coverage will include private and public middle-market enterprises, along with relevant private equity sponsors.   You’ll be able to leverage EY’s extensive global reach and network of relationships and comprehensive capabilities to communicate the firm’s unique investment banking capabilities to the client’s senior executives. You will also be responsible for leading and developing a team of mid-level and junior members ensuring their career development.

Skills and attributes for success

- Advise companies regarding M&A, strategic, and corporate finance transactions.

- Supervise, coach and mentor Senior Vice Presidents, Vice Presidents, associates and analysts to prepare compelling pitch materials, offering memoranda and related materials for M&A and capital raising mandates.

- Develop relationships with investors and strategic participants in the sector for M&A and capital raising mandates.

- Perform extensive financial analysis, valuation analysis, and pro forma financial modeling.

- Identify key issues and potential areas of valuation and transaction risk within engagements.

- Perform in-depth sector market and company-specific coverage.

- Contribute to recruiting and team development initiatives.

To qualify for the role, you must have

- A bachelor's degree and at least 8 years of directly related work experience; or a graduate degree and at least 7 years of related work experience.

- Extensive investment banking experience, particularly originating and executing M&A transactions.

- Existing Series 7 and/or 79 plus Series 63 securities licenses (in good standing).

- Ability to work directly with clients as the most senior banking team representative able to manage all client deliverables.

- Strong experience with both originating transactions and leading a team in execution.

- Excellent interpersonal and relationship-building skills with the ability to develop and maintain relationships at all levels of the organization.

- A proven record of excellence in investment banking specific to mergers, acquisitions and capital markets for MedTech and related sectors.

- Experience gained within another credible investment banking organization.

- Established networking skills in a relevant industry.

- The ability and willingness to travel and work in excess of standard hours when necessary.

- You must either reside in or be in a commutable distance to your office location for this position.

Ideally, you’ll also have

- Knowledge of how to leverage AI tools in a business setting, including Microsoft Copilot

What we look for

We’re interested in talented professionals with the ability to visualize our clients’ goals and think creatively to facilitate them - often in politically charged environments. If you have an entrepreneurial spirit, and a genuine passion for taking on new challenges, this role is for you.

What we offer you
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn  more .

- We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business.  The base salary range for this job in all geographic locations in the US is $265,000 to $325,000. Individual salaries within those ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography.  In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.

- Join us in our team-led and leader-enabled hybrid model. Our expectation is for most people in external, client serving roles to work together in person 40-60% of the time over the course of an engagement, project or year.

- Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
EY accepts applications for this position on an on-going basis.

For those living in California, please click here for additional information.

EY focuses on high-ethical standards and integrity among its employees and expects all candidates to demonstrate these qualities.

EY  |  Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

EY provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, pregnancy, genetic information, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other legally protected basis, including arrest and conviction records, in accordance with applicable law.

EY is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities including veterans with disabilities. If you have a disability and either need assistance applying online or need to request an accommodation during any part of the application process,  please call 1-800-EY-HELP3, select Option 2 for candidate related inquiries, then select Option 1 for candidate queries and finally select Option 2 for candidates with an inquiry which will route you to EY’s Talent Shared Services Team (TSS) or email the TSS at ssc.customersupport@ey.com .

jobs.description:
About EY:
At EY, we build a better working world by helping clients solve their toughest challenges and capitalize on their greatest opportunities. Join us to be part of a global team dedicated to delivering exceptional consulting services in the financial services sector.

Role Overview:
We are seeking a highly skilled Consulting FSO GRC Manager with deep expertise in Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) within the financial industry. The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in banking, capital markets, and securities trading. This role demands profound expertise in Otoritas Jasa Keuangan (OJK) regulations and local compliance mandates, seamlessly integrated with exposure to global banking environments and cross-border regulatory frameworks.

Key Responsibilities:

- ​Lead the design and optimization of comprehensive risk strategies across credit, market, operational, and liquidity risks. Translate complex regulatory requirements into actionable business transformations and operational resilience for financial institutions.

- ​Supervise, coach, and motivate high-performing, cross-functional teams. Foster a culture of excellence by guiding staff on complex risk methodologies and ensuring the rigorous adoption of firm standards.

- ​Lead the development of Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) frameworks, risk appetite statements, and Key Risk Indicators (KRIs). Assess the effectiveness of internal control systems aligned with global frameworks like COSO and SEOJK guidelines, integrating process and IT General Controls (ITGC).

- ​Implement comprehensive anti-fraud strategies in alignment with POJK mandates, including conducting rigorous Fraud Risk Assessments (FRA) and designing robust transaction monitoring and whistleblowing mechanisms.

- ​Conduct bank soundness assessments by evaluating capital adequacy, asset quality, and liquidity ratios in strict adherence to OJK guidelines to maintain institutional stability and mitigate regulatory risk.

Required Experience and Skills:

- Extensive experience in financial services, especially in retail, corporate, and investment banking.

- Strong knowledge of capital markets and securities trading.

- Familiarity with global banking regulations such as Basel III, IFRS, FATCA, and AML frameworks.

- Ability to understand complex financial products and their associated risks (e.g., derivatives, structured products).

- Proven expertise across multiple GRC pillars: governance, risk management, compliance, internal control, and fraud risk management

Qualifications:

- Minimum Bachelor’s degree from reputable overseas or local universities, majoring in Accounting, Finance, or related fields.

- At least 6 years of relevant working experience, preferably in:

- Management Consulting,

- Big-4 firms, or

- Banking or Securities

- Proven exposure to projects or work within the financial services industry.

- Fluency in English, both written and verbal, is mandatory.

- Relevant professional certifications (e.g., FRM, CIA) are a plus.

- Excellent analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

- Ability to work effectively in a dynamic, global consulting environment.

- Strong communication skills, confident in both interpersonal interactions and public speaking.

- Demonstrated leadership capabilities and ability to collaborate effectively across countries and diverse teams.

- Excellent project management skills, with experience managing multiple projects and diverse team members simultaneously.

jobs.title: Senior Manager - Business Transformation | Banking
jobs.description:
At EY, we’re committed to helping you shape your future with confidence.
We’ll support your success in a globally connected, diverse team environment and help you take your career wherever you want it to go.
Join EY and contribute to building a better working world.

Confident in your impact today. Freedom to build tomorrow.
At EY, you can be sure that what you do makes a real difference to your clients, society, your colleagues, and your own development. At the same time, you’ll have the flexibility to work in a way that suits your life. Whether you want to specialize, broaden your skills, or grow into a leadership role, you're in the driver’s seat. You’ll work alongside ambitious colleagues in an open, supportive culture where collaboration is key. We offer the tools and opportunities to grow your career and make an impact in your field.

Your new job | About your main responsibilities

Become a  Senior Manager Business Transformation at EY, shaping the future of financial services, with a focus on the Banking industry. The Business Transformation team is part of our Business Consulting service line. EY is looking for a passionate leader with substantial (strategy & delivery) experience in business transformation, project management and building relationships. Your background in the banking industry will be needed to identify and address industry challenges through innovative solutions.

Key Responsibilities:

-
Take a leading role in shaping and delivering business proposals and scoping documents

-
Drive transformative change and growth with your strategic vision

-
Engagement Delivery: Oversee the end-to-end delivery of complex, Business transformation projects, managing multi-disciplinary alongside delivery budgets and timelines.

-
Business Development & Market Expansion: Spearhead commercial growth within the Dutch and European markets by identifying organizational data bottlenecks, crafting compelling business-led proposals, and building long-term alliances with partners in the Retail, commercial and Corporate banking industry. Proactively builds and maintains a senior network in the Dutch banking sector; attends, organizes, and speaks at industry forums, roundtables, and events.

-
Teaming & Talent Cultivation: Direct, coach, and inspire managers and consultants within the Business Transformation team and collaborate across teams to integrate diverse insights.

Work on high-impact, cutting-edge projects with a strong focus on the banking sector. You’ll help leading banks, drive large-scale AI transformations, scaling AI capabilities and equipping leadership teams to embed AI across the organisation. Shape the future of banking by contributing in building banks and advise clients on go-to-market strategies, supporting entry into new markets through sharp opportunity assessments and clear, actionable strategies.

You’ll also work on next-generation Business-led (Agentic) transformation, combining AI and data to unlock new value and accelerate transformation at scale across banking.

Your new team | About your colleagues and the office
The Business Transformation team consists of almost 40 professionals. The team has a gender ratio of 55/45. Colleagues come from 9 different countries: Turkey, South Africa, France, Latvia, China, Hungary, Norway, UK, and the Netherlands. The average age within the team is around 30 years. The team has an open and collaborative culture and is socially active. There are regular social events, including drinks and team sports, as well as an annual ski trip

Your office

Amsterdam
Our Amsterdam office is located at the Zuidas: a bustling area full of companies. In our Cross Towers, we welcome up to 1,500 people every day. For a breathtaking view of the city, head to the 22nd floor. Collaboration takes on a new meaning in our Wavespace, a high-tech environment that connects clients and colleagues virtually across the globe.

Your skills and strengths | About your unique contribution

-
Experience & Background:

-
A minimum of 8 years of relevant experience

-
A completed Masters degree (WO level) in, for example, Strategic Management, Business Administration, Finance, Strategic Entrepreneurship, or a related field.

-
Proven track record designing and delivering large-scale, business-led transformations; not purely IT or process-driven, but anchored in business strategy and value

-
Deep banking industry expertise (preferably retail, corporate; optionally investment banking or payments; ideally more than one)

-
Hands-on experience with technology, data, and AI as transformation enablers, not as ends in themselves

-
Demonstrated ability to operate in high-pressure, high-stakes client environments with senior (C-suite/ExCo) stakeholder exposure

-
AI-native and an explorative mindset to investigate new topics such as AgenticAI

-
Familiar with the EY service line ecosystem (or equivalent at a peer firm) and able to cross-sell and collaborate across competencies

-
Working knowledge of regulatory transformation in banking (e.g., Basel IV, DORA, AMLA, ESG reporting) and familiarity with core banking modernization, data platforms, or AI-driven operating model design

-
Commercial Capability

-
Active business development experience. Has originated, shaped, and closed large engagements (€1M+ range), not just delivered them

-
Able to carry a revenue target and account for pipeline independently

-
Comfortable leading proposals, responding to RFPs, and navigating complex procurement processes

-
Leadership & Delivery

-
Experience leading multidisciplinary teams across strategy, technology, and change workstreams

-
Capable of serving as the “client owner”; accountable for relationship, quality, and commercial outcomes simultaneously

-
Experience contributing to practice development and developing junior staff - methodology, talent, proposition design - beyond individual project delivery

Ideally, you’ll also have

-
Dutch language - full professional proficiency is a plus

Pre-existing senior relationships at ING, ABN AMRO, de Volksbank, or Dutch subsidiaries of global banks

-
Understanding of the Dutch regulatory environment (DNB, AFM) and how it shapes transformation agendas

You r benefits | About your perks and work enjoyment

-
A competitive salary that reflects your role and responsibilities, depending on experience and qualifications. Plus, a solid pension plan for the future. In addition to your salary, you’ll receive holiday allowance and an annual bonus (based on performance and development).

-
A laptop and phone for both work and personal use, and a monthly internet allowance.

-
34 days of annual leave to recharge and unwind, plus the option to buy extra days.

-
With the mobility budget, you decide how you travel. Choose a lease car, a discounted public transport subscription, or arrange transport easily via our app.

-
At EY, we care about a healthy work-life balance. Hybrid working makes this easier. Whether you're working from the office, at a client, or from home, we’ll make sure you have a well-equipped home office.

-
The opportunity to work up to 20 days per year from abroad.

-
The option to swap 3 national holidays for non-national ones.

-
You’ll have the space to grow both personally and professionally. Whether you want to deepen your expertise, develop your personality, or improve your leadership style, we offer a broad range of trainings and courses.

-
Your well-being is our priority. We believe that when you feel good, you perform better. That’s why you’ll have access to the OpenUp wellbeing platform (including for your family). You can easily connect with psychologists and lifestyle experts within 36 hours and take part in wellbeing sessions.

-
A strong focus on teaming and various internal networks where you can join all kinds of social activities. A positive work atmosphere and good collaboration with colleagues contribute to your overall happiness at work.

-
All this within an environment where our core values of integrity, inclusiveness, and respect are central. We think it’s important that you can be yourself and fully develop into the best version of yourself. Curious about all our benefits? Click  here

Ready to shape your future with us? | About your application process

1. For this vacancy, we only ask your resume with a motivation letter.

2. First interview: Before the interview, we’ll ask you to complete an online assessment. Not a standard questionnaire, but a game-based assessment focusing on both your cognitive skills and behavioral preferences. We’ll discuss the results during the interview, which will include a colleague from the relevant department. This mutual introduction is a chance for us to get to know you, and for you to ask any questions you have.

3. Second interview: If we see a match and you’re still enthusiastic, we’ll invite you for a second interview. We’ll dive deeper into the role and other relevant topics. Sometimes, a business case is part of the process. A final interview may also follow.

4. We’re a match. You’ll receive an offer and we’ll perform a pre-employment screening.Then your new adventure begins. Welcome to EY

EY | Building a better working world
At EY, we’re building a better working world by creating long-term value for clients, people, society, and the planet—and by helping build trust in the capital markets.

With the power of data, AI, and advanced technology, EY teams help organizations tackle the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

From assurance to consulting, tax to strategy and transactions, our teams deliver across the full spectrum of professional services. Backed by deep industry knowledge, a global, multidisciplinary network, and diverse ecosystem partnerships, EY operates in more than 150 countries and territories.

jobs.title: FSO - Business Transformation - CCSB Banking - Manager
jobs.description:
Location: New York, Charlotte, Chicago, Dallas

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.  Join EY and help to build a better working world.

EY is the only professional services firm with a separate business unit – the Financial Services Organization (FSO) – dedicated exclusively to the financial services marketplace. Our FSO Business Transformation practice helps global, super-regional and regional financial services clients improve performance in a rapidly changing environment. We assemble multidisciplinary teams, apply proven global methodologies, and draw on EY’s full breadth of reach, capabilities and knowledge to deliver strategic operations, technology, product, data, compliance and risk programs for leading U.S. institutions.

About the team

Our Corporate, Commercial and Small and Medium Enterprise (CCSB) Banking practice is EY’s wholesale and commercial credit transformation franchise. We help banks reimagine how credit and lending get done – modernizing the end-to-end credit lifecycle, redesigning operating models, and embedding AI and automation into how our clients run their business. Engagements range from focused, multi-week efforts to large-scale, multi-year transformation programs. Our core strengths include:

-
Credit and lending transformation across the end-to-end credit lifecycle

-
Target operating model design and process re-engineering

-
Lending operations, core platform modernization, and migrations

-
Data and technology enablement, workflow and automation

-
Cash management, transaction banking, treasury and payments modernization

-
AI- and agentic-enabled operating models

Our work – and our clients’ ambitions – are increasingly shaped by AI. We build the business cases, points of view and value frameworks that help clients unlock capacity, and we invest heavily in bringing modern AI tooling into our own ways of working.

The opportunity

As a Manager, you will lead engagement teams and workstreams on our clients’ transformation programs, while deepening your expertise in corporate, commercial and SME banking. You will connect the project team to client leadership – translating strategy into an executable plan, driving delivery quality and pace, owning direct client relationships, and developing the next generation of consulting talent.

We look for real depth in corporate, commercial and SME banking, built through more than one path. We are equally interested in bank operators — people who have worked inside a bank in credit, underwriting, lending or loan operations, portfolio management, middle-office or business-line roles — and consulting and advisory professionals who have delivered transformation, operating model, process or technology change for banks, ideally within corporate or commercial banking specifically.

Prior consulting experience is valuable but not the only path to this role. Many strong bank operators haven’t had a formal opportunity to lead, given the hierarchy of those organizations – so we weigh delivery leadership (owning a workstream, initiative or project end-to-end) and people leadership (managing, coaching or developing others) equally. If your career has been inside a bank rather than advising one, we encourage you to apply: we will build on the consulting toolkit you bring, and we value the operating experience and credibility you offer clients from day one. Across both tracks, our ideal candidate already uses AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot, Claude and Replit to research, analyze, draft and prototype – and is eager to bring that thinking to our clients.

Your key responsibilities

As a Manager, you will typically lead a workstream of 3-4 consultants within a multi-month to multi-year transformation program, with direct ownership of client relationships. You will operate with greater autonomy than earlier-career team members and set the standard for those around you. Specifically, you will:

-
Lead delivery of a project workstream end-to-end, owning the quality, budget and timeliness of work products

-
Manage and motivate a team of 3-4 consultants, providing regular, constructive coaching and feedback

-
Own the day-to-day client relationship for your workstream as a direct, trusted point of contact

-
Develop an in-depth understanding of clients’ needs and goals to help shape solutions, not just execute a plan

-
Drive the analysis behind the story – current-/future-state assessments, operating model designs, benchmarking and business cases – and know when to challenge the data

-
Support business growth by contributing to RFP responses, proposals, points of view and other go-to-market materials, alongside client delivery work

-
Contribute to internal EY initiatives and practice collateral

Skills and attributes for success

-
A natural leader who motivates a team, builds relationships, and navigates ambiguity with confidence

-
Comfortable defining a delivery plan with your team and engagement leadership, then holding the team accountable to it

-
Consistently mentors and develops junior team members

-
Relentless focus on client service, with the judgment to know when to escalate and when to solve

-
Strong communication, critical-thinking, analytical and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams and competing priorities

-
Curiosity about how technology, data and AI can improve ways of working, and willingness to bring modern AI tools into your team’s daily work

To qualify for the role, you must have

-
A bachelor’s degree plus approximately 5-9 years of related work experience (or a master’s degree plus approximately 4-8 years), including time in a delivery-leadership or people-leadership capacity

-
Relevant experience through one of two tracks: consulting, advisory or transformation project delivery, ideally within corporate or commercial banking; or hands-on experience in corporate, commercial or SME banking, bank operations, lending operations, or middle-office functions, with experience owning a workstream/initiative end-to-end or managing and developing others

-
Demonstrated experience across several of the following: operating model design; product/process design or operations management for banking products across the credit or deposit lifecycle; change-the-bank or transformation program strategy and delivery; current-/future-state assessment and gap analysis; channel transformation; core platform transformation; or core system conversions and client migrations

-
Demonstrated ability to manage a workstream through all phases of the project lifecycle, including project plans, managing deliverables, reviewing outputs, and providing team feedback

-
Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, client-service and technical-writing skills, with genuine interest in deepening CCSB industry and content knowledge

-
Ability to travel up to approximately 60% over the course of a year, including internationally

Ideally, you’ll also have

Preferred but not required – we value potential and willingness to learn:

-
Hands-on experience applying AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT or Replit to research, analysis, drafting, prototyping and automation

-
Experience with target operating model design, process re-engineering, current-/future-state assessment, or gap analysis

-
Exposure to lending operations, core platform modernization, system conversions or client migrations

-
Knowledge of transaction banking and treasury management – including cash management, commercial card, payments, treasury operations and corporate finance

-
Knowledge of KYC, AML, and other applicable compliance regulations

-
A track record contributing to proposals and pursuits, developing reusable practice collateral, and building C-suite client relationships

-
A PMP, Lean Six Sigma, Agile/Scrum or comparable delivery-leadership certification

What we look for

We’re interested in natural leaders who motivate teams, build relationships, and solve complex client problems – with the confidence to challenge the status quo. Top performers contribute content to pursuits, structure work collaboratively, manage teams, and develop reusable collateral. If you’re passionate about helping businesses reach their full potential, this role is for you.

What working at EY offers

We offer a competitive compensation package, rewarding performance and the value you bring to our business. Our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, flexible vacation time, a generous number of observed holidays, and programs supporting your physical, financial and social well-being. We also offer:

-
The opportunity to manage a portfolio of talent within a designated service line

-
A collaborative environment focused on building a better working world

-
Strong training and development, including a culture of AI and technical upskilling, through established programs and on-the-job learning

About EY

As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and consulting services, we hire and develop passionate people to help build a better working world – giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom to make things better, however long you stay.

Join us in building a better working world. Apply now.

EY, an equal employment opportunity employer (Females/Minorities/Protected Veterans/Disabled), values the diversity of our workforce and the knowledge of our people.

What we offer you
At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.

- We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business.  The base salary range for this job is:

-

- New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $154,000 to $256,700

- Bay Area California offices – $160,500 to $267,400

You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

- To make the most of your application experience, please limit yourself to two applications within a six-month period.

- EY accepts applications for this position on an on-going basis.

- For those living in California, please click here  for additional information.

- At EY, our values set the foundation for how we work and the behaviors we expect of our people. Any misrepresentation or falsification of information or lack of integrity at any point in the recruiting process may result in withdrawal of your candidacy, revocation of an offer or immediate termination of employment.

EY  |  Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

All in to shape the future with confidence.

EY provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, pregnancy, genetic information, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other legally protected basis, including arrest and conviction records, in accordance with applicable law.

EY is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities including veterans with disabilities. If you have a disability and either need assistance applying online or need to request an accommodation during any part of the application process,  please call 1-800-EY-HELP3, select Option 2 for candidate related inquiries, then select Option 1 for candidate queries and finally select Option 2 for candidates with an inquiry which will route you to EY’s Talent Shared Services Team (TSS) or email the TSS at ssc.customersupport@ey.com .

jobs.description:

Risk Consulting – Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) – Basel III Business Analyst – Manager/Senior

Description

EY's Financial Services Office (FSO) is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional capability and product knowledge. FSO practice provides integrated consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, investment banks, broker-dealers, asset managers (traditional and alternative), insurance and energy trading companies, and the Corporate Treasury functions of leading Fortune 500 Companies. The service offerings provided by the FSO Consulting include: market, credit and operational risk management, regulatory consulting, quantitative consulting, structured finance transaction, actuarial consulting, technology enablement, risk and security, program consulting, and process & controls.

Within EY’s Business Consulting Practice, the Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) group provides solutions that can help FSO clients to identify, measure, manage and monitor the market (trading book), credit (banking book), operational, and regulatory risks associated with their trading, asset-liability management, capital management and other capital markets activities.

Within FSRM, the CSTC team assists across end-to-end aspects of Capital management, BASEL, credit risk and Stress testing related activities:

- Key role involves producing critical deliverables to the senior management and regulators including EMEIA, US and APAC entities’ credit risk review, capital projections, Basel 4, Basel 3 endgame, capital aspects of Recovery & Resolution planning (RRP), stress testing and having oversight of various regulatory requirements.

- Consulting and solutions delivery such as impact assessments, defining the target operating model, and integrated risk and finance reporting framework

- Quality assurance such as assessment of controls of the Banking industry and similar business lines covering regulatory reporting involving Basel/CRR/RRP regulations

- Early identification and accurate analysis of prudential developments and influence on changes to the capital framework.

- Regulatory capital impact assessment in legal entity simplification initiatives, business re-organizations, new business initiatives and external commitments to regulators

Clients include large domestic and global financial institutions, broker-dealers, foreign banking organizations, asset management firms with significant capital markets activities. Project teams frequently work with the senior management of these firms, including CFOs and CROs.

Role Overview

The role is for a Basel III Business Analyst supporting the Basel III Proposal Roadmap implementation. The engagement focuses on restarting Basel III Proposal implementation program, adopting the Expanded Risk-Based Approach (ERBA), accelerating Single Counterparty Credit Limits (SCCL) gross exposure measurements, and onboarding incremental Basel III data requirements into the Unified Consumption Layer (UCL) Data Factory. The candidate will support exposure-pod based execution across credit risk, securitization, credit risk mitigation, derivatives / SA-CCR, operational risk, and related regulatory capital workstreams. The role requires strong business analysis, regulatory capital, data sourcing, data profiling, source-to-target mapping, calculation logic documentation, Axiom input mapping, controls design, testing, governance, and stakeholder management capabilities. The candidate will work closely with Risk, Finance, Technology, Data, Operations, and business stakeholders to produce implementation-ready requirements, support interim ERBA calculator development, and enable transparent program execution through high-quality documentation, testing, and governance routines.

Key Responsibilities

- Support detailed implementation planning, governance, project management, status reporting, RAID / action trackers, decision logs, and senior stakeholder updates for the B3P Roadmap.

- Refresh the Basel III Proposal / ERBA gap assessment and identify new, modified, or enhanced data elements required for rule interpretation, regulatory capital calculations, and downstream reporting.

- Perform data profiling and fit-for-use analysis across existing UCL data elements and source-system data, including review of missing values, syntax consistency, data completeness, appropriateness for regulatory requirements, and data quality issues.

- Document data sourcing, transformation, derivation, and calculation logic requirements for ERBA exposure types including residential mortgage / MSR, CRE, retail, off-balance sheet, corporates, banks, securitization, credit risk mitigation, collateral haircut approach, derivatives / SA-CCR, and operational risk.

- Develop source-to-target mappings, business data dictionaries, data lineage, and transformation specifications to support onboarding of incremental Basel III data requirements into the UCL Data Factory.

- Support UCL Data Factory activities, including data movement logic, UCL data model design, legacy consumption views, UCL ADRS unification, semantic layer configuration inputs, and source-to-target reconciliation / data validation activities.

- Map data elements to Axiom-required calculation inputs and document the business rules, derivations, assumptions, controls, and evidence required to support regulatory capital processing.

- Assist in the design, build, and testing of interim ERBA calculators using available UCL data and direct source-system data until strategic UCL feeds are available.

- Support testing of calculator outputs, reconciliation of data and results, fit-for-use analysis, issue identification, remediation tracking, and user acceptance testing using project accelerators and agreed testing approaches.

- Identify and document controls for new or modified data elements, including preventative and detective controls, data quality checks, lineage controls, reconciliation points, and governance documentation.

- Recommend interim and strategic BAU data capture, data management, and process enhancements to support ERBA, SCCL gross exposure measurements, regulatory reporting, management reporting, and future-state capital insights.

- Coordinate with exposure pods, technology teams, and business stakeholders to drive agile execution across discovery, assessment, design, build, testing, and refinement sprints.

- Prepare clear, executive-ready documentation including requirements packs, mapping documents, control matrices, testing summaries, issue trackers, status decks, and steering committee materials.

- Responsibly use AI and automation tools to improve analysis, documentation quality, workflow efficiency, and delivery transparency while following engagement and client requirements.

Qualifications, Certifications and Education

Must-have:

- Master’s degree in business administration, finance, economics, engineering, statistics, information systems, or a related discipline, with at least 5 years of relevant experience in banking, consulting, risk management, regulatory capital, data management, or regulatory reporting.

- Strong understanding of Basel III / Basel III Endgame / Basel III Proposal requirements, ERBA concepts, RWA calculations, regulatory capital, credit risk, counterparty credit risk, operational risk, and regulatory reporting processes.

- Experience supporting Basel implementation, gap assessments, regulatory capital transformation, data sourcing, calculation logic documentation, data quality remediation, or regulatory reporting change programs.

- Strong business and data analysis skills, including requirements documentation, data profiling, source-to-target mapping, data lineage, data dictionaries, metadata management, reconciliation, and control documentation.

- Ability to understand exposure-level requirements across residential mortgage, CRE, retail, off-balance sheet exposures, corporates, banks, securitization, credit risk mitigation, SA-CCR, and operational risk.

- Experience working with senior stakeholders across Risk, Finance, Credit, Technology, Data, Operations, Compliance, and business teams in a structured and professional manner.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with ability to translate regulatory requirements into practical data, logic, controls, testing, and implementation deliverables.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with proficiency in preparing executive-ready PowerPoint materials, Excel trackers, meeting notes, governance reports, requirements documents, and testing summaries.

- Demonstrated focus on delivery excellence, attention to detail, process discipline, documentation quality, stakeholder management, and continuous improvement.

Good-to-have:

- Experience with Axiom, regulatory capital calculators, RWA engines, regulatory reporting platforms, or capital data warehouses.

- Technical skills such as SQL, SAS, Python, advanced Excel, data profiling tools, data visualization tools, or cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, Azure, GCP, or similar environments.

- Familiarity with UCL / data factory delivery concepts, source-to-target reconciliation, consumption views, semantic layers, data model design, ADRS unification, and ETL design documentation.

- Familiarity with SA-CCR, SCCL, credit risk mitigation, collateral haircut approach, securitization capital rules, corporate / wholesale banking products, and operational risk SMA / BIC concepts.

- Certifications such as FRM, CFA, PRM, PMP, PRINCE2, Agile / Scrum, DAMA, or other relevant risk, data, or project delivery credentials.

- Hands-on experience with project management, collaboration, and reporting tools such as MS Project, Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.

- Prior consulting experience or experience working with US banks, regional banks, global financial institutions, or regulatory-driven change and remediation programs.

The role is for a Basel III Business Analyst supporting the Basel III Proposal Roadmap implementation. The engagement focuses on restarting Basel III Proposal implementation program, adopting the Expanded Risk-Based Approach (ERBA), accelerating Single Counterparty Credit Limits (SCCL) gross exposure measurements, and onboarding incremental Basel III data requirements into the Unified Consumption Layer (UCL) Data Factory. The candidate will support exposure-pod based execution across credit risk, securitization, credit risk mitigation, derivatives / SA-CCR, operational risk, and related regulatory capital workstreams. The role requires strong business analysis, regulatory capital, data sourcing, data profiling, source-to-target mapping, calculation logic documentation, Axiom input mapping, controls design, testing, governance, and stakeholder management capabilities. The candidate will work closely with Risk, Finance, Technology, Data, Operations, and business stakeholders to produce implementation-ready requirements, support interim ERBA calculator development, and enable transparent program execution through high-quality documentation, testing, and governance routines.

Key Responsibilities

- Support detailed implementation planning, governance, project management, status reporting, RAID / action trackers, decision logs, and senior stakeholder updates for the B3P Roadmap.

- Refresh the Basel III Proposal / ERBA gap assessment and identify new, modified, or enhanced data elements required for rule interpretation, regulatory capital calculations, and downstream reporting.

- Perform data profiling and fit-for-use analysis across existing UCL data elements and source-system data, including review of missing values, syntax consistency, data completeness, appropriateness for regulatory requirements, and data quality issues.

- Document data sourcing, transformation, derivation, and calculation logic requirements for ERBA exposure types including residential mortgage / MSR, CRE, retail, off-balance sheet, corporates, banks, securitization, credit risk mitigation, collateral haircut approach, derivatives / SA-CCR, and operational risk.

- Develop source-to-target mappings, business data dictionaries, data lineage, and transformation specifications to support onboarding of incremental Basel III data requirements into the UCL Data Factory.

- Support UCL Data Factory activities, including data movement logic, UCL data model design, legacy consumption views, UCL ADRS unification, semantic layer configuration inputs, and source-to-target reconciliation / data validation activities.

- Map data elements to Axiom-required calculation inputs and document the business rules, derivations, assumptions, controls, and evidence required to support regulatory capital processing.

- Assist in the design, build, and testing of interim ERBA calculators using available UCL data and direct source-system data until strategic UCL feeds are available.

- Support testing of calculator outputs, reconciliation of data and results, fit-for-use analysis, issue identification, remediation tracking, and user acceptance testing using project accelerators and agreed testing approaches.

- Identify and document controls for new or modified data elements, including preventative and detective controls, data quality checks, lineage controls, reconciliation points, and governance documentation.

- Recommend interim and strategic BAU data capture, data management, and process enhancements to support ERBA, SCCL gross exposure measurements, regulatory reporting, management reporting, and future-state capital insights.

- Coordinate with exposure pods, technology teams, and business stakeholders to drive agile execution across discovery, assessment, design, build, testing, and refinement sprints.

- Prepare clear, executive-ready documentation including requirements packs, mapping documents, control matrices, testing summaries, issue trackers, status decks, and steering committee materials.

- Responsibly use AI and automation tools to improve analysis, documentation quality, workflow efficiency, and delivery transparency while following engagement and client requirements.

Qualifications, Certifications and Education

Must-have:

- Master’s degree in business administration, finance, economics, engineering, statistics, information systems, or a related discipline, with at least 5 years of relevant experience in banking, consulting, risk management, regulatory capital, data management, or regulatory reporting.

- Strong understanding of Basel III / Basel III Endgame / Basel III Proposal requirements, ERBA concepts, RWA calculations, regulatory capital, credit risk, counterparty credit risk, operational risk, and regulatory reporting processes.

- Experience supporting Basel implementation, gap assessments, regulatory capital transformation, data sourcing, calculation logic documentation, data quality remediation, or regulatory reporting change programs.

- Strong business and data analysis skills, including requirements documentation, data profiling, source-to-target mapping, data lineage, data dictionaries, metadata management, reconciliation, and control documentation.

- Ability to understand exposure-level requirements across residential mortgage, CRE, retail, off-balance sheet exposures, corporates, banks, securitization, credit risk mitigation, SA-CCR, and operational risk.

- Experience working with senior stakeholders across Risk, Finance, Credit, Technology, Data, Operations, Compliance, and business teams in a structured and professional manner.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with ability to translate regulatory requirements into practical data, logic, controls, testing, and implementation deliverables.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with proficiency in preparing executive-ready PowerPoint materials, Excel trackers, meeting notes, governance reports, requirements documents, and testing summaries.

- Demonstrated focus on delivery excellence, attention to detail, process discipline, documentation quality, stakeholder management, and continuous improvement.

Good-to-have:

- Experience with Axiom, regulatory capital calculators, RWA engines, regulatory reporting platforms, or capital data warehouses.

- Technical skills such as SQL, SAS, Python, advanced Excel, data profiling tools, data visualization tools, or cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, Azure, GCP, or similar environments.

- Familiarity with UCL / data factory delivery concepts, source-to-target reconciliation, consumption views, semantic layers, data model design, ADRS unification, and ETL design documentation.

- Familiarity with SA-CCR, SCCL, credit risk mitigation, collateral haircut approach, securitization capital rules, corporate / wholesale banking products, and operational risk SMA / BIC concepts.

- Certifications such as FRM, CFA, PRM, PMP, PRINCE2, Agile / Scrum, DAMA, or other relevant risk, data, or project delivery credentials.

- Hands-on experience with project management, collaboration, and reporting tools such as MS Project, Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.

jobs.title: Consultant Expérimenté en Stratégie - EY Parthenon Services Financiers (H/F)
jobs.description:
Les services financiers chez EY, c’est une organisation unique parmi les Big four : 1200 personnes dédiées à la banque, l’assurance, la gestion d’actif, les paiements, le private equity , etc. pour des grands groupes internationaux comme des fintech en mode start-up. Nous sommes la plus grande équipe dédiée au secteur financier sur le marché français répartie à travers les métiers du conseil, de l’audit, des transactions, de la fiscalité et du droit . Les carrières au sein des services financiers passent par différents métiers et nous valorisons particulièrement les échanges dans nos bureaux à l’étranger dans les plus grandes places financières mondiales.

Pourquoi pas vous ?
EY-Parthenon est un cabinet de conseil en stratégie de premier plan, accompagnant ses clients à la fois sur des missions de corporate strategy (plan stratégique, value creation…) et de stratégie liée aux transactions (Due diligences, post merger integration…).
EY-Parthenon regroupe plus de 7000 consultants dans le monde dont plus de 200 au sein du bureau de Paris. L’équipe EY-Parthenon Financial Services accompagne les institutions financières (banques, assurances, sociétés de gestions, etc.) ainsi que les fonds de Private Equity et les FinTech/AssurTech.
Nous poursuivons notre très forte croissance et recherchons pour notre bureau de Paris, des consultants expérimentés (grade senior consultant, case team leader et manager) H/F pour intervenir sur des missions auprès de clients d'envergure internationale.

Vos missions
Dans une équipe diverse et à taille humaine, vous participez à l’ensemble du processus de réflexion stratégique se situant en amont (due diligence stratégique, stratégie d’entrée, revue d’activités, etc.) et en aval (intégration, fusion, séparation) des transactions pour nos clients (directions générales, fonds d’investissements…)
Vous participez / pilotez des missions à forts enjeux et au plus haut niveau avec des équipes alliant expertise sectorielle et compétences en stratégie.
Notre choix de traiter en priorité des problématiques de stratégie vous permet d'avoir un impact fort sur les décisions des dirigeants et les résultats de nos clients.
Au sein de l'équipe, vous contribuez à la gestion et au développement du cabinet, vous donnant ainsi la possibilité de développer votre esprit entrepreneurial.

En intégrant l’équipe, vous bénéficiez de nombreuses formations techniques et méthodologiques (métiers du conseil en stratégie) ainsi que d’un cursus lié au développement personnel dispensé à l'ensemble des collaborateurs du cabinet.

Votre profil
Diplômé(e) d'une grande école de commerce ou d'ingénieur de premier rang, vous bénéficiez d’une expérience confirmée en conseil en stratégie, private equity, corporate finance ou au sein d’un département stratégie d’une institution financière de premier plan.
Doté d'un excellent sens relationnel, vous faites preuve de très bonnes capacités de structuration, analytiques et créatives.
Vous bénéficiez d’un fort esprit d'équipe, de leadership et on vous reconnait d’excellentes capacités à apporter de la valeur ajoutée à vos clients. Vous parlez couramment anglais.

Nous recherchons des candidats ayant un minimum de 3 ans d’expérience dans le milieu du conseil en stratégie, et/ou au sein d’institutions financières.
Notre équipe est en forte croissance et offre des possibilités d’évolution très attractives, alors rejoignez-nous !

A propos d’EY :

EY incarne à la fois des expertises, de l’innovation, de la confiance, de la transformation, des nouvelles technologies et des missions passionnantes.

EY c’est l’opportunité de :

- de travailler pour des clients internationaux et leaders dans leurs secteurs, des start - up , ou bien des entreprises familiales à forte valeur ajoutée ;

- d’évoluer au sein d’équipe internationale à taille humaine ;

- de découvrir d’autres cultures et de profiter de notre réseau avec notre programme Mobility4U ;

- de suivre un programme de formation complet et personnalisé . Un mentor vous suivra tout au long de votre carrière chez nous !

- de s’engager à travers nos réseaux internes autour de sujets liés à l’écologie, l’inclusion, l’associatif (Fondation EY), … et de participer à de nombreux événements (prix de l’entrepreneur de l’année, Women In, ...) !

Dans le cadre de sa politique Diversité, EY étudie, à compétences égales, toutes candidatures dont celles de personnes en situation de handicap.

En EY encontrarás mucho más que un empleo : una oportunidad real para crecer, aprender y dejar huella en una firma global líder.

En España somos cerca de 7.000 profesionales , presentes en 15 oficinas , y formamos parte de una red global de más de 400.000 personas que trabajan cada día con un propósito común: Building a Better Working World .

En EY impulsamos carreras con impacto, desarrollo estructurado y aprendizaje continuo.
Damos forma al futuro con confianza, a través de las personas y la tecnología.

#ShapeTheFutureWithConfidence #EYCareers #BuildingABetterWorkingWorld

La oportunidad

EY es una firma global líder en auditoría, consultoría, estrategia y transacciones, y servicios legales y fiscales, que acompaña a organizaciones públicas y privadas en sus retos más complejos.

En EY:

- Apostamos por la innovación continua

- Desarrollamos talento a largo plazo dentro de equipos multidisciplinares

- Impulsamos carreras con propósito y recorrido

EY Abogados ofrece un amplio abanico de servicios de asesoramiento fiscal y legal caracterizados por una atención personalizada y una adaptabilidad de su estructura a las demandas de sus clientes, en España y en el resto del mundo. jobs.title: EY Parthenon - Infrastructure Advisory (Junior and Senior Consultant)
jobs.description:
EY Parthenon Infrastructure Advisory Team is inviting talented individuals to join a team of experienced professionals who help guide our clients, both public and private sectors, to achieve their goals on developing infrastructure assets through project preparation, transactions and/or fund-raising activities.

EY is ranked no.1 deal advisor in Southeast Asia in terms of volume and value of deals for the 12th and 7th consecutive year, respectively, based on Mergermarket. We advise and assist our clients carry out their transaction plans (buy-side or sell side transactions), as well as their fund-raising activities. Our EY Parthenon Infrastructure Advisory group has an established track record of advising both public and private sectors on infrastructure projects worldwide. Our core team has a broad and deep understanding of large and complex economic and social infrastructure demonstrated by our strong public sector advisory credentials covering a range of industry sectors and procurement methodologies.

Requirements

To qualify for the role you must have:

- Minimum Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, Economics, Public Policy or Engineering from reputable overseas and local universities.

- Between 0 to 5 years of related working experience, including in Big-4 firms, Public Sector, State-Owned Enterprise, Management Consulting, Financial Institution, Private Equity, and/or Investment House.

- Working experience of dealing with international development agencies/donor would be an asset.

- Knowledge or experience in financial analysis, micro and macroeconomics, project finance and infrastructure projects, including financial modelling, quantitative analysis, procurement methodology, and procurement strategy, as well as infrastructure planning and infrastructure policy development.

- Strong knowledge of International Finance and Accounting concepts and principles as it relates to PPP infrastructure transactions

- Deep knowledge and relationships in one or more of the following sectors: Transport, Power & Utilities, Oil & Gas, Social / Urban / Green Infrastructure.

- Any professional qualifications (e.g. PMP, CFA) would be highly regarded

- Fluency in business English is mandatory both verbal and written.

- Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation and influencing skill with the ability to deal with people all levels professionally both internally and externally.

Brief Description of Role

Some of the key responsibilities would include:

- Serving public or private sector clients in project preparation of infrastructure assets, which may include the development of feasibility study, project transactions, and financial close.

- Familiarity with the prevailing regulations and relevant public policies in infrastructure sector.

- Develop and/or analyze financial model using various valuation approaches and methods to support clients’ various purposes including, but not limited to, feasibility study, financial projection review, business plan development, project transaction and structuring, joint ventures economics, and project finance transactions.

Additional for Senior:

- Analyze and/or review any related documents to the engagement, including, but not limited to, business plan or financial projections, transaction agreements and other ancillary documents, commercial and operational agreements/documents, financial reporting, etc.

- Assist in reviewing transaction agreements such as term-sheet or heads of agreement, conditional sales and purchase agreement, shareholders agreement, joint-venture agreements and other agreements.

- Pro-active in performing other necessary tasks, such as conducting industry research, researching on comparable companies, managing data room, preparing materials for discussions or meetings, managing client meetings and minutes of meetings, and other ad-hoc duties.

- Work with other EY service teams and partners consultants to deliver an integrated service to our clients.

- Likely to also work on a number of cross border assignments, working with other EY offices globally.

The role also encompasses a strong focus on team leadership and development. Beyond inspiring high-performing teams, it involves mentoring and training junior consultants, fostering their growth and equipping them with the skills to excel in project delivery and client interactions. Creating a collaborative environment is key to ensuring team success and professional fulfillment.

Additionally, the position includes preparing compelling technical and financial proposals, contributing to business development, and supporting the sales process. Analytical rigor underpins all activities, with data-driven insights forming the foundation for strategic recommendations.

Finally, the role demands adaptability and innovation, leveraging market trends to anticipate client needs and propose forward-thinking solutions in a dynamic environment.

Key skills and attributes for business

- Play a leadership role in helping grow the EY-Parthenon Strategy business.

- Define the objective and scope of strategy engagements and client deliverables in consultation with the Partner.

- Lead teams in the execution of both commercial due diligence and strategy engagements.

- Develop business strategies using tools such as market analysis, customer research, macroeconomic forecasting, business plan, transformation road map and portfolio optimization.

- Manage, develop, and mentor junior team members at the Associate, Senior Associate, Consultant levels.

- Develop and maintain relationships with clients.

- Ability to explain complex concepts clearly to clients and internal teams.

What we look for:
Academic Qualifications:

- Degree from a top business or engineering school, or equivalent in management.

- Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, or Accounting.

Professional Experience:

- 5-8 years of experience in consulting, ideally in finance, industry,

- Experience managing business strategy development in the banking, capital markets, wealth management, asset management, corporate finance ; this experience can come from prior consulting work or direct experience in the financial services industry

- Experience managing M&A strategic diligence projects in complex environments, venture capital, investment banking, commercial banking,

- Strong quantitative skills to supervise data analysis, interpret output and generate insights

- Ability to make detailed assessments of industry, products, markets, competitors and customers to identify risks and opportunities.

- Proficient in the English and French languages, including the ability to listen, understand, read and communicate effectively, both in writing and verbally, in a professional environment.

- Willingness and ability to travel, when necessary (approximately 25-50%).

Language Skills:

- Fluency in French and English, both written and spoken.

What we offer:

We offer a competitive remuneration and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. On top of that, you get opportunities for:

- Meaningful impact:  We want you to bring your unique voice and purpose to our team, and use EY as a platform for the issues you care about. With EY’s mission of building a better working world, you have the opportunity to make an impact on society, culture and community through your work.

- Growth and learning: You will be immersed in a rich learning environment from the knowledge you acquire in your work, EY’s educational resources, travel opportunities, and mentorship from our partners and your peers.

- Career Prospects:  We will provide the support you need to be successful, so you can own your own engagements and be responsible for Client success. We do not set limits on growth, meaning that your promotion comes as early as you deserve it.

- Global exposure:  You will not only get to work with global clients, but also get the opportunity to work in highly integrated teams across the globe, sector experts, and collaborate with people of diverse backgrounds everyday.

- Great people and culture:  Join an empowering and entrepreneurial working environment in which you’ll be rapidly building and growing a strategy business that makes a real impact on the market. You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

- Everything you need to grow:   You will receive one-to-one mentorship from seniors, professional development through training courses and roles on foreign teams, a flexible work at home policy, a meal and gym subsidy, wellness programmes and above all an environment where you’re valued for being you.

Why Join EY Parthenon?

Joining EY Parthenon means being part of a passionate, dynamic, and international team that places innovation and excellence at the core of its approach. You will have the opportunity to contribute to the growth and transformation of local businesses.

About EY

As a global leader in Assurance, Consulting, Strategy and Transactions, Tax, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. jobs.description:
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence?

Du willst mehr als reine Strategieberatung? Du willst tiefer einsteigen als im klassischen M&A?
