Hier arbeitest du an wegweisenden Projekten in vielfältigen Branchen: von der Neuausrichtung und Optimierung von Strategien bis hin zu transformativen Deals und Restrukturierungen. Mit datenbasierten Insights und dem gezielten Einsatz von KI-Technologien eröffnest du neue Märkte, treibst Wachstum voran und entwickelst Unternehmens- und Kapitalstrategien, die den entscheidenden Unterschied machen.

Deine Aufgaben

Als Teil unseres Deal Management & Execution-Teams in Frankfurt/Main, Hamburg, Berlin, Düsseldorf, Stuttgart oder München begleitest du komplexe Geschäftstransformationen – von Carve-outs über Post-Merger-Integration bis hin zu Joint Ventures – und gestaltest Transaktionen jeder Größenordnung aktiv mit. Dabei übernimmst du vielfältige Aufgaben:

- Du entwickelst Carve-out- oder Integrationsstrategien und planst sowie setzt diese detailliert über alle Unternehmensbereiche hinweg um.

- Du unterstützt alle Transaktionsschritte, einschließlich der Analyse von Zielunternehmen, der Partnersuche und -ansprache, der Due Diligence, der Erstellung von Investorenpräsentationen, der Verhandlungen, des Vertragsabschlusses sowie der Planung und operativen Umsetzung sowohl auf der Sell- als auch auf der Buy-Side.

- Du betreust unsere nationalen und internationalen Kund:innen als Teil funktionaler sowie sektororientierter Teams.

- Du übernimmst als Senior Consultant die Verantwortung für den Projektfortschritt und führst die Teammitglieder fachlich, bereits früh in deiner Karriere.

Dein Skillset

- Du hast dein Studium mit Schwerpunkt Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Finanzen, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Ingenieurwesen oder anderen quantitativen Studiengängen erfolgreich abgeschlossen und interessierst dich für die Strategie- und Transaktionsberatung.

- Du hast mindestens 2 Jahre praktische Erfahrungen in der Strategie-, Transaktions- oder der Restrukturierungsberatung gesammelt – alternativ bringst du Strategieentwicklungs- oder erste Transaktionserfahrungen aus der Finanz- oder Corporate-Welt mit und warst auch schon im Ausland tätig.

- Du hinterfragst Fakten kritisch und besitzt sehr gute Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten in Deutsch (mind. C1) und Englisch sowie einen sicheren Umgang mit Microsoft Office (insbesondere MS Excel und PowerPoint).

Dein Mindset

- Agil: Du bist der Meinung, dass eine flexible Denkweise genauso wichtig für den Erfolg ist wie Wissen und Fähigkeiten.

- Neugierig: Du bist ambitioniert und engagiert. Wir suchen Menschen, die in Chancen und nicht in Herausforderungen denken und durch gezielte Fragen bessere Lösungen finden.

- Teamorientiert : Du schätzt vielfältige Perspektiven und arbeitest gerne im Team. Wir suchen Menschen, die gemeinsam mit uns etwas erreichen und ein vertrauensvolles Arbeitsumfeld schaffen wollen.

Deine Benefits

Bei EY-Parthenon arbeitest du in leistungsstarken, interdisziplinären Teams mit innovativen Technologien. In einem flexiblen und inklusiven Arbeitsumfeld unterstützen wir dich in deinen unterschiedlichen Lebenssituationen. Inspirierende Kolleg:innen sowie Trainings- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten on- und off-the-Job helfen dir dabei, über dich hinauszuwachsen und die Fähigkeiten weiterzuentwickeln, die du zukünftig brauchst. jobs.title: Senior Consultant - Capital Markets
jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity

Our Financial Services Office is a unique, industry-focused practice, and our Capital Markets consulting practice is a critical part of our global offering. We help the world’s largest financial institutions navigate the continuous evolution of Capital Markets. More than ever, our clients, top banks, market infrastructure providers, trade associations, and regulators, look to us for trusted advice on every engagement.

This is an exciting opportunity to support the Capital Markets sector in addressing key challenges such as AI, digital assets, regulatory change, risk and compliance, and operational transformation. If you are eager to grow your expertise and contribute to shaping the future of Capital Markets, join us to deliver impactful solutions.

This job posting relates to an existing vacancy within our organization.

Your key responsibilities

As a Senior Consultant in Capital Markets, you will contribute to the delivery of client projects by supporting workstreams focused on regulatory compliance, risk management, digital assets, and operating model transformation. You will assist in the development of client proposals, research, and preparation of presentations and reports.

You will collaborate closely with team members and clients to analyze complex Capital Markets processes and systems, helping to identify opportunities for improvement and innovation. You will support project management activities to ensure timely and quality delivery.

You will build your network within the Capital Markets sector and the global community, developing your skills and knowledge in Capital Markets products, functions, and emerging trends such as digital assets, regulatory and market structures.

Skills and attributes for success

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with foundational knowledge of Capital Markets trade flows (front, middle, back office), risk management, digital assets, data, technology, regulatory compliance, market infrastructure, and Capital Markets products.

- Proactive and curious mindset with a willingness to learn and ask insightful questions.

- Effective communication and presentation skills to support the clear articulation of ideas and findings.

- Ability to work collaboratively in teams and adapt to new challenges.

- Willingness to travel as needed to meet client requirements.

- Eagerness to build relationships within the industry and across EY’s global Capital Markets community.

- Intellectual curiosity to stay informed on industry trends and innovations.

To Qualify for the Role You Must Have

- 3-6 years of relevant experience in the Capital Markets industry, ideally gained through a consultancy, financial services firm, or within a bank or market infrastructure provider.

- Understanding of front-to-back Capital Markets operations and their evolving relationship with technology, such as automation and AI-driven processes, digital assets and regulatory technology (RegTech), reflecting the major trends shaping the industry in Capital Markets transformation.

- Experience supporting project delivery with strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

- Good written and verbal communication and presentation skills.

- Willingness to learn and use relevant tools and software.

- Strong teamwork and client service orientation.

- Demonstrated professionalism and integrity in previous roles.

- Availability to travel as needed within and outside of Canada and flexibility to work beyond standard hours when necessary

Ideally, you’ll also

- A self-starting attitude, an ability to think outside the box and thrive on new challenges

What we look for

If you’re a natural leader with a talent for answering and communicating complex client problems, we’re interested in you. You’ll need to be great at influencing people, ready to listen and confident in challenging the status quo. If you have a genuine passion for helping businesses address their most pressing problems, this role is for you.

What we offer you

We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. In addition, our Total Rewards package allows you decide which benefits are right for you and which ones help you create a solid foundation for your future. Our Total Rewards package includes a discretionary bonus program, a comprehensive medical, prescription drug and dental coverage plan, a defined contribution pension plan, a great vacation policy plus firm paid days that allow you to enjoy longer long weekends throughout the year, statutory holidays and paid personal days (based on province of residence), and a range of exciting programs and benefits designed to support your physical, financial and social well-being. Plus, we offer:

- Support and coaching from some of the most engaging colleagues in the industry

- Learning opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career

- The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

EY reports salary ranges in accordance with applicable provincial pay transparency legislation. Individual salaries within the anticipated salary ranges noted below are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to internal equity, education, relevant experience, knowledge, and applicable skill sets.

- Toronto: $ 90,500 to $136,000

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

To help create the best experience during the recruitment process, please describe any accommodations you may need.

Inclusiveness at EY

Inclusiveness is at the heart of who we are and how we work. We’re committed to fostering an environment where differences are valued, policies and practices are equitable, and our people feel a sense of belonging. We embrace diversity and are committed to combating systemic racism, advancing gender equity and women in leadership, advocating for the 2SLGBTQIA+ community, promoting our neuroinclusion and accessibility initiatives, and are dedicated to amplifying the voices of Indigenous peoples (First Nations, Inuit, and Métis) nationally as we strive towards reconciliation. Our diverse experiences, abilities, backgrounds, and perspectives make our people unique and help guide us. Because when people feel free to be their authentic selves at work, they bring their best and are empowered to build a better working world.

Learn about our commitment to Inclusiveness at https://www.ey.com/en_ca/about-us/corporate-responsibility/equity

EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

At EY, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools as one element of our recruitment process to enhance efficiency and improve the candidate experience. While AI supports us in our process, human judgment and decision-making remain integral in our candidate experience. We are committed to the responsible use of AI, and our practices are continuously reviewed and refined to ensure they align with the highest ethical principles and regulatory requirements.

The opportunity: your next adventure awaits

EY’s Transactions Corporate Finance (TCF) department sits at the intersection of corporate finance and the M&A transactions landscape, with a focus on M&A Advisory, Transaction Diligence and Valuation, Modeling & Economics. By joining us, you will step into an ambitious, high-performing and collaborative environment, united by our purpose of building a better working world.

Our team is made up of dynamic and diverse individuals who thrive on collaboration, innovation and entrepreneurial spirit — with a strong “YES, can do” mentality.

As a member of one of the leading mid-market M&A teams in Switzerland, Europe and globally, you will work on high-profile sell-side and buy-side M&A transactions in the financial services sector. You will gain hands-on experience across the full deal lifecycle, with a steep learning curve and direct exposure to clients and transaction stakeholders.

To reinforce our growing TCF team in Zurich, with a particular focus on M&A, we are currently looking for an M&A (Senior) Consultant.

Your key responsibilities

- Prepare and review key transaction deliverables, including information memoranda, teasers, process materials, management presentations and other client-facing materials.

- Perform and review company financial models and valuations using market multiples, precedent transactions, DCF analyses and other valuation methodologies.

- Support and execute M&A transactions from origination through closing, managing workstreams and coordinating and interacting with internal and external stakeholders (e.g., clients, lawyers).

- Conduct industry, market and company analyses to support strategic decision-making and transaction execution.

- Develop target identification and buyer screening analyses, including long lists and short lists.

- Participate in and coordinate due diligence processes, identify key findings and translate them into actionable recommendations.

- Execute multiple projects and workstreams simultaneously while ensuring high-quality deliverables and adherence to tight deadlines.

- Support business development initiatives, including pitch preparation and proposal development.

What we look for

- Master’s degree or equivalent qualification in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Accounting or a related field, with a strong academic record.

- 2–4 years of relevant professional experience, ideally within M&A, Corporate Finance, Investment Banking, Deal Advisory or Private Equity.

- Demonstrated experience in executing transactions, including financial analysis, valuation, due diligence and stakeholder management.

- Ability to engage in client and buyer communications and take ownership across the transaction cycle.

- Ability to show initiate and support several transactions in parallel.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and German; French is considered a strong asset, with the ability to communicate concepts and ideas concisely. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure complex issues and develop practical recommendations.

- Entrepreneurial and ownership mindset, strong client focus and the ability to build trusted relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

- Collaborative team player with excellent interpersonal skills and a proactive, results-oriented approach.

Through our coaching and training programs, you’ll develop the skills you need - all while building a network of colleagues, mentors, and leaders who will be on the journey with you at EY and beyond.

jobs.description:
EY-Parthenon is a leading global strategy consultancy. We are committed to bringing unconventional yet pragmatic thinking together with our clients, to deliver actionable strategies for real impact in today’s complex business landscape. At EY-Parthenon, we work with corporate and private equity clients to enable them to reinvent themselves for a better future.

The exceptional EY experience. It's yours to build.

The Opportunity: Your Next Adventure Awaits?

EY Parthenon provides services within the domain of mergers and acquisitions, private and public offerings, valuations, business modeling, due diligence and financial consulting. Through our independent position with respect to lenders, investors, and investment bankers, our team of professionals is ideally placed to successfully support corporate transactions.

Within EY Parthenon, our Mergers and Acquisitions team is looking to reinforce the team with talented professionals in a Manager Mergers and Acquisitions role.

Key responsibilities

As a Manager Mergers & Acquisitions, you will be responsible for managing the execution on selected transactions as well as support and initiate business origination efforts in close cooperation with the M&A leadership. Your key tasks and responsibilities will include:

- Transaction execution - take the lead in key workstreams such as the drafting of all marketing materials (information memorandum, teaser, management presentation, etc.), client management, financial modeling etc. as well support in the negotiation of transaction documentation;

- Origination - initiate origination ideas by following key trends as well as by building sector knowledge and supporting strategic dialogues with potential clients;

- The team - contribute in the further development of the M&A team by sharing knowledge and best practices with the rest of team while continuously monitoring new evolutions in tools, analysis etc.

To qualify for the role you must have

- Master’s degree in finance, economics, business or related subject;

- 5-8 years of experience, within a consultancy firm, (investment) bank or M&A department of a large corporate;

- Team player, eager to share knowledge and help others grow, stress-resistant, entrepreneurial, pro-active and hands-on;

- Excellent communication and presentation skills, client-focused and result-oriented;

- Experienced in organization and planning throughout the M&A process;

- Strong analytical skills with good understanding of financial results and valuation techniques;

- Good knowledge of Dutch, French and English, orally and in writing;

- Very capable in PowerPoint and Excel.

What working at EY offers

- EY Family – you become part of the EY Family providing you with all the necessary skills, training and opportunities; enabling you to grow to your fullest potential.

- Attractive remuneration package - We offer an attractive remuneration package; including a company car and charging card, iPhone plus subscription, health insurance, pension plan, meal vouchers, and eco vouchers.  Thanks to our flex plan it is possible to choose what you value most.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.​

About Global Delivery Services

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.

Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.

Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.

Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.

Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Senior Consultant (Senior) with experience in delivering HR Mergers and Acquisitions / HR Transactions Projects  to join the People Consulting team. This is a great opportunity to be part of a leading global professional services organisation whilst being instrumental in the growth of the People Consulting team.

Your Key Responsibilities

- Contribute to the HR Transactions PMO by supporting project governance, tracking milestones, coordinating with global stakeholders, and ensuring timely and high-quality delivery across HR Transactions with a focus on spin-offs, carve-outs, and post-merger integration

- Assist end-to-end delivery for global transaction assignments and manage stakeholder communication across multiple time-zones

- Demonstrate strong project management skills and collaborate with stakeholders from multiple functions to align on interdependencies

- Showcase technical and analytical expertise in a deal context for key HR aspects: HR Operations, Labor Relations and Compliance, Organisation and Talent Management, Employee Experience and Day 1 Communications

- Leverage technology including AI tools, data analytics platforms, and automation solutions - throughout the deal / M&A cycle to enhance efficiency, generate deeper insights, and deliver high-impact outcomes

- Demonstrate strong presentation skills and provide compelling deliverables tailored for global stakeholders and client leadership

- Actively support proposal development, pursuits, and RFP responses in collaboration with global teams to drive business growth

- Build and demonstrate expertise in other related areas such as HR transformation, organization change management and organisation design

- Support development of thought leadership, collateral, tools, techniques, methodologies to broaden capability offerings within the practice and enhance GDS awareness across the firm

- Produce high-quality, accurate deliverables on time

Skills and attributes for success

- High integrity and commitment to work in a new and challenging environment

- Ability to manage ambiguity and be proactive

- Strong communication and presentation skills tailored for global audiences

- Collaborative mindset, cross cultural awareness and sensitivity to work effectively with diverse teams and clients

- High energy levels, agility and adaptability to meet evolving client needs

- Open to travel nationally and internationally for client projects that are approved as per EY and country specific travel advisory guidelines

- Proficiency in leveraging technology — including AI and data analytics

- Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities to interpret complex HR data and provide actionable insights

To qualify for the role, you must have:

- 3-9 years of experience in Human Capital and HR Transactions Consulting

- Conversant with at least one full HR M&A project lifecycle, covering planning, execution, monitoring, and closure

- Good understanding of the HR landscape, including total rewards, compensation structures, country-specific compliance, organization design, and transactions’ change management principles

- Knowledge of the legal and regulatory environment relating to employee rewards and reporting related to broad based compensation and benefits

- Ability to assess post-merger or acquisition scenarios and recommend suitable HR integration approaches, including operating model alignment, workforce transition strategies, cultural harmonization, and organizational design adjustments

- Understanding of the full life-cycle of Human Resources function

- Experience in review and analysis of current scenarios and underlying assumptions and the ability to compare and contrast buyer and seller current employee offerings

- Experience in providing timely and effective reporting of findings and post deal concerns

- Ability to identify possible approach post-merger or acquisition

- Master’s or MBA degree in HR or similar

- Knowledge of data and talent management tools such as Workday and SAP SuccessFactors

- Strong Excel, PowerPoint and Power BI skills

- Proficiency in leveraging technology — including AI and data analytics

Good to have:

- Experience in one or more areas of Culture, Actuarial and Equity knowledge, workforce talent, payroll, Total Rewards, talent management and/or works councils/labor unions; international knowledge of mergers and acquisitions will be an added advantage

- Knowledge of supporting HR Due Diligence assignments

- Experience of working with consulting firms

jobs.title: EY-Parthenon - Strategy & Execution - Deal Technology - Health - Enterprise Architect - Director
jobs.description:
Location: Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dallas, Hoboken, Houston, Los Angeles, McLean, New York, San Francisco

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.  Join EY and help to build a better working world.

EY-Parthenon – Strategy & Execution – Deal Technology Health – Enterprise Architect - Director

The opportunity

EY-Parthenon’s unique combination of transformative strategy, transactions and corporate finance delivers real-world value – solutions that work in practice, not just on paper. Benefiting from EY’s full spectrum of services, we’ve reimagined strategic consulting to work in a world of increasing complexity.

With deep functional and sector expertise, paired with innovative AI-powered technology and an investor mindset, we partner with CEOs, Boards, Private Equity and Governments every step of the way – enabling you to shape your future with confidence.

As a Director in EY-Parthenon’s Strategy & Execution – Deal Technology practice focusing on Health IT, you will lead high-impact engagements that drive both cost optimization and top-line growth across complex transactions and corporate transformations. You will work with C-suite executives, private equity clients, and IT leadership to identify, plan, and execute healthcare technology-driven strategies that enable innovate delivery of patient care, operational efficiencies with health plans, optimize enterprise IT platforms and optimize operational costs while also accelerating revenue and digital innovation during mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, and carve-outs as well as value creation, enterprise re-imagine, and technology transformation initiatives . This role blends deep IT expertise with strategic insight to deliver measurable value through cost transformation, digital/AI enablement, operational efficiency, and tech-enabled growth initiatives.

Within EY-Parthenon's Strategy and Execution sub service line, the Deal Technology Health practice works on the most complex and high-profile healthcare transactions, across a broad portfolio of clients. We are a group of experienced industry professionals with a background in healthcare enterprise technology who are serial transaction and strategic advisers, which enables us to bring a wealth of deep sector and functional knowledge to our clients. This role is focused on advising the Health sector. As a team, we prepare and execute separation and integration plans, identify ideas and sources of value enhancement, as well as advise on risk mitigation and the successful change of enterprise technology platforms, operations, functions, and people.

Key responsibilities

As a Director with EY-Parthenon's Strategy and Execution Deal Technology – Health practice, you will lead value-creation technology projects that span cost optimization and growth enablement. You’ll guide clients through IT-focused strategies that enhance operational efficiency and unlock new revenue opportunities. Your role will involve advising senior stakeholders, collaborating across functions, and applying emerging technologies (Clinical and revenue cycle management platforms, AI, cloud, data analytics) to deliver measurable business impact. A strong commercial mindset and the ability to balance efficiency with innovation are essential to success in this role.

Skills and attributes for success

- Build Trusted Relationships - ability to manage senior client relationships and influence client perspectives.

- Strong Problem Solving and Storytelling - be a lead for solving problems from beginning to end (problem identification, hypothesis development, synthesis, and recommendation with a compelling narrative).

- Outcomes-driven - understand and translate client needs into approach and outcomes for project delivery.

- Effective through Collaboration - be part of project teams comprising colleagues from across the EY-Parthenon sub-service lines.

- Business and Commercially Driven - working in a fast-paced, exciting environment with strong business acumen to drive value to our clients.

- Business Development - ability to drive aspects of pursuits, including presentations and client meetings.  Contribute to our practice development initiatives, supporting the continued focus on our team as a great place to work.

- Talent Development - coach junior colleagues to become high-performing.

- Learning - learn and develop technical and personal skills to support achievement of career goals, through a blend of structured learning, coaching and experiences.

To qualify, you must have

- A bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Business Information and Operations Management, Analytics or related field and 5 years of related work experience; or a graduate degree and approximately 3 years of related work experience.

- Experience in a healthcare professional services firm or health technology company, IT strategy, digital transformation, and transaction advisory.

- Expertise in the following IT skillsets:

- Hands-on technical Implementation experience of a major acute EHR platforms (Epic or Cerner) and/or ambulatory platforms (Epic, AthenaHealth, Nextgen, eClinicalworks, etc.)

- Enterprise architecture of clinical platforms and revenue cycle management platforms including integration engines such as Cloverleaf, Mirth Connect, or Boomi

- Enterprise or solution architecture for modern enterprise/back-office and admin application platforms

- Software centric product environments (SaaS, cloud native, API based ecosystems)

- Software architecture and custom application development (e.g., Java, C#, Python, APIs, and Data lake platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Databricks, Fabric)

- Network infrastructure architecture and design (LAN/WLAN, Internet Edge, Zero Trust Security Framework), and SD-WAN

- Azure AD, EntraID, MFA, PAM/IAM experience a plus

- Certifications in TOGAF®, Agile Scrum (CSM), or ITIL, highly desired.

- Proven experience in cost optimization (e.g., AI/Digital Transformation, IT synergy planning, post-merger integration or carve-out execution) and in tech-driven growth initiatives (e.g., implementing a new digital product, scaling technology to deliver excellence of patient, provider, and employee experience).

- Ability to synthesize complex technical, financial and operational data into clear, actionable insights; balanced cost efficiency with innovative tech-driven growth strategies.

- Comprehensive understanding of IT cost structures – including TCO (total cost of ownership), shared services, outsourcing, and digital transformation levers and an ability to convert various technology/IT opportunities into dollar and financial impact.

- Experience in merger & acquisition contexts – e.g., involvement in IT due diligence, IT separation or integration projects, or identifying technology synergies in deals. Understanding deal timelines and how to realize value quickly in a deal timeline is critical.

- Leadership & Soft Skills: Proven ability to lead teams and drive change. Excellent client-facing skills with experience advising senior executives. A track record of influencing decision-makers and driving initiatives to completion, especially where technology and business strategy intersect.

- You must either reside in or be in a commutable distance to your office location for this position.

- The ability and willingness to travel and work in excess of standard hours when necessary. In certain circumstances, travel may be required beyond your work location based on client and project needs.

Ideally, you will have

- An MBA, Masters in Computer Science/Engineering, Data Analytics or other relevant advanced degree, reflecting the strategic and cross-disciplinary nature of the role.

jobs.title: EY Parthenon - Senior Consultant - Carve-out & Integration
jobs.description:
Confidence in your impact today. Freedom to build tomorrow.
At EY-Parthenon, you can be sure that you are making a difference - for your client, for society, for your colleagues and for your own development. At the same time, you will have the freedom to work in a way that fits your life. Whether you choose to specialize or broaden your expertise, you are in the driver’s seat. Together with ambitious colleagues in an open and trusted culture, you aim for the best every day. Big on opportunity, friendly in collaboration. EY-Parthenon provides the resources you need to shape your career and make an impact in your field.

Your new job | About your main responsibilities
As a Senior Consultant in EY-Parthenon’s Strategy and Execution team, you play a key role in helping clients navigate complex transactions and transformations. You work across the full deal lifecycle, covering divestments, integrations, and value creation. In this role, you support decisions that directly impact business performance and long-term value, working with leading corporates and investors on high-impact, often large-scale transactions.

We work end-to-end across the transaction lifecycle. On the sell side, we help clients prepare and separate businesses, from defining the transaction perimeter and designing standalone operating models and costing to executing the carve-out. On the buy side, we work with clients to evaluate (carved-out) acquisition targets, define integration strategies, and realize synergies. Beyond the transaction, we continue to work alongside clients to realize change, challenge status quo, capture synergies, and deliver measurable improvements in performance.

You work directly with clients on carve-outs, integrations, and transformations by structuring complex topics, advising on key decisions, and ensuring plans are translated into tangible results.

In your role, you:

- Lead and execute in-depth analyses on business performance, cost structures, and operations, translating comingled data into clear insights and actionable recommendations

- Structure complex problems and translate them into clear, actionable solutions, guiding workstreams from initial hypothesis through to implementation

- Assess organizational setups and develop robust solutions, including standalone financials, operating model designs, and separation or integration approaches

- Build robust business cases for synergies, cost optimization, and broader value creation opportunities, and support their realization

- Translate strategic priorities into concrete actions and drive their execution to deliver tangible results

- Work closely with clients to guide decision-making, align stakeholders, and maintain momentum in fast-paced, high-impact environments

- Support and develop junior team members through coaching, feedback, and hands-on guidance, helping them grow while ensuring long-term, high-quality delivery

- Collaborate with managers and senior stakeholders to refine hypotheses, challenge thinking, and steer overall project delivery

Your new team | About your colleagues and the office
Your team

In this role, you work on mergers, acquisitions, and divestitures, supporting clients on decisions that materially impact their business. This can range from targeted acquisitions to more complex, large-scale transactions. You operate at the intersection of strategy, operations, and technology, contributing to topics such as transaction strategy, operational due diligence, value creation, divestitures, and integrations, with a clear focus on delivering tangible outcomes.

You are part of a close-knit team with a shared ambition, while bringing together a variety of backgrounds and perspectives. We work in a collaborative and supportive environment, where you learn from experienced colleagues, receive regular feedback, and have the opportunity to develop yourself quickly.

Your office:  Amsterdam
Our Amsterdam office is located at the Zuidas: a bustling area full of companies. In our Cross Towers, we welcome up to 1,500 people every day. For a breathtaking view of the city, head to the 22nd floor. Collaboration takes on a new meaning in our Wavespace, a high-tech environment that connects clients and colleagues virtually across the globe.

Your skills and strengths | About your unique contribution

At EY-Parthenon, we are committed to diversity and inclusion, creating an environment where every team member feels valued and empowered to bring their unique perspectives to the table. Our values of integrity, respect, and excellence guide us in everything we do. To be successful in this role we typically see:

- A minimum of 2-3 years relevant M&A experience or corporate transformations, preferably from corporate M&A teams, strategy consulting or big 4 firms

- A Master’s degree in a Science, Engineering or Business Administration related field

- Knowledge of and experience with operational aspects of M&A including due diligence, planning, synergies, value creation and / or post close transformation

- An aptitude for qualitative and quantitative analysis and the ability to link business strategy to performance

- The ability to lead and communicate effectively with sound reasoning, preferably in client facing roles

Your benefits | About your perks and work enjoyment

- A competitive salary that reflects your role and responsibilities, depending on experience and qualifications. Plus, a solid pension plan for the future. In addition to your salary, you receive holiday allowance and an annual bonus (based on performance and development).

- You receive a permanent   contract for 40 hours .

- A laptop and phone for both work and personal use, and a monthly internet allowance.

- 29 vacation days to recharge and unwind.

- With the mobility budget, you decide how you travel. Choose a lease car, a discounted public transport subscription, or arrange transport easily via our app.

- At EY, we care about a healthy work-life balance. Hybrid working makes this easier. Whether you are working from the office, at a client, or from home, we make sure you have a well-equipped home office.

- The opportunity to work up to 20 days per year from abroad.

- The option to swap 3 national holidays for non-national ones.

- You have the space to grow both personally and professionally. Whether you want to deepen your expertise, develop your personality, or improve your leadership style, we offer a broad range of trainings and courses.

- Your well-being is our priority. We believe that when you feel good, you perform better. That is why you have access to the OpenUp wellbeing platform (including for your family). You can easily connect with psychologists and lifestyle experts within 36 hours and take part in wellbeing sessions.

- A strong focus on teaming and various internal networks where you can join all kinds of social activities. A positive work atmosphere and good collaboration with colleagues contribute to your overall happiness at work.

All this within an environment where our core values of integrity, inclusiveness, and respect are central. We think it is important that you can be yourself and fully develop into the best version of yourself. Curious about all our benefits? Click  here .

Ready to shape your future with us? | About your application process

1. Application: For this vacancy, we ask you to upload a motivation letter along with your CV. This gives you the opportunity to show us your drive, motivation, and personality. At EY, we support the use of AI tools like ChatGPT, as long as your own tone and unique personality remain visible.

2. First interview: Before the interview, we will ask you to complete an online assessment. Not a standard questionnaire, but a game-based assessment focusing on both your cognitive skills and behavioral preferences. We will discuss the results during the interview, which will include a colleague from the relevant department. This mutual introduction is a chance for us to get to know you, and for you to ask any questions you have.

3. Second interview : If we see a match and you are still enthusiastic, we will invite you for a second interview. We will dive deeper into the role and other relevant topics, and you’ll be presented with a business case to assess your problem solving skills, outside the box-thinking and structured approach.

4. Third interview: You will meet two future colleagues and complete another case interview.

5. Fourth interview: A final conversation with the partner.

We’re a match. You’ll receive an offer and we’ll perform a pre-employment screening. Then your new adventure begins. Welcome to EY!

Research shows that women are less likely to apply if they don’t meet all the criteria. Please feel free to apply even if you don’t meet everything.

jobs.title: Manager / Senior Manager: HR Transactions (M&A) and Employment Law Advisory
jobs.description:
Role Purpose

EY is seeking an experienced HR Transactions and Employment Law professional to lead and grow our HR Due Diligence and Employment Law Advisory capability across South Africa and Africa.

The role supports clients and transaction teams through the full deal lifecycle by assessing workforce-related risks, employment obligations, organisational structures, leadership considerations, remuneration arrangements, labour relations exposures and operational people risks. The successful candidate will also provide employment law and labour relations advisory services to multinational and local clients across a broad range of workforce matters.

This role works closely with EY Transaction Diligence, Tax, Legal, People Consulting and broader advisory teams to help clients make informed investment, restructuring, integration and workforce decisions.

Key Responsibilities

HR Due Diligence and Transactions

- Lead and deliver HR due diligence engagements for mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, carve-outs and restructuring transactions.

- Manage the end-to-end HR due diligence process.

- Develop scopes of work, proposals and fee estimates.

- Conduct management interviews and coordinate information requests.

- Review workforce, organisational and remuneration data.

- Assess leadership structures, key talent dependencies and workforce risks.

- Evaluate employee relations, labour law and industrial relations matters.

- Review compensation, benefits, incentives and employment-related liabilities.

- Prepare clear, commercially focused risk assessments and executive reports for investors and corporate clients.

- Present key findings and recommendations to clients and deal teams.

- Support post-deal integration, separation and employee transfer planning.

Employment Law Advisory

- Provide practical and commercially focused employment law support across South Africa and, where required, African jurisdictions.

- Advise on labour and employment legislation and its application to client circumstances.

- Draft and review employment contracts, workplace policies and related employment documentation.

- Advise on restructures, retrenchments, workforce transfers and organisational redesign.

- Support clients with disciplinary, grievance, industrial relations and general employee relations matters.

- Advise on the employment aspects of cross-border projects and corporate transactions.

- Develop and deliver employment law training and thought leadership.

- Work collaboratively with EY legal, tax, transaction and people specialists on multidisciplinary engagements.

Business Development and Market Leadership

- Develop trusted client relationships and identify new advisory and transaction opportunities.

- Prepare proposals, scopes of work and engagement documentation.

- Build strong relationships with Transaction Diligence, Strategy and Transactions, Legal, Tax and People Consulting teams.

- Support the growth of EY’s HR Transactions and Employment Law Advisory offering in South Africa and Africa.

- Develop market-facing content, methodologies and thought leadership.

Project and Team Leadership

- Lead multiple engagements simultaneously while maintaining delivery quality and responsiveness.

- Manage engagement budgets, timelines, economics and risk requirements.

- Coach and develop junior team members and multidisciplinary delivery teams.

- Drive quality, consistency and commercial relevance across client deliverables.

- Build scalable methodologies, templates, knowledge assets and delivery processes.

Skills and Experience Required

Technical Skills

- Strong employment law, labour relations and employee relations expertise.

- Experience in HR due diligence, transactions or related workforce advisory services.

- Understanding of mergers and acquisitions, restructures and corporate transactions.

- Ability to assess organisational structures, remuneration arrangements, workforce costs and employment-related risks.

- Excellent analytical, report-writing and executive presentation skills.

- Proven experience in preparing proposals, managing engagements and producing high-quality client deliverables.

- Strong commercial judgement and the ability to translate technical findings into practical business recommendations.

Preferred Experience

- Significant relevant experience in consulting, legal advisory, people consulting, HR transactions, employment law or labour relations.

- Experience working on corporate transactions and due diligence assignments.

- Experience managing senior client stakeholders and multidisciplinary teams.

- Exposure to African and cross-border employment matters would be advantageous.

- Experience in business development and building an advisory pipeline would be advantageous.

Qualifications

- An LLB, labour law, human resources, industrial psychology or other relevant qualification.

- A relevant postgraduate qualification in employment or labour law would be advantageous.

- Admission as an attorney would be advantageous but is not essential where the candidate has strong practical employment law and HR transactions experience.

Key Attributes

- Commercially minded and able to operate at the intersection of people, transactions and law.

- Confident, credible and comfortable engaging with senior executives, investors and deal teams.

- Highly analytical, detail-oriented and able to identify the issues that may affect deal value, execution or integration.

- An effective communicator who can explain complex matters clearly and concisely.

- Collaborative and able to work across service lines, countries and professional disciplines.

- Proactive, adaptable and able to deliver under demanding transaction timelines.

Success Measures

- Growth in HR Due Diligence and Employment Law Advisory revenue and market presence.

- High-quality, timely and commercially relevant client advice and deliverables.

- Strong relationships with clients and EY transaction, tax, legal and people teams.

- Effective conversion of opportunities into engagements.

- Development of a scalable HR Transactions capability across South Africa and Africa.

- Consistently strong client satisfaction, engagement quality and risk management outcomes.

- Development and retention of capable team members.

Why This Role Matters

This position sits at the intersection of people, transactions and law. The role helps clients understand and mitigate workforce-related risks while identifying opportunities to protect and create value during acquisitions, restructures and business transformations. It is a highly visible, client-facing role with the opportunity to build a differentiated HR Transactions and Employment Law Advisory capability within EY Africa.

jobs.description:
We are the only professional services organisation who has a separate business dedicated exclusively to the financial services marketplace. Join Financial Services (FSO) and you will work with multi-disciplinary teams from around the world to deliver a global perspective. Aligned to key industry groups including asset management, banking and capital markets, insurance and private equity, we provide integrated consulting, assurance, tax, and transaction services.

Join this team and you will provide clients with traditional actuarial services (e.g., reserving, pricing and mergers and acquisition support), as well as leading edge services such as financial reporting and measurement, financial risk management, modelling, hedging, reinsurance, securitization, economic capital and solvency.

With so many offerings, you have the opportunity to develop your career through a broad scope of engagements, mentoring and formal learning. That’s how we develop outstanding leaders who team to deliver on our promises to all of our stakeholders, and in so doing, play a critical role in building a better working world for our people, for our clients and for our communities. Sound interesting? Well this is just the beginning. Because whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime.

The opportunity

As part of our non-life (GI) actuarial team, you’ll focus on high-impact opportunities to apply your knowledge and experience that will shape our services. You’ll build valuable relationships with clients and develop strong capabilities, through both formal training and working with senior mentors and talented colleagues. You will be at the forefront of issues that are shaping the insurance industry in Asia and gain a wide exposure to a diverse range of actuarial projects.

Your key responsibilities

As a Senior Associate in the Actuarial Consulting team, you will be assisting and leading the delivery of a wide range of client engagements, leading or working as part of a project team, relating to, Merger & Acquisitions (M&A) and due diligence; valuation, pricing and product development and regulatory changes. You will also be performing evaluation in areas related to financial risk, product distribution and capital issues.

Skills and attributes for success

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

- Strong drive to excel professionally, and to guide and motivate others

- Advanced written and verbal communication skills

- Dedicated, innovative, resourceful, analytical and able to work under pressure

- Foster an efficient, innovative and team-oriented work environment

To qualify for the role you must have

- Minimum 2 years of experience in the non-life actuarial team or an actuarial consulting firm. Candidates with lesser experience will be considered for Associate position

- Good exam progress with either the Institute and Faculty of Actuaries (UK), Casualty Actuarial Society (CAS), the Society of Actuaries (SoA) or the Institute of Actuaries of Australia

- Good written and verbal communication skills

Ideally, you’ll also have

- Depth of experience in at least one of the following areas from a Non-Life perspective:

- financial modeling

- financial and regulatory reporting

- reserving

- product pricing and distribution strategy

- ERM / solvency framework/ statutory capital

- M&A due diligence

- IFRS 17

What we look for

Highly motivated individuals with excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to prioritize shifting workloads in a rapidly changing industry. An effective communicator, you’ll be a confident team player equipped with strong people management skills and a genuine passion to make things happen in a dynamic organization. If you’re ready to take on a wide range of responsibilities, and are committed to seeking out new ways to make a difference, this role is for you.

M&A Senior Consultant – ERP

Let us introduce you the job offer by EY GDS Poland – a member of the global integrated service delivery center network by EY.

We are looking for a M&A Senior Consultant for ERP to support complex transformation and separation programs, including large-scale divestitures acting as a trusted advisor to clients throughout the full lifecycle of separation initiatives. In this role, you will primarily focus on defining the approach, shaping solutions, and guiding execution. You will help clients understand required changes across their technology landscape, business processes, and operating models, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives.

Our team is one of largest M&A groups of advisors, focusing on transformation advice for private and public clients. Our deep sector knowledge, our global network with local market experts, enable us to add real value to our client’s projects.

- Support end-to-end ERP workstreams in strategic and complex transformations, or M&A transactions

jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Confidence in your impact today. Freedom to build tomorrow.
At EY-Parthenon, you can be sure that you’re making a difference – for your client, for society, for your colleagues and for your own development. At the same time, you’ll have the freedom to work in a way that fits your life. Whether you choose to specialize, broaden your expertise or grow into leadership, you’re in the driver’s seat. Together with ambitious colleagues in an open and trusted culture, you aim for the best every day. Big on opportunity, friendly in collaboration. EY provides the resources you need to shape your career and make an impact in your field.

Your new job | About your main responsibilities

Leverage your expertise as a senior consultant / manager in Financial Due Diligence and make a difference in the transaction world.  With us, you will have the opportunity to conduct in-depth financial analyses and provide valuable insights to the owners and management teams of our clients. As part of our team, you will be involved in assessing financial information, identifying risks and opportunities, and presenting clear reports. Do you want to use your financial expertise to contribute to successful transactions?

- You will analyze the historical and projected results of the company, its financial position, and other complex issues, using data analytics, combining insights from various sources, and conducting interviews.

- By analyzing (projected) EBITDA, working capital levels, and balance sheet positions, you will map out the value drivers, opportunities, and risks of the company.

- Together with the team, you will translate your conclusions into specific points of attention for the valuation and structuring of the transaction. This will provide input for negotiations regarding the purchase price and terms of the transaction.

- You will be the critical link in the M&A process with your team, maintaining close contact with other advisors, both within and outside EY, and other stakeholders in the transaction.

- Contribute to the development of the team, both professionally and informally, and play a role in building client relationships.

Your new team | About your colleagues and the office

Mergers and acquisitions are among the most complex projects for a company, with significant strategic impact. The risks associated with such a transaction can be substantial, with many factors influencing the success and speed of the transaction. To avoid the well-known "cat in the bag," the buyer must conduct thorough research into the financial, commercial, operational, tax and legal aspects of the company to be acquired. The specialists in Transaction Diligence act as a spider in the web when conducting financial due diligence investigations.

Your office

Zwolle
Our office in Zwolle was recently renovated and feels fresh and modern. Its location right off the highway makes it easily accessible. Inside, there’s a friendly and welcoming atmosphere, and thanks to its compact size, you’ll quickly get to know everyone. A great place to work together and stay connected.

Your skills and strengths | About your unique contribution

- You have at least 3-5 years of work experience and have an affinity for mergers and acquisitions, corporate finance, and the financial world in general.

- You hold a master’s degree in finance, (Financial) Economics, Finance & Investments, Accounting & Financial Management, or another finance-oriented or technical field.

- You are proficient in both Dutch and English, both spoken and written.

- You are experienced with Microsoft Office and Excel and have an affinity for working with new data analysis tools (Alteryx and Power BI).

- You have experience with managing or coaching junior colleagues and enjoy helping others grow their knowledge.

Your benefits | About your perks and work enjoyment

- A competitive salary that reflects your role and responsibilities, depending on experience and qualifications. Plus, a solid pension plan for the future. In addition to your salary, you’ll receive holiday allowance and an annual bonus (based on performance and development).

- You’ll receive a permanent contract for 40 hours .

- A laptop and phone for both work and personal use, and a monthly internet allowance.

- 29-34 vacation days to recharge and unwind, plus the option to buy extra days.

- With the mobility budget, you decide how you travel. Choose a lease car, a discounted public transport subscription, or arrange transport easily via our app.

- At EY, we care about a healthy work-life balance. Hybrid working makes this easier. Whether you're working from the office, at a client, or from home, we’ll make sure you have a well-equipped home office.

- The opportunity to work up to 20 days per year from abroad.

- The option to swap 3 national holidays for non-national ones.

- You’ll have the space to grow both personally and professionally. Whether you want to deepen your expertise, develop your personality, or improve your leadership style, we offer a broad range of trainings and courses.

- Your well-being is our priority. We believe that when you feel good, you perform better. That’s why you’ll have access to the OpenUp wellbeing platform (including for your family). You can easily connect with psychologists and lifestyle experts within 36 hours and take part in wellbeing sessions.

- A strong focus on teaming and various internal networks where you can join all kinds of social activities. A positive work atmosphere and good collaboration with colleagues contribute to your overall happiness at work.

All this within an environment where our core values of integrity, inclusiveness, and respect are central. We think it’s important that you can be yourself and fully develop into the best version of yourself. Curious about all our benefits? Click  here .

Ready to shape your future with us? | About your application process

- For this vacancy, we ask you to upload a motivation letter along with your CV. This gives you the opportunity to show us your drive, motivation, and personality. At EY, we support the use of AI tools like ChatGPT, as long as your own tone and unique personality remain visible.

- Our first contact: After your application, our recruiter will call you within seven days for a short introduction. We’ll explore whether the role could be a good match.

- First interview: Before the interview, we’ll ask you to complete an online assessment. Not a standard questionnaire, but a game-based assessment focusing on both your cognitive skills and behavioral preferences. We’ll discuss the results during the interview, which will include a colleague from the relevant department. This mutual introduction is a chance for us to get to know you, and for you to ask any questions you have.

- Second interview: If we see a match and you’re still enthusiastic, we’ll invite you for a second interview. We’ll dive deeper into the role and other relevant topics. Sometimes, a business case is part of the process. A final interview may also follow.

- We’re a match. You’ll receive an offer and we’ll perform a pre-employment screening. Then your new adventure begins. Welcome to EY!

Research shows that women are less likely to apply if they don’t meet all the criteria. Please feel free to apply even if you don’t meet everything.

jobs.title: Senior Associate (Manager), M&A (Montreal)
jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity

Running a business is all about making intelligent decisions, powered by accurate information. As a Mergers & Acquisitions (“M&A”) Senior Associate (Manager), you’ll help make that happen. You will be an important part of our talented and highly experienced team and work at the forefront of high-profile transactions.

EY has an established industry leading M&A Practice. Within the M&A group, we offer expertise in mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, financing and valuations and advise clients on all aspects of strategic transaction and capital sourcing activities. When you join our industry-leading team, you’ll be working with leading business tools and methodologies to provide strategic advice to some of the most sophisticated clients around. We are a growing practice that has the resources to serve any client, anywhere in the world.

This job posting relates to an existing vacancy within our organization.

Your key responsibilities:

As a Senior Associate (Manager), you will have the opportunity to be involved in the execution of the M&A process, from deal sourcing to closure. The role of a Senior Associate (Manager) within EY’s M&A group is challenging and fast paced, that requires dedication and a strong work ethic. Your key responsibilities will include:

- Perform market research and analysis, including analysis of key business drivers and market, competition and industry risk and opportunity analysis.

- Synthesize research information such as comparable company and precedent transactions to be used in modeling, competitive analysis, industry analysis, potential buyers, negotiation support and various other applications.

- Prepare detailed financial models, including scenario analysis.

- Prepare valuation analysis using a range of valuation techniques, including discounted cash flow analysis, comparable market multiples and precedent transaction analysis.

- Prepare quality first drafts of pitches, marketing materials, management presentations and client presentations.

- Oversee an electronic data room and manage a due diligence process for buy and sell side engagements, working closely with client and target personnel.

- Provide strategic advice to clients across a range of industries and transactions.

- Support the VPs and SVPs in identifying and exploring potential new business.

Skills and attributes for success

We are looking for candidates who are highly motivated, analytical, logical thinkers with a passion for transactions and have a very strong attention to detail. Being a strong team player is critical with the ability to adapt to changing requirements or deadlines in support of our clients’ goals.

To be successful in this role, you should have the following attributes:

- This role involves interaction with clients operating nationally and globally. Bilingualism in both French and English is therefore a requirement of this role.

- Working knowledge of the Canadian and International Finance and Accounting concepts and understanding of key business drivers, principally as they relate to M&A transactions.

- Strong Word, Excel, PowerPoint and financial modeling skills.

- Ability to work independently to complete tasks.

- An ability to work well under pressure with multiple competing deadlines, while maintaining attention to detail.

- Ability to develop relationships and liaison with EY colleagues and team members to achieve premium outcomes for our clients.

- A “roll up the sleeves” attitude.

- A passion for working with entrepreneurs and private business owners and management teams.

To qualify for the role, you must have

- Undergraduate degree in Business, Finance, Accounting or another similar program.

- Minimum 6+ years of relevant work experience (e.g. Investment banking, M&A, financing, corporate development, financial analysis, etc.).

Ideally, you’ll also have

A professional designation, such as the:

- CPA designation;

- CBV designation or progress towards the completion of the CBV program of studies; or

- CFA designation or progress towards the completion of the CFA program of studies

What we offer you

We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. In addition, our Total Rewards package allows you decide which benefits are right for you and which ones help you create a solid foundation for your future. Our Total Rewards package includes a discretionary bonus program, a comprehensive medical, prescription drug and dental coverage plan, a defined contribution pension plan, a great vacation policy plus firm paid days that allow you to enjoy longer long weekends throughout the year, statutory holidays and paid personal days (based on province of residence), and a range of exciting programs and benefits designed to support your physical, financial and social well-being. Plus, we offer:

- Support and coaching from some of the most engaging colleagues in the industry

- Learning opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career

- The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

To help create the best experience during the recruitment process, please describe any accommodations you may need.

Inclusiveness at EY

Inclusiveness is at the heart of who we are and how we work. We’re committed to fostering an environment where differences are valued, policies and practices are equitable, and our people feel a sense of belonging. We embrace diversity and are committed to combating systemic racism, advancing gender equity and women in leadership, advocating for the 2SLGBTQIA+ community, promoting our neuroinclusion and accessibility initiatives, and are dedicated to amplifying the voices of Indigenous peoples (First Nations, Inuit, and Métis) nationally as we strive towards reconciliation. Our diverse experiences, abilities, backgrounds, and perspectives make our people unique and help guide us. Because when people feel free to be their authentic selves at work, they bring their best and are empowered to build a better working world.

Learn about our commitment to Inclusiveness at  https://www.ey.com/en_ca/about-us/corporate-responsibility/equity

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

At EY, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools as one element of our recruitment process to enhance efficiency and improve the candidate experience. While AI supports us in our process, human judgment and decision-making remain integral in our candidate experience. We are committed to the responsible use of AI, and our practices are continuously reviewed and refined to ensure they align with ethical principles and regulatory requirements.

jobs.title: FSO - Technology Consulting - Integration Lead (Core Banking / Core Insurance)
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are seeking an experienced individual to drive integration of next-generation core system with downstream applications and systems across different business segments (e.g. Retail, SME, and Commercial).
This role is responsible for designing, planning, and executing the integration of legacy systems, third-party platforms, and modern cloud-native applications as part of a core system modernisation initiative.
You will lead the integration architecture, coordinate cross-functional technical teams, manage interfaces across internal and external systems, and ensure secure, scalable, and reliable integrations.
This role is essential to ensuring end-to-end system interoperability and smooth business operations across a highly regulated enterprise environment.

The Opportunity

Join our growing Financial Services, Technology Consulting team to play a key role in core system modernisation. This full-time role provides the chance to work alongside a high-performing team of consultants, architects, and domain specialists, leveraging cutting-edge tools and methodologies to deliver transformative outcomes for our clients.
You will have the opportunity to shape our client’s digital future, helping them unlock value from their data and systems to remain competitive in a rapidly evolving industry.

Key Responsibilities

Integration Leadership

- Define integration strategy, architecture, and approach aligned with project objectives and program timelines

- Serve as the primary liaison between clients, core banking vendors, third-party providers, and internal teams for all integration matters

- Oversee the end-to-end integration lifecycle between core banking platforms and supporting applications (e.g. payments, CRM, digital channels, and third-party services)

Collaboration & Coordination

- Coordinate with technical leads, business analysts, and solution architects to ensure consistent and reliable integration across all workstreams

- Guide planning for system integration testing (SIT/UAT), interface validation, and operational readiness

- Identify integration risks and dependencies early, and facilitate timely mitigation in collaboration with stakeholders

Governance & Reporting

- Provide regular updates to senior leadership and governance forums on integration progress, challenges, and resolutions

- Ensure adherence to integration standards, best practices, and compliance requirements throughout the project lifecycle

Required Qualifications

Education & Technical Skills

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field

- Over 8 years of experience in core system integration or related system implementation and project management experience

- Proven expertise with next-generation core system platforms and integration frameworks (e.g. API-led, middleware, messaging layers)

- Understanding of modern core system architectures, including cloud-enabled, modular, and scalable systems

- Strong knowledge of integration patterns, data flows, synchronization strategies, and interface management

- Deep understanding of financial services core modules, such as:

- Banking  (e.g. CASA, Deposits, Loans, Payments, Customer, Treasury)

- Familiarity with banking operations, business processes, and regulatory reporting (e.g., financial accounting, CCRIS, STATsmart, MFRS9, PIDM, EAL)

- Insurance  (e.g. Policy administration, Underwriting, Claims Management, Payments, Re-insurance)

- Treasury  (e.g. Customer, Trade Booking, Trade Event, Settlement, Post Settlement)

Professional Certification

- TOGAF or similar enterprise architecture certification

- Relevant cloud certifications (e.g., AWS, Azure, or GCP)

- Agile, SAFe, or ITIL certifications a plus

Leadership & Soft Skills

- Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience coordinating multiple vendors, internal teams, and senior client leadership

- Excellent communication, strategic planning, and decision-making capabilities

- Problem-solving mindset with a strong sense of ownership and accountability

- Ability to work under pressure and manage competing priorities

What We Offer You

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

EY's financial services practice provides integrated Consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, retail banks, investment banks, broker-dealers & asset management firms, and insurance firms from leading Fortune 500 Companies.
