Role : AI/Data Platform Engineering Manager

Experience Guide : Guide / 10+ years

Primary Skill Area : Enterprise Platforms: Databricks, Snowflake, MS Fabric & Autonomous Data Engineering

The opportunity

Lead enterprise-scale Data, AI, and Aladdin platform engineering programmes across Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, and cloud ecosystems. The Manager is accountable for solution strategy, delivery leadership, Aladdin integration and onboarding, stakeholder engagement, platform operating model, governance, data quality, security, service integration, Git-based engineering, SRE practices, AI/agentic enablement, and capability growth for modern data platforms.

Your key responsibilities

- Lead end-to-end delivery of enterprise data platform and Aladdin integration programs across cloud, big data, governance, analytics, and AI-enabled engineering ecosystems.

- Drive data discovery, asset alignment, onboarding strategy, and integration planning for Aladdin inbound and outbound services, ensuring alignment with client requirements and BlackRock specifications.

- Act as the primary liaison between clients, BlackRock, architects, business stakeholders, and engineering teams to conduct requirements workshops, data parity discussions, solution reviews, and delivery governance.

- Define solution roadmaps, delivery milestones, operating models, and implementation strategies across Aladdin programs, including Early Look, Early Win, and subsequent onboarding phases.

- Translate business requirements into scalable data engineering, integration, compliance, reporting, and platform solutions leveraging modern architectures including Lakehouse, Data Fabric, Semantic Layer, and AI-ready data platforms.

- Lead the design and implementation of robust data pipelines, ingestion frameworks, APIs, workflow orchestration, scheduling, metadata-driven processing, and cross-platform integrations supporting Aladdin services.

- Drive data quality, reconciliation, audit, compliance, and control frameworks to ensure data accuracy, completeness, traceability, regulatory adherence, and successful data parity outcomes.

- Establish metadata-driven monitoring, observability, lineage, logging, operational reporting, and Data SRE practices to improve platform reliability, transparency, and operational resilience.

- Oversee platform performance, Spark optimization, dependency management, workload scalability, production readiness, incident management, and root cause analysis for large-scale data processing environments.

- Define and enforce engineering standards across Git, CI/CD, Infrastructure-as-Code, DevOps, automation, testing, deployment, release management, and environment governance.

- Lead cloud deployment, application onboarding, infrastructure integration, security controls, and platform enablement across Azure, AWS, Microsoft Fabric, and enterprise technology ecosystems.

- Drive data governance, privacy, security, access management, metadata management, lineage, auditability, and compliance requirements in partnership with architecture, risk, cyber, and regulatory stakeholders.

- Evaluate and promote the adoption of AI, Agentic AI, Fabric, GenAI, and LLMOps capabilities to accelerate metadata discovery, documentation, data quality management, monitoring, operational efficiency, and intelligent data engineering workflows.

- Identify opportunities to leverage automation, AI-assisted engineering, and reusable accelerators to simplify business processes, improve delivery efficiency, and enhance operational support models.

- Manage delivery risks, dependencies, stakeholder expectations, issue resolution, and cross-functional coordination across multiple workstreams and client engagements.

- Mentor teams, foster engineering excellence, and drive adoption of modern data platforms, Data & AI, and automation-led delivery practices.

Skills and attributes for success

Skill / capability area - Details

- Data Platforms, Architecture & Integration    -    Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, Lakehouse Architectures, Data Warehouses, Data Lakes, Enterprise Platform Integration, Data Products, Semantic Data Solutions, Modern Data Ecosystems.

- Aladdin & Investment Data Platforms   -  BlackRock Aladdin Integration, Data Onboarding, Asset Alignment, Data Discovery, Data Parity Validation, Reconciliation, Compliance & Reporting Processes, Investment Data Management, Inbound and Outbound Data Services.

- Platform Strategy & Delivery Leadership      -       Platform Roadmaps, Operating Models, Delivery Governance, Stakeholder Management, Enterprise Architecture Alignment, Risk Management, Production Readiness, Technical Leadership and Capability Development.

- AI, GenAI & Agentic Enablement       -       Cortex AI, Databricks AI/BI & Genie, Mosaic AI, Fabric Copilot, Azure AI Foundry, RAG, Graph RAG, Agentic AI, LLMOps, AI Governance, Responsible AI, AI-enabled Engineering and Automation.

- Engineering & Integration      -       APIs, Data Integration Patterns, Event-Driven Architectures, CDC, Git, CI/CD, Infrastructure-as-Code, Automation Frameworks, Release Management, Solution Design and Architecture Reviews

- Cloud & DevOps   -  Azure, AWS, GCP, Terraform/Open Tofu, Kubernetes, Docker, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Policy-as-Code, Platform Automation, Enterprise Scheduling and Orchestration Solutions.

- Governance, Security & Reliability    -     RBAC/ABAC, Immuta, Microsoft Purview, Collibra, Data Classification, Lineage, Audit Controls, Data Privacy, Regulatory Compliance, Data Quality, Observability, Data SRE, FinOps, Platform Reliability

- Client & Stakeholder Management    -      Requirements Workshops, Data Parity Discussions, BlackRock Engagement, Business & Technology Alignment, Cross-Platform Coordination, Delivery Planning, Dependency Management and Executive Communication.

To qualify for the role, you must have

- Relevant experience guide: Guide / 10+ years

- 10+ years in data engineering, cloud data platforms, AI platforms, platform engineering, enterprise architecture or delivery leadership.

- Strong hands-on understanding of platform architecture, APIs, enterprise integration, Git/CI-CD, data security, governance, SRE operations and AI/agentic engineering.

- Experience delivering investment data platform integrations, including data onboarding, data parity, reconciliation, compliance/reporting workflows, and preferably BlackRock Aladdin inbound/outbound data integration solutions.

- Preferred certifications aligned to cloud architecture, data engineering, DevOps, security, AI/ML, governance and platform-specific technologies.

Ideally, you'll also have

- Acts as trusted advisor to senior stakeholders while staying credible in architecture and engineering discussions.

- Experience leading complex data integration and transformation programs involving multiple stakeholders, vendors, and client teams.

- Understanding of investment management data ecosystems, including data onboarding, reconciliation, compliance/reporting processes, and exposure to BlackRock Aladdin integration programs

- Balances strategy, delivery governance, team leadership, platform operations and hands-on technology judgement.

- Comfortable building future-ready autonomous data engineering capability and mentoring teams through emerging AI-native practices.

- Proven ability to manage cross-functional teams, delivery milestones, dependencies, risks, and governance across large-scale data programs.

- Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with experience leading business requirement workshops, solution reviews, and executive-level discussions.

- Balances strategy, delivery governance, team leadership, platform operations and hands-on technology judgement.

- Demonstrates a collaborative mindset and drives innovation through automation, standardization, and continuous improvement initiatives.

jobs.title: Technology Consulting & Business Development Consultant - EY GDS Spain
jobs.description:
The opportunity

Join EY GDS Spain as a Senior Manager in Technology Strategy & Consulting and become a key contributor to high-impact international engagements. This role offers a unique opportunity to operate at the intersection of technology, business strategy, and business development, working directly with senior stakeholders, Partners, and clients to shape technology-driven solutions.

As a member of our team in the EY GDS Spain office in Malaga under a hybrid system (two times per week in the office) , you will collaborate closely with other teams, supporting strategic consulting engagements, technology transformation initiatives, and business development opportunities. This is a high-level consulting role that requires strong business acumen, broad technology understanding, and the ability to engage confidently with C-level stakeholders.

Your key responsibilities

You will play a critical role in helping clients solve complex business challenges through technology-enabled strategies and transformation initiatives.

- Lead and support IT strategy and technology consulting engagements across a variety of industries.

- Participate in business development, sales, and pre-sales activities, helping shape proposals and client solutions.

- Understand client needs and translate business challenges into technology-enabled recommendations and transformation roadmaps.

- Advise clients on areas such as IT strategy, operating models, technology governance, and application landscapes.

- Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and contribute to strategic decision-making processes.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design integrated solutions that align business objectives with technology capabilities.

- Manage multiple initiatives simultaneously, ensuring high-quality deliverables and client satisfaction.

Skills and attributes for success

-
Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving abilities, with the capability to simplify complex business and technology challenges.

-
Excellent presentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills, particularly with executive and C-level audiences.

-
Strong consulting mindset with the ability to navigate ambiguity and adapt to changing client priorities.

-
Ability to combine technology understanding with business and financial perspectives.

-
Proven ability to influence decision-making and communicate effectively across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

-
Agile and collaborative approach to working in international and multicultural environments.

To qualify for the role, you must have

-
10+ years of experience within a Big Four, consulting firm, or technology advisory environment.

-
Proven experience in IT Strategy, Technology Consulting, Digital Transformation, or Technology Advisory.

-
Experience supporting or leading pre-sales, proposal development, business development, or commercial activities.

-
Strong experience engaging with senior client stakeholders and executive leadership teams.

-
Broad understanding of technology architecture, IT operating models, and business technology alignment.

-
Experience working across large and complex transformation portfolios.

-
Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

Ideally, you’ll also have

-
Intermediate or advanced level of French or German.

-
Experience within industries such as Pharmaceuticals, Life Sciences, Manufacturing, Consumer Products, or other complex enterprise environments.

-
Exposure to Enterprise Architecture, Technology Strategy, Vendor Strategy, or Technology Operating Models.

-
Experience working in international consulting environments.

-
Relevant technology or consulting certifications.

What we look for

We are looking for a commercially minded consulting professional who combines strong business acumen with a solid understanding of technology. The ideal candidate is comfortable engaging with senior executives, shaping client opportunities, and translating complex business challenges into practical technology strategies.

Success in this role requires a blend of consulting expertise, strategic thinking, communication skills, and the ability to contribute both to business development efforts and the successful delivery of client engagements.

What we offer

In EY GDS Spain, we’re committed to fostering a vibrant environment where every team member can thrive. We provide a space for continuous learning and the flexibility to define your own success, empowering you to make a meaningful impact in your own way. Our diverse and inclusive culture values who you are and encourages you to help others find their voice.

Additionally, here’s what makes us stand out:

- Empowering Career Development : Unlock your potential with tailored training and development programs designed to elevate your skills and propel your career forward. We invest in your growth because your success is our success.

- Flexible Work-Life Integration : Enjoy the freedom of our hybrid work model, allowing you to blend professional responsibilities with personal passions. We understand that life is more than just work, and we support you in achieving that balance.

- Comprehensive Well-Being Programs : Prioritize your health with our extensive wellness initiatives, including psychological support sessions and health resources. At EY GDS Spain, your well-being is at the heart of what we do.

- Meaningful Volunteering Opportunities : Make a difference in your community through our engaging volunteering programs. Join us in giving back and creating a positive impact while building connections with like-minded colleagues.

- Recognized Performance and Rewards : Celebrate your achievements with our recognition programs that honor both individual and team successes. We believe in acknowledging hard work and dedication, ensuring you feel valued every step of the way.

Join us at EY GDS Spain, where your journey is supported, your contributions are celebrated, and your future is bright.

To learn more about what we offer, visit our  Careers in Global Delivery Services | EY - Global

About EY GDS

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is the hub of innovation, a technology powerhouse, a global talent center and a driver of operational excellence within EY, propelling EY’s purpose of building a better working world. With a robust network spread across 8 countries and 21 cities, EY GDS’ dynamic network of highly talented professionals leverage data, AI, and leading-edge technology to enhance EY's wide array of services in Assurance, Consulting, Tax and EY-Parthenon.

By seamlessly integrating with EY member firms across the globe, EY GDS contributes significantly to EY's purposeful and sustainable growth, delivering insights and solutions that foster trust in capital markets and create value for EY clients, society, and the planet.

EY GDS is all in to shape the future with confidence, addressing today's challenges, and anticipating tomorrow's needs. EY GDS is not just reimagining the future of work—it's actively building it, ensuring agility, efficiency, and resilience in an ever-evolving world.

If you are interested in being part of our team, we kindly invite you to submit your CV in English to apply for this position.

The exceptional EY GDS experience. It’s yours to build.

jobs.title: Manager Strategy & Operations - Public Operations
jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Zeker van je impact vandaag | Vrij om te bouwen aan morgen

Publieke organisaties staan voor complexe maatschappelijke opgaven en tegelijkertijd voor de uitdaging om hun dienstverlening, uitvoering en prestaties continu te verbeteren. Als Manager Strategy & Operations help je organisaties om strategische ambities te vertalen naar concrete verbeteringen in de dagelijkse praktijk.

Je ondersteunt opdrachtgevers bij het verbeteren van sturing, samenwerking, processen en organisatie-inrichting. Zo draag je bij aan duurzame verandering en maatschappelijke impact voor burgers, bedrijven en publieke professionals.

Jouw nieuwe baan | Over je belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden

Als Manager Strategy & Operations leid je complexe verbeter- en verandertrajecten binnen publieke organisaties. Je vertaalt strategie en beleid naar uitvoerbare veranderagenda’s en begeleidt organisaties bij vraagstukken op het gebied van governance, operating models, procesverbetering, prestatiesturing en organisatieontwikkeling.

Je bent een strategisch gesprekspartner voor managementteams en senior stakeholders en weet complexe vraagstukken terug te brengen tot duidelijke keuzes en concrete resultaten. Daarnaast stuur je projectteams aan, begeleid je consultants in hun ontwikkeling en draag je actief bij aan de groei van onze dienstverlening en proposities binnen Public Operations.

Jouw nieuwe baan | Over je belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden

Als Manager Strategy & Operations ben je verantwoordelijk voor het optimaliseren van operationele processen en het bevorderen van een cultuur van continue verbetering binnen de organisatie.

- Je analyseert operationele metrics en gebruikt data om verbeterpunten te identificeren en strategische beslissingen te onderbouwen.

- Je werkt effectief samen met verschillende afdelingen zoals strategie, productie, planning en control & finance.

- Door jouw leiderschap en analytische vaardigheden zorg je ervoor dat de organisatie haar operationele doelstellingen en KPI's behaalt. Daarnaast motiveer je collega’s en begeleid je hen in hun ontwikkeling.

Jouw nieuwe team | Over je collega’s en het kantoor

Binnen de afdeling Operations zetten wij onze expertise in om organisaties te ondersteunen bij het optimaliseren van hun operationele processen. Wij geloven dat systeemdenken essentieel is om de onderlinge afhankelijkheden tussen verschillende afdelingen en processen te begrijpen. Met onze kennis van procesverbeteringsmethodologieën zoals Lean en Six Sigma helpen we onze klanten niet alleen met strategische aanbevelingen, maar zijn we ook actief betrokken bij de uitvoering van verbeterinitiatieven. Samen werken we aan het verhogen van de productiviteit en het realiseren van doelstellingen.

Jouw kantoor

Ons kantoor in Amsterdam bevindt zich op de Zuidas: een bruisende plek waar veel bedrijven zijn gevestigd. In onze Cross Towers worden maar liefst 1500 mensen per dag bij binnenkomst verwelkomd. Voor een adembenemend uitzicht op Amsterdam ga je naar de 22e verdieping. Samenwerken krijgt door de Wavespace een nieuwe betekenis. Deze High-Tech omgeving brengt wereldwijd klanten en collega’s virtueel samen.

Jouw vaardigheden en skills | Over je unieke bijdrage

- Je hebt minimaal 4 jaar relevante werkervaring binnen strategie, transformatie, organisatieontwikkeling of operationele verbetertrajecten, bij voorkeur in consultancy.

- Je hebt ervaring met programmamanagement, verandermanagement, governance, operating models of prestatiesturing binnen complexe organisaties, bij voorkeur in de publieke sector.

- Je bent een sterke adviseur en gesprekspartner voor managementteams en senior stakeholders.

- Je combineert analytisch vermogen en bestuurlijke sensitiviteit met een pragmatische aanpak die leidt tot duurzame resultaten.

- Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal uitstekend en hebt affiniteit met publieke organisaties.

Jouw arbeidsvoorwaarden | Over je voordelen en werkplezier

- Een passend salaris voor je rol en verantwoordelijkheid, afhankelijk van ervaring en kwalificaties. Plus, een goed pensioen. Fijn voor later. Bovenop je salaris ontvang je ook vakantiegeld en een jaarlijkse bonus (afhankelijk van resultaten en ontwikkeling).

- Je krijgt een contract voor 32-40 uur per week

- Een laptop en telefoon die je ook privé mag gebruiken en een maandelijkse internetvergoeding.

- 34 vakantiedagen, om op te laden en bij te tanken + de mogelijkheid om meer dagen te kopen.

- Met het mobiliteitsbudget bepaal jij zelf hoe je reist, kies bijvoorbeeld voor een leaseauto, een voordelig OV-abonnement of regel je vervoer eenvoudig via onze app.

- Bij EY vinden we een gezonde werk-privé balans belangrijk. Hybride werken maakt dat een stuk makkelijker. Of je nu werkt op kantoor, bij de klanten of thuis; Wij zorgen ervoor dat je een goed ingerichte thuiswerkplek krijgt.

- De mogelijkheid om 20 werkdagen per jaar vanuit het buitenland te werken.

- De mogelijkheid om 3 nationale feestdagen om te ruilen voor niet-nationale feestdagen.

- Zowel persoonlijk als professioneel krijg je alle ruimte om te groeien. Of je je nu wilt ontwikkelen in je vak, als persoon of in je leiderschapsstijl, we hebben een uitgebreid aanbod aan trainingen en opleidingen.

- Jouw gezondheid staat voorop. Wij geloven dat als je goed in je vel zit, je ook beter presteert. Zo krijg je onder andere toegang tot het wellbeing platform OpenUp (en ook jouw gezin). Je kunt hier laagdrempelig en binnen 36 uur in gesprek gaan met psychologen en lifestyle experts én kun je deelnemen aan sessies op het gebied van wellbeing.

- Veel aandacht voor teaming en verschillende interne netwerken waarmee je aan allerlei sociale activiteiten kunt deelnemen. Een fijne werksfeer en goede samenwerking met collega’s dragen immers ook bij aan jouw werkgeluk.

- Dat alles binnen een omgeving waar onze kernwaarden integriteit, inclusiviteit en respect centraal staan. We vinden het belangrijk dat je jezelf kunt zijn én je volop kunt ontwikkelen tot de beste versie van jezelf. Benieuwd naar al onze voorwaarden? Klik   hier

Jouw toekomst samen met ons vormgeven? | Over je sollicitatieproces

- Snel en eenvoudig solliciteren – Stuur ons alleen je cv. Zo maken we het jou makkelijk om snel te solliciteren.

- Kennismakingsgesprek – Binnen een week neemt onze recruiter contact met je op om te kijken of de rol bij je past.

- Online assessment – Voor het interview maak je een korte, game-based assessment die jouw cognitieve vaardigheden en gedragsvoorkeuren in kaart brengt. De resultaten bespreken we samen tijdens het interview.

- Interviews – Je eerste gesprek is met onze recruiter en een collega uit de betreffende afdeling. Dit is een wederzijdse kennismaking: wij leren jou kennen en jij ons. Als er een match is, gaan we tijdens het tweede gesprek dieper in op de rol en andere relevante onderwerpen. Soms hoort hier ook een business case bij. Vaak volgt er nog een laatste gesprek om alle openstaande vragen te bespreken.

- Aanbod & pre-employment screening – Als we beiden enthousiast zijn, ontvang je een aanbod en ronden we de pre-employment screening af. Daarna kan jouw avontuur bij EY beginnen.

EY  |  Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

Business Transformation - a m?ultidisciplinary competency, gathering capabilities in transformation architecture, experience design, business design and transformation execution to problem-solve, design and deliver large scale, multi-year, multi-stakeholder transformation programs.

Supply Chain and Operations - we provide a unique combination of industry-specific, strategic, operational and financial insights, digital technology advances and strategic alliance partners to deliver better outcomes and also help clients effect fundamental change in their operations’ performance to support sales growth, become more cost competitive, minimize risk and ensure operational resilience.

Your key responsibilities

Technical Excellence

- Strong foundation in business consulting methodologies with the ability to assess operational challenges and identify improvement opportunities. Experience in Growth Strategy and Commercial Due Diligence. Ability to support data-driven decision-making through structured problem-solving and quantitative analysis. Skilled in translating business requirements into actionable recommendations aligned to operational goals. Proficient in applying general consulting tools and frameworks to deliver practical, implementation-focused solutions.

Skills and attributes

To qualify for the role you must have
Qualification

- Undergrad from a Tier 1 college

- MBA/ Post Grad from a Tier 1 College

Experience

- Consulting - Strategy, Due Diligence, Growth, Transformation

What we look for

People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

What we offer

Fuelled by the brilliance of our people, EY has emerged as the strongest brand and the most attractive employer in our field, with market-leading growth over competitors. Our people work side-by-side with market-leading entrepreneurs, game-changers, disruptors, and visionaries. jobs.title: EY-Parthenon Senior Consultant - Operational M&A
jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

As you write your next chapter, what shape will it take?

Are you ready to take the next step in your M&A career and work on some of the most exciting deals in the market? We are looking for a Senior Consultant to join our Transaction Strategy and Execution team in Copenhagen.

In this role, you will be part of a high-performing team that supports clients across the full deal lifecycle: from M&A strategy to execution. You will work closely with clients on complex, high-impact engagements, where your insights and capabilities will drive real results. At the same time, you will play an active role in shaping our team, contributing to a strong culture and supporting the development of future leaders.

Shape your future with confidence.

Skills and attributes for success

You are analytically strong and comfortable working with complex data and problem-solving. You bring a structured and pragmatic approach, combined with strong business understanding and attention to detail.

You thrive in fast-paced environments and can manage ambiguity while maintaining focus on delivering high-quality outcomes. At the same time, you communicate clearly and confidently, translating complexity into actionable insights for both clients and colleagues.

You bring experience from client-facing or in-house roles across the M&A cycle (pre- and/or post-deal) and operational delivery, for example:

- Carve-out and operational due diligence

- Assessing standalone viability, cost structures and operational risks to inform deal decisions and separation planning

- Value creation and synergy assessment

- Identifying, quantifying and tracking revenue and cost synergies, and embedding them into value creation plans and integration and execution activities

- Deal strategy and deal management

- Supporting deal strategy and execution, including coordinating with stakeholders and driving governance, planning and milestone tracking across the transaction lifecycle

As a Senior Consultant, you will work across a range of M&A engagements spanning M&A strategy, operational diligence, as well as value creation and deal management. You are passionate about the operational aspects of M&A, thrive in fast-paced and ambiguous environments, and build trusted relationships with clients and colleagues.

Your main responsibilities include:

- Conducting operational due diligence/value creation analysis

- Managing and driving workstreams across pre- and post-deal engagements

- Supporting business development through pitch content, proposals and client conversations

- Coaching and supporting more junior team members, and contributing to practice development initiatives

What we look for

As our new colleague you bring 3-6 years of experience from strategy and M&A consulting or industry experience. You bring an inclusive approach, building strong relationships with both clients and colleagues and are a strong communicator who can translate complex ideas into clear and actionable insights. You take ownership of your work with a consistent focus on quality and impact.

What’s in it for you

- Work on complex, high-profile M&A and divestment engagements

- Collaborate with integrated teams across geographies and disciplines

- Continuous coaching, feedback and formal learning to support your development

- Hybrid work model, balancing in-office and client-site collaboration with flexibility

- A role with broad responsibility and room to shape how we deliver and grow

What you can expect during the recruitment process

- Interview process will include a take-home case and an on-the-spot case

- Your CV gives us the basics; a strong cover letter helps us understand your motivation and relevant experience beyond M&A consulting

Please submit your application no later than 1 December 2026. Selection and interviews are ongoing. If you have any questions or need more information about the role, please contact Malthe Pedersen at malthe.t.pedersen@parthenon.ey.com. For questions regarding the recruitment process, contact Jakob Damsted at  jakob.damsted@dk.ey.com .

jobs.title: Manager - General Insurance Actuarial Consulting
jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Manager – General Insurance Actuarial Consulting

The opportunity

As an experienced Manager, you'll provide strategic actuarial consulting services to clients across the general insurance sector, with a focus on long-tail injury schemes including workers compensation and motor accident/CTP insurance. You'll manage high-profile projects, deliver insights that help organisations navigate uncertainty and help clients build confidence with their key stakeholders.

This role offers the opportunity to work across a diverse range of engagements while helping to grow the next generation of actuarial talent.

Your key responsibilities

- Forge trusted relationships with a range of clients, making a significant impact in both the public and private sectors to enhance community wellbeing.

- Stay at the forefront of industry developments, regulatory change and emerging trends, contributing to thought leadership and shaping conversations across the sector.

- Develop and implement actuarial models and methodologies, analyse and interpret data to uncover critical insights for informed decision-making.

- Coach and develop junior team members, fostering a culture of continuous learning and development.

- Champion continuous improvement and shape the next generation of processes, tools, and analytical approaches.

- Expand your skills and professional horizons by engaging in a variety of projects – from business transformation, capital and risk management, pricing, and product innovation to liability valuation and appointed actuary work.

- Collaborate across our broader Financial Services practice, including strategy, transactions, tax, technology, and risk professionals.

Skills and attributes for success

- Qualifications and experience:  A Bachelor’s degree in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, or a related field. Completed, or progressing towards, a professional actuarial qualification (e.g., FIAA), with 7+ years of professional experience in an actuarial role, including workers compensation, motor accident injury insurance or similar. Experience with coding, programming, and AI is highly valued.

- Industry knowledge:  In-depth understanding of long tail, bodily injury lines of business and general insurance. Experience in areas like product development and pricing, claims and reserving, underwriting and reinsurance, capital and risk management, asset and liability valuation, IFRS 17, regulatory and prudential frameworks, advanced analytics and portfolio strategy is advantageous.

- Skills and abilities:  Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for building and maintaining client relationships, and the ability to present complex information clearly to non-specialists. Proven analytical and problem-solving skills; strong quantitative abilities; proficiency with actuarial software, techniques and ability to review technical work across Excel, SAS, R, and Python.

- Project management and leadership:  Ability to manage projects, develop new business opportunities, and mentor junior staff. Demonstrates initiative, a can-do attitude, and proactiveness in trying new approaches.

- Adaptability and continuous learning:  Comfortable with complexity and flexible in a dynamic, technology-driven environment. Commitment to staying up to date with market trends, legislation, and regulatory changes, and contributing to business thought leadership.

jobs.description:

Senior Consultant / Manager – General Insurance Claims Transformation

The opportunity

As a Senior Consultant or Manager in General Insurance Claims Transformation, you will play a hands on role helping insurers transform their claims capabilities across personal and commercial lines to deliver improved customer outcomes, operational efficiency, and measurable business value.

You will work across the end to end claims lifecycle, partnering with clients to design and deliver future state, AI enabled claims solutions and contributing to or leading defined workstreams within broader transformation programs.

The role involves collaborating within multidisciplinary, international teams and is based in Warrang – Sydney and Naarm – Melbourne, with flexible working options available.

- Act as a General Insurance claims domain specialist across the end-to-end claims lifecycle, from FNOL through to settlement, recovery, and subrogation.

- Lead and deliver business analysis and solution design activities, including requirements elicitation, process mapping, and functional artefacts.

- Design future-state claims processes and AI-enabled use cases such as intelligent triage, automation, document processing, analytics, and decision support.

- Own or contribute to defined claims transformation workstreams, accountable for quality, outcomes, and value realisation.

Working in the Belfast Team and reporting to the Belfast Team Leader the successful candidate will provide a wide range of support to the Consulting business including operational risk management, compliance and the review of contracting/bid documents.

- Act as a point of contact for the review and resolution of contractual and operational risk management related queries including:

- Business relationships.

- Liability.

- Regulatory/Auditor Independence.

- Data Protection.

- Third party risk.

- Terms & Conditions, Confidentiality Agreements and Data Protection.

- General contracting and sub-contracting principles/practices.

- Review and advise on client agreements, Statements of Work, subcontracts, NDAs with varying levels of complexity and with minimal direction but in accordance with EY’s contract negotiation guidelines and procedures.

- Address operational risk related issues as they arise invoking appropriate escalation and support functions as required.

- Address contract related issues as they arise, with appropriate escalation to General Counsel and other support functions as required.

- Propose and assist with the development of solutions for the enhancement of Quality processes, practices and contracting.

- Identification and ongoing management of regulatory requirements, including Independence during commercial contracting negotiations.

- Support the deployment of specific Risk Management projects and initiatives and become involved in running risk mitigation assessment programmes.

- An understanding of urgency, with an ability to break down complex queries in a timely manner.

- Intellectual agility/flexibility to rapidly understand/solve complex risk/contracting problems using commercial awareness.

- Ability to work with senior stakeholders from Independence, Risk Management, and the wider Quality teams to discuss complex issues and seek resolution.

- Ability to work alongside the Firm’s partner group and be able to influence it in the successful design and implementation of Quality and Risk Management practices.

- Ability to be approachable, supportive, responsive and yet be prepared to make and defend difficult decisions on the application of contractual, regulatory and risk principles.

- Ability to present complex and difficult messages and feedback effectively using a variety of training and influencing techniques.

As a Senior Consultant or Manager, you’ll provide actuarial consulting to clients across the private and government sectors, specialising in General Insurance and/or Private Health Insurance. Your responsibilities will include managing projects and delivering results and strategic advice that help clients handle risk, optimise performance, and develop growth strategies.

Your key responsibilities

- Forge strategic partnerships with a diverse range of clients, making a significant impact in both the public and private sectors to enhance community wellbeing.

- Collaborate across our broader Financial Services practice, including strategy, transactions, tax, technology, and risk professionals.

- Engage in a variety of projects – from business transformation, capital and risk management, pricing, and product innovation to liability valuation and appointed actuary work.

- Develop and implement actuarial models and methodologies, analyse and interpret data to uncover critical insights for informed decision-making.

- Mentor and develop junior team members, fostering a culture of continuous learning and development.

- Stay abreast of industry trends, regulatory and legislative changes, and actively contribute to business thought leadership.

- Champion continuous improvement and shape the next generation of processes, tools, and analytical approaches.

Skills and attributes for success

Completed, or progressing towards, a professional actuarial qualification (e.g., FIAA), with 2 to 8 years of professional experience in an actuarial role. Experience with coding, programming, and AI/GenAI is highly valued.

- Skills and Abilities: Proven analytical and problem-solving skills; strong quantitative abilities; proficiency with actuarial software and techniques using Excel, SAS, R, and Python. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for building and maintaining client relationships, and the ability to present complex information clearly to non-specialists.

jobs.description:
C hez EY, nous sommes « All in » pour façonner votre avenir en toute confiance. Ensemble, nous orienterons votre carrière selon vos aspirations. Rejoignez EY et contribuez à construire un monde meilleur.

Notre opportunité :

Notre équipe Technology Strategy & Transformation recherche des Consultant(e)s sénior à Manager CTO Advisory et Green IT,  pour intervenir auprès des Chiefs Technology Officers (CTO) afin de les accompagner dans leurs transformations technologiques et organisationnelles. En nous rejoignant, vous prendrez part à des missions de conseil riches et variées pour transformer les entreprises et la DSI.

Vos principales responsabilités :

- Accompagner la DSI dans sa transition vers le  Cloud public ou de confiance

- Définir la stratégie IT avec les  plateformes technologiques afin d’être plus agile et aligné avec les enjeux business

- Définir la stratégie technologique  de nos clients (Cloud & Datacenter, Bigdata, Edge Computing, IA, Metaverse industriel, IoT, DevOps, Réseaux, Observabilité)

- Accompagner nos clients dans  leur démarche numérique responsable, la définition de la stratégie,  le   cadrage de programmes de transformation et l’accompagnement à la mise en œuvre

Vos compétences pour réussir :

- Expertise liée à la  transformation cloud , aux  schémas directeurs technologiques , à  l'optimisation des processus , à  l’approche DevOps , à  l'observabilité , aux  plates-formes IT for IT ou au Green IT

- Définir une vision stratégique à moyen et long terme pour l'infrastructure technologique d'une organisation à travers un schéma directeur technologique, en alignant les choix technologiques avec les objectifs métier dans le secteur retail

- Définir la stratégie de transformation du SI vers le Cloud, cadrer cette transformation sur les plans financiers, technologiques, organisationnels, puis piloter la mise en œuvre pour un leader mondial de l’énergie

- Réaliser une étude stratégique pour définir les conditions d’hébergement d’une plateforme gouvernementale chez un acteur cloud de confiance

- Accompagner la création d’une entreprise post Day 1 et définir l’organisation, les processus et les outils cibles de la DSI

- Définir la stratégie d’observabilité, accompagner dans le choix de l’outil, lancer le POC et réaliser le Business Case pour nos clients

Ce que nous recherchons :

- Une  expérience significative de 5 à 8 ans  au sein d’un cabinet de conseil ou d’une DSI sur des sujets liés à la  transformation cloud , aux  schémas directeurs technologiques , à  l'optimisation des processus , à  l’approche DevOps , à  l'observabilité , aux  plates-formes IT for IT ou au Green IT.

- Des compétences en gestion humaine  pour encadrer des collaborateurs plus juniors (les faire grandir en mission et durant leurs activités en interne) et gestion opérationnelle (être responsable du delivery opérationnel lors de la réalisation des missions auprès de nos clients)

- Développement commercial pour présenter des solutions innovantes aux clients : avant-ventes et ventes, prospection commerciale, qualification d’appels d’offres et de besoins client, élaboration de proposition d’accompagnement mais aussi savoir prendre part au design, à la construction et à l’amélioration de notre offre CTO Advisory & Green IT.

- Niveau d’anglais et de français courant  à l’oral et à l’écrit

- Atout supplémentaire : certifications Cloud, ITIL, SAFE

Ce que nous vous offrons :

- Le développement de vos compétences et des expériences uniques au sein d’un environnement de travail diversifié et inclusif.

- Un environnement de travail flexible #Smartworking@EY

- L’opportunité de découvrir d’autres cultures en travaillant au contact d’équipes connectées à l’échelle mondiale et grâce à nos programmes de mobilité à l’international #Mobility4U.

- Un package complet : un bonus discrétionnaire annuel, une prime de participation, des RTT, une mutuelle avantageuse, une carte titre-restaurant, le remboursement de votre abonnement de transports en commun à hauteur de 75% ou une aide financière pour l’achat d’un vélo.

- De nombreux autres avantages : des primes de cooptation, un abonnement sportif Wellpass à tarif préférentiel, l’entrée gratuite aux musées du Louvre et Eugène-Delacroix, un accès privilégié à l’Opéra de Paris..

Etes-vous prêt(e) à façonner votre avenir avec confiance ? Postulez dès aujourd'hui.

Processus de recrutement :

Le processus de recrutement est composé en moyenne de 3 entretiens (RH et métier). Les entretiens, menés à distance et en présentiel, permettent d’échanger sur votre parcours, d’évaluer vos compétences et de répondre à vos questions.

Dans le cadre de sa politique Inclusion, EY étudie, à compétences égales, toutes candidatures dont celles de personnes en situation de handicap.

EY s'engage à créer de la valeur pour ses clients, ses collaborateurs, la société et la planète, tout en renforçant la confiance dans les marchés financiers. Grâce à la data, à l'intelligence artificielle et aux technologies avancées, les équipes aident les clients   façonner l'avenir avec confiance et à développer des solutions pour les enjeux d’aujourd'hui et de demain. Les équipes EY interviennent dans l’audit, le conseil, la fiscalité, la stratégie et les transactions. Fortes d'une expertise sectorielle, d'un réseau multidisciplinaire connecté à l'échelle mondiale et de partenaires d'écosystème diversifiés, les équipes EY interviennent dans plus de 150 pays et territoires.

jobs.title: Senior Consultant - Technology Strategy & Transformation
jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Zeker van je impact vandaag. Vrij om te bouwen aan morgen.
Bij EY weet je zeker dat je het verschil maakt: voor je klant, de samenleving, je collega én je eigen ontwikkeling. Tegelijk krijg je de vrijheid om te werken op een manier die bij jouw leven past. Of je nu kiest voor verdieping, verbreding of leiderschap: jij hebt de regie. Samen met ambitieuze collega’s in een open en vertrouwde cultuur ga je elke dag voor het hoogst haalbare. Groot in mogelijkheden, vriendelijk in samenwerking. EY zorgt voor de middelen die je nodig hebt je carrière verder vorm te geven en impact te maken binnen jouw vakgebied.

Jouw nieuwe baan | Over je belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden

Technologie is tegenwoordig een belangrijk onderdeel bij transformaties binnen organisaties en heeft daarbij impact op de structuur van organisaties en de manier van werken. Als Senior Consultant Technology Strategy & Transformation begeleid je organisaties bij veranderingen, variërend van kortlopende strategische trajecten (zoals het ontwerpen van de IT-visie, strategie en operating model) tot langdurige transformatieprogramma’s en (technologie) implementaties die de organisatie en werkwijze fundamenteel veranderen. De diensten die we aanbieden richten zich voornamelijk op de agenda's van de Chief Technology Officer (CTO) en Chief Information Officer (CIO).

Belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden:

Je vervult een leidende rol, waarin je onder meer verantwoordelijk bent voor de volgende werkzaamheden:

- Ondersteuning van klanten bij de ontwikkeling van technologie, IT-visie, strategie, operating model, organisatie-inrichting, governance en kostenoptimalisatie.

- Advisering aan klanten bij het (strategisch) ontwerp en implementatie van de nieuwste technologische innovaties, zoals Gen AI of grote platformen zoals SAP en Microsoft.

- Ontwerpen en implementeren van (IT) oplossingen die zijn afgestemd op de bedrijfsdoelen, strategische context en operationele modellen van de klant.

- Voorbereiden van C-level besluitvormingsmaterialen, ondersteund door gedegen analyses en heldere storytelling.

- Verantwoordelijk voor delen van een project, van project/programma management, uitvoeren van analyses en het opleveren van adviezen.

- Ondersteunen en coachen van junior collega's.

- Betrokken zijn bij industrieonderzoek, klantgericht leiderschap, RFP's en/of klant rondetafelgesprekken.

Daarnaast werk je nauw samen met klanten en collega's om nieuwe kansen te identificeren en proactief te communiceren. Hierbij ontwikkel je diepgaande klantrelaties en positioneer je jezelf als een ‘trusted advisor’. Je neemt eigenaarschap over je eigen carrière en ontwikkeling.

Jouw nieuwe team | Over je collega’s en het kantoor

Jouw Team

Je komt terecht in een hecht en ambitieus team van circa 65 collega’s. We werken op vrijdag samen op kantoor en sluiten de week af met een vrijdagmiddag borrel. Daarnaast organiseren we regelmatig team activiteiten en gaan we jaarlijks op skitrip.

Je werkt samen aan impactvolle projecten met strategen, managers en andere ervaren professionals waarbij je ook met andere teams binnen consulting kunt samenwerken. Wij werken binnen het team in een matrixstructuur van chapters en sectoren. In chapters bouw je diepgaande kennis op binnen thema’s zoals AI, CIO Advisory, Cloud en front-to-back transformaties. Vervolgens pas je deze expertise toe binnen specifieke sectoren, zoals Banking, Insurance, Government & Infra, Consumer & Health, Industrial & Energy en Technology, Media & Telecom.

Voorbeelden van enkele projecten:

- Ontwikkeling van IT-visie, strategie en operating models in diverse sectoren.

- Analyse van enterprise architectuur en roadmap aanbevelingen voor een toekomstbestendige inrichting

- Implementatie van softwareoplossingen binnen o.a. verzekeraars, banken en consumer goods.

Hierna vindt er nog een laatste gesprek plaats met een partner van de afdeling.

jobs.title: AI Governance Risk Project and Program Management
jobs.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

As part of Enterprise Technology function, we are seeking Senior Program Manager / Associate Director to drive measurable business value through the successful delivery of complex, cross-functional programs and transformation initiatives.

The role is responsible for end-to-end program leadership, governance, financial oversight, risk and dependency management, stakeholder alignment, and delivery assurance across business and technology environments. The position combines strategic thinking with practical execution, while leading teams and strengthening project and program management capability.

The opportunity

We are seeking a Senior Manager / Associate Director - Project & Program Management to lead strategic programs and enterprise transformation initiatives across the enablement services functions.

As a program leader, you will translate business priorities into practical roadmaps, integrated plans, governance structures, and measurable outcomes. You will work with senior stakeholders, clients, delivery teams, and partners to manage complexity, resolve delivery challenges, and maintain focus on value, quality, cost, and timelines.

The ideal candidate brings broad experience in program management, business transformation,  service transitions, and managed services, together with strong financial, commercial, people leadership, and executive communication skills.

Your key responsibilities

- Lead complex, large-scale, cross-functional programs from initiation through execution, transition, and closure.

- Translate strategic objectives into program roadmaps, integrated delivery plans, milestones, governance structures, and measurable outcomes.

- Establish and strengthen PMO frameworks, delivery standards, executive reporting, decision forums, and delivery assurance mechanisms.

- Oversee program budgets, forecasts, resource plans, cost performance, and progress against approved business cases.

- Lead business transformation, operating model changes, process improvement, technology-enabled initiatives, service transitions, automation, and digital modernization.

- Establish effective risk, issue, dependency, change, quality, and escalation management practices.

- Build trusted relationships with senior leaders, clients, business stakeholders, technology teams, vendors, and strategic partners.

- Lead steering committees and executive reviews, communicate program performance and trade-offs, and resolve complex stakeholder and delivery challenges.

- Lead, mentor, and develop project managers, program managers, PMO professionals, workstream leads, and geographically distributed teams.

- Drive operational readiness and the effective transition of solutions into managed services or business-as-usual operations where applicable.

- Use project and portfolio platforms, analytics, automation, KPIs, and dashboards to improve transparency, decision-making, predictability, and benefits tracking.

- Contribute to investment planning, commercial assessments, proposals, solutioning, and continuous improvement of delivery methods and reusable practices.

Skills and attributes for success

To qualify for the role you must have

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Science / Engineering, Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

- Typically 18+ years of progressive experience in project and program management, PMO leadership, enterprise transformation, managed services, delivery or global operations.

- Proven experience leading complex programs with multiple workstreams, dependencies, senior stakeholders, and geographically distributed teams.

- Strong capability in program governance, integrated planning, financial management, resource planning, risk mitigation, delivery assurance, and executive reporting.

- Experience delivering business transformation, operating model change, service transition, process improvement, automation, or technology modernization initiatives.

- Ability to influence senior stakeholders, facilitate decisions, manage ambiguity, and resolve complex delivery challenges.

- Experience leading and developing project managers, program managers, PMO professionals, and cross-functional teams.

- Strong business acumen, executive communication, negotiation, structured problem-solving, and change leadership skills.

- Working knowledge of Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, and hybrid delivery approaches, with the judgment to select and tailor methods to program needs.

- Experience using project and portfolio management tools such as Microsoft Project, Planview, Jira

Ideally, you will also have

- PMP, PRINCE2 Practitioner, MSP, or an equivalent project, program, Agile, change, or service management certification.

- Experience in professional services, consulting, IT services, global business services, regulated industries, or a large enterprise environment.

- Experience contributing to business cases, commercial reviews, proposals, solutioning, or client development activities.

- Experience establishing PMO or delivery governance capabilities and improving project management maturity.

What we look for

A strategic and delivery-focused leader who can connect business objectives with practical execution. Someone who combines strong program management discipline with commercial awareness, transformation experience, and sound judgment; builds trusted relationships; develops high-performing teams; and remains accountable for measurable outcomes in complex and changing environments.

What working at EY offers

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland & the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies & sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills & insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

- Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.

- Succesd s as define  by you : We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.

- Transformative leadership : We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.

- Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

jobs.title: SAP CC Flex Program Manager (Global)
jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity

EY has curated a dynamic ecosystem of Alliance and Ecosystem relationships which creates new forms of customer value to help our clients rapidly and digitally transform. Our ecosystem consists of more than 100 relationships which allow us to provide a wide range of collaborative opportunities and solutions to our clients. We help them tap into the latest technologies to achieve transformational outcomes and be more agile, innovative, resilient and better equipped to respond to disruptive change.

As EY continues to grow our Alliances, we need an SAP CC Flex Program manager who can work with SAP coordinating with the respective Alliance Go to Market Leaders and Alliance Relationship Directors to manage the day to day aspects of specific SAP investment and commercial programs – including relationship collaboration and governance, alliance program oversight, contracts and compliance management and performance intelligence.  This is a great opportunity to work with people across the global as well as across multiple EY service lines and sectors.

Your key responsibilities

Your role will sit within the Alliance and Ecosystem Relationship team that provides commercial and investment program management oversight for the top EY alliances. Specifically, the SAP CCFlex Program Manager will work as part of the Global Alliance Enablement teams working directly with the SAP Go-to-Market Alliance Leadership, counterparts within the alliance partner’s organization and EY’s delivery practices to coordinate and deliver upon of the objectives of the SAP commercial program.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

- Manage the SAP Commercial Program for SAP CCFlex

- Interact with SAP to interpret new programs and programmatic updates, develop plan for how EY will leverage and optimize programs, and coordinating with operations support team to define processes to execute upon the repeatable aspects of the program

- Activate new countries and regions across SAP ensuring proper governance is in place, e.g. supporting business plans, executive relationships, operating cadence and enabling alliance contracts

- Work with Go To Market Alliance Leadership to develop SAP business case and sales plan

- Facilitate top to top SAP alliance relationships and program management to mobilize on program sales plan, accelerate field engagement, and drive action

- Provide management oversight and direction of the offshore team that manages on-going execution of program such as registration and claiming processes

- Provide coordination support across Sector, Service Line and region

- Provide program input into alliance SAP Business reviews, sharing progress with others in similar roles around the globe

- Drive Compliance with internal policies and requirements

This role location is based is Netherlands.  You can anticipate a mix of virtual work along with regular coordination with other team members across the Globe. The role will require some minimal travel.

Skills and attributes for success

To qualify for the role you must have:

- Ability to juggle many activities and provide enablement services in the areas of: relationship management, governance oversight, contract management, operational support, strong relationship building skills and communication skills with senior leaders, and is highly organized

- Ability to balance evaluating and building new programs and adjusting to changes within those programs

Job Description: GDS Meetings and Events Program Manager

Job title: GDS Meetings and Events Program Manager

Function: Ernst & Young Global Services – Supply Chain Services

Role summary

The GDS Meetings and Events Program Manager is a highly responsible role who will oversee Meetings and Events related spend and support M&E program activities across GDS locations globally. The role will act as a key day-to-day point of contact for GDS stakeholders on program management, operational requirements, reporting, supplier performance, and process improvement initiatives supporting the Global M&E program.

The role will work closely with Meetings & Events colleagues, suppliers, internal business stakeholders, procurement, finance and other enabling teams to promote M&E policies, guidelines and procedures, drive compliance, improve stakeholder experience and support cost-saving opportunities.

The successful candidate will be expected to operate independently, influence stakeholders across levels and geographies, and contribute to the broader purpose and objectives of EY’s Travel, Meetings & Events program.

Key responsibilities

Program management and stakeholder partnership

- Be the primary point of contact for GDS stakeholders on M&E program management, operational queries, reporting requirements and policy guidance.

- Support senior stakeholders across GDS locations and provide guidance on Meetings & Events related matters, ensuring alignment with global program objectives.

- Promote the values, objectives and strategy of the Meetings & Events program and broader procurement function in all stakeholder interactions.

- Influence change and support the implementation of the Global M&E strategy across relevant GDS locations and business groups.

Event operations, sourcing and supplier management

- Oversee and support venue sourcing, event planning and supplier engagement for GDS meetings and events, ensuring solutions are aligned to stakeholder requirements and business needs.

- Be the escalation point for supplier-related matters and help maintain strong supplier relationships through performance monitoring, policy alignment and contractual delivery.

- Support M&E related RFPs, vendor onboarding, supplier renewals and other procurement activities as required.

Policy, compliance and governance

- Promote and support compliance with EY’s Meetings & Events policies, Supply Chain Services policy, corporate meetings policy, procurement policy and related procedures.

- Ensure compliance with EY standardised meeting contracts, addendums, framework agreements and relevant internal processes.

- Review business compliance with the overall M&E program, including BRIDGE, Independence, Finance and Procurement processes.

- Influence policy and standards relating to M&E spend, including venue, meals, agencies and related event categories.

- Support adoption of viable process solutions aligned with global standards, including process governance and operational controls.

Financial management, reporting and performance

- Help prepare initial and final event or meeting budgets and support cost management throughout the event lifecycle.

- Drive cost efficiencies and supplier negotiations, ensuring value-add opportunities are reviewed and exhausted where applicable.

- Review data reporting, identify cost-saving opportunities and present relevant insights to stakeholders.

- Manage and report key performance indicators to monitor program effectiveness, supplier performance and operational efficiency

Process improvement and global alignment

- Lead and support GDS M&E projects, including expansion of the M&E catalogue across GDS locations and harmonisation of processes with global teams

- Identify and recommend best practices by networking with Travel Management Company colleagues, venue sourcing teams, suppliers and industry peers.

- Contribute ideas and best practices to improve M&E processes, stakeholder experience and program efficiency.

- Support use of relevant M&E tools and intake channels, including Cvent and other internal systems, to ensure event requests are accurately assigned and managed.

Teaming and leadership

- Work closely with direct reports, M&E support personnel and extended support teams to deliver consistent program outcomes.

- Provide guidance to meeting requestors, meeting planners, third-party providers and internal stakeholders on program requirements and event execution

- Demonstrate strong communication, influencing and stakeholder management skills when working with senior leaders, suppliers and cross-functional teams.

Supervision responsibilities

This role will have responsibility for M&E support personnel and will work closely with the extended M&E support team to support program delivery across GDS locations.

Skills and attributes for success

- The ideal candidate will be an effective communicator, self-motivated, detail-oriented and results-driven, with the ability to work independently and engage confidently with stakeholders at all levels of seniority.

- The candidate should demonstrate strong organisational skills, the ability to prioritise effectively, commercial awareness, attention to detail, calmness under pressure and a passion for delivering high-quality event and program outcomes

- The role requires strong stakeholder management, supplier management, analytical thinking, process improvement orientation and the ability to support change across a complex, global and cross-cultural environment.

Education

- Fluent written and spoken English language skills are required

- A degree in Business, Hospitality, Travel, Procurement or a related discipline is preferred but not mandatory.

- Additional Asian language skills may be beneficial for broader regional stakeholder engagement, although they are not mandatory.

Experience

- Minimum 5–8 years of relevant corporate experience managing Meetings & Events programs or working in a senior role in the travel, hospitality, meeting planning, venue sourcing, destination management or travel management industry.

- Experience managing large, complex events or M&E programs in a multinational, service-focused or cross-cultural environment is highly beneficial.

- Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office tools, particularly Excel and PowerPoint, is required.

- Experience with Cvent, meeting intake tools, data reporting, Power BI, Power Platform, Ariba or related procurement and event technology platforms will be an added advantage.

Job requirements

Due to the global nature of EY, the candidate will be expected to work flexibly with colleagues in person and virtually across multiple time zones.

A stable and reliable home internet connection is required for effective remote teaming, and the role may require working from the EY GDS office in India, based on local policies.

Some international travel may be required, and the candidate should have a valid passport or the ability to obtain one. There may also be occasions where work outside regular business hours is required due to collaboration across multiple time zones.

What we look for

We are looking for a confident, collaborative and commercially minded program manager who can work with senior stakeholders, suppliers and global colleagues to deliver efficient, compliant and high-quality Meetings & Events outcomes. The right candidate will bring a calm-under-pressure mindset, strong ownership, excellent communication skills and the ability to influence change while continuously improving the stakeholder experience.

Job Title: GDS Alliances Operations Lead Analyst

Job Summary:

The GDS Alliances Operations Lead Analyst will operate from the GDS Program Operations CoE and provide structured operations, governance, stakeholder coordination, reporting, content management and execution support across multiple alliances within the broader Global Alliances and Ecosystem Relationship Enablement function. The role may support selected alliances on an ongoing basis while providing flexible, needs-based support to others in response to changing business priorities. The incumbent will help alliance leadership teams run effective, insight-led and scalable operating models by tracking priorities, managing operational cadence, improving process discipline and enabling timely execution across sell, build and deliver motions. Working closely with alliance, market, finance, contracts, training, BMC and enablement stakeholders, the role will strengthen delivery consistency, improve data and reporting quality, simplify ways of working and identify automation opportunities, including the responsible use of AI-enabled tools to reduce manual effort, enhance reporting narratives and improve operational outcomes.

Essential Functions of the Job:

- Serve as the central operations and PMO support point for assigned alliance activities, ensuring priorities, workstreams, owners, timelines, risks, dependencies and follow-ups are clearly captured, tracked and progressed with discipline.

- Provide assigned alliance leadership teams with timely business insights through structured reporting, dashboards and executive-ready narratives covering sales, pipeline, opportunity tagging, partner-sourced and co-sell activity, prospect tracking, key GTM wins, book of business movements, partner program measures and other relevant performance indicators.

- Support governance cadence for leadership meetings, QBRs, planning forums and operational reviews by developing agendas, storyboarding content, coordinating inputs, preparing meeting materials, capturing actions and tracking closure.

- Maintain and continuously refresh alliance reference materials, SharePoint content, leadership-ready presentations, internal updates and other enablement assets to improve findability, consistency, relevance and adoption across stakeholder groups.

- Coordinate with Brand, Marketing and Communications teams to develop, review and maintain alliance-related content, ensuring alignment with messaging standards, stakeholder expectations and partner program requirements.

- Program manage partner tools, portals and operational processes across assigned alliances, including access request tracking, issue resolution, adoption monitoring, certification and skills currency tracking, training coordination and tool administration support.

- Work with alliance investment, finance, legal and enablement teams to support applicable market development fund, co-investment and related funding processes across assigned alliances, including investment tracking, compliance monitoring, periodic reviews, documentation readiness, claims support and process adherence.

- Support alliance contract and governance activities, including initiation and tracking of localization of global agreements, program documentation, partner designation, distinction or specialization requirements, and related compliance actions in collaboration with the Ecosystem Contracts team and relevant business stakeholders.

- Partner with onshore alliance leaders and enablement contacts across assigned alliances on strategic projects, transformation initiatives, stakeholder mapping, partner offering or marketplace coordination, event or sponsorship coordination, training interventions and other priority initiatives as required.

- Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize and improve alliance operations processes through process mapping, documentation, issue analysis, control strengthening, data quality improvement and adoption of reusable templates and playbooks.

- Leverage automation and responsible AI-enabled tools, where appropriate, to reduce repetitive manual activity, improve reporting turnaround time, support content drafting, enhance insight generation, improve follow-up tracking and enable scalable service delivery.

- Manage stakeholder expectations, communication plans and delivery commitments with clarity, responsiveness and strong service orientation across global and regional teams.

Knowledge and Skill Requirements:

- Strong understanding of alliance, ecosystem or partner program operations, preferably in a professional services, technology, consulting, shared services, GCC or global capability center environment; exposure to multiple technology partners, enterprise software, cloud, data, CRM, workflow automation, low-code platforms or digital transformation ecosystems would be advantageous.

- Working knowledge of sales, revenue, pipeline, opportunity lifecycle, partner program metrics, GTM motions, co-sell or referral activity, partner distinctions, specialization requirements and performance reporting, with the ability to interpret data and convert it into concise executive-ready insights.

- Strong program and project management skills, including planning, tracking, governance cadence management, risk and dependency monitoring, action follow-up and management of multiple priorities with competing deadlines.

- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, with Power BI, Power Automate, SharePoint, workflow tools or other reporting and collaboration platforms considered an advantage.

- Experience with continuous improvement, process simplification and operational excellence, including process mapping, SOP development, control documentation, audit readiness, root cause analysis and issue resolution.

- Ability to identify automation opportunities and apply digital tools responsibly to improve productivity, reporting quality, follow-up discipline, knowledge management and stakeholder experience.

- Practical exposure to generative AI tools for research, content development, summarization, insight generation, workflow support and productivity enhancement; preferable exposure to Agentic AI concepts, AI-enabled process automation, AI agents or Copilot-style productivity tools.

- Strong stakeholder management capability, with the ability to engage senior onshore stakeholders, anticipate needs, manage expectations and build trusted advisor relationships across functions and geographies.

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, including business writing, executive presentation development, narrative building and the ability to create high-quality content with limited initial guidance.

- Strong analytical thinking, problem solving, research capability and attention to detail, with the ability to work across multiple teams to drive practical and timely resolution.

- Experience working in virtual, matrixed and multi-geography environments with cultural sensitivity, collaboration discipline and a global mindset.

- Knowledge of EY and GDS operations, organization structure, operating model, management information systems and independence concepts for internal candidates; Big 4, consulting, technology or leadership support exposure for external candidates would be preferred.

Job Requirements:

Academics:

- MBA, postgraduate qualification, or equivalent professional experience preferred.

- Bachelor’s degree required; degree in business, technology, engineering, commerce, or a related discipline preferred.

- Project/program management certification, process improvement certification, or relevant alliance, partner program, technology partner or enterprise software certification would be an added advantage.

- Relevant certifications or digital badges in generative AI, responsible AI, AI-enabled productivity, prompt engineering, automation, analytics, or Agentic AI concepts would be highly desirable, particularly where they demonstrate practical application in business operations, reporting, process improvement, knowledge management, or stakeholder enablement.

Experience:

- 8+ years of progressive, relevant experience in alliance operations, program management, business operations, sales/GTM enablement, ecosystem support, consulting operations, technology partner enablement or enterprise software partner operations; experience supporting multiple alliances or technology partner ecosystems would be preferred.

- Demonstrated experience supporting senior stakeholders in a matrixed, global environment, with exposure to governance routines, executive reporting, process coordination, and cross-functional delivery.

- Experience in reporting, dashboarding, content development, stakeholder tracking, or operational improvement initiatives would be beneficial.

Working Hours:

- Working hours will be aligned with the applicable US Central or Eastern Time Zones, based on stakeholder coverage and business requirements.
