As you write your next chapter, what shape will it take?

Are you ready to take the next step in your M&A career and work on some of the most exciting deals in the market? We are looking for a Senior Consultant to join our Transaction Strategy and Execution team in Copenhagen.

In this role, you will be part of a high-performing team that supports clients across the full deal lifecycle: from M&A strategy to execution. You will work closely with clients on complex, high-impact engagements, where your insights and capabilities will drive real results. At the same time, you will play an active role in shaping our team, contributing to a strong culture and supporting the development of future leaders.

Shape your future with confidence.

Skills and attributes for success

You are analytically strong and comfortable working with complex data and problem-solving, using AI-enabled tools to enhance analysis and insight generation. You bring a structured and pragmatic approach, combined with strong business understanding and attention to detail.

You thrive in fast-paced environments and can manage ambiguity while maintaining focus on delivering high-quality outcomes. At the same time, you communicate clearly and confidently, translating complexity into actionable insights for both clients and colleagues.

You bring experience from client-facing or in-house roles across M&A execution (pre- and/or post-deal) and operational delivery, for example:

- Product and technology diligence

- Assessment of the product portfolio and roadmap, together with the underlying technology and R&D setup to evaluate commercial attractiveness/value creation potential

- IT diligence

- Evaluating the IT environments, from strategy to costs, to identify risks and opportunities, and to inform the investment case

- Technology integration and separation

- Leading technology workstreams, from strategy to execution/operationalization

- Digital value creation

- Assessing digital and AI-driven value creation opportunities, and implications for the deal theses and post-deal value capture

As a Senior Consultant, you will work across a range of M&A engagements spanning M&A strategy, operational diligence, as well as value creation and deal management. You are passionate about the operational aspects of M&A, thrive in fast-paced and ambiguous environments, and build trusted relationships with clients and colleagues.

Your main responsibilities include:

- Conducting operational due diligence/value creation analysis

- Managing and driving workstreams across pre- and post-deal engagements

- Supporting business development through pitch content, proposals and client conversations

What we look for

As our new colleague you bring 3-6 years of experience from strategy and M&A consulting or industry experience. You bring an inclusive approach, building strong relationships with both clients and colleagues and are a strong communicator who can translate complex ideas into clear and actionable insights. You take ownership of your work with a consistent focus on quality and impact.

What’s in it for you

- Work on complex, high-profile M&A and divestment engagements

- Collaborate with integrated teams across geographies and disciplines

- Continuous coaching, feedback and formal learning to support your development

- A purpose-led culture focused on creating long-term value for clients and society

- Hybrid work model, balancing in-office and client-site collaboration with flexibility

- A role with broad responsibility and room to shape how we deliver and grow

What you can expect during the recruitment process

- Interview process will include a take-home case and an on-the-spot case

- Your CV gives us the basics; a strong cover letter helps us understand your motivation and relevant experience beyond M&A consulting

Please submit your application no later than 1 December 2026. Selection and interviews are ongoing. If you have any questions or need more information about the role, please contact Malthe Pedersen at malthe.t.pedersen@parthenon.ey.com. For questions regarding the recruitment process, contact Jakob Damsted at  jakob.damsted@dk.ey.com .

jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Position Summary (Enter the description)  -  Strategic Transformation Leader aligned to Technology sector

Objective and purpose :

There is a mandate to scale-up the strategic transformation partner (STP) program in GDS across focus sectors and integrated sector solutions. The requirement is for a partner who will be responsible for origination and delivery of high‑value deals in the Technology sector, with deep experience across Semiconductors, Hardware, Software, and Digital Platforms, driving end‑to‑end transformation programs across Cost Takeouts, M&A, Growth, Profitability, Finance, and Supply Chain Operations

Scope of the position :

- Originate opportunities by deeply understanding client strategy, operating context, and disruption themes, translating insights into transformation plays

- Own personal and practice-level revenue outcomes with primary weightage on sales, pipeline health and cost of sales efficiency

- Act as a trusted transformation advisor to C-suites of technology clients

- Lead growth agenda conversations spanning cost takeouts and productivity unlocks, operating model redesign, GCC transformation, post-merger integration and carve-outs

- Build and maintain a robust sector pipeline with clear deal progression and prioritization

- Orchestrate integrated, cross‑disciplinary solutions across strategy, operating model and organization design, finance transformation, commercial excellence, and technology consulting to address complex client challenges.

- Develop repeatable, market‑leading Technology sector offerings, including playbooks, frameworks, and accelerators that differentiate the practice and create measurable client value

Essential Functions of the job (Enter the description)

- Lead pursuits and proposals for large, complex transformation and transactions in the Technology sector, with a strong focus on Semiconductors, Electronics, Hardware OEMs, and Software/SaaS businesses.

- Design and execute cost‑takeout and profitability programs, including operating‑model redesign, shared services / GCO, and technology‑enabled automation, with specific experience in Semiconductor fabs, design‑services, and electronics manufacturing ecosystems

- Lead or co‑lead M&A integration, carve‑out, and divestiture programs in the Technology sector, including Semiconductor IP, foundry services, and electronics supply‑chain assets, with a strong focus on synergy capture, supply‑chain integration, and working‑capital optimization

- Build and maintain C suite relationships with technology companies and tech enabled enterprises to position EY as the partner of choice for strategy, M&A, and transformation

- Sponsor, oversee, and govern complex transformation engagements, ensuring strategic alignment, disciplined execution, and measurable value realization

- Oversee development and commercialization of sector-specific assets, platforms, and benchmarks, ensuring they address client needs and differentiate EY offerings

- Shape and articulate differentiated, value‑led proposals that seamlessly integrate strategy, operations, technology, and organizational change

- Drive integrated go‑to‑market initiatives across consulting, SaT, tax, and assurance, Service Lines to bring holistic solutions to clients.

- Strengthen sector eminence by contributing to thought leadership and leading market conversations

Analytical/Decision making Responsibilities (Enter the description)

- Evaluate and qualify large, complex Technology‑sector pursuits, using analytical judgment to assess market attractiveness, competitive positioning, client readiness, win probability, and required investment to shape a winning strategy.

- Make strategic decisions on solution architecture and value definition by analyzing cloud‑modernization requirements, product/platform economics, cost structures, engineering productivity metrics, and tech‑stack maturity to craft differentiated, outcomes‑driven proposals.

- Direct commercial‑modeling and deal‑shaping decisions for multi‑tower transformation programs in software, SaaS, semiconductor, hardware, and digital‑platform clients, balancing margin, risk, scope feasibility, and delivery model implications.

- Evaluate M&A hypotheses and synergy‑capture opportunities (e.g., semiconductor supply‑chain consolidation, product portfolio optimization, IP carve‑outs, software integration) using operational, financial, and technology‑architecture analyses to support client decision‑making.

- Analyze client technology‑innovation trends and disruption risks (AI acceleration, platform shifts, hardware–software convergence, cloud economics, semiconductor capacity cycles) to guide account strategy, sector offerings, and EY investment priorities.

Education and Experience (Enter the description)

- 25+ Years in Consulting (Big 4, strategy consulting) or technology‑sector transformation, spanning software/SaaS, semiconductors, electronics, hardware OEMs, cloud, or platform-led businesses

- Advanced degree preferred, MBA/MS in Engineering/Computer Science; bachelors degree in business, technology, engineering required

Knowledge and Skill requirements (Enter the description)

- Strong commercial acumen, financial modeling, and deal‑structuring skills, with an understanding of Semiconductor capital cycles, fab economics, and electronics supply‑chain dynamics.

- Expertise in operating‑model design, process transformation, and technology‑enabled automation, including experience with Semiconductor manufacturing, design‑services, and electronics ecosystems.

- Ability to close large, complex transformation deals

- Proven enterprise-scale transformation leadership

- Consulting growth and pursuit leadership experience

Good to have (Differentiators)

- Capability to shape solutions at the convergence of hardware–software–cloud, aligning product engineering, platform modernization, and AI integration—mirroring the industry’s shift toward integrated systems and agentic AI orchestration

- Ability to simplify deeply technical concepts (semiconductor roadmaps, AI compute economics, platform engineering) into persuasive narratives for CEOs, CTOs, CFOs, and Boards—driving alignment in high‑stakes decisions.

- Ability to influence external industry discourse through points of view, keynote talks, and perspectives on AI, cloud, semiconductors, and digital engineering—enhancing EY’s brand and credibility.

jobs.description:
Requisition Id: 1700925

As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom. At EY, we don't just focus on who you are now, but who you can become. We believe that it’s your career and ‘It’s yours to build’ which means potential here is limitless and we'll provide you with motivating and fulfilling experiences throughout your career to help you on the path to becoming your best professional self.

The opportunity : Senior Project Consultant-GOV-Tech Consulting-CNS - TC - Technology Strategy & Transformation - New Delhi

GOV :

Our Global Government & Public Sector (GPS) is a network of highly skilled professionals dedicated to serving our clients by bringing best-in-class international experience and insight combined with local knowledge to solve the most critical problems facing governments today. We actively focus on building solutions that help public sector entities face the challenges of the future and reinvent themselves.

Digital transformation is not just about new technologies; it involves an overhaul of organizational structures, governance, work processes, culture and mindset. It also means realizing a wider vision of relationships and business models that will redesign how public services function.

To achieve this vision, we help clients balance strategic choices to re-ignite performance. We have developed a suite of cross-service line strategic solutions that align with our client priorities.

We have a proud record of helping governments meet their challenges head-on, and we work closely with them to build a world that works better for all citizens.

CNS - TC - Technology Strategy & Transformation :

EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client-centric approach focuses on driving long-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.

In Tech Consulting, we are transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. It places humans@center, leverages technology@speed and enables innovation@scale.

Your key responsibilities :-

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior PostgreSQL Database Administrator with 6–10 years of strong experience in architecting, implementing, and optimizing PostgreSQL databases in large-scale, mission‑critical environments. The ideal candidate will serve as a subject matter expert for PostgreSQL, lead database initiatives, ensure high availability, and collaborate with engineering, architecture, DevOps, and product teams.

Key Responsibilities

Database Architecture & Design

- Lead the design and implementation of high-performance PostgreSQL database architectures.

- Define standards for schema design, indexing strategy, data partitioning, sharding, and storage optimization.

- Provide technical guidance for database scalability, capacity planning, and data growth strategy.

Administration & Operations

- Install, configure, patch, and maintain PostgreSQL instances across production and non-production environments.

- Set up and manage replication architectures (streaming, logical, cascading, synchronous/asynchronous).

- Implement and manage robust backup and disaster recovery strategies using pgBackRest, Barman, or enterprise tools.

- Ensure database security, compliance, auditing, and encryption best practices.

Performance Tuning & Troubleshooting

- Lead deep‑dive analysis of performance issues using EXPLAIN/ANALYZE, pg_stat views, auto‑vacuum tuning, and indexing improvements.

- Investigate and resolve locking issues, deadlocks, replication lag, and query bottlenecks.

- Drive proactive database health checks and optimization strategies.

Automation & DevOps Integration

- Build automation for database provisioning, monitoring, backup, failover, and upgrades using Ansible, Python, Shell, etc.

- Collaborate with DevOps teams to integrate PostgreSQL into CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure‑as‑Code frameworks.

- Create scripts and tools to streamline operations in large, distributed environments.

Monitoring & Observability

- Implement enterprise-grade monitoring using Prometheus/Grafana, pgAdmin, Nagios, or equivalent.

- Define alerting, dashboards, and audit logging for runtime health, anomalies, and capacity usage.

Collaboration & Leadership

- Partner with development teams for query optimization, schema changes, and data modeling.

- Mentor junior DBAs and guide cross-functional teams on best practices.

- Participate in on-call rotations, incident management, and root cause analysis.

- Drive PostgreSQL roadmap discussions, version upgrades, and technology evaluations.

Required Skills

- 6–10 years of solid hands-on experience as a PostgreSQL DBA in production environments.

- Strong expertise in PostgreSQL internals, architecture, WAL, MVCC, autovacuum, and checkpoint tuning.

- Deep knowledge of performance tuning, index optimization, and query execution plans.

- Proven experience with HA/DR solutions, replication topologies, and failover strategies.

- Strong command of Linux administration (RHEL/Ubuntu).

- Excellent scripting in Shell, Python, or Bash.

- Knowledge of security practices, SSL/TLS, IAM, roles/privileges, and encryption mechanisms.

Good-to-Have Skills

- Experience with PostgreSQL extensions: PostGIS, pgPool-II, TimescaleDB, Citus, FDWs.

- Exposure to Kubernetes, Helm, Operators, and containerized database deployments.

What we look for

People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

What we offer

Fuelled by the brilliance of our people, EY has emerged as the strongest brand and the most attractive employer in our field, with market-leading growth over competitors. Our people work side-by-side with market-leading entrepreneurs, game-changers, disruptors, and visionaries. As an organization, we are investing more time, technology, and money than ever before in skills and learning for our people. At EY, you will have a personalized Career Journey and also the chance to tap into the resources of our career frameworks to better know about your roles, skills, and opportunities.

jobs.title: Junior Consultant - Supply Chain & Operations
jobs.description:
EY Consulting is global practice with more than 70,000 people around the globe. We are building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client-centric approach focuses on driving long-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems, and our consulting services are recognized by the global analyst community and our 25+ alliance partners. EY Consulting is made up of three sub-service lines: Business Consulting, Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.

What you will do

As a member of the Business Consulting, you will contribute technically to Consulting client engagements and internal projects including business development. An important part of your role will be to actively establish internal and external professional relationships. You will also assist in identifying potential business opportunities for Ernst & Young within existing engagements and escalate these as appropriate.

Our consultants are creative, analytical, self-driven, effective collaborators and leaders who work seamlessly within integrated teams in different environments. You will have access to world class methods and knowledge, and innovative EY learning program (such as EY Tech MBA) with the opportunity to build a better working world.

As a Junior Consultant in our Consulting - Supply Chain & Operations team, you will gain the opportunity to work on projects across  Supply Chain , Procurement , Operational Excellence , and Manufacturing Excellence . If you already have experience in these areas, we would love to hear about it. If not, show us your potential to grow into a strong consultant in these fields—and we will provide the support and development to help you get there.

Responsibilities, Qualifications, Certifications

Client delivery responsibilities

- Contribute to engagement team to integrate client’s strategy and technology.

- Participate as a fieldwork team member in Consulting engagements for supply chain and operation management.

- Work effectively as a team member, sharing responsibility, providing support, maintaining communication, and updating senior team members on progress.

- Leverage data and technology to assist senior team members in providing innovative solutions to client’s challenges.

- Assist in preparing high quality work products for clients and other related parties in timely manner.

- Anticipate and identify risks within engagements and raise any issues with senior members of the team.

- Develop and maintain productive working relationships with client personnel.

Qualifications:

- Have a bachelor’s degree in the areas of Industrial Engineering / Business Administration / Operation Management . Master’s degree will be an advantage.

- Fresh graduate with limited working experience.

- Min GPA 3.20 out of 4.00 from reputable universities.

- Understanding on the principles of business management.

- Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.

- Fluency in Indonesia and proficiency in English is a mandatory, both verbal and written.

- Fluency in using key Microsoft Office.

- Have high ability to work individually and collaboratively with others.

- Have high ability to work effectively under pressure and meet established goals and objectives within the specified deadline.

- Highly motivated and a strong drive to learn including independent learning.

- Ability to work across different disciplines, move into new challenges and develop a robust understanding of different industries.

Why work with us

EY values:

- People who demonstrate integrity, respect, teaming and inclusiveness

- People with energy, enthusiasm and the courage to lead

- People who build relationships based on doing the right thing

- Diversity and inclusiveness are core to who we are and how we work

- EY amplifies social impact through EY Ripples

- EY enables rapid upskills of our people for hot skills required to enable the business and our clients through EY Badges program

- EY offers first-ever fully accredited virtual corporate MBA free to all EY people

jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Senior Manager - Workforce Advisory - People Consulting

Mā  te kahukura ka rere te manu  I  With wings a bird will fly

What if we didn’t focus on who you are now, but who you could become?

The Team: People Consulting

We work globally and collaborate to bring professional teams together to address complex issues relating to organisation and workforce transformations. Our EY professionals ask better questions and work with clients to create holistic, innovative answers that deliver quality results.

This role can be based in  Tāmaki Makaurau (Auckland).

What’s in it for you?

- We’re making significant investments to build a team with the right resources. Joining now means being able to seize the opportunities that accompany that growth and shape the future of this fast-growing practice

- You’ll work with people who inspire and bring out the best in you, develop new and different skillsets with access to the latest digital tools and technology and learning platforms

- You’ll experience our diverse and inclusive culture. We believe that only the highest-performing teams that maximize the power of different perspectives can succeed in this fast-changing environment

Kei a  koe te mana I The choice is your s

The Role:

We are looking for an experienced Senior Manager to join our People Consulting team in Auckland. We are seeking a strategic and commercially minded leader with fresh ideas and an innovative approach to help shape and grow our high-performing team. People Consulting helps organisations solve some of their largest and most complex people-related challenges.

As a Senior Manager , you will lead the delivery of large-scale transformation programs, drive client relationships, and contribute to the growth of our People Consulting practice. You will:

- Lead engagement with internal and external stakeholders to provide advice and support on change and learning projects

- Proven experience in the delivery of challenging projects across a diverse range of organisations

- Design and develop the implementation of solutions, develop strategic recommendations, reports, and delivering impactful client presentations.

- Manage the delivery of complex projects, applying sound judgment to identify and resolve issues, ensuring successful delivery of people-related projects and initiatives

- Support the growth and development of Consultants and Senior Consultants through providing coaching, guidance and opportunities to learn.

- Provide leadership and direction across multiple engagements, applying sound judgement to identify and mitigate risks, resolve issues, and ensure successful outcomes.

- Drive business development activities, including identifying opportunities, contributing to proposals, and supporting the growth of the People Consulting practice.

- Lead and inspire high-performing teams, fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement. Contribute to thought leadership, market presence, and EY's reputation as a leader in people and workforce transformation.

Ō  Pūmanawa I What we’re looking for

Here’s our ‘wish list’ but don’t worry if you don’t tick all the boxes. We’re interested in your strengths, what you want to learn, and how far you want to go.

- Change, HR & Talent Transformation, in-depth experience across change management (including strategy, stakeholder engagement, communications, business readiness, learning design, and employee experience), HR transformation (HR strategy, HRIS/technology, payroll, outsourcing, processes, and risk), and talent management (operating model, organisation design, workforce planning, analytics, retention and succession strategies).

- Commercially and strategically driven, with extensive experience in a consulting environment, and a strong track record of building client relationships and delivering tailored, value-driven solutions. Demonstrated ability to drive business development, contribute to practice growth, and influence senior decision-makers.

- Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to engage diverse stakeholders, build authentic relationships, and communicate complex ideas effectively (including through storytelling), alongside strong project management capability and the ability to manage competing priorities.

- Digital & Transformation Capability,  experience leveraging digital platforms (e.g. SAP, Microsoft, ServiceNow) and emerging technologies such as AI to enhance processes, enable data-driven decision-making, and support organisational transformation initiatives.

- Experience working with clients across  retail, consumer, and manufacturing sectors  will be highly regarded.

-
Leadership and Team Development - experience leading multidisciplinary teams and developing high-performing talent through coaching, mentoring, and creating pathways for growth. Passionate about fostering an inclusive, collaborative, and high-performing team culture.

- Relevant change management and delivery certifications are highly desirable, including:

- AIM (Accelerating Implementation Methodology)  – practical adoption-focused approach

- CPCM (Certified Problem & Change Manager)  – combines problem-solving and change

- ATD Change Management Certificate  – learning/HR-led approach

- PROSCI / CCMP / APMG

- Agile Change Management (APMG or Agile Change Leadership Institute) -  focus on iterative, adaptive change in agile environments

- Adjacent certifications:

-

-

- PMP / PRINCE2  – project governance (often paired with change roles)

- ITIL  – change in IT service environments

- Lean Six Sigma  – process change and continuous improvement

Kuhu  mai ki a EY I Come, be a part of EY

In our friendly, collaborative environment, you’ll receive the support, formal training and coaching you need to progress quickly along the career path you choose. Not to mention the opportunity to be exposed and keep up to date with novel business models and cutting-edge technology trends.

- Learn about our commitment to DE&I at  www.ey.com/nz/diversity-inclusiveness

- Understand how our benefits can support you at  www.ey.com/nz/benefits

Apply now… we’re over 1,000 perspectives in Aotearoa New Zealand and we’re ready to welcome yours.

Of je nu kiest voor verdieping, verbreding of leiderschap: jij hebt de regie. Samen met ambitieuze collega’s in een open en vertrouwde cultuur ga je elke dag voor het hoogst haalbare. Jouw nieuwe baan | Over je belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden
Als Senior Consultant Finance Transformatie – Financiële Sector richt je je primair op banken, verzekeraars, pensioenorganisaties, vermogensbeheerders, fintechs en andere financiële instellingen.

Je maakt deel uit van de Finance Transformatie-competentie binnen CFO Consulting. Financiële dienstverlening is jouw sectorfocus. Je werkt over de volle breedte van Finance Transformatie en draait mee in projecten.

Onze Finance Transformatie-competentie ondersteunt klanten over het volledige spectrum van financiële transformatie: van het definiëren van toekomstige operating modellen en governance-structuren tot het implementeren van procesverbeteringen, digitale mogelijkheden en ondersteunende technologieën.

Wij werken met CFO’s en senior finance stakeholders aan vraagstukken zoals:

- Finance strategie vertalen naar toekomstbestendige operating modellen, organisatiestructuren, governance en helder end-to-end proceseigenaarschap.

- Finance Technology inzetten als motor voor transformatie, waaronder ERP- en EPM-platformen, workflow- en automatiseringsoplossingen en digitale finance capabilities.

- Complexe finance-transformatieprogramma’s vormgeven en realiseren, van de ambitie en businesscase tot implementatie en verankering in de organisatie.

- Planning, forecasting, performance management, afsluitingsprocessen, consolidatie, rapportage en besluitvorming versterken door procesverbetering, standaardisatie en passende Finance Technology.

Belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden

- Meewerken aan advies- en transformatietrajecten voor CFO’s en finance stakeholders binnen de financiële sector, gericht op finance-strategie, operating modellen en transformatieprioriteiten.

- Bijdragen aan het herontwerpen en implementeren van toekomstige finance kernprocessen zoals FP&A, Record-to-Report, afsluiting, consolidatie, Order-to-Cash en Procure-to-Pay.

- Finance functies helpen verbeteren door standaardisatie, automatisering en technologiegedreven transformatie, in samenwerking met technologiecollega’s en EY alliance partners.

- Effectief samenwerken binnen multidisciplinaire teams en met klantstakeholders; als Senior Consultant zelfstandig onderdelen van projecten of werkstromen coördineren.

- Bijdragen aan klantrelaties, proposities en de ontwikkeling van de Finance Transformatie-competentie en, als Senior Consultant, minder ervaren consultants inhoudelijk begeleiden en commerciële kansen signaleren.

Jouw nieuwe team | Over je collega’s en het kantoor
Jouw team

Finance Transformatie is een van de kerncompetenties binnen CFO Consulting. Je wordt onderdeel van één geïntegreerd Finance Transformatie-team en werkt samen met collega’s met verschillende sector- en transformatie-expertises. Vanuit jouw financiële sector-focus bouw je mee aan relevante marktproposities en klantrelaties, terwijl je tegelijkertijd actief bijdraagt aan de bredere ontwikkeling, staffing en delivery van de competentie.

Je werkt intensief samen met andere EY-competenties, waaronder Data & AI, Treasury, Technical Accounting, Project Management, Risicomanagement & Regelgeving en Transacties. Zo combineer je diepgaande sectorkennis met de schaal en expertise van een multidisciplinair team.

Jouw kantoor

Amsterdam
Ons kantoor in Amsterdam bevindt zich op de Zuidas: een bruisende plek waar veel bedrijven zijn gevestigd. In onze Cross Towers worden dagelijks veel collega’s en bezoekers verwelkomd. Voor een bijzonder uitzicht op Amsterdam ga je naar de 22e verdieping. In de Wavespace werken klanten en collega’s in een hightechomgeving zowel fysiek als virtueel samen.

Jouw vaardigheden en skills | Over je unieke bijdrage

- 3–5 jaar ervaring in finance transformatie, finance consulting of als financial professional met een sterke change mindset.

- Een afgeronde wo-master, bij voorkeur in bedrijfskunde, economie, finance, accountancy, econometrie, data of een vergelijkbare richting.

- Affiniteit met de financiële sector en interesse in de agenda van CFO’s en finance functies; voor Senior Consultants bij voorkeur aangevuld met relevante sectorervaring.

- Kennis van of interesse in financiële processen, finance operating modellen, performance management, afsluiting, consolidatie en rapportagetransformatie.

- Interesse in projectmatig werken en technologiegedreven finance transformatie, waaronder ERP-, EPM-, workflow- en automatiseringsoplossingen; voor Senior Consultants bij voorkeur ervaring met het coördineren van een deelproject of werkstroom.

- Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal, gecombineerd met sterke analytische, communicatieve en samenwerkingsvaardigheden en een proactieve, leergierige en resultaatgerichte instelling. Beheers je de Nederlandse taal nog niet, dan ben je bereid deze snel eigen te maken.

Jouw arbeidsvoorwaarden | Over je voordelen en werkplezier

- Een passend salaris voor je rol en verantwoordelijkheid, afhankelijk van ervaring en kwalificaties. Plus, een goed pensioen. Fijn voor later. Boven op je salaris ontvang je ook vakantiegeld en een jaarlijkse bonus (afhankelijk van resultaten en ontwikkeling).

- Een laptop en telefoon die je ook privé mag gebruiken en een maandelijkse internetvergoeding.

- 29 vakantiedagen, om op te laden en bij te tanken.

- Met het woon-werkbudget bepaal jij zelf hoe je reist, kies bijvoorbeeld voor een voordelig OV-abonnement of regel je vervoer eenvoudig via onze app.

- Bij EY vinden we een gezonde werk-privé balans belangrijk. Hybride werken maakt dat een stuk makkelijker. Of je nu werkt op kantoor, bij de klanten of thuis; Wij zorgen ervoor dat je een goed ingerichte thuiswerkplek krijgt.

- De mogelijkheid om 3 nationale feestdagen om te ruilen voor niet-nationale feestdagen.

- Zowel persoonlijk als professioneel krijg je alle ruimte om te groeien. Of je je nu wilt ontwikkelen in je vak, als persoon of in je leiderschapsstijl, we hebben een uitgebreid aanbod aan trainingen en opleidingen.

- Jouw gezondheid staat voorop. Wij geloven dat als je goed in je vel zit, je ook beter presteert. Zo krijg je onder andere toegang tot het wellbeing platform OpenUp (en ook jouw gezin). Je kunt hier laagdrempelig en binnen 36 uur in gesprek gaan met psychologen en lifestyle experts én kun je deelnemen aan sessies op het gebied van wellbeing.

- Veel aandacht voor teaming en verschillende interne netwerken waarmee je aan allerlei sociale activiteiten kunt deelnemen. Een fijne werksfeer en goede samenwerking met collega’s dragen immers ook bij aan jouw werkgeluk.

En dat alles binnen een omgeving waar onze kernwaarden integriteit, inclusiviteit en respect centraal staan. We vinden het belangrijk dat je jezelf kunt zijn én je volop kunt ontwikkelen tot de beste versie van jezelf. Benieuwd naar al onze voorwaarden? Klik hier

Jouw toekomst samen met ons vormgeven? | Over je sollicitatieproces

- Voor deze vacature vragen we je om naast je cv ook een motivatiebrief te uploaden. Hiermee krijg je de kans om jouw drijfveren, motivatie en persoonlijkheid aan ons te laten zien. Bij EY staan wij achter het gebruik van AI-tools zoals ChatGPT, zolang jouw eigen toon en unieke persoonlijkheid zichtbaar blijven.

- Ons eerste contact: na jouw sollicitatie belt onze recruiter jou voor een korte kennismaking. We verkennen alvast kort over en weer of de functie bij jou zou passen.

- Het eerste gesprek: we vragen je om van tevoren een online assessment te maken. Geen standaard vragenlijst, maar game-based waarin zowel naar jouw cognitieve vaardigheden als je gedragsvoorkeuren wordt gekeken. In het gesprek bespreken we de uitkomsten met elkaar en is er ook een collega van de betreffende afdeling aanwezig. Tijdens deze wederzijdse kennismaking leren we jou graag kennen en heb jij gelegenheid om ook jouw vragen te stellen.

- Het tweede gesprek: Als wij na het eerste gesprek een match zien en jij ook nog enthousiast bent, volgt er een tweede kennismaking. In dit gesprek gaan we dieper in op de functie en andere relevante thema’s en soms maakt ook een businesscaseonderdeel uit van de procedure. Het kan zijn dat er nog een laatste gesprek plaatsvindt.

- We zijn een match. Je ontvangt van ons een aanbod en we doen een pre-employment screening. Daarna start jouw nieuwe uitdaging. Welkom bij EY!

Uit onderzoek blijkt dat vrouwen minder snel solliciteren wanneer ze niet aan álle criteria voldoen. Solliciteer gerust, ook als je niet aan alles voldoet.

EY  |  Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories

jobs.title: Senior Manager - Business Consulting Risk - TMT - CNS - RISK - PROCESS & CONTROLS - Bangalore
jobs.description:
Requisition Id: 1745863

As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom. At EY, we don't just focus on who you are now, but who you can become. We believe that it’s your career and ‘It’s yours to build’ which means potential here is limitless and we'll provide you with motivating and fulfilling experiences throughout your career to help you on the path to becoming your best professional self.

The opportunity : Senior Manager-TMT-Business Consulting Risk-CNS - RISK - PROCESS & CONTROLS - Bangalore

TMT :

Industry convergence offers TMT (Technology, Media & Entertainment, and Telecommunications) organizations the chance to evolve and transform, but it also presents challenges around competitiveness and delivering agile corporate strategies for growth. Content distributors are transforming into content producers, service providers are becoming tech companies, technology companies are the catalyst for dramatic change in every sector, and customers want the latest innovations now.

We help TMT companies create compelling employee and customer experiences, retaining skills and talent while achieving enterprise-wide operational excellence. We help them protect their data, brand and reputation. We also enable the pursuit of M&A strategies that systematically create value, reduce risk and transform TMT companies into powerhouses that will lead the technology revolution of the future – building a better working world for all.

CNS - RISK - PROCESS & CONTROLS :

EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client-centric approach focuses on driving long-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.

We help our clients in identifying and managing the interplay between upside and downside risk in order to make the long-term decisions to prevent risk and impact on their organization's ability to meet its future business strategy and objectives. The 3 key fields of play are :

Enterprise Risk - helps clients identify and address key risk areas, while building the agility to respond quickly. The areas of focus include Enterprise risk and resilience, Internal audit, Compliance and Internal controls

Technology Risk - helps clients to achieve sustainable growth by supporting their efforts to protect their business performance and by providing trusted communications on internal control and regulatory compliance to investors, management, regulators, customers and other stakeholders. EY teams accomplish this by assessing the technology risks that are introduced to businesses.

Financial Services Risk - helps clients in the financial sector to identify, manage and monitor the risks in their business. It is done through a transformative and agile approach including process and procedures, risk, data modeling and analytics, reporting to stakeholders and third parties, business requirements (for software selection and IT implementation), analysis of assets and liabilities, and capital and liquidity management.

Your key responsibilities

Technical Excellence

- Strong expertise in process mining and process discovery using tools such as SAP Signavio, ARIS, and Celonis. Hands-on experience in analyzing and improving end-to-end business processes across P2P, O2C, R2R, Inventory, and Warehousing. Working knowledge of SAP environments with the ability to assess process flows, control points, and operational dependencies. Experience in solutioning process and control transformation initiatives aligned to business consulting risk requirements. Proven ability to build and lead teams while contributing to business development and client solution design.

- Lead large BPM engagements end-to-end, owning delivery quality, commercial performance, and client satisfaction across multi-workstream programs.

- Design and operationalise BPM Centres of Excellence for clients: operating models, governance structures, modelling conventions, repository management, and adoption programs.

- Deliver hands-on process architecture and modelling work on SAP Signavio, Software AG ARIS, and Celonis, holding the technical bar for the engagement team.

- Build winning proposals for RFPs and RFIs: solution design, effort estimation, commercial construction, and orals presentations.

- Own and deepen client relationships at senior levels, converting delivery credibility into account growth and repeat business.

- Run engagement PMO disciplines: status reporting, risk and issue management, dependency tracking, financial tracking, and steering committee management.

- Lead, coach, and develop project teams of 5 to 15 practitioners across onshore and offshore locations.

- Contribute to practice development: assets, methods, training, and the mentoring of Managers and Senior Consultants.

- Travel overseas for short-term project deliveries, workshops, and client engagements as required.

Skills and attributes

To qualify for the role you must have
Qualification

- Bachelor of Commerce

- Master of Commerce

- Bachelor of Business Administration

- Master of Business Administration

- Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science

- Bachelor of Computer Applications

- Master of Computer Applications

- PhD in Computer Science

- Bachelor of Technology in Mechanical Engineering

- Bachelor of Engineering in Electrical

- Master of Engineering in Electronics

Experience

- Backend Development (3+ years)

- Frontend Development (2+ years)

- Data Engineering (4+ years)

- Project Management (6+ years)

- Business Analysis (3+ years)

- Artificial Intelligence (3+ years)

- Business Intelligence (3+ years)

- Financial Analysis (3+ years)

What we look for

People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

What we offer

Fuelled by the brilliance of our people, EY has emerged as the strongest brand and the most attractive employer in our field, with market-leading growth over competitors. Our people work side-by-side with market-leading entrepreneurs, game-changers, disruptors, and visionaries. As an organization, we are investing more time, technology, and money than ever before in skills and learning for our people. At EY, you will have a personalized Career Journey and also the chance to tap into the resources of our career frameworks to better know about your roles, skills, and opportunities.

EY is equally committed to being an inclusive employer, and we strive to achieve the right balance for our people—enabling us to deliver excellent client service while allowing our people to build their careers as well as focus on their wellbeing.

If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.

Join us in shaping the future with confidence. Apply Now

jobs.title: Infrastructure Lead, Senior Associate / Technology Consulting, AI and Data
jobs.description:
At EY, we develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.

We work together across our full spectrum of services and skills powered by technology and AI, so that business, people and the planet can thrive together.

We’re all in, are you?

Join EY and shape your future with confidence.

The opportunity

EY AI & Data is the data and advanced analytics capability within EY Asia-Pacific, with over 500 specialist employees working across multiple industry sectors. You will be part of a dynamic team that implements information-driven strategies, data platforms and advanced data analytics solution systems that help grow, optimize and protect client organizations. You will be given opportunities to go beyond strategy and provide end to end design, build and implementation of real-life data transformations and be part of the team with some of the best architects, project managers, business analysts, data scientists, big data engineers, developers and consultants in the region. We are seeking a Junior Infrastructure Lead to support and assist in managing our IT infrastructure across on-premise systems, cloud environments, and SAS platforms. This role is suited for an infrastructure engineer ready to take on team coordination and small project leadership responsibilities, while still being very hands-on in operations.

Your key responsibilities

- Support the Infrastructure Lead in managing daily operations across servers, networks, cloud platforms, and SaaS tools.

- Take ownership of small infrastructure initiatives (e.g., server patching, SaaS rollout, cloud migration tasks).

- Provide guidance and mentorship to junior engineers or interns.

- Assist in monitoring system performance, troubleshooting issues, and escalating complex problems when needed.

- Help ensure security, backup, and disaster recovery measures are in place and executed.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams (security, applications, vendors) to deliver infrastructure services.

- Document procedures, configurations, and infrastructure changes.

- Stay up to date with new technologies and propose improvements.

To qualify for the role, you must have

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.

- Minimally 4 years of hands-on IT infrastructure experience (system admin, cloud support, or network operations).

- Exposure to:
• On-premise infrastructure (Windows/Linux servers, virtualization, networking basics).
• Cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
• SAS
• Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to work independently on assigned tasks and lead smaller projects.
• Good communication and teamwork skills, with some experience guiding peers or junior colleagues.
• Certifications (e.g., Azure Administrator Associate, AWS Solutions Architect Associate, ITIL Foundation) are advantageous.

What we look for

Highly motivated individuals with excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to prioritize shifting workloads in a rapidly changing industry. An effective communicator, you’ll be a confident team player that collaborates with people from various teams while looking to develop your career in a dynamic organization.

What working at EY offers

EY offers a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. We are committed to being an inclusive employer and are happy to consider flexible working arrangements. Plus, we offer:

- Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.

- Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.

- Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.

- Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

Company description

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

All in to shape the future with confidence.

GOV :

Our Global Government & Public Sector (GPS) is a network of highly skilled professionals dedicated to serving our clients by bringing best-in-class international experience and insight combined with local knowledge to solve the most critical problems facing governments today. We actively focus on building solutions that help public sector entities face the challenges of the future and reinvent themselves.

Digital transformation is not just about new technologies; it involves an overhaul of organizational structures, governance, work processes, culture and mindset. It also means realizing a wider vision of relationships and business models that will redesign how public services function.

To achieve this vision, we help clients balance strategic choices to re-ignite performance. We have developed a suite of cross-service line strategic solutions that align with our client priorities.

We have a proud record of helping governments meet their challenges head-on, and we work closely with them to build a world that works better for all citizens.

SaT :

The Government and public sector transactions services is part of EY's Government & Public Sector (GPS) Services which is a network of highly skilled professionals from assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, devoted to serving the government and public sector organizations and institutions.

The practice combines private sector leading practice with an understanding of the public sector’s diverse needs, focused on delivering improved public services. Government and public sector transactions services, sits under EY’s Transaction Advisory Services practice, a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team, working with leading businesses across a range of industries. This practice is in a unique position to deliver implementable strategies given the firm’s sector depth, transaction perspectives, and operational insights.

The practice provides experience working with various sectors such as, Transport, Social & Health care, Education, Urban & Infrastructure, Economic Development Advisory , Water waste & Sanitation, Power & Utilities and Public Finance & Management.

SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory :

Strategy and Transactions enables clients to reimagine ecosystems, reshape portfolios and reinvent for a better future. Using our Capital Agenda framework, we work with clients to find answers to today’s toughest strategic, financial, operational and commercial questions. We help corporates, private equity, governments, sovereign wealth funds, private and family businesses, and educational institutions with their key financial issues. From portfolio review and capital allocation processes to financial planning analytics and decision support, we have the people, analytics and tools to better allocate capital. Our team helps clients manage their risk/return trade-offs to support them with better decision-making around financing and capital efficiency.

Whether clients are preserving, optimizing, raising or investing, our Connected Capital Solutions (CCS) are our five go-to-market offerings that help drive competitive advantage and increased returns through improved decision-making. The CCS include Strategy, Corporate Finance, Buy and Integrate, Sell and Separate and Reshaping Results, and are underpinned by our Connected Capital Technologies.

Our key focus areas are - Investment Banking Advisory, Valuations, Modeling and Economics, Transaction Diligence,  Restructuring and Turnaround Services, Project Finance and infrastructure, EY Parthenon - Strategy and EY Parthenon - Execution.

Your key responsibilities

Technical Excellence

- Position Summary The Consultant will support development and maintenance of the regulatory intelligence repository, KYA framework and recommendation engine for NSWS. The role requires extensive research, sectoral mapping, regulatory analysis, stakeholder engagement and development of structured decision rules for business approvals and compliances. Educational Qualification Postgraduate degree in Public Policy, Economics, Management, Law, Governance, Public Administration or related field. Certifications or coursework in regulatory affairs, public policy or business process analysis preferred. Experience Minimum 5 years of relevant experience. Experience in Ease of Doing Business reforms, regulatory analysis, compliance management, government advisory or policy consulting. Experience working with Government Ministries, State Governments or regulatory agencies is desirable. Prior consulting experience will be advantageous. Key Roles & Responsibilities Regulatory Research & Compliance Mapping Conduct detailed research on approvals, licenses, permits, registrations and compliance obligations. Map regulatory requirements across sectors, states and business lifecycle stages. Document legal basis, authorities, timelines, fees, documents and applicability conditions. Maintain structured approval and compliance databases. KYA Questionnaire Development Convert regulatory requirements into business-friendly KYA questions. Design applicability criteria, response options and branching logic. Develop sector-specific questionnaires and decision rules. Support testing and refinement of recommendation outputs. Regulatory Change Tracking Monitor Acts, Rules, Notifications, Circulars and policy reforms. Assess implications of regulatory changes on existing KYA repositories. Update recommendation logic and compliance databases. Maintain version control, change logs and audit records. Consultation & Validation Conduct consultations with Ministries, regulators and State departments. Organise workshops with industry chambers and sector associations. Consolidate stakeholder feedback and incorporate validated changes. Support issue resolution arising from consultations. Data Analytics & Intelligence Support Generate sector-wise, state-wise and lifecycle-specific insights. Prepare analytical reports and dashboards. Support development of strategic intelligence products for NSWS. Develop briefing notes, issue notes and recommendations for stakeholders. Quality Assurance & Implementation Participate in validation and testing exercises. Support UAT and NSWS configuration activities. Verify accuracy and completeness of approval mappings. Ensure consistency across sectoral KYA packages. jobs.description:
Location: Boston, Chicago, New York, San Francisco, Los Angeles

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.  Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity

EY-Parthenon’s unique combination of transformative strategy, transactions and corporate finance delivers real-world value – solutions that work in practice, not just on paper. Benefiting from EY’s full spectrum of services, we’ve reimagined strategic consulting to work in a world of increasing complexity.

With deep functional and sector expertise, paired with innovative AI-powered technology and an investor mindset, we partner with CEOs, Boards, Private Equity and Governments every step of the way – enabling you to shape your future with confidence.

In today’s complex business landscape, creativity has become a necessary ingredient for sustained success. EY-Parthenon Strategy has an ideal balance of strengths – deep and concentrated skills with broad executional capabilities, intimate client relationships with larger networks of support, and proven processes along with a progressive spirit to unlock opportunity for our clients, amplify the impact of our strategies, and make EY-Parthenon Strategy the global advisor of choice for business leaders. You have the opportunity to develop your career through a broad scope of engagements, mentoring and formal learning.

Your key responsibilities

Within EY-Parthenon’s Strategy and Execution Commercial Due Diligence practice, Senior Associates/Consultants identify and analyze the client’s most strategic issues. They are generally the primary contact for our clients, responsible for developing work plans, designing and conducting analyses, synthesizing conclusions and managing other case team members. Senior Associates/Consultants work on a variety of client issues, such as developing growth strategies for organizations, performing due diligence on acquisition candidates, assessing attractiveness of potential targets, understanding new markets, turning around underperforming institutions, reducing operating costs and implementing change, and have the opportunity to assume immediate management responsibility.

Skills and attributes for success

-
Perform secondary research using a variety of sources (e.g., analyst reports, market research reports, news articles).

-
Executing various analyses (e.g., customer segmentation, market sizing, competitor analysis, macroeconomic forecasting) to support the strategic recommendations.

-
Design and executing in-depth interview guides with key organizational stakeholders, industry experts and customers.

-
Analyzing business plans and pro-forma financial models to help identify key assumptions and drivers.

-
Managing and directing the analytical efforts of junior team members at the Associate level daily.

To qualify for the role, you must have

-
Outstanding academic performance, with a bachelor's degree and at least 2 years of related work experience; or a graduate degree and approximately 18 months of related work experience.

-
Experience in strategy consulting, private equity, investment banking, market research, or a quantitative type of research function.

-
Ability to make detailed assessments of industry, products, markets, competitors and customers to identify risks and opportunities.

-
Proficient in the English language, including the ability to listen, understand, read and communicate effectively, both in writing and verbally, in a professional environment.

-
Effective organization and time management skills with ability to work under pressure and adhere to project deadlines.

-
You must either reside in or be in a commutable distance to your office location for this position.

-
The ability and willingness to travel and work in excess of standard hours when necessary. In certain circumstances, travel may be required beyond your work location based on client and project needs.

Ideally, you’ll also have

-
MBA or graduate degree with at least 18 months of related work experience.

-
Excellent problem solving, project management, facilitation and interpersonal skills.

-
Knowledge of how to leverage firm-approved AI tools in a business setting, including Microsoft Copilot.

We are looking for candidates who have a strong aptitude for quantitative and qualitative analysis and the ability to link business strategy to performance. Being a strong team player is critical with the ability to adapt to changing requirements or deadlines in support of our clients’ goals

At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers .

Success in this role will be measured through the delivery of trusted, timely, and highly utilized reporting and analytics solutions; high stakeholder satisfaction; improved data quality and governance; increased adoption of AI, automation, and self-service capabilities; measurable business impact from data-driven insights; and the development of a high-performing, innovative Reporting & Analytics team.

About Sales & Strategic Pursuits (S&SP)

EY's Sales & Strategic Pursuits (S&SP) function unites sales leadership, sector insight, technology expertise and solution depth to drive market-leading growth. As EY's growth catalyst, S&SP shapes and executes integrated go-to-market strategies across priority accounts, industry sectors and strategic alliances, delivering differentiated value through a deeply client-centric culture.

The opportunity

As a Functional Supply Chain Alliance Sales Executive (SE), you will operate at the front edge of growth across EY's alliance ecosystem. This is a true sales hunter role focused on originating net-new opportunities, building pipeline and closing EY services revenue through deep partnership with Blue Yonder, o9 Solutions and ServiceNow, as well as direct engagement with clients and EY account teams.

You will be a market-facing, quota-carrying executive seller with deep functional expertise across supply chain planning, manufacturing operations, logistics, fulfillment and frontline workforce transformation. You will create demand rather than simply respond to it, identifying whitespace, shaping transformational conversations and positioning alliance-powered EY solutions that address complex supply chain and manufacturing challenges.

The role is cross-sector, with priority focus on Consumer Products, Retail, Life Sciences, Industrial Products and Mobility. Success requires the ability to connect functional supply chain priorities to the capabilities of multiple alliance platforms and to orchestrate the right combination of EY services, sector knowledge and partner technology.

Key responsibilities

Sales origination and execution

- Relentlessly originate net-new, alliance-powered services pipeline by identifying unmet client needs, emerging priorities and transformation opportunities.

- Drive sales across three core channels: direct client origination, alliance partner field-led co-sell motions and EY account team-led pursuits.

- Lead early-stage opportunity identification and qualification, shaping pursuits from signal detection and discovery through deal maturation, win strategy and close.

- Deliver against defined sales, origination and pipeline goals, maintaining disciplined opportunity management, forecasting and paths-to-plan.

- Build senior client relationships and lead consultative conversations with supply chain, operations, manufacturing, technology and enterprise transformation executives.

- Provide market intelligence and guidance across the sales cycle, including buyer priorities, competitive positioning, partner dynamics, win themes and pursuit strategy.

Alliance leadership and ecosystem orchestration

- Build trusted relationships across Blue Yonder, o9 Solutions and ServiceNow field sales, industry, solution and alliance leadership teams so EY is positioned as a preferred transformation partner.

- Evangelize EY's alliance-powered supply chain and manufacturing offerings, credentials and points of view with partner sellers, clients and EY teams.

- Shape joint account plans and go-to-market motions, influence partner investment toward EY-led pursuits and create repeatable plays across priority sectors and accounts.

- Serve as the connective tissue across multiple alliances, identifying multi-partner opportunities and orchestrating complementary platforms and services around client outcomes.

- Be the face of the priority supply chain alliances within EY's functional and sector communities, and the face of EY to relevant partner field and industry teams.

Functional and sector impact

- Translate supply chain and manufacturing strategy into executable transformation opportunities spanning planning, inventory, logistics, fulfillment, manufacturing operations, maintenance, quality, workforce enablement and operational visibility.

- Bring manufacturing-industry credibility and knowledge of the operating models, regulatory considerations, network dynamics and value levers relevant to Consumer Products, Retail, Life Sciences, Industrial Products and Mobility.

- Connect alliance capabilities to sector-specific outcomes, including resilient planning, improved service and availability, inventory and working-capital performance, manufacturing productivity, quality, compliance, workforce effectiveness and faster decision-making.

- Work with EY sector, account and capability leaders to prioritize accounts, activate differentiated offerings and build integrated teams for pursuits.

Alliance solution focus

The SE will bring sufficient functional fluency to identify, shape and sell opportunities involving:

- Blue Yonder: supply chain planning, demand and supply orchestration, inventory optimization, logistics, warehouse and transportation capabilities, and fulfillment transformation.

- o9 Solutions: integrated business planning, digital supply chain planning, scenario modeling, decision intelligence and cross-functional planning transformation.

- ServiceNow Industrial Connected Workforce (ICW): digitized frontline tasks, captured knowledge, standardized workflows, AI-assisted decision-making, predictive insights and connected operational execution across manufacturing environments.

- Multi-platform environments: the ability to position these solutions within a broader ERP, MES, CMMS, data, cloud and AI landscape and to identify where alliance combinations create differentiated client value.

AI-enabled selling and innovation

- Infuse AI into account research, intelligent prospecting, opportunity prioritization, pattern recognition, storytelling, proposal shaping and pursuit orchestration.

- Champion AI-enabled EY and alliance solutions with credibility, connecting technology capabilities to measurable supply chain and operations outcomes.

- Serve as a role model for modern AI-forward sales execution and help elevate sales effectiveness across pursuit teams.

Skills and attributes for success

- Hunter mindset with a strong bias for action, curiosity, persistence and discipline follow-through.

- Deep functional knowledge of end-to-end supply chain and manufacturing operations, combined with the ability to translate technology into enterprise business outcomes.

- Exceptional executive presence and the ability to influence senior client, EY and alliance partner stakeholders without direct authority.

- Consultative selling style and the credibility to operate as a trusted advisor rather than a transactional seller.

- Proven ability to navigate a highly matrixed, alliance-driven environment and mobilize cross-service-line, cross-sector and multi-partner teams.

- Strong commercial judgment, pipeline discipline, storytelling and ability to shape complex transformation pursuits.

- Comfort using data and AI insights to guide decisions, account strategies and executive conversations.

To qualify, you must have

- 10+ years of quota-carrying sales experience in professional services, technology and/or enterprise solutions.

- Demonstrated success as a net-new business hunter, with experience across prospecting, discovery, qualification, pursuit shaping and winning complex supply chain solutions.

- Direct experience selling supply chain, manufacturing, operations or digital transformation services to large enterprise clients.

- Meaningful experience in manufacturing and experience serving clients in one or more of the following sectors: Consumer Products, Retail, Life Sciences, Industrial Products and Mobility.

- Functional expertise across supply chain planning and execution, with sufficient depth to engage senior business and technology buyers.

- Working knowledge of Blue Yonder, o9 Solutions and/or ServiceNow, with the ability to develop deep expertise and relationships across all three partner ecosystems.

- Understanding of cloud, SaaS/PaaS, data, AI and integration considerations across ERP, MES, CMMS and other supply chain and manufacturing systems.

- Experience positioning complex, multi-stakeholder digital, technology and/or managed services transformations to C-suite executives.

- Exceptional client relationship management, executive communication and influencing skills.

Ideally, you'll also have

jobs.title: Client Technology - Customer Success Management - Role: Technical Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.  Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity

Technology is central to how EY serves clients and protects trust. The Associate Director, Technical Customer Success Manager (TCSM) is the senior technical advisor for strategic accounts, combining customer success, architecture, cloud, cybersecurity and risk expertise to improve technical health, accelerate secure adoption and translate technology performance into measurable business value.

Working with Customer Success Managers (CSMs), Global Client Service Partners, account technology leaders, Product and Engineering, Information Security, Risk Management and Support, the TCSM owns the technical success plan and coordinates action across the customer lifecycle.

Your key responsibilities

Own account technical health and protection

- Own a portfolio-level view of technical health across adoption, utilization, service performance, incidents, security posture, dependencies, technical debt and open risks.

- Define health indicators, thresholds and action plans; lead recurring technical health reviews and provide clear executive reporting on business impact, decisions, owners and next actions.

- Proactively identify technology, security, privacy, resilience, integration and operational risks that could affect client trust, service continuity or revenue; coordinate mitigation with the accountable governance and delivery teams.

- Lead technical coordination for significant incidents and escalations, including impact assessment, recovery planning, executive communication and post-incident follow-through.

Drive secure adoption and measurable value

- Partner with CSMs to build outcome-based success plans that connect customer priorities, technical milestones, adoption, value realization and risk reduction.

- Guide onboarding, implementation, integration, configuration, optimization and operational readiness for priority capabilities; remove technical blockers and improve time to value.

- Use product engagement, service, integration and risk signals to identify underutilization, adoption gaps and opportunities to protect or grow the account.

- Communicate measurable outcomes such as adoption, resilience, productivity, risk reduction and value realized; support renewal and expansion strategy through technical insight.

Serve as a trusted technical advisor

- Build credibility with senior account leaders, CIO and CTO organizations, CISOs, enterprise architects, product owners and engineering teams.

- Lead architecture reviews, technical workshops, governance discussions and protection planning; translate complex technical and security issues into business implications, options and recommendations.

- Advise on cloud, cybersecurity, identity, data protection, AI, integrations, resilience and emerging technology risks using an industry-informed and risk-aware perspective.

- Lead through influence across a complex, global and matrixed environment, mobilizing Product, Engineering, Security, Risk and Support around customer outcomes.

Scale insight, governance and the CSE practice

- Maintain actionable technology intelligence on capabilities, ownership, dependencies, lifecycle status, risks and opportunities for assigned accounts.

- Act as the voice of the customer by converting feedback, technical blockers and field patterns into structured product, roadmap, service and support recommendations.

- Create reusable health scorecards, success plans, escalation playbooks, reference materials and executive reporting; use approved AI and automation to improve analysis and consistency.

- Mentor colleagues and strengthen collaboration across Customer Success, architecture, engineering, security, risk and product communities.

Skills and attributes for success

- Strong technical foundation across cloud platforms, enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, identity and access management, data protection, integrations, APIs and technology operations.

- Demonstrated ability to assess complex environments, identify material risks, diagnose issues and drive cross-functional resolution.

- Working knowledge of Zero Trust, least privilege, secure by design, vulnerability management, threat detection, incident response, security posture management and data loss prevention.

- Executive presence with the ability to connect technical performance to client trust, service resilience, revenue protection, adoption and growth.

- Strong consulting, facilitation, stakeholder management, prioritization and follow-through skills, with the ability to manage multiple strategic accounts and high-visibility escalations.

To qualify for the role, you must have

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, cybersecurity, engineering, business technology or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

- Approximately 8 to 12 years of progressive experience in customer success management, technical account management, solutions architecture, enterprise architecture, cloud or security consulting, technology risk, implementation or technology operations.

- At least five years in a customer-facing or senior stakeholder-facing technical role supporting complex enterprise, strategic account or global environments.

- Experience in at least two of the following: cloud security, security operations, identity and access management, data protection, infrastructure or application security, resilience, enterprise integrations or technology risk.

- Experience developing technical success plans, health assessments, architecture recommendations, risk mitigation plans, adoption strategies or executive technology assessments.

- Ability to communicate technical risk to senior leaders and coordinate outcomes across Security, Risk, Product, Engineering, Support and business teams without direct authority.

Ideally, you will also have

- Experience in professional services, consulting, regulated industries or globally matrixed organizations, with relevant sector knowledge.

- Familiarity with recognized cybersecurity and governance frameworks such as NIST Cybersecurity Framework, NIST Zero Trust Architecture, ISO/IEC 27001, CIS Controls, COBIT or Cloud Security Alliance guidance.

- Experience with DevSecOps, CI/CD controls, cloud security posture management, vulnerability management, SIEM, DLP, endpoint security, infrastructure as code or security automation.

- Experience applying AI responsibly to customer intelligence, technical support, security operations or risk management, and creating reusable technical assets or communities of practice.

Preferred certifications

One or more role-relevant credentials are preferred, such as Microsoft Cybersecurity Architect Expert, Azure Security Engineer Associate, Security Operations Analyst Associate, Identity and Access Administrator Associate, CISSP, CCSP, CISM, AWS Certified Security, Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer, CompTIA Security+, GIAC, TOGAF, ITIL 4, PMP or Certified Customer Success Manager. Candidates should hold, or be prepared to obtain within 12 months, at least one relevant cloud or security certification. Certifications complement demonstrated technical and customer-facing experience.

Measures of success

- Improved technical health, risk visibility and completeness of executive reporting

- Reduced unresolved technical, security and operational risk, repeat incidents and avoidable escalations.

- Faster onboarding, secure adoption and time to value for priority capabilities.

- Revenue protected or growth influenced through proactive technical leadership and credible customer outcomes.

- Timely mitigation follow-through, stronger stakeholder confidence and actionable product or service improvements.

- Adoption and reuse of CSE playbooks, standards, health scorecards and enablement assets.

Role positioning

The CSE is the strategic technical counterpart to the CSM. The CSM leads relationship strategy, stakeholder alignment and the overall value narrative. The CSE leads technical health, architecture and integration guidance, secure adoption, technical risk visibility and governance. Both share accountability for Protect, Grow, executive reporting and strategic account outcomes.
