Job Description: GDS Meetings & Events Sourcing Manager

Job Title: Assistant Director – Sourcing – GDS Meetings & Events

The Opportunity

The Manager – Sourcing – GDS Meetings & Events is responsible for leading the strategic sourcing function for Meetings & Events across GDS, providing oversight and direction to the sourcing team while ensuring best-in-class commercial outcomes, supplier performance and stakeholder satisfaction.

This role serves as the primary sourcing leader for hotels, venues, event management agencies, destination management companies, audio-visual providers, production companies, and other M&E service providers. The individual will drive sourcing strategy, supplier negotiations, market intelligence and governance while collaborating closely with the Meetings & Events Program Manager to support broader program objectives.

The successful candidate will combine deep hospitality and procurement expertise with strong leadership capabilities to drive service excellence, optimize costs, strengthen supplier partnerships and deliver value-driven sourcing solutions that align with EY policies, risk requirements and Meetings & Events standards.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Sourcing Leadership

- Lead and manage the Meetings & Events sourcing function across GDS.

- Develop sourcing strategies aligned with business requirements, stakeholder needs and program objectives.

- Provide oversight and direction to sourcing specialists on venue sourcing projects and supplier engagements.

- Establish sourcing best practices, governance standards and operational procedures.

- Partner with the Meetings & Events Program Manager to support strategic initiatives and operational priorities.

- Ensure sourcing activities align with global Meetings & Events program objectives and procurement requirements.

Commercial Review & Negotiations

- Review and approve supplier proposals, quotations, contracts and commercial recommendations submitted by the sourcing team.

- Lead negotiations for strategic, high-value and complex sourcing engagements.

- Drive competitive bidding processes, RFPs, RFQs and supplier evaluations.

- Secure advantageous commercial terms, concessions, value-added benefits and contractual protections.

- Identify opportunities for cost avoidance, cost reduction and supplier consolidation.

- Support supplier renewals and strategic contract reviews while maximizing commercial value for the firm.

Market Intelligence & Industry Expertise

- Maintain comprehensive knowledge of hospitality and event industry trends across key markets.

- Conduct ongoing market research covering:

- Hotels and resorts

- Convention centers and event venues

- Event management companies

- Destination management companies

- Audio Visual providers

- Production and creative agencies

- Transportation and logistics providers

- Benchmark market pricing, supplier capabilities and contracting practices.

- Develop and maintain supplier intelligence databases and preferred supplier resources.

- Provide strategic market insights and sourcing recommendations to stakeholders and leadership.

Supplier Relationship Management

- Build and maintain strategic relationships with key suppliers and hospitality partners.

- Serve as the escalation point for supplier-related issues and commercial disputes.

- Lead supplier governance reviews and performance discussions.

- Monitor supplier service levels, contract compliance and stakeholder feedback.

- Drive supplier improvement plans where required.

- Support supplier onboarding, due diligence and risk management activities.

Program Governance & Compliance

- Ensure sourcing activities comply with EY Meetings & Events policies, procurement requirements and contracting standards.

- Promote adoption of approved sourcing processes, supplier frameworks and governance controls.

- Review sourcing recommendations to ensure compliance with legal, procurement, finance, BRIDGE and independence requirements.

- Support audit readiness, documentation standards and supplier governance initiatives.

- Collaborate with the Program Manager to drive operational excellence and policy adherence across the M&E function.

Stakeholder Management

- Build strong relationships with senior business stakeholders, event sponsors and procurement partners.

- Provide strategic sourcing guidance throughout the event lifecycle.

- Act as a trusted advisor on venue selection, supplier strategy and commercial considerations.

- Collaborate closely with Meetings & Events Program Managers, Event Managers and supporting functions to deliver efficient event outcomes.

- Manage stakeholder escalations and ensure a high standard of service delivery and responsiveness.

Team Leadership & Development

- Lead, coach and develop the Meetings & Events Sourcing Specialists.

- Assign meetings, monitor performance and ensure consistent delivery standards across the sourcing team.

- Promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation and continuous improvement.

- Support team capability building through training, mentoring and knowledge sharing.

- Establish performance measures and operational goals aligned with program objectives.

- Foster strong collaboration between sourcing, event management and program management team

Reporting, Analytics & Continuous Improvement

- Review sourcing activity, supplier performance and commercial outcomes through meaningful reporting and analytics.

- Develop KPIs and performance metrics measuring supplier effectiveness, cost savings and sourcing efficiency.

- Identify opportunities to improve processes, technology utilization and stakeholder experience.

- Support continuous improvement initiatives impacting sourcing, contracting and supplier management activities.

- Ensure accurate maintenance of sourcing data, Cvent records, Ariba uploads and supplier databases

Skills & Competencies

- Strong expertise in hotel, venue and event supplier sourcing, with a deep understanding of hospitality operations and industry terminology.

- Proven contract negotiation, supplier management and procurement experience with a strong commercial mindset.

- Ability to drive cost optimisation, budget management and data-driven sourcing decisions.

- Excellent stakeholder management, communication and influencing skills across all levels.

- Strong analytical, organisational and problem-solving capabilities with attention to detail.

- Ability to build and maintain strategic supplier relationships while working independently in a global, fast-paced environment.

Education

Graduate or Bachelor’s degree in hospitality management, Tourism, Business Administration, Procurement, Supply Chain or a related field preferred.

Hospitality or procurement-related professional certifications are advantageous.

Experience

- 10+ years of proven experience in venue sourcing, hospitality procurement, destination management, corporate event management or strategic sourcing.

- 5+ years’ experience in managing a team of sourcing managers or specialists

- Strong experience negotiating hotel contracts and managing large-scale venue sourcing projects.

- Experience working with global hotel chains, event agencies and hospitality suppliers.

- Demonstrated knowledge of meetings and events operations and procurement practices.

- Experience working in multinational, matrixed and stakeholder-driven environments is highly desirable.

What We Look For

We are seeking a commercially minded sourcing professional with deep hospitality industry expertise and a proven ability to negotiate complex event agreements. The ideal candidate will combine strong market knowledge, supplier relationship management and strategic thinking to deliver best-in-class sourcing solutions while supporting EY's global Meetings & Events programme objectives.

Job Description

Role title: Data Acquisition Category Manager

About the AI Ready Data Function:

EY aspires to become the world’s most trusted AI-powered professional services firm, delivering transformative value to clients and employees. Leveraging its extensive data across finance, legal, HR, and core business operations, EY is uniquely positioned to accelerate its data strategy and unlock new opportunities for growth and protection of its business.

To achieve this vision, all Service Lines and global regions must collaborate on strategic priorities aligned with EY’s “All In” goal: safeguarding the current US$50B revenue base while generating the next US$50B. Central to this effort is advancing data management across its lifecycle to enhance existing services and create innovative offerings.

EY’s AI Ready Data Strategy, led by Applied Innovation and the Global Data Office, is the foundation for this transformation. The Data Office drives applied innovation by redefining how data is discovered, managed, utilized, and scaled. A key enabler is the development of an enterprise data platform supported by robust governance, unlocking the full potential of EY’s data assets to fuel innovation and deliver next-level client service.

The Data Acquisition team plays a critical role within this function, enabling EY to source, manage, and optimize strategic data needed to support global service lines, regions, and client engagements.

About the Delivery Team:

The Data Acquisition team consists of Category Managers, Inventory & Finance specialists, and work with colleagues in the wider Data Office and other teams such as Procurement. Together, the team delivers an integrated approach to sourcing and managing data across EY. Category Managers work directly with business stakeholders and collaborate with Procurement, GCO, Finance, Risk and other global functions to meet enterprise data needs efficiently and compliantly.

Position Summary:

The Data Acquisition Category Manager is responsible for managing one or more assigned data categories and Vendors relationships, ensuring the strategic sourcing, evaluation, commercial negotiation, lifecycle management, and performance monitoring of data vendors and products.

This role supports EY’s enterprise data strategy by ensuring that data acquisitions are aligned to:

- business needs,

- category specific insights,

- cost transparency,

- global governance standards, and

- long-term strategic value creation.

Category Managers combine business acumen, data product expertise, vendor knowledge, and commercial negotiation skill to enable trusted, scalable, cost-effective data solutions for the firm.

What We Look For

A successful Category Manager demonstrates curiosity, commercial acumen, and the ability to work constructively with stakeholders. You are comfortable navigating complexity and ambiguity, can build strong relationships across global teams, and proactively seek ways to enhance category performance and value. You bring disciplined execution, high integrity, and a commitment to learning and continuous improvement.

Essential Responsibilities of the Job:

In alignment with the Head of Data Acquisition enterprise sourcing strategy, this role will:

Category Strategy & Planning

- Develop and maintain category plans based on business demand, market insights, and EY’s data strategy.

- Identify emerging opportunities, risks, and trends that shape future category direction.

- Define priorities and usage needs across regions, service lines, and stakeholder groups.

Vendor & Product Management

- Manage assigned vendors across their lifecycle, including evaluation, onboarding, performance monitoring, and issue escalation.

- Lead negotiations and prepare for renewals, ensuring alignment with licensing, IP, privacy, and usage requirements.

- Maintain clear segmentation and scorecards to track vendor performance and product value.

Commercial & Financial Management

- Support budget planning and provide transparency on costs, category spend, and financial risks.

- Conduct category specific analyses such as TCO, ROI, and Cost information assessments.

- Partner with Procurement, Finance and Risk to optimize commercial terms and ensure compliance.

Stakeholder Partnership

- Gather and translate business requirements into clear data specifications.

- Match business use cases to the most appropriate data sources or products within your categories.

- Work collaboratively with functions (Service and Sub Service Lines including Super Region Management and stakeholders, Procurement, Finance, GCO, Risk) to ensure alignment and coordinated execution.

Delivery, Reporting & Governance

- Maintain accurate inventories of category related data assets, contracts, and obligations.

- Produce category specific reporting to support decision making and transparency.

- Ensure all sourcing activity adheres to EY data governance, licensing, and risk management standards.

Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities:

- Apply sound judgment when evaluating data products, commercial options, and vendor proposals.

- Use usage insights, consumption patterns, and ROI data to inform renewal recommendations and prioritization.

- Make decisions that balance business value, cost efficiency, and governance obligations.

Knowledge and Skills Requirements:

- Experience in data management, data supply chains, vendor management or procurement in a global organization.

- An in-depth knowledge of the 3rd Party Data Marketplace providers and vendors such as LSEG, S&P, IDC, Gartner.

- Strong understanding of licensing models, IP and usage rights.

- Ability to analyse comparative strengths of data products and competitive landscapes.

- Skilled in negotiation, relationship management, and working across multi disciplinary teams.

- Proficiency in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint; familiarity with Power BI preferred.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong stakeholder facing presence.

Education & Experience:

- Bachelor’s degree or at least 5 years of relevant experience.

- Experience in procurement, supply chain, commercial negotiation, or data vendor ecosystems preferred.

- Consulting or cross functional project experience advantageous.

- Ability to translate business needs into clear data requirements.

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

The Opportunity

Join our dynamic Business Performance team as an Organization and Workforce Manager, where you will play a pivotal role in optimizing workforce, talent, and mobility strategies. You will be instrumental in future-proofing our operations through the design, development, and influence on operating models and continuous change. As a trusted advisor, you will develop and implement workforce strategies that align with business and functional strategy to meet business objectives. Your expertise will be crucial in understanding workforce requirements to design organizations at the operating model and organization design level to achieve strategic intent.

Key Responsibilities

Our approach to organizational design helps guide our clients from assessment through to implementation. You’ll lead large-scale organizational design projects and advise stakeholders while building relationships with colleagues and clients.  You’ll also work collaboratively to deliver innovative and insightful solutions for a range of challenges, from how to best structure teams to deliver on the organization’s strategy to how the organization’s structure can allow for more agile ways of working.

Skills and Attributes for success

Some key capabilities you should be prepared to bring to client facing and internal initiative teams include:

- You’ll be expected to lead project workstreams, from planning through implementation – including managing project resources and budgets effectively, and identify and effectively manage and mitigate any risks and issues

- Understanding of using organizational design, strategic workforce planning and change management as integral components of transformational initiatives focused on accelerating business performance. Understanding of the opportunities and risks associated with acquisitions, divestures, mergers and the organizational design implications

- Demonstrate technical competence in our key capabilities and take a practical/business driven approach to solving complex client challenges

- Contribute to generate profitable revenue by identifying additional engagement opportunities and building lasting relationships with clients

- Influence and persuade clients and stakeholders to gain support for any major change initiatives and/or decisions

- Encourage and facilitate collaboration amongst team members, and promote an inclusive working environment

- Understanding of human resources opportunities, challenges and issues in at least one of the sectors we serve (e.g., Oil & Gas, Health, Telecommunications, Power & Utilities, Insurance, Media & Entertainment)

- Contribute to business development and client pursuit activities by preparing proposals and delivering presentations for potential clients

- Passionate about advancing the People Consulting practice by leading the development of thought leadership and EY approaches, tools and methodologies in organization design

- Coach and develop teams and colleagues, and act as a visible role model for our people

To qualify for the role, you must have:

- Relevant professional service experience, with a global management consultancy firm, or niche consultancy in which you gained exposure to a large-scale project(s)

- Around 6-9 years of prior experience in  Operating Model Development,   Organizational Structure and Design, Strategic Workforce Planning, Capability Mapping, Organizational Assessment, and Organizational Governance ,  with success in current job applying one or more of these capabilities

- Experience of leading org. design engagements in one or more of the following functional domains – supply chain, IT, finance, customer, sales & marketing. Should have worked in large multi-disciplinary teams as part of functional and enterprise-wide transformation engagements

- Proven track record in managing and analyzing large datasets and using analytics in project execution. Deep expertise in working with and engaging clients in discussions around the use of digital assets in the delivery of org. design projects

- Bachelor's degree required in a related field of business, human resources, psychology

- Willingness to travel as needed, and comfortable working in a hybrid environment with an average of three (3) days per week at a client site or within an EY office.

If you’re looking for a role that will challenge you, give you opportunities to grow and encourage you to own your career, this role is for you.

We’re interested in professionals who enjoy promoting the people agenda in organizations and change initiatives, bringing people issues and challenges to the forefront with the knowledge how these are addressed will be a key success factor in whatever an organization is trying to accomplish.  You’ll need the confidence to keep the people agenda front and center, as well as the interpersonal skills and communications savvy to do this in a way that integrates well with executive priorities and objectives.

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn  more .

- We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business.  The base salary range for this job in all geographic locations in the US is $125,900 to $231,100.  The base salary range for New York City Metro Area, Washington State and California (excluding Sacramento) is $151,200 to $262,600.  Individual salaries within those ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography.  In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.

- Join us in our team-led and leader-enabled hybrid model. Our expectation is for most people in external, client serving roles to work together in person 40-60% of the time over the course of an engagement, project or year.

- Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.

Stay in Compliance Lead – GCS

Job Summary:

The Stay In Compliance Lead within Global Connectivity Solutions (GCS) is responsible for defining, governing, and driving the global network infrastructure compliance strategy to ensure network devices remain current, secure, and aligned with supported hardware and software standards. The role is responsible for maintaining the software and hardware currency of network infrastructure across WAN, LAN, WiFi, SD-WAN, telephony, and related connectivity platforms by leading regular software upgrades, security patching, hardware refresh governance, and configuration remediation activities.

The position proactively identifies and mitigates security risks by leveraging OEM tools, vulnerability intelligence platforms, and security advisories to assess the exposure of network infrastructure to emerging threats and vulnerabilities. Working closely with I&O Stay in Compliance (SIC), Business Relationship Managers (BRMs), OSTS, Network Engineering, Network Operations, Product Owners, and vendor partners, the role drives GCS enterprise-wide compliance initiatives, ensures timely execution of remediation activities, and strengthens the organization's overall network security posture. The Stay In Compliance Lead serves as the central authority for network lifecycle governance, vulnerability management, compliance reporting, and risk reduction across the global connectivity estate.

Job Description

- Own and lead the Global Connectivity Solutions (GCS) vulnerability management program, ensuring identification, assessment, prioritisation, remediation, and reporting of security vulnerabilities across the entire GCS product portfolio.

- Develop and maintain a comprehensive vulnerability remediation and risk management roadmap, leveraging data-driven insights, analytics, and risk-based prioritisation to reduce overall security exposure.

- Establish and execute Global Vulnerability Management compliance plans across WAN, LAN, WiFi, SD-WAN, Telephony, NAC, Internet Edge, and associated network infrastructure platforms.

- Drive end-to-end remediation governance for critical, high, and medium-risk vulnerabilities, ensuring timely closure or approved risk exceptions in accordance with business and security requirements.

- Maintain accountability for compliance against remediation SLAs and security standards established by Information Security, tracking progress, ageing, and compliance performance across the GCS estate.

- Partner with Information Security, Product Owners, Network Engineering, Network Operations, Service Management, OSTS, BRMs, and other stakeholders to ensure effective execution of security remediation activities.

- Define, implement, and continuously enhance policies, standards, processes, and procedures governing vulnerability management, software currency, hardware lifecycle compliance, and security remediation activities.

- Establish and maintain a robust controls framework that ensures effective governance, auditability, compliance monitoring, and risk management across GCS services.

- Collaborate closely with Information Security and Enterprise Technology stakeholders to lead GCS participation in Critical Vulnerability Response Plan (CVRP) exercises and enterprise-wide cyber response activities.

- Continuously monitor OEM advisories, vulnerability intelligence feeds, security bulletins, and threat intelligence platforms to identify risks impacting GCS infrastructure and services.

- Partner with vendors and OEMs to assess the impact of emerging security threats, recommended mitigations, software defects, and lifecycle-related risks.

- Drive execution of critical security patching, emergency remediation activities, and infrastructure upgrades to reduce organisational risk exposure.

- Act as the primary GCS representative within the Intelligent Operations Center (IOC) for security vulnerability management, remediation coordination, and risk response activities.

- Review, challenge, and validate risk exception requests, ensuring technical justification, compensating controls, and business impact assessments are appropriately documented before approval.

- Provide technical guidance and risk advisory support to leadership teams, product owners, and business stakeholders regarding vulnerability remediation strategies and compliance obligations.

- Develop, maintain, and publish executive dashboards, scorecards, and management reports covering vulnerability exposure, remediation progress, security compliance, software currency, hardware currency, and risk posture across GCS.

- Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), risk indicators (KRIs), remediation targets, and compliance metrics to measure programme effectiveness.

- Drive automation and continuous process improvement initiatives across vulnerability assessment, remediation tracking, software upgrades, patch management, compliance reporting, and IOC operational activities.

- Partner with Service Management teams to ensure all security remediation activities adhere to established governance, change management, ITSM, and operational compliance requirements.

- Own stakeholder communications related to security vulnerabilities, remediation plans, compliance risks, maintenance activities, and risk mitigation strategies.

- Lead incident-related vulnerability remediation activities, ensuring effective coordination across technical teams and timely communication to stakeholders.

- Lead and manage the GCS Stay In Compliance team, ensuring clear accountability, ownership, and execution of vulnerability management and remediation activities.

Knowledge & Competencies Required:

- Deep understanding of enterprise networking technologies including routing, switching, wireless, SD-WAN, telephony, NAC, DNS, DHCP, and network security platforms.

- Strong expertise in vulnerability management, network security compliance, patch management, and infrastructure lifecycle governance.

- Experience working with OEM security advisory tools and vulnerability management platforms such as Cisco PSIRT, Meraki, Arista, Palo Alto, Versa, ServiceNow Vulnerability Response, Tenable, Qualys, or similar technologies.

- Strong knowledge of security frameworks, risk management methodologies, and infrastructure hardening principles.

- Proven experience managing software upgrades, firmware lifecycle programs, and security remediation initiatives.

- Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess business risk, prioritize remediation activities, and drive measurable outcomes.

- Experience developing compliance dashboards, executive reporting, and operational metrics.

- Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence and coordinate across technology, security, vendor, and business teams.

- Knowledge of infrastructure lifecycle management, EOL/EOS governance, and technology refresh planning.

- Experience leveraging automation and AI-driven capabilities to enhance compliance monitoring and remediation processes.

- Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to explain technical risks to both technical and non-technical audiences.

- Ability to lead complex global initiatives involving multiple stakeholders, regions, and vendor organizations.

- Demonstrated leadership capability with a proactive, outcome-driven, and risk-focused approach.

Job Requirements:

Education:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related technical discipline

Experience:

Minimum of 12 years of experience in Network technology support.

Certification Requirements:

CCNP preferred, Certification on Versa or CCIE is value add.

jobs.title: EY-Parthenon - Manager - Strategy and Transformation - Industries
jobs.description:
EY-Parthenon is a leading global strategy consultancy. We are committed to bringing unconventional yet pragmatic thinking together with our clients, to deliver actionable strategies for real impact in today’s complex business landscape. At EY-Parthenon, we work with corporate and private equity clients to enable them to reinvent themselves for a better future.

The exceptional EY experience. It's yours to build.

The Opportunity: Your Next Adventure Awaits?

EY-Parthenon teams believe every successful business strategy is underpinned by an in-depth understanding of industry dynamics and the competitive landscape in which it sits. EY-Parthenon teams help clients develop actionable and impactful ways to manage complex shifting challenges and transform their organizations.

The team has built an extensive experience in various domains with the value creation spectrum, such as Strategic Transformations, Transaction Strategy and Execution, Commercial Due Diligence, Commercial Strategy & Pricing and Growth Strategies.

EY-Parthenon is a fast-growing service offering within EY Belgium. This is providing new team members broader responsibilities, more exposure to clients and overall, a significant opportunity for personal growth and development.  Currently we are looking for a Strategy & Transformation Manager to join our team in Belgium.

Your Key Responsibilities

General expectations:

- The EY-Parthenon Strategy & Transformation Manager will have a leading role in the development and execution of our strategy services in Brussels.

- Contribute to business development, by preparing client meetings and project proposals and by participating in client discussions

- Manage projects, coordinate multiple strategy and transaction engagements and motivate your team to work together on common tasks.

- Successfully supervise, coach, and mentor all levels of staff within but also outside of your project context.

- Deliver a high degree of client satisfaction with the engagement process and work products sufficient to drive additional and repeated engagements.

- Demonstrate ability to not only identify strategic opportunities, risks and issues, but also to recommend resolutions.

Strategy & Transformation specific expectations:

- Demonstrate advanced knowledge of all phases and aspects of strategy development and implementation.

- Determine new target operating models and organization design.

- Support clients in achieving sustainable performance and/or improvements within their organizations.

- Create a customized change management strategy and roadmap based on the needs of the project and implement the change management activities for each phase of the project .

- Anticipate organizational changes that come with large-scale implementations and the change management and communications interventions which will be needed .

- Influence a broad spectrum of stakeholders toward achieving business goals, understanding how potential process and system changes might impact upstream and downstream processes and/or systems.

- Analyze cost structures and develop cost reduction or performance improvement programs.

- Work and/or collaborate with key business stakeholders to develop business cases as well as define a roadmap to implement the remediation.

- Work with key stakeholders to improve existing or developing new operational processes and procedures, on a regional/global basis as needed.

- Assist with the organization transformation including building internal process expertise and capabilities.

- Develop integration or carve-out strategies and define and execute detailed planning and implementation concepts across all business and group functions.

Your Profile

You have:

- 4-7 years working experience in a strategy advisory company and/or in a corporate strategy department.

- Master’s degree in civil, bio- or business engineering or economics. An MBA degree is considered as a strong asset.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a practical ability to shape the business agenda and define strategic roadmaps.

- Experience with managing complex business projects, working with multi-disciplinary teams.

- Strong people and leadership skills (incl. cross-functional collaboration, team management and people development & coaching).

- Strong internal and external business development acumen.

- Entrepreneurial spirit, team player and excellent communicator.

- Excellent knowledge of English, Dutch and/or French.

- Motivated to go the extra mile to help build and develop a consulting business that was introduced in Belgium not so long ago.

- Strong affinity with AI & genuine interest in applying new AI trends in a professional context

- Flexible to be engaged in projects across Western Europe.

What’s In It For You

- EY Family – you become part of the EY Family providing you with all the necessary skills, training and opportunities; enabling you to grow to your fullest potential.

- Attractive remuneration package - We offer an attractive remuneration package; including a company car and charging card, iPhone plus subscription, health insurance, pension plan, meal vouchers, and eco vouchers.  Thanks to our flex plan it is possible to choose what you value most.

- Flexible working arrangements - We are proud of our flexible working arrangements. We will actively support you in building a successful career and delivering excellent client service without sacrificing your personal priorities. We offer flexible working hours and working from home multiple days per week is possible.

- I nspiring work environment - At EY we are dedicated to providing you with an inspiring work environment. A work environment that allows you to further develop your skills and enables you to fulfill your true potential.

- Learning & personal growth - You will benefit from an onboarding program, receive extensive training and will be coached by a counselor. We offer a clear career path tailored to your unique skills with necessary guidance.

- Fun - By joining our EY- teams, you can participate in team activities, and companywide events and enjoy a drink during our monthly after-work drink.

- Sustainability - We have a fleet of hybrid and electric cars. Our flex plan makes it possible for you to choose the most sustainable option for you. You can also opt for a train subscription or lease a bike.

- Artificial Intelligence – stay up to date with the latest AI trends through our extensive training opportunities and integrated AI systems. You’ll learn how to leverage AI in a smart and efficient way in your day-to-day work, while developing skills to identify, quantify and track value creation when integrating AI into client environments.

- Diversity & Inclusion - At EY we are passionate about the inclusion and support of individuals of all groups; we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, or disability status.

- Location - All of our offices are easily accessible by public transport and/or by car and have parking space. They all have parking spaces and charging stations are provided.

Here at EY, you’ll have the chance to build a truly exceptional experience. We’ll empower you with the latest technology, surround you with high-performing teams, and provide the global scale and diverse and inclusive culture you need to discover your full potential. Through our coaching and training programs, you’ll develop the skillsets you need to stay relevant today and in the future – all while building a network of colleagues, mentors, and leaders who will be on the journey with you at EY and beyond.

jobs.title: Environment Manager - Risk Management & GCO - EY Global Delivery Services
jobs.description:
Environment Manager – Risk Management & GCO

Overview

Enterprise Technology provides reliable, secure, and resilient technology services to support global business functions. Within this landscape, Risk Management & GCO requires robust environment strategy, governance, and operational excellence to support critical regulatory and control platforms.

The Environment Manager is responsible for managing the end-to-end lifecycle of all environments supporting Risk Management and GCO applications, including planning, provisioning, governance, and coordination with release and change management processes. This role requires strong leadership, operational discipline, and the ability to align technical environments with business and regulatory requirements.

The Opportunity

The Environment Manager will lead environment strategy and execution across Risk Management and GCO platforms, ensuring environments are aligned with business priorities, release schedules, and control requirements. This role is accountable for environment availability, stability, and readiness to support development, testing, and production activities.

You will partner with product owners, development, production support, and business stakeholders to enable seamless delivery and operational continuity.

Key Responsibilities

- Coordinate, plan, and manage all environment-related activities including provisioning, refresh, and lifecycle management.

- Define environment strategy covering availability, utilization, and capacity planning.

- Align environment schedules with release and deployment timelines to ensure readiness.

- Partner with Service Delivery and Operations to ensure coordinated delivery and operational readiness.

- Establish and enforce governance standards including environment controls, access, and data integrity.

- Drive issue resolution related to environment conflicts or instability.

- Provide leadership, direction, and coaching to support teams.

- Ensure clear communication across business, development, QA, and operations teams.

- Identify and implement operational improvements to reduce cost and increase quality.

- Support Agile/SAFe planning and execution across multiple products.

- Track and communicate environment metrics and readiness status.

- Contribute to budget planning and resource strategy.

Analytical / Decision-Making Responsibilities

- Communicate effectively with Risk Management, GCO leadership, and Enterprise Technology stakeholders.

- Influence prioritization and allocation of environments across competing initiatives.

- Balance delivery demands with operational stability and compliance requirements.

- Build strong stakeholder relationships to enable aligned decision-making.

Knowledge and Skills Requirements

- Strong understanding of enterprise environment management practices.

- Ability to translate business and regulatory requirements into environment strategies.

- Experience in Agile/SAFe delivery models.

- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

- Experience with tools such as GitHub, ServiceNow, or similar platforms.

- Ability to develop long-term environment roadmaps aligned to product strategy.

To Qualify for the Role You Must Have

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related discipline.

- 10+ years of experience managing large-scale enterprise environments or platforms.

- 5+ years of experience in environment planning and lifecycle management.

- 5+ years supporting release and change management processes.

- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

- Experience supporting system implementations or migrations.

- Experience with multiple SDLC methodologies including Agile and Waterfall.

- Strong project management capabilities and ability to manage competing priorities.

Preferred Qualifications

- Familiarity with regulatory and compliance-driven environments.

- SAFe or Agile certifications.

- Experience with cloud-based enterprise environments.

What We Look For

- A self-starter with strong ownership and accountability.

- Ability to work across complex, multi-team environments.

- Strong focus on operational excellence and continuous improvement.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you will be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. Our total rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, retirement plans, and a wide range of paid time off options, including flexible vacation based on individual needs and circumstances.

You will have access to continuous learning opportunities to develop the mindset and skills needed to adapt to evolving technology and business demands.

We provide a flexible work environment that empowers you to define your own path to success, supported by leadership coaching, tools, and resources to help you make a meaningful impact.

Our culture emphasizes inclusion and collaboration, ensuring that individuals are respected, empowered, and encouraged to contribute their perspectives while supporting others in doing the same.

- Culture change – architecting the soft and hard measures required to instill a cost-conscious mindset in the organisation and to sustain the benefits of a cost transformation.

- Turnaround / Operational Restructuring - including accelerated cost out, crisis management.

- Fix-Sell-Close - developing and implementing strategic restructuring options for underperforming businesses (or divisions/functions of businesses).

- Account / client management – Proven ability to manage key client accounts effectively, demonstrating consistent commercial success through the development and maintenance of strong client relationships.

- Financial Analysis – Excellent financial analysis and quantitative skills, including ability to review analysis of other team members, quickly identify key insights, and link operational drivers to P&L, cash and balance sheet impacts.

- Business and Commercially Driven – Demonstrable track record of working in a fast-paced environment, while leveraging strong business acumen to add value to clients.

We are open to cross-industry experience but our preferred / focus sectors are:

Additionally you must have:

- A passion for and an understanding how to drive organisational change: from drafting a ‘case for change’ and building leadership alignment to constructing change programmes and designing soft and hard measures to ensure change ‘sticks’

jobs.description:

We advise corporate, financial services, institutional investor, private equity, and public sector clients on strategic, commercial, operational, and investment-related decisions that drive long-term value creation. - Market entry strategy and opportunity sizing

- Divestment options analysis

- Purpose-led strategy and long-term value

- Business model reinvention

- Digital strategy and innovation

- Go-to-market strategy

- Investment strategy and growth strategy

- Institutional investor strategy and portfolio optimization

- Insurance strategy and transformation

- Capital allocation and investment decision-making

- Investment product and distribution strategy

- Operating model design and performance improvement

- M&A, strategic transactions, and investment due diligence

- Customer and channel strategy for financial services organizations

You'll work with a high-performing, integrated team which focuses on a variety of global and local corporate, government, and private equity clients. You'll have a diverse range of stretching experiences which will give you continuous learning and development opportunities as well as a great sense of achievement.  The Canadian Practice is closely integrated with the Americas EY Parthenon organization. We bring the power of our deep global and local insights, client relationships and an informed, current perspective.

Your key responsibilities

We are looking for a candidate to join as Senior Manager in the Canadian Corporate and Operational Strategy team.  The Senior Manager will play an integral role that involves working closely with other members of the rapidly growing Americas Corporate and Operational Strategy team to deliver a variety of engagements and help develop our practice further.

- Lead strategic engagements for clients across financial services, insurance, asset management, wealth management, and institutional investing sectors.

- Manage complexity and lead the engagement planning

- Drive business development efforts by identifying new opportunities, cultivating long-term client relationships, and expanding internal and external networks.

- Support client relationship management while executing projects, delivering a high degree of client satisfaction with the engagement process.

- Support clients in evaluating portfolio strategies, capital allocation decisions, strategic investments, acquisitions, and divestitures.

- Advise executive teams on strategic planning and priorities, growth opportunities and long-term value creation initiatives.

- Assess growth opportunities, competitive positioning, market dynamics, and investment strategies through rigorous quantitative and qualitative analysis.

- Develop strategic recommendations related to business growth, operating model transformation, product innovation, distribution effectiveness, and value creation.

- Analyze investment trends, industry disruptions, customer behavior, and emerging market opportunities to identify strategic implications for clients.

- Support commercial and investment due diligence engagements through market assessments, competitive analysis, and financial evaluation.

- Integrate AI into day-to-day delivery while validating outputs, challenging assumptions, and maintaining accountability for quality.

- Use AI to accelerate analysis, scenario generation, and insight development while maintaining clear linkage to business outcomes.

- Foster an inclusive culture throughout the team and within engagements and proactively build a personal network within the firm.

- Proactively build a personal network within the firm

- Provide effective apprenticeship and coaching to junior team members, fostering professional development, knowledge sharing, and a culture of continuous learning.

- Develop a community within the team – volunteering to support to develop an offer, or other internal practice build initiatives such as Learning, Operations, Resourcing, Recruitment, etc.

Ideal qualifications for this position include:

- Engineering, Finance or Commerce undergrad (MA, MBA, PhD an asset),

- Minimum of 8 years relevant work experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, private equity, institutional investing or financial service strategy roles.

- Demonstrated leadership experience to lead, motivate, and develop high-performing teams while driving successful client outcomes across multiple engagements.

- Experience developing and evaluating corporate, investment, portfolio, or growth strategies.

- Knowledge of financial services sectors including insurance, asset management, wealth management, pensions, institutional investing, and capital markets is considered a strong asset.

- Experience assessing investment opportunities, market attractiveness, business performance, and value creation initiatives.

- Strong understanding of financial and operational drivers of performance within investment management, insurance, or broader financial services organizations.

- Demonstrated ability to combine strategic thinking with financial and investment analysis to support executive decision-making.

- Advanced modelling skills (Excel) and visualization skills (Tableau and/or Power BI).

- Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex ideas and influence senior stakeholders effectively.

- A passion for delivering client impact with a demonstrated track record of initiative, adaptability, intellectual curiosity and excellence in fast-paced environments.

This job posting relates to an existing vacancy within our organization.

We’re interested in talented professionals with the ability to visualize our clients’ goals and think creatively to facilitate them - often in politically charged environments. If you have an entrepreneurial spirit, and a genuine passion for taking on new challenges, this role is for you.

We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. In addition, our Total Rewards package allows you decide which benefits are right for you and which ones help you create a solid foundation for your future. - The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

Because when people feel free to be their authentic selves at work, they bring their best and are empowered to build a better working world.

jobs.description:
The opportunity

EY-Parthenon is establishing a Strategy Realized Global Delivery Team in Argentina to provide near-shore support to the US teams. The Argentina based team(s) are expected to be involved on client engagements across the Strategy Realized service line, including but not limited to strategic assessments, growth strategy, new market or product entry, venture building, go-to-market, commercial diligence and operational transformation.

This role is designed for a strong people manager and problem solver who can lead ‘case cracking’ with the global team, while also managing project timelines, work products and workload. The successful candidate will combine consulting discipline, analytical rigor, strong business judgment, an AI-first mindset with excellent people and project management skills to deliver high-quality work in a fast-paced, client-service environment.

Key responsibilities

- Project leadership: Serve as the day-to-day project lead and primary point of contact for assigned workstreams or engagements, coordinating across Argentina, US and broader global delivery teams

- Work planning and coordination: Translate engagement objectives into clear workplans, milestones, team responsibilities and review cadences; manage timelines, dependencies, stakeholder inputs and issue escalation

- Structured problem solving: Lead and/or support junior team members with framing ambiguous strategic questions, developing issue trees, formulating hypotheses and aligning the team on the analytical path required to answer the client question

- Analytics leadership: Guide quantitative and qualitative analyses, including selection of data sources, methodology design, model logic, quality checks, interpretation of results and articulation of limitations

- Recommendations design: Drive the team from findings to implications, pressure test options, identify risks and trade-offs, and shape practical recommendations for clients

- Deliverable development: Own the quality of client-ready deliverables, including Excel models, PowerPoint slides, dashboards, executive summaries and other outputs in accordance with EYP guidelines

- Quality reviews: Review work product for analytical logic, accuracy, synthesis, storyline, slide polish and source support before sharing with US teams or senior leadership

- Team coaching: Coach Senior Associates, Consultants and junior team members by setting clear expectations, reviewing work, building problem-solving skills and providing actionable feedback

- Collaboration and communication: Collaborate proactively and frequently with local and global teams, communicate risks early, and ensure the team remains aligned on priorities and next steps

- Practice development: Contribute to team-building efforts, reusable assets, playbooks, AI-enabled delivery approaches and knowledge management as the near-shore team scales

Qualifications and experience

- Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or relevant master’s degree preferred

- Approximately 5 to 8+ years of relevant professional experience in management consulting, investment banking, private equity, corporate strategy, corporate development, business development, transformation or an adjacent strategic project environment

- Demonstrated experience leading workstreams or small project teams from problem structuring and analysis through final deliverable creation

- Strong proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel, with ability to review executive-level analyses and develop client-ready presentations

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, including ability to synthesize complex topics into structured narratives for senior stakeholders

- Demonstrated aptitude for both quantitative and qualitative analysis, including comfort working with imperfect and/or large data sets and multiple information sources

- Experience managing junior team members, including assigning work, reviewing outputs and providing feedback

- Ability to work effectively across time zones in a near-shore delivery model and collaborate with geographically distributed teams

Preferred experience

- Experience performing market landscape assessments, customer and competitor research, market sizing, revenue growth analysis, synergy assessment, operational transformation, value creation planning, diligence or transformation roadmap development

- Experience identifying risks and opportunities across markets, customers, competitors, financial performance, operations and organizational capabilities

- Familiarity with data tools such as Power BI, SQL, Python, R or advanced Excel

- Demonstrated aptitude to learn, use and keep pace with AI tools and solutions coming to market, and to drive adoption in ways that enhance work product quality and delivery speed

jobs.title: EY-Parthenon Manager Commercial Due Diligence
jobs.description:
Manager – Commercial Due Diligence (CDD) | EY-Parthenon

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Confidence in your impact today. Freedom to build tomorrow.

At EY, you can be sure that you’re making a difference – for your client, for society, for your colleagues and for your own development. At the same time, you’ll have the freedom to work in a way that fits your life. Whether you choose to specialize, broaden your expertise or grow into leadership, you’re in the driver’s seat. Together with ambitious colleagues in an open and trusted culture, you aim for the best every day. Big on opportunity, friendly in collaboration. EY provides the resources you need to shape your career and make an impact in your field.

Your new job | About your main responsibilities

As a Manager in the Commercial Due Diligence team, you will lead project teams on commercial due diligence engagements and broader growth strategy assignments for private equity and corporate clients. You will combine strong problem solving and analytical skills with team leadership, client management and coaching responsibilities. Your main activities will include:

- Lead commercial due diligence and growth strategy projects from kick-off to final client presentation, ensuring high-quality output and clear recommendations.

- Structure and oversee analyses on markets, customers, competitors and business performance drivers, using both primary and secondary research as well as quantitative modelling.

- Review and manage deal materials to identify critical commercial opportunities, risks and key value drivers related to a proposed transaction.

- Guide project teams in translating complex findings into clear, actionable insights for management teams, C-level executives and investment professionals.

- Take ownership of project planning, day-to-day team management and quality control across workstreams and deliverables.

- Coach and develop consultants and senior consultants through daily guidance, feedback and on-the-job mentoring.

- Build strong client relationships and act as a trusted sparring partner throughout the course of an engagement.

- Contribute actively to business development by helping shape proposals, supporting pitches and identifying follow-on opportunities.

- Support the continued growth of the practice through recruitment, team development and knowledge sharing.

Your new team | About your colleagues and the office

Your team: Within the Strategy department of EY-Parthenon, we focus on developing strategies for growth, digitalization, M&A, and transformation, to help organizations achieve their long-term goals. Our Commercial Due Diligence team works with private equity investors and corporate clients on high-impact strategic questions related to transactions, market attractiveness, growth potential and value creation. We work with organizations in the private equity, energy, financial services, healthcare and life sciences, retail, FMCG, technology, media and telecom sectors. The team is highly engaged and consists of ambitious and knowledgeable professionals who enjoy solving complex problems together and delivering the best possible outcomes for clients.

Your office: Amsterdam Our Amsterdam office is located at the Zuidas: a bustling area full of companies. In our Cross Towers, we welcome up to 1,500 people every day. For a breathtaking view of the city, head to the 22nd floor. Collaboration takes on a new meaning in our Wavespace, a high-tech environment that connects clients and colleagues virtually across the globe.

Your skills and strengths | About your unique contribution

- You have a minimum of 5 years of strategy consulting experience or equivalent, with a strong track record in commercial due diligence, growth strategy and transaction-related work.

- You have proven experience in leading project teams and coaching junior colleagues in a fast-paced, high-performance environment.

- You hold a Master’s degree in Economics, Engineering or Business Administration with strong academic results and coursework relevant to the position.

- You bring a strong commercial mindset and are able to identify the market and company performance drivers that matter most in an investment context.

- You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure complex questions and turn them into practical client recommendations.

- You are comfortable performing and reviewing detailed commercial assessments of markets, customers and competitors by leveraging primary and secondary research tools.

- You have experience presenting findings and recommendations to senior client stakeholders, including management teams, C-level executives and investment professionals.

- You have experience contributing to business development, including proposal writing, pitch preparation and broader practice-building initiatives.

- You are fluent in Dutch and English.

Your benefits | About your perks and work enjoyment

- A competitive salary that reflects your role and responsibilities, depending on experience and qualifications. Plus, a solid pension plan for the future. In addition to your salary, you’ll receive holiday allowance and an annual bonus (based on performance and development).

- You’ll receive a full-time contract.

- A laptop and phone for both work and personal use, and a monthly internet allowance.

- 34 vacation days to recharge and unwind.

- With the mobility budget, you decide how you travel. Choose a lease car, a discounted public transport subscription, or arrange transport easily via our app.

- At EY, we care about a healthy work-life balance. Hybrid working makes this easier. Whether you’re working from the office, at a client, or from home, we’ll make sure you have a well-equipped home office.

- The opportunity to work up to 20 days per year from abroad.

- The option to swap 3 national holidays for non-national ones.

- You’ll have the space to grow both personally and professionally. Whether you want to deepen your expertise, develop your personality, or improve your leadership style, we offer a broad range of trainings and courses.

- Your well-being is our priority. We believe that when you feel good, you perform better. That’s why you’ll have access to the OpenUp wellbeing platform (including for your family). You can easily connect with psychologists and lifestyle experts within 36 hours and take part in wellbeing sessions.

- A strong focus on teaming and various internal networks where you can join all kinds of social activities. A positive work atmosphere and good collaboration with colleagues contribute to your overall happiness at work.

All this within an environment where our core values of integrity, inclusiveness, and respect are central. We think it’s important that you can be yourself and fully develop into the best version of yourself.

Curious about all our benefits? Click here: https://www.ey.com/nl_nl/werken-bij-ey/arbeidsvoorwaarden

Ready to shape your future with us? | About your application process

1. Motivation letter and CV: For this vacancy, we ask you to upload a motivation letter along with your CV. This gives you the opportunity to show us your drive, motivation, and personality. At EY, we support the use of AI tools like ChatGPT, as long as your own tone and unique personality remain visible.

2. Our first contact: After your application, our recruiter will call you within 5 days for a short introduction. We’ll explore whether the role could be a good match.

3. Interviews: We’ll conduct multiple interviews in one day. During these conversations, we’ll discuss your cultural fit, motivation, ambition and fit for the role. You’ll also work on a strategic case, which allows us to see your approach, thinking and structuring capabilities in practice.

4. Partner conversations: If we see a strong mutual match, we’ll invite you for conversations with our partners. This is a final opportunity to explore the role, our team and your ambitions in more depth.

5. We’re a match. You’ll receive an offer and we’ll perform a pre-employment screening. Then your new adventure begins. Welcome to EY!

Research shows that women are less likely to apply if they don’t meet all the criteria. Please feel free to apply even if you don’t meet everything.

EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets. Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

jobs.title: Manager - Strategy & Execution
jobs.description:
The most important things in a few sentences

We develop strategies and deliver transformations that move our clients' business forward, with a strong focus on the healthcare and energy sectors.

In our work, we combine rigorous analysis with ideas that have a real impact on how companies operate – from healthcare providers and pharma players to energy utilities and global infrastructure players. You will work on projects with local as well as international clients that shape the future of essential industries and contribute to long-term, sustainable value creation.

Your role in the team

„At the Strategy & Execution team, we're at the forefront of a rapidly expanding global strategy consulting of EY, with a strong sector specialization in healthcare and energy. Our role involves guiding corporate and private equity clients through critical strategic and commercial considerations that significantly impact their investment decisions in highly regulated and transforming markets.

We navigate various strategic realms, crafting corporate strategies, assessing market entry opportunities, innovating product and service strategies, and analyzing divestment options – often in the context of healthcare systems transformation, energy transition, decarbonization, and infrastructure modernization.

Our focus spans purpose-driven long-term value, business model reinvention, digital innovation, and strategic cost evaluation.

You'll collaborate within a high-performing, cohesive team that serves a diverse portfolio of global and local clients, predominantly in healthcare and energy, including corporates and private equity investors active in these sectors. “

- Martin Hrežo, Partner, Strategy & Execution

What is important to us

Responsibilities:

- Project Leadership : Lead teams to deliver project milestones.

- Strategic Input and Execution : Offer strategic input and assist in the execution of growth plans, mergers, or acquisitions, including transactions and transformations in healthcare and energy sectors.

- Display Problem-Solving Thinking : Apply a problem-solving mindset to dissect complex challenges encountered during market entry evaluations or strategic projects.

- Continuous Learning and Team Collaboration : Embrace a proactive approach to learning, keeping abreast of industry trends, market dynamics, and emerging technologies.

- Contributing to Strategic Projects : Actively participate in strategic initiatives aimed at market entry, growth, and expansion plans, particularly within healthcare and energy markets. Develop and present client-focused solutions for both projects and business development.

- Executing Detailed Analyses : Plan and execute qualitative and quantitative analyses, feasibility studies, and strategic recommendations in complex, often regulated environments.

- Client Relationship Skills : A demonstrated ability to build strong client relationships, fostering trust and credibility through effective communication, understanding client needs, and delivering a high-quality service.

- Team Development : Cultivate an inclusive team culture and contribute towards internal firm initiatives.

Qualifications:

- Sector expertise in healthcare and/or energy  (e.g. healthcare providers, pharma, medtech, payers, energy utilities, renewable energies, infrastructure, or energy transition topics).

- Experience in other sectors (e.g. operations, logistics, financial services, automotive, oil & gas, telco) is an advantage

- You possess a minimum of  2 years' experience in strategy consulting as senior/leading role  in management consulting firm

- You have completed a university degree – strategy/consulting/economics

- English + czech/slovak  (both working professional level or native)

- Working visa in EU.

Preferred Qualities:

- Global Perspective : An appreciation for diverse cultures and a global mindset that enables understanding and navigating international markets effectively. This includes sensitivity to cultural nuances and an openness to exploring opportunities beyond regional boundaries.

- Adaptability to Ambiguity : Proven capacity to thrive in ambiguous situations or uncertain environments, showcasing resilience and adaptability while maintaining focus and clarity in complex and ever-evolving scenarios.

- Leadership Potential : Display signs of leadership potential, whether through prior leadership experiences, initiative-taking, or the ability to influence peers positively, indicating the potential to grow into leadership roles within the team.

- Business Understanding : Display a solid understanding of business across multiple sectors.

What we offer

We offer an attractive starting salary with an annual bonus if your work goes well. Additionally, we provide benefits that will surely please you:

- Time off:  6 weeks of leave to recharge.

- Referral reward:  Earn from 10,000 to 70,000 CZK for referring a new colleague.

- Benefit points:  30,000 CZK on Benefity.cz to spend as you wish. For example, you can purchase a Multisport card, shop for gifts, or book a trip on Slevomat.

- Professional development: You will continuously learn and develop your skills with us. We offer a unique professional development program and a wide range of courses in our learning map. You can access the educational portal and we offer language courses. Our colleagues will provide support in the form of counseling and internal coaching.

- Employee discounts:  Enjoy discounted offers on a wide range of services. Discounts are available at Fruitisimo, Sushi Time, and the BodyBody fitness center, amongst others.

- Health and care:  Gain access to fast and convenient online consulting at uLékaře.cz from qualified doctors.

- Teamwork and fun:  With us, it's not just about work, but also about fun and team cooperation. We frequently organize team events such as dinner or bowling, alongside company parties and other great events that strengthen our team atmosphere. You can also participate in CSR activities.

What to expect after submitting your application

- The first step is an  online meeting with our recruiter  Karolina, where you will discuss all the necessary details of the position.

- Subsequent rounds are  online interviews with Strategy & Execution team members  where you will receive a brief introduction from one of our colleagues, followed by a case study. These rounds will also include questions relating to personal fit. They are a great opportunity to meet and interact with your potential future team members.

- The final part of the selection process is an interview with the  team partner - Martin Hrežo.

You can join us anytime. We will arrange the start date according to your needs. We look forward to meeting you!

jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

The opportunity

EY is looking for a Manager/ Senior Manager to join our leading Valuation and Modelling and Economics practice, with focus on Financial Services Sector (Banking and Capital Markets (BCM), Insurance, and Wealth and Asset Management (WAM)).

Your key responsibilities

EY has an established industry leading practice in Strategy and Transactions practice. We advise our clients in addressing their transaction and non-transaction related decision-making process including strategic planning, identification and assessment of value creation for various purposes including strategic expansions / optimizations, reshaping results, operating model redefinition, feasibility assessment/business planning, financial reporting, market valuation, transactional considerations, etc.

You will understand the key business drivers, co-developing our approach with the client, agreeing value measurements with the client, providing value to the client through insights, factual conclusions and advice. You will support Financial Services Sector clients in defining their strategic objectives and priorities through performing strategic analysis work to transaction execution. You will plan, prepare and review deliverables in various forms including excel data books, written reports, presentations and discussions with the client. You will understand the capabilities of the firm and look for opportunities to sell additional services to our clients.

Skills and attributes for success

We are looking for experienced Strategy and Transactions professionals with good understanding and experience relevant for the Financial Services Sector (Banking, Insurance and Asset Management), to join our high performing team.

Qualifications & Experience:

- As a minimum, a bachelor's degree in finance, economics, accounting or business and 7-12 years of related business valuation work experience

- In-depth understanding as well as expertise in various valuation methodologies, market assessment, market sizing, feasibility and business plans building, operating and commercial models review, financial analyses, capital allocation and cost optimization, portfolio optimization etc.

- Financial modelling skills including experience building models from scratch

- Strong understanding of the financial services institutions’ balance sheet structure and operating models.

- Broad understanding of IFRS standards related to fair value measurements, business combination, impairment testing etc.

Ideally, you’ll also

- Have previous valuation experience in professional services/Big 4 Firm

- Made an achievement of or significant progress towards a CFA

Solution driven individual and “out-of-comfort” zone thinker with demonstrated record of solving complex problems and completing challenging projects. GOV :

Our Global Government & Public Sector (GPS) is a network of highly skilled professionals dedicated to serving our clients by bringing best-in-class international experience and insight combined with local knowledge to solve the most critical problems facing governments today. We actively focus on building solutions that help public sector entities face the challenges of the future and reinvent themselves.

Digital transformation is not just about new technologies; it involves an overhaul of organizational structures, governance, work processes, culture and mindset. It also means realizing a wider vision of relationships and business models that will redesign how public services function.

To achieve this vision, we help clients balance strategic choices to re-ignite performance. We have developed a suite of cross-service line strategic solutions that align with our client priorities.

We have a proud record of helping governments meet their challenges head-on, and we work closely with them to build a world that works better for all citizens.

SaT :

The Government and public sector transactions services is part of EY's Government & Public Sector (GPS) Services which is a network of highly skilled professionals from assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, devoted to serving the government and public sector organizations and institutions.

The practice combines private sector leading practice with an understanding of the public sector’s diverse needs, focused on delivering improved public services. Government and public sector transactions services, sits under EY’s Transaction Advisory Services practice, a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team, working with leading businesses across a range of industries. This practice is in a unique position to deliver implementable strategies given the firm’s sector depth, transaction perspectives, and operational insights.

The practice provides experience working with various sectors such as, Transport, Social & Health care, Education, Urban & Infrastructure, Economic Development Advisory , Water waste & Sanitation, Power & Utilities and Public Finance & Management.

SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory :

Strategy and Transactions enables clients to reimagine ecosystems, reshape portfolios and reinvent for a better future. Using our Capital Agenda framework, we work with clients to find answers to today’s toughest strategic, financial, operational and commercial questions. We help corporates, private equity, governments, sovereign wealth funds, private and family businesses, and educational institutions with their key financial issues. From portfolio review and capital allocation processes to financial planning analytics and decision support, we have the people, analytics and tools to better allocate capital. Our team helps clients manage their risk/return trade-offs to support them with better decision-making around financing and capital efficiency.

Whether clients are preserving, optimizing, raising or investing, our Connected Capital Solutions (CCS) are our five go-to-market offerings that help drive competitive advantage and increased returns through improved decision-making. The CCS include Strategy, Corporate Finance, Buy and Integrate, Sell and Separate and Reshaping Results, and are underpinned by our Connected Capital Technologies.

Our key focus areas are - Investment Banking Advisory, Valuations, Modeling and Economics, Transaction Diligence,  Restructuring and Turnaround Services, Project Finance and infrastructure, EY Parthenon - Strategy and EY Parthenon - Execution.

Your key responsibilities

Technical Excellence

- Senior Project Manager shall be stationed at the Head Office of the Ports & Transport Department (PTD) in Gandhinagar and will provide support in the following areas: a) Assisting in the preparation of periodic status reports, minutes of meetings, and tracking of action points arising from meetings conducted by the PTD; b) Supporting the preparation of presentations for review and status update meetings with officials of the GoG and GoI; c) Assisting in the conceptualization of new initiatives, including preparation of concept notes, briefs, and presentations; d) Coordinating with officials across various HoDs under the PTD to collate and compile project-related updates.

To qualify for the role you must have
Qualification

- •\tShall have a Post Graduate Degree in Transport Planning / Business Administration or relevant streams •\tStrong working experience in Transport Planning •\tExperience of working in assignments under Government organisations

Experience

- •\tShall have a Post Graduate Degree in Transport Planning / Business Administration or relevant streams •\tStrong working experience in Transport Planning •\tExperience of working in assignments under Government organisations

People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements.
