TMT :

Industry convergence offers TMT (Technology, Media & Entertainment, and Telecommunications) organizations the chance to evolve and transform, but it also presents challenges around competitiveness and delivering agile corporate strategies for growth. Content distributors are transforming into content producers, service providers are becoming tech companies, technology companies are the catalyst for dramatic change in every sector, and customers want the latest innovations now.

We help TMT companies create compelling employee and customer experiences, retaining skills and talent while achieving enterprise-wide operational excellence. We help them protect their data, brand and reputation. We also enable the pursuit of M&A strategies that systematically create value, reduce risk and transform TMT companies into powerhouses that will lead the technology revolution of the future – building a better working world for all.

CNS - BC - FINANCE :

EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client-centric approach focuses on driving long-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.

Business Consulting works with clients to reimagine or transform their business purpose and model; create growth; manage cost and efficiency; respond to market pressures and regulation; and resolve operational challenges. The scope of this team encompasses innovation, strategy and purpose, through deep functional experience in business transformation, finance, supply chain and operations, providing support for the complex and large-scale program and portfolio management.

It has multiple fields of play such as:

Finance Consulting - helps assess and transform our clients' finance function to improve performance and effectiveness. We help organizations implement service and cost improvement initiatives, and embed a performance management process and culture that unites the business around its core objectives.

Business Transformation - a m?ultidisciplinary competency, gathering capabilities in transformation architecture, experience design, business design and transformation execution to problem-solve, design and deliver large scale, multi-year, multi-stakeholder transformation programs.

Supply Chain and Operations - we provide a unique combination of industry-specific, strategic, operational and financial insights, digital technology advances and strategic alliance partners to deliver better outcomes and also help clients effect fundamental change in their operations’ performance to support sales growth, become more cost competitive, minimize risk and ensure operational resilience.

Your key responsibilities

Technical Excellence

- Business Planning & Service Delivery

- Convert business priorities into clear operating plans, capacity requirements, service objectives and team goals.

- Own end-to-end delivery for the assigned finance process or portfolio, ensuring agreed service levels, quality, accuracy and timeliness.

- Monitor operational performance through meaningful KPIs, root-cause analysis and action plans; provide transparent updates to leadership and stakeholders.

- Plan resources effectively across business cycles, month/quarter/year-end peaks, transitions and transformation initiatives. Finance Process Leadership

- Lead one or more finance domains based on experience and business need: RTR, PTP, OTC, Treasury, Controllership and/or FP&A.

- For RTR/Controllership: oversee close, general ledger, reconciliations, journal governance, intercompany, reporting, balance-sheet integrity and audit support, as applicable.

- For PTP: oversee purchasing-to-payment operations including invoice processing, controls, vendor queries, payments, ageing and working-capital opportunities, as applicable.

- For OTC: oversee billing, cash application, collections, credit management, dispute resolution, receivables reporting and working-capital performance, as applicable.

- For Treasury: oversee cash positioning, liquidity, banking operations, payments, forecasts, controls and treasury reporting, as applicable.

- For FP&A: oversee planning, budgeting, forecasting, management reporting, variance analysis, performance insights and decision support, as applicable. Controls, Compliance & Risk Management

- Ensure processes operate in accordance with company policies, accounting standards, delegation of authority, regulatory requirements and internal control frameworks.

- Maintain robust process documentation, SOPs, desktop procedures, control evidence and knowledge repositories.

- Identify financial and operational risks early, implement preventive and corrective actions, and support internal, statutory and external audits.

- Promote a strong controls and compliance culture while balancing governance with efficient business outcomes. Transformation & Operational Excellence

- Drive simplification, standardization, automation and productivity improvement across the assigned portfolio.

- Use data and process insights to identify recurring issues, remove non-value-added activities and improve customer experience.

- Partner with technology, process owners and business teams on system implementations, migrations, transitions and continuous-improvement programs.

- Embed scalable ways of working and share leading practices across teams and locations. Stakeholder & Change Management

- Build trusted relationships with business finance, operations, procurement, sales, tax, legal, technology, banks, vendors, customers and auditors, as relevant to the portfolio.

- Facilitate governance reviews, resolve escalations, communicate trade-offs clearly and ensure ownership of agreed actions.

- Act as a change leader during organizational, process and technology transformation. People Leadership

- Lead, coach and develop a high-performing team with clear accountability, role clarity and performance expectations.

- Plan staffing, hiring, onboarding, succession and capability development in line with current and future business needs.

- Create an inclusive, collaborative and learning-oriented environment that supports engagement, retention and internal mobility.

Skills and attributes

To qualify for the role you must have
Qualification

- Graduation/Post Graduation in Finance or related domain

Experience

- 2-5 years

What we look for

People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

What we offer

Fuelled by the brilliance of our people, EY has emerged as the strongest brand and the most attractive employer in our field, with market-leading growth over competitors. jobs.title: FSO FAAS TAAG - Transactions-Manager
jobs.description:
Location: Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Charlotte, Dallas, Hoboken, McLean, New York

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.  Join EY and help to build a better working world.

When our clients are facing complex finance and accounting issues, they look to us for insights given our deep experience and subject matter expertise Whether weighing the pros and cons of capital transaction structure alternatives, analyzing the hedging strategy to minimize operational risk, leasing a new headquarters, investing in a new business, we provide the support and guidance needed for to allow our clients to answer important questions.

The opportunity
Our Financial Accounting Advisory Services (FAAS) team is growing exponentially, and as a Manager in our Transactions group, you will play a critical role in shaping and sustaining that momentum. Working across a broad range of industries, you will have the opportunity to advance your career by developing and communicating innovative, strategic solutions both internally and with clients.

This role requires a strong focus on listening to and understanding our clients’ unique challenges, enabling you to deliver tailored insights and an exceptional client experience in an environment where there are no “off-the-shelf” solutions. As part of our Financial Services Office (FSO) FAAS Transactions team, you will advise companies on complex financial reporting and accounting matters, including—but not limited to— revenue recognition; share-based payments; financial asset transfers and securitizations; consolidation; leases; and mergers and acquisitions.

Your Key Responsibilities
The nature of this role means no two projects will be the same. That means you’ll need to develop a deep understanding of key complex accounting areas and use that knowledge to think on your feet and challenge existing practices to help our clients develop answers to complex issues. You’ll also be collaborating with colleagues within FAAS and across multiple service lines, so we’ll look to you to build relationships and identify opportunities to bring insights across all disciplines beyond accounting to our clients. . Regular travel may be required as you will be meeting with key clients, some of those being the most respected in their fields.

Skills And Attributes For Success

- Consulting with clients on complex and technical accounting issues

- Collaborating with partners, senior managers and clients to influence strategy, balancing risk and client expectations

- Ensuring our Engagement team thoroughly understands our clients’ unique needs, ambitions and expectations

- Building relationships with colleagues across multiple service lines to provide seamless integrated service

- Managing performance and identifying opportunities to improve our products and processes

To qualify for the role you must have

- A bachelor's degree, CPA certification and 2 to 5 years work experience preferably as an auditor in a public accounting firm

- Strong technical writing and presentation skills

- A thorough understanding of US GAAP

- Exposure or interest in revenue recognition, share-based payments, financial asset transfers such as securitizations and factoring agreements,  consolidations and equity method accounting

- Exposure to strategic transactions, such as business combinations, M&As and joint ventures

- An understanding of financial services industry, as well as commonly used terminology, processes and tools

- A proven record of excellence when managing, mentoring and improving a team of high-performing colleagues

- The confidence to research and resolve emerging client issues, including regulations, industry practices and new technologies

What We Look For
We’re interested in versatile people with the ability to take on new responsibilities and listen to clients to help them meet their goals. We’re not just looking for technical accounting experience — we’re after genuinely interesting people with the ability to build relationships, negotiate, present and think in unique and creative news ways. If you’re a confident leader with a curious mind and the ability to solve complex issues, this role is for you.

What Working At EY Offers
We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, a minimum of three weeks of vacation plus ten observed holidays and three paid personal days, and a range of programs and benefits designed to support your physical, financial and social well-being. Plus, we offer

- Support and coaching from some of the most engaging colleagues in the industry

- Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career

- The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

About EY
As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom to make things better. So that whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime.

If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.

Make your mark. Apply today.

What we offer you
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn  more .

- We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business.  The base salary range for this job in all geographic locations in the US is $112,700 to $206,500.  The base salary range for New York City Metro Area, Washington State and California (excluding Sacramento) is $135,200 to $234.800.  Individual salaries within those ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography.  In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.

- Join us in our team-led and leader-enabled hybrid model. Our expectation is for most people in external, client serving roles to work together in person 40-60% of the time over the course of an engagement, project or year.

- Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
EY accepts applications for this position on an on-going basis.

jobs.title: EY-Parthenon - Senior Manager - Transaction Diligence
jobs.description:
Confidence in your impact today. Freedom to build tomorrow.

At EY, you can be sure that you’re making a difference – for your client, for society, for your colleagues, and for your own development. At the same time, you’ll have the freedom to work in a way that fits your life. Whether you choose to specialize, broaden your expertise, or grow into leadership, you’re in the driver’s seat. Together with ambitious colleagues in an open and trusted culture, you aim for the best every day. Big on opportunity, friendly in collaboration. EY provides the resources you need to shape your career and make an impact in your field.

Your new job | About your main responsibilities

Leverage your expertise as a Senior Manager in Financial Due Diligence and make a difference in the transaction world.  With us, you will have the opportunity to conduct in-depth financial analyses and provide valuable insights to the owners and management teams of our clients. As part of our team, you will be involved in assessing financial information, identifying risks and opportunities, and presenting clear reports. Do you want to use your financial expertise to contribute to successful transactions?

Responsibilities:

- You will manage engagements where we analyze the historical and projected results of the company, its financial position, and other complex issues, using data analytics, combining insights from various sources, and conducting interviews.

- You’ll lead complex financial due diligence projects from scoping to completion, coordinating multidisciplinary teams and overseeing quality control.

- By reviewing (projected) EBITDA, working capital levels, and balance sheet positions, you will map out the value drivers, opportunities, and risks of the company.

- Together with the team, you will translate your conclusions into specific points of attention for the valuation and structuring of the transaction. This will provide input for negotiations regarding the purchase price and terms of the transaction.

- You will be the critical link in the M&A process with your team, maintaining close contact with other advisors, both within and outside EY, and other stakeholders in the transaction.

- Contribute to the development of the team and thought leadership.

Your new team | About your colleagues and the office

Mergers and acquisitions are among the most complex projects for a company, with significant strategic impact. The risks associated with such a transaction can be substantial, with many factors influencing the success and speed of the transaction. To avoid the well-known "cat in the bag," the buyer must conduct thorough research into the financial, commercial, operational, and legal aspects of the company to be acquired. The specialists in Transaction Diligence act as a spider in the web when conducting financial due diligence investigations.

The Team

Within the Transaction Diligence department, we investigate and analyze financial results to understand the story behind them and gauge financial health. The goal is to assist our clients in making strategic investment decisions. You will work closely on a project with direct colleagues and other departments within EY to form a complete picture of the company being investigated. Our clients are very diverse, including multinationals, SMEs, financial institutions, and private equity firms.

Your office

Amsterdam
Our Amsterdam office is located at the Zuidas: a bustling area full of companies. In our Cross Towers, we welcome up to 1,500 people every day. For a breathtaking view of the city, head to the 22nd floor. Collaboration takes on a new meaning in our Wavespace, a high-tech environment that connects clients and colleagues virtually across the globe.

Your skills and strengths | About your unique contribution

- You have at least 8 years of work experience in mergers and acquisitions, and have strong affinity with corporate finance, and the financial world in general.

- You hold a master's degree in Finance, (Financial) Economics, Finance & Investments, Accounting & Financial Management, or another finance-oriented or technical field.

- You have strong commercial acumen and experience in leading teams and engagements.

- You are proficient in both Dutch and English, both spoken and written.

- You are experienced with Microsoft Office and Excel, and have an affinity for working with new data analysis tools (Alteryx and Power BI).

-

Your benefits | About your perks and work enjoyment

- A competitive salary that reflects your role and responsibilities, depending on experience and qualifications. Plus, a solid pension plan for the future. In addition to your salary, you’ll receive holiday allowance and an annual bonus (based on performance and development).

- You’ll receive a permanent contract for 40 hours .

- A laptop and phone for both work and personal use, and a monthly internet allowance.

- 34 vacation days to recharge and unwind, plus the option to buy extra days.

- With the mobility budget, you decide how you travel. Choose a lease car, a discounted public transport subscription, or arrange transport easily via our app.

- At EY, we care about a healthy work-life balance. Hybrid working makes this easier. Whether you're working from the office, at a client, or from home, we’ll make sure you have a well-equipped home office.

- The opportunity to work up to 20 days per year from abroad.

- The option to swap 3 national holidays for non-national ones.

- You’ll have the space to grow both personally and professionally. Whether you want to deepen your expertise, develop your personality, or improve your leadership style, we offer a broad range of trainings and courses.

- Your well-being is our priority. We believe that when you feel good, you perform better. That’s why you’ll have access to the OpenUp wellbeing platform (including for your family). You can easily connect with psychologists and lifestyle experts within 36 hours and take part in wellbeing sessions.

- A strong focus on teaming and various internal networks where you can join all kinds of social activities. A positive work atmosphere and good collaboration with colleagues contribute to your overall happiness at work.

All this within an environment where our core values of integrity, inclusiveness, and respect are central. We think it’s important that you can be yourself and fully develop into the best version of yourself. Curious about all our benefits? Click here .

Ready to shape your future with us? | About your application process

1. For this vacancy, we ask you to upload a motivation letter along with your CV. This gives you the opportunity to show us your drive, motivation, and personality. At EY, we support the use of AI tools like ChatGPT, as long as your own tone and unique personality remain visible.

2. Our first contact: After your application, our recruiter will call you within 5 days for a short introduction. We’ll explore whether the role could be a good match.

3. First interview: Before the interview, we’ll ask you to complete an online assessment. Not a standard questionnaire, but a game-based assessment focusing on both your cognitive skills and behavioral preferences. We’ll discuss the results during the interview, which will include a colleague from the relevant department. This mutual introduction is a chance for us to get to know you, and for you to ask any questions you have.

4. Second interview: If we see a match and you’re still enthusiastic, we’ll invite you for a second interview. We’ll dive deeper into the role and other relevant topics. Sometimes, a business case is part of the process. A final interview may also follow.

5. We’re a match. You’ll receive an offer and we’ll perform a pre-employment screening. Then your new adventure begins. Welcome to EY!

Research shows that women are less likely to apply if they don’t meet all the criteria. Please feel free to apply even if you don’t meet everything.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

UKI Assurance - Transaction Forensics - Sales & Purchase Agreements - Manager

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture, and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

This is a high-profile role working with some of the world's largest companies and offers an exciting opportunity to gain exposure to the dynamic world of Transaction Forensics. Our team is highly ambitious and has significant growth aspirations over the next year.

The opportunity

EY's Forensic and Integrity Services – Sale and Purchase Agreements (SPA) team provides expert support to clients, investment banks, lawyers, and deal teams on Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A) pricing mechanisms and the accounting aspects of SPAs, including support around any post-deal Completion Accounts. You will assist clients in their SPA negotiations and will interact with deal teams and clients across the transaction life cycle.

Your key responsibilities

You will manage and deliver advice around the price adjustment mechanisms on M&A transactions, working closely with clients, their bankers and legal advisers, transaction diligence teams, and other SPA team members. This may include analysis of cash, debt and working capital adjustments, preparation of pricing schedules, reviewing and commenting on the financial aspects of the SPA, assisting the client with their preparation or review of Completion Accounts, and performing Leakage reviews.

- Managing and contributing to the delivery of Transaction Forensics engagements, per agreed timeline and budget

- Adhering to Quality and Risk Management (QRM) to ensure client work is delivered consistently and in compliance with EY's quality standards

- Supporting negotiations with clients throughout the transaction, agreeing detailed and compelling outputs

- Providing insightful, deal-relevant points of view and recommendations to the client by leveraging your technical and commercial expertise

- Building valued relationships with internal contacts and external clients to support development of the engagement pipeline

- People and performance management, coaching of junior colleagues throughout the performance year

Skills and attributes for success

Interpersonal skills and risk management are key as you will be working closely with due diligence teams to identify and mitigate risk for clients, as well as developing a strong internal and external network. For the right candidate, this opportunity will provide stimulation and challenge, and the prospect of career development in a key specialism within the firm.

To qualify for the role, you must have

- Fully qualified as a chartered accountant e.g. ACA / ACCA / CA / ICAS / ICAEW or international equivalent

- Experience coordinating M&A transactions in a managerial capacity

- Expertise in financial information analysis, including modelling, testing, documenting financial scenarios and anticipating challenges

- Project management and people management experience

Ideally, you’ll also have

- Commercial awareness and the desire to learn and share industry knowledge

- An application and solution-based approach to problem solving and a collaborative approach to management

- Strong negotiation capabilities, able to analyse strengths and weaknesses of opposing cases, formulate alternative scenarios, and advise on strategic implications

- Ability to simultaneously handle multiple pressing assignments, and sensitive and adversarial situations

- Ability to communicate clearly to clients and other advisors, including confidently preparation and delivery of high calibre presentations and thought leadership

What we look for

We are looking for highly motivated team players who are hands-on and rigorous in their working style, and capable of thriving in a fast-paced environment. We’re interested in people with excellent analytical and negotiation techniques, and a desire to develop their specialist skill set in a high value-add area for corporate and private equity clients.

What we offer

EY is committed to being an inclusive employer and we are happy to consider flexible working arrangements. We strive to achieve the right balance for our people, enabling us to deliver excellent client service whilst allowing you to build your career without sacrificing your personal priorities. While our client-facing professionals can be required to travel regularly, and at times be based at client sites, our flexible working arrangements can help you to achieve a lifestyle balance.

We offer a competitive remuneration package. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings, and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:

- Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.

- Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.

- Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.

- Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

If you can demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.

The exceptional EY experience. Shape your future with confidence!

Apply now.

Please note : Prior to finalizing your application, you will be asked to provide personal information across several dimensions of diversity and inclusiveness. The information you provide is kept entirely confidential and will not be used to evaluate your candidacy. We collect this data to help us analyse our recruitment process holistically and implement actions that promote diversity and inclusiveness. While optional, we encourage you to provide this information to hold us accountable towards our goal of building a better working world. We ask because it matters!

EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

jobs.description:
Wien | Vollzeit | ab sofort | Consulting

Dein Team & Umfeld

Unser rund 35-köpfiges Technology Strategy & Transformation Team unterstützt Unternehmen bei der strategischen Ausrichtung ihrer Technologieorganisationen. Als IT Strategy Team begleiten wir unsere Kund:innen bei der Entwicklung von IT-Strategien, der Gestaltung zukunftsfähiger IT Operating Models sowie bei IT-Themen im Rahmen von Transaktionen, in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unserer Strategieberatung EY-Parthenon.

Unser modernes Office im IZD-Tower mit Blick auf die Donau bietet Raum für Produktivität, kreative Pausen in der EY-Lounge und echten Teamspirit.

Deine Aufgaben & Verantwortlichkeiten

- Entwicklung von IT-Strategien, IT Operating Models und Transformation Roadmaps für die zukunftsfähige Ausrichtung von IT-Organisationen

- Bearbeitung von IT-Themen in M&A Projekten, von der IT Due Diligence bis hin zu IT Carve-outs und Post-Merger-Integrationen

- Analyse von IT-Kosten, Synergiepotenzialen sowie Ableitung von Maßnahmen

- Aufbereitung und Präsentation von Ergebnissen sowie Handlungsempfehlungen für IT-Management, Investor:innen und C-Level-Stakeholder:innen

- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit anderen EY Service Lines sowie internationalen Expert:innen in interdisziplinären Projektteams

- Übernahme von Verantwortung für (Teil-)Projektteams, Workstreams und strategische Initiativen

Fähigkeiten für deinen Erfolg

Must-haves:

- Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium mit Schwerpunkt Wirtschaft, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung

- 3-8 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Managementberatung, IT-Strategie, IT-Organisationsentwicklung oder einer vergleichbaren strategischen Funktion

- Analytisches Denkvermögen und strukturierte Problemlösungsfähigkeiten

- Sicherer Umgang mit KI-gestützten Tools beziehungsweise Interesse daran, neue Technologien im Arbeitsalltag aktiv einzusetzen

- Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (C1-Niveau)

Nice-to-haves:

- Erfahrung in der fachlichen Führung von (Teil-)Projektteams, Workstreams oder strategischen Initiativen

- Tiefgreifende Kenntnisse im Bereich IT Due Diligence, IT Carve-outs und IT Post-Merger-Integrationen

- Erfahrung im Aufbau und der Weiterentwicklung von Kund:innenbeziehungen sowie in Business Development oder Angebotsprozessen

Das bieten wir dir

- Flexibilität im Alltag: Homeoffice, Workation, Sabbatical sowie flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle ermöglichen eine individuelle Gestaltung deines Arbeitsalltags.

- Mobilität: Übernahme der Kosten für öffentliche Verkehrsmittel sowie zusätzliche Angebote wie Bike-Leasing erleichtern deinen Weg ins Office.

- Gelebte Feedbackkultur: Regelmäßige Feedbackgespräche, klare Entwicklungsziele und transparente Leistungsbeurteilung begleiten deinen Karriereweg bei EY.

- Weiterentwicklung: Vielfältige Trainings, Coachings und Zertifizierungen, z. B. im Bereich Strategie- und Transaktionsberatung, Enterprise Architecture oder Projektmanagement.

- Internationale Zusammenarbeit: Cross-Border-Transaktionen und Projekte mit Teams und Kund:innen aus unterschiedlichen Ländern.

- Teamkultur: Regelmäßiger Austausch, Teamevents und gemeinsame Weiterentwicklung stehen bei uns im Mittelpunkt.

- „Bring a Friend“: Das eigene Netzwerk lohnt sich – Empfehlungen werden mit einer Prämie honoriert.

EY zählt zu den weltweit führenden Unternehmen in der Prüfung und Beratung. jobs.title: Manager/Senior Manager Transaction Services EY-Parthenon F/H - Paris
jobs.description:
EY-Parthenon est un des leaders mondiaux du conseil de direction générale en matière de stratégie, de transformation et de transaction. Nous réunissons 25 000 consultants à travers le monde, intégrés à notre réseau de 400 000 professionnels EY dans 150 pays. De la conception à l’exécution de vos stratégies et de vos transactions, EY-Parthenon vous aide à redéfinir votre futur.
Nos équipes apportent un éclairage extérieur et des savoir-faire précis, combinant des expertises multisectorielles et multidisciplinaires approfondies, avec des capacités de pointe en matière d'analyse de données, d'IA et de technologie.
Nous accompagnons ainsi les directions générales et leur comité de direction, les conseils d'administration, les fonds d'investissement et les gouvernements à chaque étape de leurs réflexions et de leurs prises de décision, pour les aider à façonner leur avenir en toute confiance.

L’opportunité

Nous recrutons un  Manager ou Senior Manager (H/F) pour l’activité Transaction Services de notre bureau de Paris .

Vos Missions

Au sein de nos équipes, vous guiderez les entreprises vers une accélération de leur croissance en les conseillant sur des projets de croissance externe, de séparation, mais aussi de refinancement ou d’optimisation de la performance et des résultats.

Vous évoluerez dans un environnement pluridisciplinaire intégrant l’ensemble des métiers du conseil en transaction (stratégie, finance, opérations…) avec une forte composante internationale. Nos équipes rassemblent des professionnels issus de divers secteurs et zones géographiques avec pour mission d’évaluer les projets d’investissement des clients et de fournir une réponse intégrée à des problématiques complexes.

Dans le cadre de la compétence Transaction Services vous réaliserez notamment des missions de due diligences financières (d’acquisition ou de cession) consistant en une analyse rigoureuse de la performance d’une entreprise, de la qualité de son modèle opérationnel et des risques et opportunités attachées à la décision d’investissement. Vous accompagnerez nos clients sur l’ensemble du cycle de la transaction, de la phase d’analyse à la signature du contrat d’acquisition ou de cession mais aussi dans le cycle post transaction dans la mise en place de plans d’intégration ou de création de valeur.

En tant que Manager ou Senior Manager vos responsabilités seront de piloter les travaux d’une équipe de consultants. Vous définirez le plan d’analyse, mènerez les échanges avec les dirigeants et conseils de l’entreprise cible et serez le garant de l’excellence et de la qualité de l’exécution. Vous aurez la position d’interlocuteur privilégié de notre client avec lequel vous établirez une relation de partenaire de confiance tout au long de la transaction .

Votre Profil:

H/F, de formation supérieure Bac +5 (école de commerce et/ou d'ingénieurs, université), vous avez une expérience d’au moins 5 ans en cabinet de conseil en transaction services ou en cabinet d’audit, ou encore au sein d’un service « corporate développement » ou « FP&A » en entreprise.

Vous maitrisez la comptabilité et les techniques financières et avez une parfaite maîtrise de l'anglais.

Curiosité, souplesse, autonomie, excellent sens relationnel, goût de l'analyse et esprit de synthèse, rigueur et méthode sont les qualités premières pour vous épanouir au sein de nos équipes.

Une appétence pour le développement commercial est également attendue pour le grade de Manager/Senior Manager.

Vivez l’expérience EY, rejoignez-nous !

Dans le cadre de sa politique de Diversité, EY étudie, à compétences égales, toutes les candidatures dont celles de personnes en situation de handicap.

jobs.description:

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Role Snapshot

Client-facing manufacturing and AI transformation leader accountable for shaping, mobilizing, and delivering complex, technology-enabled solutions that combine deep manufacturing domain expertise with modern data, AI, and industrial technology capabilities to produce measurable operational and business outcomes.

The opportunity

As a Senior Manager in Supply Chain Manufacturing, you will lead client-facing transformation programs across manufacturing strategy, operational excellence, plant performance, digital manufacturing, industrial AI, data platforms, and technology-enabled operations. You will guide clients from problem definition and value-case development through functional and technical design, implementation, adoption, stabilization, scaling, and value realization. This delivery role requires a strong techno-functional balance: the credibility to lead manufacturing operating-model and process transformation, together with the technology fluency to direct modern data, AI, application, integration, and IT/OT delivery. You will lead multidisciplinary teams and remain accountable for quality, risk, outcomes, and the client experience.

Your key responsibilities

In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for the effective management and delivery of complex processes, solutions, and projects, with a keen focus on quality and risk management. You will navigate operational and organizational dynamics, manage client relationships, and contribute to revenue generation and commercial relationship management. This role will challenge you to:

- Lead the end-to-end delivery of complex manufacturing transformation programs, from mobilization and design through implementation, deployment, stabilization, and value realization.

- Own senior client relationships, establish delivery governance, align stakeholders, facilitate decisions, and communicate program status, risks, dependencies, and outcomes.

- Translate manufacturing priorities and P&L value levers into executable workplans, functional and technical solution designs, process changes, AI use cases, technology requirements, data products, operating-model changes, and adoption plans.

- Direct multidisciplinary teams across manufacturing operations, functional design, product management, data engineering, data science, AI, enterprise and solution architecture, application delivery, integration, change management, testing, deployment, and support.

- Manage scope, schedule, quality, budget, resources, dependencies, issues, risks, and contractual commitments using disciplined delivery and risk-management practices.

- Lead manufacturing process and solution design across production performance, asset productivity, maintenance, quality, planning, warehousing, operational excellence, and IT/OT integration.

- Lead the design and delivery of scalable industrial data foundations, including cloud and edge data platforms, unified namespaces, canonical and semantic data models, ontologies, asset hierarchies, master data, knowledge graphs, metadata, lineage, and governance.

- Shape and industrialize AI solutions—including predictive and prescriptive analytics, generative AI, copilots, agents, anomaly detection, root-cause intelligence, digital twins, and decision support—while establishing appropriate model governance, security, monitoring, human oversight, and responsible AI controls.

- Connect technology delivery to manufacturing management systems and operational excellence, including P&G’s Integrated Work System (IWS), zero-loss methods, total employee ownership, daily direction setting, standards, capability building, and sustained performance improvement.

- Guide solution configuration, integration, testing, deployment, cutover, training, adoption, and operational handover while ensuring business and technical readiness.

- Define outcome measures, establish performance baselines, track value realization, and work with client leaders to sustain improvements.

- Identify follow-on opportunities based on client needs and delivery insights and collaborate with account teams to shape extensions and additional services.

- Capture delivery lessons, reusable assets, and implementation insights for incorporation into the broader manufacturing knowledge and solution portfolio.

- Lead, coach, and develop Managers and delivery teams while fostering accountability, collaboration, inclusion, and high performance.

Skills and attributes for success

To thrive in this role, you will need a strong foundation in business performance, supply chain, and manufacturing, complemented by hands-on fluency in modern data, AI, and industrial technology delivery. Success requires the ability to bridge plant-floor realities, functional process design, enterprise architecture, and scalable technology implementation.

- Deep manufacturing and supply chain expertise with the ability to connect operating-model, process, data, technology, and workforce considerations.

- Strong techno-functional leadership: able to engage credibly with operators, engineers, and manufacturing leaders while translating their needs for architects, data engineers, data scientists, developers, cybersecurity teams, and platform owners.

- Knowledge of modern industrial data architecture, including lakehouse and data-mesh patterns, time-series and event data, semantic layers, ontologies, canonical data models, knowledge graphs, data products, APIs, streaming integration, MLOps, and DataOps.

- Ability to evaluate AI opportunities for feasibility, value, data readiness, workflow fit, adoption, scalability, and risk—and to move priority use cases from prototype through production and enterprise deployment.

- Executive communication, structured problem-solving, systems thinking, commercial awareness, and the ability to influence senior stakeholders.

- Ability to lead multidisciplinary teams, manage competing priorities, and maintain high standards for quality and risk management.

- Knowledge of manufacturing domains such as production performance, asset productivity, maintenance, quality, planning, warehousing, operational excellence, and IT/OT integration.

- Demonstrated ability to mobilize and recover complex programs, make decisions under ambiguity, and drive teams toward outcomes.

- Strong client relationship, facilitation, negotiation, change leadership, and conflict-resolution skills.

- Commercial delivery acumen covering scope, estimates, staffing, engagement economics, contracts, change control, and value realization.

To qualify for the role, you must have:

- A bachelor's degree in engineering, supply chain, operations, information systems, business, or a related discipline; a master's degree is preferred.

- No less than 8-10 years of relevant experience spanning manufacturing, supply chain, operational excellence, digital manufacturing, industrial data and AI, technology consulting, or a related field.

- Experience leading complex manufacturing transformation, solution development, or technology-enabled improvement initiatives.

- Experience leading Managers and multidisciplinary teams across business, functional, data, and technology workstreams.

- Practical knowledge of manufacturing strategy and operating models, P&G’s Integrated Work System (IWS) or comparable operational excellence systems, plant transformation, manufacturing technology landscapes, and emerging AI capabilities.

- Ability to travel as needed based on business and role requirements. Travel can range from 80-100%

- Experience delivering client-facing manufacturing transformation programs through design, implementation, deployment, and stabilization.

- Experience managing program governance, scope, schedule, resources, quality, financial performance, risks, issues, and dependencies.

- Experience leading senior client stakeholders and multidisciplinary delivery teams.

- Experience translating manufacturing business requirements into process, data, AI, functional, integration, security, and technical architecture requirements, with traceability through build, test, deployment, and value realization.

Ideally, you’ll also have

- Experience leading multi-site or global manufacturing transformation and deployment programs.

- Knowledge of ISA-95, Purdue models, industrial data architectures, IT/OT integration, and manufacturing cybersecurity considerations.

- Implementation experience with SymphonyAI industrial solutions or comparable industrial AI platforms, as well as MES/MOM, connected worker, industrial analytics, digital performance management, asset performance management, quality, maintenance, LIMS, ERP, or warehouse solutions.

- Experience with agile, hybrid, and traditional program-delivery methods, including testing, cutover, adoption, and hypercare.

- Experience applying AI agents, digital assistants, predictive analytics, anomaly detection, root cause intelligence, and autonomous decision support to manufacturing processes and operational challenges.

- Experience designing or delivering industrial data platforms that connect IT, OT, engineering, and edge sources using unified namespaces, semantic and graph-based models, ontologies, knowledge graphs, asset and performance models, APIs, metadata, lineage, and data governance.

- Relevant program management, operational excellence, cloud, data, or manufacturing technology certifications.

What we look for

We are looking for a Senior Manager who combines manufacturing credibility, technical-functional depth, AI and data fluency, commercial judgment, and disciplined delivery leadership. The successful candidate will bridge strategy and execution, connect plant-floor needs to enterprise technology, build trust with senior clients and technical teams, lead solutions through implementation challenges, and remain accountable for scalable, sustainable business outcomes.

• Excellent communication and storytelling skills.

We are looking for a proactive, curious and collaborative Service Designer who is passionate about creating services that deliver real value to people and organizations. Our global Supply Chain Services team includes over 450 people working across 33 countries and speaking 46 languages. - Talent & BMC (Brand, Marketing and Communications)

Beyond the basic provision of reliable, cost-effective IT infrastructure and operations, EYT is increasingly acting as a catalyst for business success.  Priority projects such as Global CRM, Data Center Consolidation, and messaging and collaboration are essential to delivering on EY’s Global Priorities, and in sustaining our competitive advantage as the most globally integrated organization in professional services.

The Technology Procurement team supports key programs and solutions globally in partnership with our Client Technology and Service Line colleagues to continue to enhance EY’s position as a technology driven industry leader.

Global Procurement is part of the global Supply Chain Services function focusing on the requirements from the Technology teams and managing circa $1.5B of spend annually.

Your key responsibilities

Supporting the Technology Procurement team in the delivery and management of procurement activities may include the following activities:

- Manage full lifecycle of contracts for assigned programs of work and key suppliers

- Pro-actively manage contract and license renewals

- Build and foster collaborative working relationships with EYT and other internal business partners

- Supporting and leading stakeholders through the Onboarding of Technology Goods and Services end-to-end process.

- Socialization and facilitation of the Procurement policy and processes, ensuring that the project teams and stakeholders understand the value of the policy and adhere to it accordingly

- Partnering with General Counsel’s Office (legal) to lead key negotiations and reporting on the quantitative and brand value delivered.

- Effectively build a pipeline of deals and develop the appropriate resourcing plans.

- Supporting improvement in processes, policy, systems, management information and reporting.

- Working with senior EYT and Service Line stakeholders to help develop a category strategy which supports the overall global technology strategy.

- Strong experience with senior stakeholder management with the ability to collaboratively co-develop strategies and set and manage expectations.

- Experience with negotiating contracts related to software licensing & rationalization, cloud-based solutions and professional services

- Experience with negotiating contracts globally and regionally.

- Experience of managing complex service agreements both from the commercial and service delivery side

- Minimum 4 years’ experience of working in a Sourcing/Procurement role in a complex and global environment

- Strong influencing and networking skills as the organization relies on working in cross functional teams across borders

- Good knowledge of key IT vendors and new technologies is important to successfully work with the EYT teams

- Strong communication skills required; must have the ability communicate in English effectively, transparently, and timely across multiple mediums (email, voice, IM, etc) in a global environment

- The ability to independently manage and prioritize workload

- Strong organizational skills

- Demonstrate a positive attitude and have an appetite for change

- Provide high level of Exceptional Client Service

jobs.title: GDS Executive Director - Finance, Digital & Business Transformation
jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Executive Director – Enterprise Finance Transformation, GBS and FinTech Enablement

Consulting | Finance, Digital & Business Transformation

Role Purpose

The Executive Director will own the strategy, growth, and delivery of enterprise-wide finance transformation programs, integrating finance operating model redesign, GBS/SSC transformation, FP&A modernization, digital finance, and FinTech enablement.

This role is accountable for identifying transformation opportunities, shaping value-led business cases, designing future-state operating models, leading complex multi-year implementations, and ensuring sustainable performance improvement across global clients.

The Executive Director serves as a trusted C-suite advisor while building high-performing solution leadership teams and scaling market-leading transformation offerings.

As part of the Finance Consulting leadership team, the Executive Director will own and drive large-scale, end-to-end finance and business transformation programs across global clients. This role will oversee multiple solution towers including:

- Finance Transformation & Target Operating Model (TOM)

- Global Business Services (GBS) / Shared Services

- FP&A, BPRA & Enterprise Performance Management (EPM)

- Finance Process Optimization (R2R, O2C, P2P)

- Digital Finance, Automation, Analytics & FinTech Enablement

Key Accountability Areas & Detailed Responsibility Statements

Enterprise Assessment & Opportunity Identification

- Lead enterprise-wide finance maturity assessments across strategy, processes, technology, governance, and talent

- Identify cost, efficiency, control, and value creation opportunities across finance functions and shared services

- Quantify transformation benefits including productivity uplift, working capital impact, margin improvement, and risk reduction

- Benchmark clients against industry-leading practices and digital maturity standards

- Translate diagnostic insights into prioritized transformation portfolios

Strategy, Roadmap & Business Case Ownership

- Define multi-year finance transformation visions aligned to enterprise strategy

- Design target operating models including:

- Centralized, hybrid, and GBS structures

- Process ownership frameworks

- Digital-first finance architectures

- Develop detailed transformation roadmaps with sequencing, investment phasing, and benefit realization plans

- Own complex financial business cases including:

- Capex/Opex modeling

- ROI, NPV, and payback analysis

- Risk and sensitivity modeling

- Present executive-ready transformation recommendations to boards and C-suite leadership

End-to-End Transformation Delivery Leadership

- Lead large-scale, multi-workstream programs covering:

- Finance TOM & organizational redesign

- GBS/SSC setup, migration, and optimization

- Core process transformation (R2R, O2C, P2P)

- FP&A and performance management modernization

- Digital automation and analytics enablement

- Establish strong governance models, program controls, and benefit tracking

- Manage complex stakeholder landscapes across finance, IT, operations, and executive leadership

- Ensure on-time, on-budget delivery with measurable value realization

Digital Finance & FinTech Integration

- Define digital finance strategies integrating ERP, EPM, automation, analytics, and emerging FinTech solutions

- Lead implementations of:

- SAP S/4HANA, Oracle, Workday Finance

- EPM platforms (Anaplan, Tagetik, OneStream, Board, Oracle EPBCS)

- Intelligent automation (RPA, AI-driven close, continuous accounting)

- Advanced analytics and real-time reporting platforms

- Leverage FinTech ecosystems for:

- Treasury digitization and real-time payments

- Embedded finance models

- Automated controls and compliance

- Cloud-native financial platforms

- Drive measurable digital ROI and adoption across transformed finance organizations

CFO Advisory & Strategic Leadership

- Serve as trusted advisor to CFOs, COOs, CIOs, and business leadership

- Shape CFO agendas across:

- Cost transformation and productivity

- Performance management and profitability

- Digital finance modernization

- Risk, compliance, and governance enhancement

- Lead executive workshops on finance strategy, operating model evolution, and digital roadmaps

- Support strategic decisions on capital allocation, investment prioritization, and enterprise transformation

Business Development & Market Leadership

- Own revenue growth targets across finance transformation and digital finance portfolios

- Originate and close large multi-year transformation programs

- Lead complex proposal pursuits, RFP/RFI responses, and executive deal shaping

- Develop market-leading offerings, frameworks, accelerators, and thought leadership

- Build long-term strategic client relationships and cross-service collaboration

People, Capability & Solution Leadership

- Lead solution heads across GBS, FP&A, Process Transformation, and Digital Finance

- Build and scale multidisciplinary transformation teams

- Drive capability development across consulting, digital, and industry expertise

- Mentor high-potential leaders and create strong succession pipelines

- Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, and delivery excellence

Required Experience & Qualifications

- 18–25+ years in finance transformation consulting and/or senior finance leadership roles

- Proven leadership of large-scale enterprise transformation portfolios

- Deep expertise across:

- Finance operating models & shared services

- FP&A/EPM modernization

- Core finance process transformation

- Digital finance and automation

- Strong track record of business case creation and value realization

- Extensive C-suite advisory experience

Education & Certifications (preferred):

- MBA or Master’s degree in Finance/Business/Technology

- CA, CPA, ACCA, CFA, CMA, PMP or equivalent

Key Leadership Competencies

- Enterprise transformation strategy

- Executive communication & influence

- Commercial growth leadership

- Complex program governance

- Digital innovation mindset

- Talent development and coaching

- Results-driven execution

What Success Looks Like in This Role

- Delivery of measurable financial and operational value across transformation portfolios

- Strong client trust and long-term advisory relationships

- Consistent revenue growth and market expansion

- High-performing solution leadership teams

- Recognized market leadership in finance transformation and digital finance

In essence:

This Executive Director is the architect, value creator, deal shaper, delivery owner, digital enabler, and people builder across the entire finance transformation ecosystem.

Marketing Mix Transformation Manager

Location: Katowice - 2 days in office / 3 days remote

Let us introduce you to the opportunity at EY GDS Poland, part of EY’s global integrated service delivery network.

Job Offered by EY GDS Poland, a member of the worldwide EY service delivery network. Join our team as a Marketing Transformation Manager specializing in Digital Marketing & Marketing Technology applications. Enhance your international experience while working alongside our global market leaders and innovators. Help businesses transform with people-focused, data-driven, and tech-enabled strategies. Co-create and implement distinctive brands, products, and services that generate significant value for businesses, their employees, and customers.

As a Manager level Marketing Consultant, you'll leverage your expertise to make recommendations that drive business development. Working within a diverse, seasoned team, you'll take part in high-level marketing projects, providing specialized knowledge in MarTech, digital marketing and marketing mix. Being part of this reputable team means immersing yourself in cutting-edge technologies and methodologies, helping to deliver seamless user experiences to our premier clients.

The opportunity

As our Marketing Transformation Manager specializing in digital marketing & marketing technologies, you'll guide the evolution of complex digital marketing strategies and MarTech solutions. This entails taking part in critical negotiations, evaluating risks, and optimally executing marketing initiatives. Your job will be to comprehend the MarTech, digital marketing strategy, marketing spend and marketing media mix optimization and contribute to achieving widespread enterprise aims. You will assist in identifying growth opportunities, integrating them post-implementation, and liaising with our internal teams. You will build and maintain robust relationships with clients, professionals in the field, and company stakeholders, ensuring project objectives are met within set timelines and budgets.

Your key responsibilities

- Advising clients on digital marketing and MarTech selection, implementation, and evaluation

- Assisting in the creation and rollout of digital marketing strategies

- Proactively contributing to marketing technology projects

- Supporting clients in their marketing spend and marketing media mix optimization

- Guiding the implementation of marketing enhancement measures

- Collaborating with varied departments within the global EY network, facilitating project progress, and supporting team members' professional growth

- Driving the learning and adoption of Marketing Mix insights, aligning contributing functions

Skills and attributes for success

- Minimum of seven years of professional Digital Marketing and MarTech experience

- University degree in Marketing, Business, Advertising, or related field (Master's, MBA or Ph.D. is a plus)

- Strong program/ project management experience in complex international organizations

- Familiarity with AI-based predictive analytics

- Strong analytical skills, rapid comprehension, and precise work methods

- Possesses financial acumen and can build business cases and track value realization

To qualify for the role, you must have

- Bachelor’s degree with at least 7 years of relevant work experience

- Excellent communication skills in English + another European language (German or French preferred (min. C1))

- Professional experience with a focus on MarTech, Digital and Media Mix marketing strategy

- Extensive knowledge of marketing automation, programmatic advertising, and data management platforms

- Profound understanding of customer relationship management (CRM) systems

Ideally, you’ll also have

- Experience with Digital Transformation: Proven leadership in driving digital change initiatives, considering the increasing role of digital tech in marketing

- Understanding of Regulatory Landscape: Sound knowledge of data privacy regulations and compliance issues in digital marketing

- Professional Certifications: Certificates in digital marketing, MarTech, or related fields (e.g., Google Analytics, Adobe Certified Expert, etc.) is a plus

- Experience working in retail/FMCG environments, and managing analytics vendors or RFP processes

What we look for

We are searching for candidates who are driven, analytical, logical thinkers with an interest in the intersection of marketing and technology. TMT :

Industry convergence offers TMT (Technology, Media & Entertainment, and Telecommunications) organizations the chance to evolve and transform, but it also presents challenges around competitiveness and delivering agile corporate strategies for growth. Content distributors are transforming into content producers, service providers are becoming tech companies, technology companies are the catalyst for dramatic change in every sector, and customers want the latest innovations now.

We help TMT companies create compelling employee and customer experiences, retaining skills and talent while achieving enterprise-wide operational excellence. We help them protect their data, brand and reputation. We also enable the pursuit of M&A strategies that systematically create value, reduce risk and transform TMT companies into powerhouses that will lead the technology revolution of the future – building a better working world for all.

CNS - RISK - PROCESS & CONTROLS :

EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client-centric approach focuses on driving long-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.

We help our clients in identifying and managing the interplay between upside and downside risk in order to make the long-term decisions to prevent risk and impact on their organization's ability to meet its future business strategy and objectives. The 3 key fields of play are :

Enterprise Risk - helps clients identify and address key risk areas, while building the agility to respond quickly. The areas of focus include Enterprise risk and resilience, Internal audit, Compliance and Internal controls

Technology Risk - helps clients to achieve sustainable growth by supporting their efforts to protect their business performance and by providing trusted communications on internal control and regulatory compliance to investors, management, regulators, customers and other stakeholders. EY teams accomplish this by assessing the technology risks that are introduced to businesses.

Financial Services Risk - helps clients in the financial sector to identify, manage and monitor the risks in their business. It is done through a transformative and agile approach including process and procedures, risk, data modeling and analytics, reporting to stakeholders and third parties, business requirements (for software selection and IT implementation), analysis of assets and liabilities, and capital and liquidity management.

Your key responsibilities

Technical Excellence

- We are building a differentiated Process Advisory and Data Analytics capability within EY India's Risk Consulting practice. This role sits at the intersection of internal audit, enterprise controls, SAP data architecture and advanced analytics — and is designed for someone who can translate complex ERP data into measurable business outcomes using process mining and process intelligence platforms. You will not be a tool operator. You will be the person who understands why a process is broken, which SAP tables hold the evidence, how to build the data model that proves it, and what the value case looks like for the CXO. If you come from a strong internal audit and controls background with deep SAP knowledge and analytical thinking, this role is designed for you — even if you have never used a process mining platform before. We will train you on the tools (Celonis, SAP Signavio, ARIS). What we cannot train is business judgment, data intuition and the ability to see value where others see transactions. That is what we are hiring for. What You Will Do

- Lead the advisory and analytics layer on process mining engagements — defining what to mine, why it matters, and what the business impact is before a single dashboard is built

- Design and own the data model for process mining implementations: – Identify the right SAP tables (BKPF, BSEG, VBAK, VBAP, EKKO, EKPO, MSEG, MKPF, CDHDR, etc.) and their joins for O2C, P2P, R2R, Inventory and Manufacturing processes – Define event log structures, case IDs, activity mappings and timestamp logic from raw ERP data – Handle data quality issues, edge cases and multi-system landscapes at enterprise scale (50+ table data models)

- Build value cases and outcome frameworks for Tier-1 use cases — DSO reduction, maverick spend identification, rework elimination, inventory turns, duplicate payment detection

- Lead conformance and variant analysis — interpreting mined process flows against designed processes, identifying root causes, and translating findings into executive-ready narratives

- Work directly with CXOs and GCC leadership to present findings, drive action and own the value realisation story

- Support pre-sales and business development — solution design, scoping, pricing, POC delivery and proposal writing for mining engagements

- Mentor and develop junior consultants on SAP data architecture, controls logic and analytical thinking What You Bring (Must-Have)

- CA / CPA / CIA / CFE qualification is strongly preferred. MBA with 6+ years in internal audit, controls advisory or financial process consulting will also be considered. This is a practitioner role — we need people who have done the work, not managed it from a distance

- 6–12 years of experience in internal audit, enterprise controls, risk advisory or financial process consulting — Big 4 or strong mid-tier background preferred

- Deep working knowledge of SAP ERP tables and data structures — you should be able to explain the relationship between BKPF/BSEG, VBAK/VBAP/LIKP/VBRK, EKKO/EKPO/EBAN without looking it up

- Experience with IFC/ICFR design and testing, SOX compliance, or controls-based audit engagements — you understand what a control gap looks like and what it costs

- Strong SQL skills and comfort working with large datasets (millions of records)

- Data and analytics orientation — experience with data extraction, transformation, visualisation and interpretation (tools could be Power BI, Tableau, Python, Excel advanced analytics, or similar)

- Ability to connect data findings to business outcomes — not just 'what happened' but 'what it costs and what to do about it'

- Consulting-grade communication — you can present to a CFO, write a findings report, and lead a client workshop What Would Be a Bonus (Good-to-Have)

- Exposure to process mining platforms (Celonis, SAP Signavio Process Intelligence, UiPath Process Mining) — but genuinely not required

- Experience with SAP S/4HANA migration or transformation projects

- Knowledge of BPMN process modelling or process documentation

- Experience working in or with Global Capability Centres (GCCs)

- Familiarity with Celonis PQL, SAP ABAP, or data engineering concepts (event logs, ETL pipelines)

- Prior Big 4 or management consulting experience Why This Role

- You will join EY India's leading BPM and Process Mining practice

- You will be trained on Celonis, SAP Signavio and ARIS by certified practitioners — your audit and SAP background is the hard part; the tools are the easy part

- You will work directly with a Partner who is deeply hands-on and invested in building careers, not just billing hours

jobs.title: Senior Consultant (Transfer Pricing)
jobs.description:
As a Senior Consultant in the Transfer Pricing team at EY, you will work on projects for large international and local clients, help them structure intra-group transactions, ensure compliance with global TP regulations, and support them during tax audits. The role combines analytical work, communication with clients, project management and participation in business development initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

-
Conduct functional and economic analyses of intra-group transactions.

-
Perform benchmarking studies using specialized TP databases.

-
Prepare transfer pricing documentation (Local File, Master File, Country-by-Country elements).

-
Develop financial and economic models to support TP calculations.

-
Advise clients on transfer pricing implications of business restructuring and new transaction flows.

-
Participate in the design and review of TP policies and methodologies.

-
Support clients during TP audits and negotiations with tax authorities.

-
Manage day-to-day project workflows and ensure timely delivery.

-
Coordinate junior team members and review their analytical work.

-
Communicate with clients: clarify requests, present findings, explain methodologies.

-
Assist managers and partners in preparing proposals and developing business opportunities.

-
Contribute to thought leadership: prepare internal reports, presentations, industry reviews.

-
Participate in practice development, training and knowledge sharing within the team.

-
Higher education in Economics, Finance, Accounting, Business, or related fields.

-
4+ years of experience in transfer pricing

-
Experience in Big4 is an advantage, but not mandatory.

-
Practical experience with transfer pricing analyses and benchmarks.

-
Advanced Excel skills; experience with analytical tools/databases is a plus.

-
Strong research and analytical skills.

-
Strong communication skills and ability to present complex concepts clearly.

-
Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously under tight deadlines.

-
Attention to detail and strong problem-solving capabilities.

-
Team-player attitude with leadership potential.

English — Upper-Intermediate+ (ability to work with English documentation and communicate with clients).

Work with industry-leading clients and global projects.

-
Professional growth and training within an international environment.

-
Clear career path and development opportunities.

-
Access to EY global knowledge base and learning platforms.

-
Competitive compensation and benefits package.

GOV :

Our Global Government & Public Sector (GPS) is a network of highly skilled professionals dedicated to serving our clients by bringing best-in-class international experience and insight combined with local knowledge to solve the most critical problems facing governments today. We actively focus on building solutions that help public sector entities face the challenges of the future and reinvent themselves.

Digital transformation is not just about new technologies; it involves an overhaul of organizational structures, governance, work processes, culture and mindset. It also means realizing a wider vision of relationships and business models that will redesign how public services function.

To achieve this vision, we help clients balance strategic choices to re-ignite performance. We have developed a suite of cross-service line strategic solutions that align with our client priorities.

We have a proud record of helping governments meet their challenges head-on, and we work closely with them to build a world that works better for all citizens.

SaT :

The Government and public sector transactions services is part of EY's Government & Public Sector (GPS) Services which is a network of highly skilled professionals from assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, devoted to serving the government and public sector organizations and institutions.

The practice combines private sector leading practice with an understanding of the public sector’s diverse needs, focused on delivering improved public services. Government and public sector transactions services, sits under EY’s Transaction Advisory Services practice, a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team, working with leading businesses across a range of industries. This practice is in a unique position to deliver implementable strategies given the firm’s sector depth, transaction perspectives, and operational insights.

The practice provides experience working with various sectors such as, Transport, Social & Health care, Education, Urban & Infrastructure, Economic Development Advisory , Water waste & Sanitation, Power & Utilities and Public Finance & Management.

SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory :

Strategy and Transactions enables clients to reimagine ecosystems, reshape portfolios and reinvent for a better future. Using our Capital Agenda framework, we work with clients to find answers to today’s toughest strategic, financial, operational and commercial questions. We help corporates, private equity, governments, sovereign wealth funds, private and family businesses, and educational institutions with their key financial issues. From portfolio review and capital allocation processes to financial planning analytics and decision support, we have the people, analytics and tools to better allocate capital. Our team helps clients manage their risk/return trade-offs to support them with better decision-making around financing and capital efficiency.

Whether clients are preserving, optimizing, raising or investing, our Connected Capital Solutions (CCS) are our five go-to-market offerings that help drive competitive advantage and increased returns through improved decision-making. The CCS include Strategy, Corporate Finance, Buy and Integrate, Sell and Separate and Reshaping Results, and are underpinned by our Connected Capital Technologies.

Our key focus areas are - Investment Banking Advisory, Valuations, Modeling and Economics, Transaction Diligence,  Restructuring and Turnaround Services, Project Finance and infrastructure, EY Parthenon - Strategy and EY Parthenon - Execution.

Your key responsibilities

Technical Excellence

- Position Summary The Consultant will support development and maintenance of the regulatory intelligence repository, KYA framework and recommendation engine for NSWS. The role requires extensive research, sectoral mapping, regulatory analysis, stakeholder engagement and development of structured decision rules for business approvals and compliances. Educational Qualification Postgraduate degree in Public Policy, Economics, Management, Law, Governance, Public Administration or related field. Certifications or coursework in regulatory affairs, public policy or business process analysis preferred. Experience Minimum 5 years of relevant experience.
