jobs.title: Risk Consulting - Actuarial - Healthcare Analytics and Model Validation - Senior
jobs.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

Senior – Healthcare Analytics & Model Validation, EY GDS Consulting

Global Delivery Services is one of EY's greatest global assets – a network of service delivery centers that provide high-quality services at a competitive cost for all EY’s client serving and enablement teams. Every day, we combine our subject matter expertise with our technology and automation skills to develop new solutions that deliver greater value for EY. If you have a passion for enabling world class Actuarial and Analytics services globally to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic GDS team!

The opportunity

We are looking for a Senior to join our Actuarial and Analytics team delivering solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EY’s global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals.

Within our talented and dynamic team, the members work on multiple client engagement teams that perform healthcare analytics, predictive modeling, model governance and help organizations make better business decisions through data driven insights. The role will focus on independent model validation, healthcare analytics, and model risk management activities across financial, operational, predictive, forecasting, and AI/ML models. The team members also receive on-the-job training to acquire practical experience in addressing business/technical issues and in applying industry knowledge and EY policies/procedures on client engagements.

Within our growing team, members work alongside healthcare, actuarial, data science, and business stakeholders to assess model methodologies, assumptions, data quality, performance, documentation, and governance frameworks. The role offers an excellent opportunity to gain exposure to advanced analytical techniques, healthcare economics, predictive modeling, and emerging AI/ML applications while contributing to critical business decisions.

Our growing team of professionals comes from diverse backgrounds and is committed to being trusted advisors to our clients.

Your key responsibilities

As a Senior in Actuarial and Analytics team, your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.

On engagements, you will:

- Be responsible for providing high-quality results and generating effective solutions, working along with Senior Consultants, Managers and Senior Managers in delivering the project.

- Provide focused solutions and training to Staff members.

- Be responsible for ensuring all engagements are delivered within the designated time.

- Deliver engagements in line with EY values and commitment to quality and ensuring that work is of high standards.

- Manage day-to-day priorities, provide regular status updates, and accurately track and report project KPIs to support project delivery.

- Collaborate effectively with client teams, data scientists, business users, and other EY professionals.

Within the actuarial and analytics practice you will:

- Validate healthcare cost forecasting and claims prediction models.

- Review claims cost and utilization forecasting methodologies.

- Assess budget planning and financial forecasting models.

- Evaluate reimbursement optimization and revenue cycle analytics models.

- Review Fraud, Waste and Abuse (FWA) detection models and analytical frameworks.

- Support validation of AI/ML models used in healthcare decision-making.

- Analyze large healthcare datasets to identify trends, anomalies, and model performance issues.

- Perform ad hoc analytical projects and research activities.

- Stay informed of current developments in healthcare analytics, predictive modeling, AI/ML, and model governance.

- Stay informed of current business/economic developments relevant to the industry/geography.

We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.

Skills and attributes for success

Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require analytical rigor, intellectual curiosity, strong problem-solving abilities, the ability to communicate complex findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, having a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organizations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS Actuarial and Analytics team.

We are looking for professionals who:

- Demonstrate strong attention to detail and analytical thinking.

- Can independently investigate and challenge model assumptions.

- Have excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- Thrive in collaborative and client-facing environments.

- Are passionate about continuous learning and innovation.

- Can manage multiple priorities while maintaining high-quality standards.

To qualify for the role, you must have

- 3+ years of experience in healthcare analytics, predictive modelling, model validation, actuarial analytics, risk analytics, data science, or related quantitative fields.

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Actuarial Science, Data Science, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related quantitative discipline.

- Strong understanding of statistical, forecasting, predictive modelling, and machine learning techniques.

- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including PivotTables, Power Query, advanced formulas, data modelling, data validation, and VBA/macros.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

- Ability to multi-task and flexible work attitude packed with good analytical skills.

- Ability to interpret complex quantitative results and communicate findings effectively.

Ideally, you’ll also have

- Experience in US healthcare, health insurance, or managed care organizations.

- Exposure to healthcare claims analytics, medical cost forecasting, utilization management, or provider analytics.

- Experience reviewing AI/ML models and predictive analytics solutions.

- Familiarity with Model Risk Management (MRM) frameworks and model governance standards.

- Knowledge of Medicare, Medicaid, commercial health insurance, and provider reimbursement processes.

- Experience in presenting analytical findings and validation conclusions to senior stakeholders.

- Exposure to cloud-based analytics platforms and modern data ecosystems.

- Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets.

- Experience using Python and/or SAS for analytics, model development, or validation activities.

- Experience performing data quality reviews and quantitative testing.

- Experience of handling a small team will be an advantage.

- AI Literacy – Good knowledge on GenAI, Agentic AI would be an added advantage

What we look for

- Strong knowledge of healthcare analytics, predictive modeling, data science, and model validation practices.

- Deep knowledge and experience of the insurance industry and/or consulting. Relevant recent healthcare analytics experience in leading engagement with recognized health insurers and healthcare service providers.

- Up to date knowledge of the regulatory environment impacting insurers and other financial service organizations.

What we offer

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

jobs.description:

The opportunity

We currently have career opportunities for Senior Consultants within our Canadian Fraud Risk Consulting practice with a focus on fraud analytics, detection and data science. Our team helps financial institutions transform fraud risk management through the application of data, artificial intelligence, machine learning, and advanced analytical techniques in an increasingly complex threat landscape.

Emerging technologies, evolving fraud typologies, and real-time payment ecosystems require organizations to enhance their fraud detection capabilities with sophisticated analytical solutions. We help financial institutions strengthen fraud prevention and detection using data analysis, statistical methods, machine learning, and practical improvements to fraud processes and technology.

This job posting relates to an existing vacancy within our organization.

Your key responsibilities

As a Senior Consultant, you will work directly with clients and multidisciplinary EY teams to deliver advanced analytics, machine learning, and data-driven fraud risk solutions. Responsibilities include:

- Design, develop, validate, and deploy fraud detection rules and models across banking and payment products.

- Analyze large and complex datasets to identify emerging fraud patterns, trends, vulnerabilities, and opportunities for enhanced fraud mitigation.

- Collaborate with fraud SMEs, business stakeholders, and technology teams to translate business challenges into analytical use cases and model requirements.

- Support the development of fraud risk strategies across payments, account takeover, identity fraud, synthetic identity, money movement, and emerging fraud typologies.

- Develop fraud dashboards and management reporting to track fraud trends, losses, detection performance, operational outcomes, and key risk indicators.

- Contribute to data preparation, feature engineering, and model monitoring activities that support sustainable fraud analytics programs.

- Present analytical findings and recommendations to senior client stakeholders in a clear, business-oriented manner.

- Contribute to business development activities, proposals, thought leadership, and innovation initiatives focused on fraud analytics, AI, and emerging technologies.

- Evaluate fraud rules or models using measures such as fraud capture, false-positive rates, precision, recall, operational impact, and financial outcomes.

Skills and attributes for success

Advanced Analytical Mindset

- Strong quantitative, statistical, and problem-solving capabilities.

- Ability to transform large volumes of structured and unstructured data into actionable insights.

- Passion for leveraging AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics to solve complex fraud challenges.

High-Performance Teaming

- Demonstrated ability to collaborate across data science, engineering, fraud operations, and business teams.

- Experience managing workstreams and contributing to project delivery within consulting or financial services environments.

Strong Communication Skills

- Ability to communicate technical concepts, model outcomes, and analytical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.

- Experience creating executive-ready presentations, reports, and client deliverables.

Curiosity and Innovation

- Strong interest in emerging fraud trends, AI technologies, and analytical methodologies.

- Proactive approach to experimentation, innovation, and continuous learning.

Integrity and Inclusiveness

- Commitment to ethical AI principles, model governance, and responsible use of data.

- Ability to thrive in diverse teams and collaborative environments.

To qualify for the role you must have

- At least three years of experience in fraud analytics, data science, machine learning, quantitative risk management, or advanced analytics within financial services or consulting.

- Experience working with banks, credit unions, payment organizations, fintechs, or fraud risk teams.

- Experience designing, testing, tuning or evaluating fraud-detection scenarios, thresholds or risk indicators.

- Strong understanding of fraud detection methodologies, fraud operations, transaction monitoring, or financial crime analytics.

- Experience manipulating and analyzing large-scale datasets and developing practical analytical solutions.

- Proficiency in SQL and experience with at least one analytical programming language or platform, such as Python, R, or SAS.

- Experience with PowerBI.

Ideally, you'll also have

- Bilingual (English/French) considered an asset.

- Hands-on experience developing and validating predictive models using Python, R, SQL, SAS, or similar analytical tools.

- Experience with payment fraud, card fraud, account takeover, digital banking fraud, or first-party fraud.

- Knowledge of MLOps, model governance, explainable AI, and model monitoring practices.

- Exposure to graph analytics, network analytics, entity resolution, or behavioural analytics.

- Exposure to practical uses of generative AI or AI-assisted analytics in fraud risk management is an asset.

- Experience applying supervised and unsupervised machine learning techniques—including gradient boosting, random forests, anomaly detection, clustering, and neural networks—to fraud detection problems is considered an asset.

jobs.title: Senior Consultant - Fraud Analytics
jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity

We currently have career opportunities for Senior Consultants within our Canadian Fraud Risk Consulting practice with a focus on fraud analytics, detection and data science. Our team helps financial institutions transform fraud risk management through the application of data, artificial intelligence, machine learning, and advanced analytical techniques in an increasingly complex threat landscape.

Emerging technologies, evolving fraud typologies, and real-time payment ecosystems require organizations to enhance their fraud detection capabilities with sophisticated analytical solutions. We help financial institutions strengthen fraud prevention and detection using data analysis, statistical methods, machine learning, and practical improvements to fraud processes and technology.

This job posting relates to an existing vacancy within our organization.

Your key responsibilities

As a Senior Consultant, you will work directly with clients and multidisciplinary EY teams to deliver advanced analytics, machine learning, and data-driven fraud risk solutions. Responsibilities include:

- Design, develop, validate, and deploy fraud detection rules and models across banking and payment products.

- Analyze large and complex datasets to identify emerging fraud patterns, trends, vulnerabilities, and opportunities for enhanced fraud mitigation.

- Collaborate with fraud SMEs, business stakeholders, and technology teams to translate business challenges into analytical use cases and model requirements.

- Support the development of fraud risk strategies across payments, account takeover, identity fraud, synthetic identity, money movement, and emerging fraud typologies.

- Develop fraud dashboards and management reporting to track fraud trends, losses, detection performance, operational outcomes, and key risk indicators.

- Contribute to data preparation, feature engineering, and model monitoring activities that support sustainable fraud analytics programs.

- Present analytical findings and recommendations to senior client stakeholders in a clear, business-oriented manner.

- Contribute to business development activities, proposals, thought leadership, and innovation initiatives focused on fraud analytics, AI, and emerging technologies.

- Evaluate fraud rules or models using measures such as fraud capture, false-positive rates, precision, recall, operational impact, and financial outcomes.

Skills and attributes for success

Advanced Analytical Mindset

- Strong quantitative, statistical, and problem-solving capabilities.

- Ability to transform large volumes of structured and unstructured data into actionable insights.

- Passion for leveraging AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics to solve complex fraud challenges.

High-Performance Teaming

- Demonstrated ability to collaborate across data science, engineering, fraud operations, and business teams.

- Experience managing workstreams and contributing to project delivery within consulting or financial services environments.

Strong Communication Skills

- Ability to communicate technical concepts, model outcomes, and analytical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.

- Experience creating executive-ready presentations, reports, and client deliverables.

Curiosity and Innovation

- Strong interest in emerging fraud trends, AI technologies, and analytical methodologies.

- Proactive approach to experimentation, innovation, and continuous learning.

Integrity and Inclusiveness

- Commitment to ethical AI principles, model governance, and responsible use of data.

- Ability to thrive in diverse teams and collaborative environments.

To qualify for the role you must have

- At least three years of experience in fraud analytics, data science, machine learning, quantitative risk management, or advanced analytics within financial services or consulting.

- Experience working with banks, credit unions, payment organizations, fintechs, or fraud risk teams.

- Experience designing, testing, tuning or evaluating fraud-detection scenarios, thresholds or risk indicators.

- Strong understanding of fraud detection methodologies, fraud operations, transaction monitoring, or financial crime analytics.

- Experience manipulating and analyzing large-scale datasets and developing practical analytical solutions.

- Proficiency in SQL and experience with at least one analytical programming language or platform, such as Python, R, or SAS.

- Experience with PowerBI.

Ideally, you'll also have

- Bilingual (English/French) considered an asset.

- Hands-on experience developing and validating predictive models using Python, R, SQL, SAS, or similar analytical tools.

- Experience with payment fraud, card fraud, account takeover, digital banking fraud, or first-party fraud.

- Knowledge of MLOps, model governance, explainable AI, and model monitoring practices.

- Exposure to graph analytics, network analytics, entity resolution, or behavioural analytics.

- Exposure to practical uses of generative AI or AI-assisted analytics in fraud risk management is an asset.

- Experience applying supervised and unsupervised machine learning techniques—including gradient boosting, random forests, anomaly detection, clustering, and neural networks—to fraud detection problems is considered an asset.

What we offer

At EY, our Total Rewards package supports our commitment to creating a leading people culture built on high-performance teaming, where everyone can achieve their potential and contribute to building a better working world for our people, our clients and our communities. We offer a competitive compensation package where you'll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. Our Total Rewards package includes comprehensive medical, prescription drug and dental coverage, a defined contribution pension plan, a vacation policy, firm-paid days, statutory holidays and paid personal days based on province of residence, and a range of programs and benefits designed to support your physical, financial and social well-being. Plus, we offer:

- Support, coaching and feedback from engaging colleagues

- Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career

- The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that's right for you

EY reports salary ranges in accordance with applicable provincial pay transparency legislation. Individual salaries within the anticipated salary ranges noted below are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to internal equity, education, relevant experience, knowledge, and applicable skill sets.

- Toronto: $90,500 to $136,000

Inclusiveness at EY

Inclusiveness is at the heart of who we are and how we work. We’re committed to fostering an environment where differences are valued, policies and practices are equitable, and our people feel a sense of belonging. We embrace diversity and are committed to combating systemic racism, advancing gender equity and women in leadership, advocating for the 2SLGBTQIA+ community, promoting our neuroinclusion and accessibility initiatives, and are dedicated to amplifying the voices of Indigenous peoples (First Nations, Inuit, and Métis) nationally as we strive towards reconciliation. Our diverse experiences, abilities, backgrounds, and perspectives make our people unique and help guide us. Because when people feel free to be their authentic selves at work, they bring their best and are empowered to build a better working world.

Learn about our commitment to Inclusiveness at  https://www.ey.com/en_ca/about-us/corporate-responsibility/equity

Als Berater:in bei EY Business Consulting Finance Strategy / GBS in Hamburg, Hannover, Berlin, München, Frankfurt/Main, Köln, Düsseldorf oder Stuttgart unterstützt du unsere Kund:innen bei deren Transformationen mit Fokus auf die vielfältige CFO Agenda. Wir verfolgen einen ganzheitlichen Beratungsansatz, beginnend mit der Unterstützung des Onboardings neuer CFOs, über die Vorbereitung von Unternehmenstransformationen (ausgelöst z.B., durch SAP S/4 HANA oder neue Geschäftsmodelle), bis hin zur Übersetzung der Unternehmensstrategie in Fachkonzepte für das Target Operating Model (Geschäftsprozesse, Organisationsdesign und Business/Shared Services) und das Steuerungsmodell. In unserem Team übernimmst du vielfältige Aufgaben:

- Unterstützung bei der Entwicklung von Fachkonzepten und Strategiepapieren

- Erarbeitung und Bewertung von Entscheidungsoptionen

- Mitwirkung bei der Vorbereitung und Durchführung von Kundenworkshops und Arbeitsterminen

- Durchführung von vorbereitenden Analysen und Auswertungen

- Als Consultant bist du fester Bestandteil unseres Teams, arbeitest ab Tag eins auf einem unserer Projekte, bringst deine Erfahrung ein, baust diese weiter aus und übernimmst zunehmend Verantwortung innerhalb unseres Teams

- Als Senior Consultant geben wir dir die Möglichkeit direkt Verantwortung zu übernehmen – sowohl für juniorere Teammitglieder als auch in der Leitung von Arbeitspaketen oder im Rahmen eines Teilprojektes

Dein Skillset

- Überdurchschnittlich guter Studienabschluss in Betriebs- oder Volkswirtschaftslehre, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder vergleichbaren Studiengängen (idealerweise mit den Schwerpunkten Finanz- und Rechnungswesen oder Controlling)

- Erste Praxiseinblicke in der Beratung oder in Finanz-/ Controlling- / Strategieabteilungen eines Unternehmens sowie sehr gute kommunikative Fähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch auf C1 Niveau

- Begeisterung für die CFO Agenda inklusive Querschnittsthemen wie Artificial Intelligence, Value Management und ESG

Dein Mindset

- Agil: Du bist der Meinung, dass eine flexible Denkweise genauso wichtig für den Erfolg ist wie Wissen und Fähigkeiten.

- Neugierig: Du bist ambitioniert und engagiert. Wir suchen Menschen, die in Chancen und nicht in Herausforderungen denken und durch gezielte Fragen bessere Lösungen finden.

- Teamorientiert : Du schätzt vielfältige Perspektiven und arbeitest gerne im Team. Wir suchen Menschen, die gemeinsam mit uns etwas erreichen und ein vertrauensvolles Arbeitsumfeld schaffen wollen.

Deine Benefits
Bei EY arbeitest du in leistungsstarken, interdisziplinären Teams mit innovativen Technologien. In einem flexiblen und inklusiven Arbeitsumfeld unterstützen wir dich in deinen unterschiedlichen Lebenssituationen. Inspirierende Kolleg:innen sowie Trainings- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten on- und off-the-Job helfen dir dabei, über dich hinauszuwachsen und die Fähigkeiten weiterzuentwickeln, die du zukünftig brauchst. Eine steile Lernkurve ist dir garantiert. Mehr über unsere Benefits .

Bewirb dich noch heute!
Mehr Informationen zum Bewerbungsprozess bei EY findest du auf unserer Karriereseite .
Was andere über uns sagen, findest du auf  kununu  und  Glassdoor .
Bei EY leben wir Vielfalt und begrüßen alle Bewerbungen. Sag uns gerne frühzeitig Bescheid, wenn wir dich hinsichtlich eines barrierefreien Bewerbungsprozesses unterstützen können.

jobs.title: FSO - Risk Consulting - FRM (Market Risk/IBOR) - Experienced Hires - Hong Kong
jobs.description:
EY's Financial Services Office (“FSO”) is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional capability and product knowledge. FSO practice provides integrated advisory services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, investment banks, broker-dealers, asset managers (traditional and alternative), insurance and energy trading companies, and the Corporate Treasury functions of leading Fortune 500 Companies. The service offerings provided by the FSO Advisory include: market, credit and operational risk management, regulatory advisory, quantitative advisory, structured finance transaction, actuarial advisory, technology enablement, risk and security, program advisory, and process & controls.

Within EY's FSO Advisory Practice, the Financial Services Risk Management (“FSRM”) group provides solutions that help FSO clients to identify, measure, manage and monitor the market, credit, operational, and regulatory risks associated with their trading, asset-liability management, capital management and other capital markets activities.

Your key responsibilities

- Assist clients in Quantitative Risk projects focused on Market Risk and Counterparty Credit Risk management

- Manage and run projects effectively, conduct business analysis, collect user requirement, and perform user acceptance test and impact analysis

- Effectively work with a diverse group of project stakeholders to influence strategic direction to meet business goals and support benefits realization

- Monitor project progress; manage project risk

- Demonstrate strong technical capabilities, professional knowledge, and ability to quickly assimilate new knowledge. Stay abreast of new developments in valuation and risk management methodology, current market practices in risk-finance alignment and theirs corresponding regulatory requirements Skills and attributes for success

- Strong knowledge in Market Risk and / or Counterparty Credit Risk Methodologies and frameworks in banks and other financial institutions

- Excellent interpersonal and communication skills

- Self-motivated with a sense of ownership and accountability. Able to work independently and perform under pressure

- Problem solver and adapter to dynamic changes of projects and market behaviour

To qualify for the role you must have

- At least 2+ years of experience within a consulting firm, a bank or other financial institution’s risk management, valuation control or quantitative analytics related business functions

- Bachelor’s degree in Quantitative Finance, Financial Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering or other numerical subjects from a reputable institution; an advanced degree and professional certification (e.g. FRM / CFA) will be a bonus

- Demonstrate understanding of Derivative Pricing, Market Risk and CVA methodologies used for trading, risk management and regulatory capital requirement

- Fluent in English and Chinese (both written and verbal). Ideally, you’ll also have

- Previous programming experience in languages such as VBA, Python or MATLAB would be an advantage

- Experience with IBOR transition is a plus What working at EY offers

- Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around

- Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career

- The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we’re using the finance products, expertise and systems we’ve developed to build a better working world. That starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities, and creative freedom to make things better. Whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime. And with a commitment to hiring and developing the most passionate people, we’ll make our ambition to be the best employer a reality.

jobs.description:

This role is open to candidates based in Norway.

We are seeking an experienced IT Business Relationship Manager (BRM) at Associate Director level to serve as the primary interface between the EY global’ s Enterprise Technology (ET) organization and Nordic Business Unit within the Europe Central region.

As the senior Enterprise Technology representative for the Nordics, you will operate as the trusted technology business partner to Nordic executive leadership—balancing local regulatory, financial, and operational realities with global technology standards, roadmaps, and investment decisions.

In practice, you will act as the de facto local IT leadership voice for the Nordic countries, owning executive engagement, risk escalation, financial transparency, and business impact across all enterprise technology services.

The opportunity

An opportunity exists for an IT Business Relationship Manager (BRM) to represent Enterprise Technology (ET) across the Nordic Business Unit, covering Denmark, Finland, Norway and Sweden.

The BRM will work closely with Nordic executive leadership, enablement functions, vendors and regional CTO team and global ET teams to:

- Act as the primary technology point of contact for the Nordic business unit and, in some cases, as the de‑facto local Business Unit IT leadership representative

- Understand business demand, priorities and performance expectations, and translate these into effective adoption of enterprise technology solutions

- Represent Nordic Business Unit requirements, risks and regulatory considerations into ET roadmaps, decisions and governance forums

- Support transparency and confidence in technology financial planning, investment decisions and ongoing cost management

- Ensure that enterprise technology services are delivered and operated in line with Nordic local business, legal and regulatory obligations

Your key responsibilities

- Business Partnership & Relationship Management

- Act as the primary Enterprise Technology point of contact for the Nordic Business Unit, building trusted relationships with senior business, enablement and regional CTO stakeholders.

- Understand business demand, priorities and performance expectations, and translate these into appropriate enterprise and workplace‑related technology solutions, in collaboration with enablement functions.

- Guide stakeholders in navigating the ET organization, ensuring clarity on ownership, prioritization and decision‑making.

- Enterprise Technology Governance & Roadmaps

- Build strong relationships with ET Product Line Leaders and global ET functions, understanding solution capabilities and roadmaps.

- Advocate for Nordic Business Unit needs, constraints and priorities in global forums, balancing local requirements with global standards and governance.

- Identify and sponsor opportunities to improve end‑user experience across enterprise and workplace technologies, and manage expectations during roll‑outs, upgrades and adoption.

- Financial Governance & Transparency

- Contribute to enterprise technology budget planning and tracking for the Nordic Business Unit.

- Provide transparency on cost and value implications of ET solutions, supporting informed prioritization and investment decisions.

- Facilitate reporting to Nordic leadership on progress and financial impact of Business Unit‑funded initiatives.

- Risk, Compliance & Vendor Interface

- Act as a key Nordic point of contact for IT, data security and vendor‑related compliance matters, in collaboration with legal, quality and compliance teams.

- Support preparedness, reviews and reporting related to local regulatory and compliance obligations, working with Global ET teams, risk management, legal, procurement and vendors as required.

- Incidents, Escalations & Service Impact

- Serve as the Nordic point of contact for enterprise technology incidents, outages and business escalations.

- Coordinate with global ET teams to ensure timely resolution, clear stakeholder communication, and assessment of Nordic business impact related to deployments or service changes.

To qualify for the role, you must have

- Ability to be based in and permitted to work in Norway; exceptions may be considered for other Nordic locations

- Fluency in a Scandinavian language is required, with a preference for Norwegian

- Passionate about enhancing employee experience through technology

- Ability to creatively apply IT to solve business problems, with a focus on customer needs and expectations

- Ability to operate successfully in a global multi-cultural and partnership organizational environment

- Ability to communicate financial and technical information to a diverse business audience

- Flexibility to adjust to multiple demands and shifting priorities

Please note that a background check will be conducted as part of the recruitment process.

Skills and attributes for success

- Relationship building & stakeholder management – Ability to establish trusted relationships with senior business leaders, enablement functions, vendors and global technology teams, and operate as a credible business advisor.

- Business and technology acumen – Strong understanding of enterprise technology services, governance and operating models, with the ability to translate business needs into technology outcomes.

- Financial and commercial awareness – Ability to understand, explain and challenge technology costs, investments and trade‑offs to support sound decision‑making.

- Structured problem solving – Ability to assess complex, ambiguous situations, identify implications for the Business Unit, and drive resolution across a matrixed organisation.

- Governance, risk and compliance mindset – Comfort engaging on data security, regulatory and vendor‑related matters, in partnership with risk, legal and compliance functions.

- Communication & influence – Ability to communicate clearly at executive level, tailor messages to diverse audiences and influence outcomes without formal authority.

- Cultural & matrix agility – Ability to work effectively across countries, cultures and global teams, balancing local needs with global standards and expectations.

Ideally, you’ll also have

- A Technology or Business-related degree, or equivalent work experience

- 10+ years of proven experience in an IT leadership position, with a minimum of 5 years in Technology infrastructure management requiring customer interaction.

- Strong working knowledge of ITIL and project management

What we look for

Experienced senior level leader in Technology Infrastructure management with a wide array of exposure to end user technology, networking and data processing operations. The candidate must have an outgoing interpersonal style with excellent communication skills at executive level. He/She should see approaching problems long before other people in the team sees it and offer/advocate for solutions to these problems. The candidate must be able to deal with a high degree of complexity and ambiguity.

What we offer you

At EY,  we’ll  develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences.  We’ll  empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn  more .

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

jobs.title: (Senior) Consultant Supply Chain Planning - Public Operations
jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Zeker van je impact vandaag | Vrij om te bouwen aan morgen

Publieke organisaties staan voor grote uitdagingen op het gebied van capaciteit, voorspelbaarheid en dienstverlening. Als (Senior) Consultant Supply Chain Planning help je publieke organisaties om vraag, capaciteit en middelen beter op elkaar af te stemmen en operationele prestaties duurzaam te verbeteren. Je werkt aan vraag- en capaciteitsplanning, werkvoorraadsturing, logistieke ketens en prestatiesturing. Zo draag je direct bij aan een efficiëntere dienstverlening voor burgers en bedrijven.

Jouw nieuwe baan | Over je belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden

Als (Senior) Consultant Supply Chain Planning analyseer je operationele processen en vertaal je complexe vraagstukken naar concrete verbeteringen. Je brengt knelpunten in planning, capaciteit en ketens in kaart en ontwikkelt oplossingen die aansluiten bij de praktijk van publieke organisaties. Je werkt nauw samen met opdrachtgevers, faciliteert workshops en begeleidt verbetertrajecten van analyse tot implementatie. Met behulp van data en operationele inzichten help je organisaties om prestaties inzichtelijk te maken en beter te sturen op capaciteit, voorspelbaarheid en dienstverlening.

Jouw nieuwe team | Over je collega’s en het kantoor

Binnen de afdeling Operations zetten wij onze expertise in om organisaties te ondersteunen bij het optimaliseren van hun operationele processen. Wij geloven dat systeemdenken essentieel is om de onderlinge afhankelijkheden tussen verschillende afdelingen en processen te begrijpen. Met onze kennis van procesverbeteringsmethodologieën zoals Lean en Six Sigma helpen we onze klanten niet alleen met strategische aanbevelingen, maar zijn we ook actief betrokken bij de uitvoering van verbeterinitiatieven. Samen werken we aan het verhogen van de productiviteit en het realiseren van doelstellingen.

Jouw kantoor

Ons kantoor in Amsterdam bevindt zich op de Zuidas: een bruisende plek waar veel bedrijven zijn gevestigd. In onze Cross Towers worden maar liefst 1500 mensen per dag bij binnenkomst verwelkomd. Voor een adembenemend uitzicht op Amsterdam ga je naar de 22e verdieping. Samenwerken krijgt door de Wavespace een nieuwe betekenis. Deze High-Tech omgeving brengt wereldwijd klanten en collega’s virtueel samen.

Jouw vaardigheden en skills | Over je unieke bijdrage

- Je hebt een WO-master afgerond in bijvoorbeeld Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, Bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare richting.

- Je hebt minimaal 3 jaar relevante werkervaring binnen supply chain planning, capaciteitsmanagement, operations, bij voorkeur in de consultancy.

- Je hebt ervaring met supply chain planning, forecasting, capaciteitsmanagement, workforce planning of operationele sturing binnen complexe organisaties, bij voorkeur in de publieke sector.

- Je bent analytisch sterk en weet data en inzichten te vertalen naar concrete verbetermaatregelen.

- Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal uitstekend en hebt affiniteit met publieke organisaties.

Jouw arbeidsvoorwaarden | Over je voordelen en werkplezier

- Een passend salaris voor je rol en verantwoordelijkheid, afhankelijk van ervaring en kwalificaties. Plus, een goed pensioen. Fijn voor later. Bovenop je salaris ontvang je ook vakantiegeld en een jaarlijkse bonus (afhankelijk van resultaten en ontwikkeling).

- Je krijgt een contract voor 32-40 uur per week

- Een laptop en telefoon die je ook privé mag gebruiken en een maandelijkse internetvergoeding.

- 29 vakantiedagen, om op te laden en bij te tanken + de mogelijkheid om meer dagen te kopen.

- Met het mobiliteitsbudget bepaal jij zelf hoe je reist, kies bijvoorbeeld voor een leaseauto, een voordelig OV-abonnement of regel je vervoer eenvoudig via onze app.

- Bij EY vinden we een gezonde werk-privé balans belangrijk. Hybride werken maakt dat een stuk makkelijker. Of je nu werkt op kantoor, bij de klanten of thuis; Wij zorgen ervoor dat je een goed ingerichte thuiswerkplek krijgt.

- De mogelijkheid om 20 werkdagen per jaar vanuit het buitenland te werken.

- De mogelijkheid om 3 nationale feestdagen om te ruilen voor niet-nationale feestdagen.

- Zowel persoonlijk als professioneel krijg je alle ruimte om te groeien. Of je je nu wilt ontwikkelen in je vak, als persoon of in je leiderschapsstijl, we hebben een uitgebreid aanbod aan trainingen en opleidingen.

- Jouw gezondheid staat voorop. Wij geloven dat als je goed in je vel zit, je ook beter presteert. Zo krijg je onder andere toegang tot het wellbeing platform OpenUp (en ook jouw gezin). Je kunt hier laagdrempelig en binnen 36 uur in gesprek gaan met psychologen en lifestyle experts én kun je deelnemen aan sessies op het gebied van wellbeing.

- Veel aandacht voor teaming en verschillende interne netwerken waarmee je aan allerlei sociale activiteiten kunt deelnemen. Een fijne werksfeer en goede samenwerking met collega’s dragen immers ook bij aan jouw werkgeluk.

- Dat alles binnen een omgeving waar onze kernwaarden integriteit, inclusiviteit en respect centraal staan. We vinden het belangrijk dat je jezelf kunt zijn én je volop kunt ontwikkelen tot de beste versie van jezelf. Benieuwd naar al onze voorwaarden? Klik   hier

Jouw toekomst samen met ons vormgeven? | Over je sollicitatieproces

- Snel en eenvoudig solliciteren – Stuur ons alleen je cv. Zo maken we het jou makkelijk om snel te solliciteren.

- Kennismakingsgesprek – Binnen een week neemt onze recruiter contact met je op om te kijken of de rol bij je past.

- Online assessment – Voor het interview maak je een korte, game-based assessment die jouw cognitieve vaardigheden en gedragsvoorkeuren in kaart brengt. De resultaten bespreken we samen tijdens het interview.

- Interviews – Je eerste gesprek is met onze recruiter en een collega uit de betreffende afdeling. Dit is een wederzijdse kennismaking: wij leren jou kennen en jij ons. Als er een match is, gaan we tijdens het tweede gesprek dieper in op de rol en andere relevante onderwerpen. Soms hoort hier ook een business case bij. Vaak volgt er nog een laatste gesprek om alle openstaande vragen te bespreken.

- Aanbod & pre-employment screening – Als we beiden enthousiast zijn, ontvang je een aanbod en ronden we de pre-employment screening af. Daarna kan jouw avontuur bij EY beginnen.

EY  |  Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

Source to Settle Enablement (S2SE) optimizes the source to settle lifecycle through delivery of best-in-class user experience, processes, and tools to enable more efficient spend management, S2SE delivers exceptional stakeholder experience by simplifying the source-to-settle process, reducing the administrative burden to drive financial success for EY and our clients.

At the same time, you’ll have the freedom to work in a way that fits your life. Whether you choose to specialize, broaden your expertise or grow into leadership, you’re in the driver’s seat. Together with ambitious colleagues in an open and trusted culture, you aim for the best every day. Big on opportunity, friendly in collaboration. EY provides the resources you need to shape your career and make an impact in your field.

Your new job | About your main responsibilities

As a Senior Consultant in Procurement you help leading companies with for example their Procurement operating model, strategy development, strategy implementation, sustainable sourcing or a spend analysis.  As a consultant your role will be to lead a sub project within client engagements. You will work independently as well as in teams at our clients, supporting them with improving their business performance. You will use your quantitative and qualitative analytical skills to help structure and analyse the problems of the client and report the findings and results. Drawing on your knowledge, skills, and experience, you will start to build valued relationships with external clients and internal peers.  You will play an active role and contribute to the EY SC&O team internally by developing project proposals, solutions, trainings, and thought leadership.

Your new team | About your colleagues and the office

Our clients place considerable trust in us and our advice, and people who are passionate about going above and beyond to improve our working world, unifies us as a team. This is crucial in enabling us to consistently deliver or exceed on our commitments. Build, maintain and strengthen relationships to increasingly become a trusted point of contact within Procurement. Your team is delivering Procurement projects for industry-leading clients in and outside the Netherlands, within a multi-disciplinary team. The team delivers solutions for complex and existing challenges in the field of Procurement (e.g. Sustainability regulations and compliance, or spend analysis and cost optimization).

Your office

Our Amsterdam office is located at the Zuidas: a bustling area full of companies. In our Cross Towers, we welcome up to 1,500 people every day. For a breathtaking view of the city, head to the 22nd floor. Collaboration takes on a new meaning in our Wavespace, a high-tech environment that connects clients and colleagues virtually across the globe.

Your skills and strengths | About your unique contribution

- 2-5 years’ work experience in a Procurement related environment (Consulting or business).

- A master’s degree preferably in the field of Business, Operations management, or Supply Chain Management.

- An analytical and a structured way of working, you are strong in conceptual thinking, and you have a great drive and are enthusiastic.

- Proactive and energetic, with innovative qualities that enable high quality work to be delivered often in relatively short timeframes.

- Collaborative team player, with the capability to work within cross-functional teams, collaborating with colleagues from different countries and departments to achieve common goals.

- Results oriented, focused on achieving high quality value to clients, and continuously striving for excellence.

- Proficiency in project management, to handle multiple tasks simultaneously, ensuring deadlines are met, and clients are kept informed.

- Fluent language skills in English & Dutch.

Your benefits | About your perks and work enjoyment

- A competitive salary that reflects your role and responsibilities, depending on experience and qualifications. Plus, a solid pension plan for the future. In addition to your salary, you’ll receive holiday allowance and an annual bonus (based on performance and development).

- You’ll receive a 32- 40 hours contract.

- A laptop and phone for both work and personal use, and a monthly internet allowance.

- 29 vacation days to recharge and unwind, plus the option to buy extra days.

- With the mobility budget, you decide how you travel. Choose a lease car, a discounted public transport subscription, or arrange transport easily via our app.

- At EY, we care about a healthy work-life balance. Hybrid working makes this easier. Whether you're working from the office, at a client, or from home, we’ll make sure you have a well-equipped home office.

- The opportunity to work up to 20 days per year from abroad.

- The option to swap 3 national holidays for non-national ones.

- You’ll have the space to grow both personally and professionally. Whether you want to deepen your expertise, develop your personality, or improve your leadership style, we offer a broad range of trainings and courses.

- Your well-being is our priority. We believe that when you feel good, you perform better. That’s why you’ll have access to the OpenUp wellbeing platform (including for your family). You can easily connect with psychologists and lifestyle experts within 36 hours and take part in wellbeing sessions.

- A strong focus on teaming and various internal networks where you can join all kinds of social activities. A positive work atmosphere and good collaboration with colleagues contribute to your overall happiness at work.

- All this within an environment where our core values of integrity, inclusiveness, and respect are central. We think it’s important that you can be yourself and fully develop into the best version of yourself. Curious about all our benefits? Click here .

Ready to shape your future with us? | About your application process

1. For this vacancy, we only ask for your CV. This way, it’s quick and easy to apply.

2. First interview: Before the interview, we’ll ask you to complete an online assessment. Not a standard questionnaire, but a game-based assessment focusing on both your cognitive skills and behavioral preferences. We’ll discuss the results during the interview, which will include a colleague from the relevant department. This mutual introduction is a chance for us to get to know you, and for you to ask any questions you have.

3. Second interview: If we see a match and you’re still enthusiastic, we’ll invite you for a second interview. We’ll dive deeper into the role and other relevant topics. Sometimes, a business case is part of the process. A final interview may also follow.

4. We’re a match. You’ll receive an offer and we’ll perform a pre-employment screening. Then your new adventure begins. Welcome to EY!

EY  |  Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

jobs.title: Senior Consultant - Supply Chain - Procurement - Milano
jobs.description:
Senior Consultant – Supply Chain Procurement - Milano

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

Se cerchi un percorso di crescita in un contesto internazionale dove le tue idee contano davvero, sei nel posto giusto.   In un contesto in cui l'intelligenza artificiale sta ridefinendo il modo di lavorare, crediamo che il vero valore nasca dalla capacità delle persone di interpretare la complessità, costruire relazioni di fiducia e trasformare le opportunità tecnologiche in impatto concreto per clienti, organizzazioni e società.

Perché candidarsi in EY?

Lo abbiamo chiesto a chi ci lavora già! Questi i fattori più influenti:

- Investimento sulle competenze del futuro : In EY la tecnologia non sostituisce il contributo delle persone: lo amplifica. Per questo investiamo nello sviluppo di competenze, relazioni e capacità di giudizio che permettono di affrontare le sfide più complesse e generare valore sostenibile nel tempo. Fin dal primo giorno, avrai accesso a eventi, strumenti e corsi sull’Intelligenza Artificiale, per imparare a usare la tecnologia come leva per amplificare il tuo impatto.

- Formazione continua : oltre 50 ore di corsi tecnici e manageriali all’anno previsti per ciascuna persona; per integrare apprendimento e lavoro quotidiano, trasformando ogni progetto in un’occasione di crescita.

- Sviluppo e progressione di carriera : solo negli ultimi 12 mesi, oltre la metà delle persone di EY si è vista riconoscere un avanzamento di carriera; con percorsi in cui competenze, potenziale e contributo individuale diventano elementi centrali.

- Mobilità e opportunità internazionali , compresa la possibilità di lavorare in smart working dall’estero fino a 20 giorni senza essere in trasferta;

- Lavoro ibrido senza giornate prestabilite centralmente.

- Un network internazionale su cui poter contare.

Scopri nel concreto che cosa fa il team Supply Chain Procurement!

L’opportunità:

Unisciti al team di Procurement & Supply Chain di EY per guidare e realizzare sourcing strategico, valutazioni make-or-buy, progettazione di modelli operativi e programmi di trasformazione aziendale end-to-end. Aiuterai i clienti a ripensare come il procurement crea valore — dall'ottimizzazione dei costi all'abilitazione digitale, integrazione ESG, gestione del rischio dei fornitori e miglioramento delle performance lungo il ciclo di vita Source-to-Pay (S2P).

Per la nostra sede di Milano , siamo alla ricerca di un/una potenziale Senior Consultant che si occuperà di:

Sourcing Strategico & Eccellenza nelle Categorie

- Guidare ed eseguire iniziative di sourcing strategico, inclusi analisi della domanda, modellazione TCO, analisi dei costi attesi, scouting dei fornitori, processi RfX/RfQ, e‑aste e negoziazioni complesse;

- Eseguire valutazioni make-or-buy per supportare decisioni strategiche, sfruttando criteri finanziari, operativi e basati sul rischio;

- Progettare e implementare strategie allineate con gli obiettivi aziendali, le esigenze degli stakeholder e le dinamiche di mercato;

- Supportare le attività di gestione dei contratti, inclusa la definizione di KPI/SLA, monitoraggio delle performance, mitigazione dei rischi e sviluppo dei fornitori.

Modello Operativo & Trasformazione dei Processi

- Progettare Modelli Operativi Target (TOM) per le funzioni di procurement, inclusi governance, strutture organizzative, redesign dei processi (S2P/P2P), matrici RACI e framework di capacità;

- Mappare, valutare e ridisegnare i processi di procurement per migliorare efficienza, trasparenza, conformità e adozione digitale;

- Supportare il deployment di piattaforme di procurement digitale (SAP Ariba, Coupa, Ivalua, Jaggaer, ecc.) attraverso la definizione dei requisiti, allineamento dei processi, selezione delle soluzioni e supporto all'implementazione.

Trasformazione Aziendale & Digitale

- Guidare programmi di trasformazione per i clienti, collegando la strategia di procurement con il cambiamento organizzativo, l'adozione della tecnologia, l'abilitazione degli stakeholder e il miglioramento delle performance;

- Condurre workshop, progettazione della roadmap di trasformazione, sviluppo di business case e attività di gestione del cambiamento;

- Aiutare i clienti a sbloccare valore attraverso automazione, analisi, procurement abilitato dall'IA, intelligenza sul rischio dei fornitori e integrazione ESG.

Gestione degli Stakeholder & Consegna

- Lavorare a stretto contatto con team cross-funzionali (Finanza, Supply Chain, IT, Legale) e stakeholder senior fino al C-suite;

- Garantire deliverable di alta qualità, esecuzione tempestiva e forte coordinamento del team.

Per cominciare cerchiamo un/una professionista che abbia:

- Laurea magistrale in Ingegneria o Economia con ottimi voti;

- Esperienza di 4-5 anni in società di consulenza o aziende in mansioni con focus su Supply Chain e Procurement;

- Expertise distintiva in almeno 2 delle seguenti aree:

- Ottimizzazione di Processi di Procurement e Supply Chain

- Analisi numerica della spesa e iniziative di saving generation e value creation

- Sourcing strategico & negoziazione con fornitori

- Valutazioni make-or-buy

- Ridisegno di modelli operativi procurement o supply chain

- Ottima conoscenza di strumenti analitici (Excel avanzato; Power BI è un plus)

- Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese

Nice to have:

- Esperienza con soluzioni di procurement digitale (Ariba / Coupa / Ivalua / Jaggaer).

- Certificazioni: APICS/CPIM, CIPS, PMP/Prince2, Lean Six Sigma.

- Esperienza in ESG, rischio fornitori/TPRM, o sostenibilità nel procurement.

- Esposizione a IA/automazione per il procurement (intelligenza documentale, flussi di lavoro automatizzati, motori di scoring).

In EY potrai:

- Accelerare le tue competenze : Grazie a corsi e programmi di sviluppo orientati al futuro, utilizzando tecnologie smart e applicazioni AI che ti liberano dalle attività ripetitive: da Copilot365 al tool proprietario EYQ, passando per PowerBI

- Allargare i tuoi orizzonti : Lavora in team internazionali, disponendo di un network di professionisti globali

- Dare il meglio di te : Investi costantemente nel tuo benessere personale e nello sviluppo della tua carriera, con una figura di Counselor che ti supporta dal primo giorno.

Avrai infine l’opportunità di:

- accedere a benefits e programmi di welfare aziendale diversificati ;

- partecipare a programmi di leadership .

Per la presente posizione è previsto un range retributivo compreso tra 33.000€ e 44.000€, definito sulla base di criteri oggettivi e neutri rispetto al genere. Il rapporto di lavoro è regolato dal CCNL Commercio; il livello di inquadramento contrattuale e collettivo e la relativa disciplina applicabile saranno determinati in coerenza con l’esperienza e il profilo professionale della risorsa inserita nel processo di selezione.

In EY crediamo che ciascuna persona porti con sé qualcosa di unico:
Le tue esperienze, ambizioni e prospettive contribuiscono a creare un ambiente in cui l’unicità di ognuno diventa la nostra forza collettiva.
Promuoviamo una cultura inclusiva , dove tutte le voci sono ascoltate e valorizzate: Together, all in.
Valorizziamo ogni forma di unicità — età, genere, abilità, esperienza, cultura, orientamento sessuale, religione, disabilità e background socioeconomico — e assicuriamo che tutte le nostre offerte siano aperte anche a persone con disabilità, in linea con la legge italiana L.68/99.

Per offrirti la migliore esperienza possibile nel processo di selezione, ti invitiamo a segnalarci eventuali esigenze o supporti di cui potresti avere bisogno.

EY | La nostra missione? Building a better working world

In EY ci occupiamo di consulenza direzionale, strategica, legale, tributaria, tecnologica, organizzativa e di revisione contabile. Lo facciamo attraverso un network mondiale di servizi professionali presente in oltre 150 Paesi in tutto il mondo. In  Italia  siamo un Team di oltre  9.000 persone , distribuite in  20 città  in tutta Italia.

Crediamo fortemente nella creazione di valore a lungo termine, attraverso una crescita economica che sia inclusiva e sostenibile per tutti, dai colleghi ai clienti, dall'ambiente alla società.

Consultant who can drive the functional and SAP Ariba aspects of managing procurement, Strategic

• Interface and communicate with the onsite process leads and in some cases the end client as well

• The SAP Ariba Architect/Consultant will be responsible for the successful delivery of functional and
technical components of procurement, strategic sourcing, catalog management, sourcing analytics using
SAP Ariba and its components.
• This role will apply functional and technical integration knowledge of SAP Ariba tools, ECC systems and
functional procurement/sourcing processes. The consultant will implement leading practices within the
business planning cycles, including strategic, financial, and operational planning. The consultant will
perform hands-on Ariba design and configuration (reports, input schedules, script logic, allocations,
distributions, etc.)
• Excellent business communication skills
Preferred Skills:

As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. We believe that it’s your career and ‘It’s yours to build’ which means potential here is limitless and we'll provide you with motivating and fulfilling experiences throughout your career to help you on the path to becoming your best professional self.

The opportunity  : Senior Consultant-National-Forensics-ASU - Forensics - Investigations & Compliance - Bangalore

National :

National comprises of sector agnostic teams working across industries for a well rounded experience.

ASU - Forensics - Investigations & Compliance :

Successful organizations depend on their reputation for keeping promises, respecting laws and behaving ethically to maintain stakeholder trust. EY Forensic & Integrity Services professionals help organizations protect and restore enterprise and financial reputation. We assist companies and their legal counsel to investigate facts, resolve disputes and manage regulatory challenges. We put integrity at the heart of compliance programs to help better manage ethical and reputational risks.

Our integrated approach ranges from enhancements in areas of perceived weakness or issues — including governance, controls, culture and data insights — to full organizational design and structural implementation. We want to help companies safeguard and restore financial and brand reputations. The insights and quality services we deliver help build trust and confidence in the capital markets and in economies the world over.

Your key responsibilities

Technical Excellence

- Job Description – Senior Consultant – Forensic Investigations & eDiscovery Location Bengaluru Service Line EY Forensic & Integrity Services Position Summary EY is seeking a highly motivated Senior Consultant – Forensic Investigations & eDiscovery to support complex investigations, fraud reviews, regulatory matters, and document review engagements. The individual will work closely with Managers, Senior Managers, legal counsel, compliance teams, and client stakeholders to execute investigations, analyse evidence, manage document reviews, and deliver high-quality investigative insights. The ideal candidate should be a Chartered Accountant (CA) with a strong understanding of forensic investigations, fraud risk management, forensic accounting, and document review methodologies. Prior experience in eDiscovery platforms such as Relativity and Intella is highly desirable. The role requires hands-on involvement in managing and performing document reviews, analysing financial and electronic evidence, and supporting client-facing investigations. Key Responsibilities Investigations & Forensic Accounting Support and execute investigations involving: Employee misconduct Procurement fraud Vendor collusion Bribery and corruption Conflict of interest Payroll fraud Asset misappropriation Financial irregularities Conduct forensic accounting reviews and transaction testing. Analyse financial records, accounting entries, contracts, invoices, and supporting documentation. Identify red flags, control failures, and misconduct indicators. Assist in preparing investigation reports and executive summaries. eDiscovery & Document Review Conduct document review and email review for investigations, litigation support, regulatory matters, and compliance reviews. Perform first-level and second-level review of electronic documents. Identify relevant, responsive, and potentially privileged documents. Execute review protocols and coding guidelines. Prepare review summaries and issue chronologies. Support review managers in tracking reviewer productivity and quality metrics. Assist in fact development through review of emails, chats, financial records, and business documents. Participate in large-scale managed review projects involving multiple custodians and complex data sets. Forensic Technology Use forensic technology platforms for review and analysis of electronic evidence. Conduct keyword searches, communication analysis, email threading, and issue-based document review. Support investigative workflows using technology-enabled review processes. Fraud Risk & Controls Support fraud risk assessments and anti-fraud control reviews. Review business processes including: Procure-to-Pay (P2P) Revenue Finance & Accounting HR & Payroll Treasury and Payments Identify process gaps and assist in developing remediation recommendations. Client Delivery Work directly with engagement managers to deliver projects on time and within budget. Participate in client meetings, interviews, and evidence review sessions. Prepare high-quality workpapers, analyses, and client deliverables. Support proposal development and practice development initiatives when required. Mandatory Qualification Chartered Accountant (CA) – Mandatory. The reference profile demonstrates strong CA-led forensic and audit experience. Additional certifications such as CFE, CISA, ACAMS, or equivalent would be an advantage. Experience 3–6 years of relevant experience in: Forensic investigations Fraud risk management Internal audit Forensic accounting Compliance reviews eDiscovery and document review Required Skills Investigation Skills Forensic investigations Fraud risk reviews Financial analysis Transaction testing Internal investigations Root cause analysis Report writing eDiscovery & Document Review Skills Document review Email review Evidence assessment Review coding Privilege identification Quality control reviews Fact chronology development Managed review support Technology Skills Preferred / Desired Relativity Intella Additional Advantage Microsoft Purview eDiscovery Nuix EnCase Brainspace SQL Power BI Advanced Excel Business Process Knowledge Procure-to-Pay (P2P) Order-to-Cash (O2C) HR & Payroll General Ledger Treasury & Payments Third-Party Risk Management

Skills and attributes

To qualify for the role you must have
Qualification

- CA

Experience

- Data Analysis (2+ years)

What we look for

People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

What we offer

Fuelled by the brilliance of our people, EY has emerged as the strongest brand and the most attractive employer in our field, with market-leading growth over competitors. Our people work side-by-side with market-leading entrepreneurs, game-changers, disruptors, and visionaries. As an organization, we are investing more time, technology, and money than ever before in skills and learning for our people. At EY, you will have a personalized Career Journey and also the chance to tap into the resources of our career frameworks to better know about your roles, skills, and opportunities.

EY is equally committed to being an inclusive employer, and we strive to achieve the right balance for our people—enabling us to deliver excellent client service while allowing our people to build their careers as well as focus on their wellbeing.

If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.

Join us in shaping the future with confidence. Apply Now

Job Description: GDS Meetings & Events Sourcing Manager

Job Title: GDS Meetings & Events Sourcing Manager

The Opportunity

The GDS Meetings & Events (M&E) Sourcing Manager will be responsible for the strategic sourcing, contracting and supplier management of hotels, venues, destination management companies (DMCs), event agencies, production houses, transportation providers and other event-related suppliers supporting EY meetings and events globally.

This role will serve as the subject matter expert for venue and event sourcing, providing commercial guidance and market intelligence to stakeholders while driving value, compliance, cost optimisation and service excellence. The successful candidate will possess strong hospitality industry knowledge, a deep understanding of hotel operations and contracting terminology, and the ability to negotiate complex event agreements across multiple markets. The role will work closely with internal stakeholders, procurement teams, meeting planners and suppliers to deliver sourcing solutions that align with EY's Meetings & Events strategy and policies.

Key Responsibilities

- Strategic Venue & Supplier Sourcing

- Lead venue sourcing activities for meetings, conferences, leadership events, training programmes, offsites and client-facing events.

- Analyse event requirements and develop sourcing strategies aligned with business objectives, budget and attendee experience expectations.

- Source and evaluate hotels, convention centres, resorts, event venues, destination management companies (DMCs), event agencies and other event suppliers.

- Conduct market research and benchmark venue rates, supplier capabilities and industry trends to support decision-making.

- Provide venue recommendations based on location suitability, contractual terms, operational feasibility, attendee experience and commercial value.

- Contract Negotiation & Commercial Management

- Lead RFP, RFQ and proposal evaluation processes for hotels, venues and event suppliers.

- Negotiate commercial terms, pricing, concessions and contractual protections to maximise value and mitigate risk.

- Ensure all supplier agreements comply with EY procurement policies, legal requirements and standard contract templates.

- Drive savings initiatives through strategic sourcing, preferred supplier utilisation and volume-based negotiations.

- Support supplier renewals and contract reviews while maintaining a strong supplier governance framework.

- Hospitality & Industry Expertise

- Serve as the M&E team's subject matter expert on hotel operations, venue management and hospitality contracting.

- Demonstrate strong knowledge of hotel industry terminology including:

- Guest room blocks and pickup analysis

- Attrition and cancellation clauses

- Food & Beverage minimum commitments

- Meeting room rental structures

- Complimentary ratios and concession strategies

- Revenue displacement and peak period pricing

- Force majeure and risk mitigation clauses

- Commission and non-commission models, and negotiated rate structures

- Advise stakeholders on hotel operational considerations that impact cost, attendee experience and event success.

- Maintain knowledge of regional and global hospitality market trends, supplier capabilities and emerging venue solutions.

- Stakeholder Management

- Partner with meeting sponsors, event planners and business stakeholders to understand sourcing requirements and event objectives.

- Provide sourcing guidance and recommendations throughout the meeting and event lifecycle.

- Act as the primary escalation point for venue and supplier-related issues during sourcing and contracting phases.

- Build strong relationships with key hotel brands, venue operators, event agencies and industry partners.

- Supplier Performance & Governance

- Monitor supplier performance against contractual service levels and programme expectations.

- Support supplier onboarding, due diligence and ongoing relationship management activities.

- Maintain sourcing databases, preferred supplier catalogues and venue intelligence resources.

- Identify opportunities to enhance supplier performance, improve service delivery and strengthen strategic partnerships.

- Reporting & Process Improvement

- Analyse sourcing activity, contract performance and savings opportunities through reporting and KPI management.

- Support compliance monitoring and programme governance initiatives across the M&E function.

- Drive continuous improvement initiatives to streamline sourcing processes, improve stakeholder experience and enhance programme efficiencies.

- Own and drive data entry and accuracy on CVENT and contract uploads on ARIBA

- Support sourcing-related technology platforms, databases and supplier management tools.

Education

- Bachelor’s degree in hospitality management, Tourism, Business Administration, Procurement, Supply Chain or a related field preferred.

- Hospitality or procurement-related professional certifications are advantageous.

Experience

- Minimum 3 – 5 years of experience in hotel sales, venue sourcing, hospitality procurement, destination management, corporate event management or strategic sourcing.

- Strong experience negotiating hotel contracts and managing large-scale venue sourcing projects.

- Experience working with global hotel chains, event agencies and hospitality suppliers.

- Demonstrated knowledge of meetings and events operations and procurement practices.

- Experience working in multinational, matrixed and stakeholder-driven environments is highly desirable.

Skills & Competencies

- Strong expertise in hotel, venue and event supplier sourcing, with a deep understanding of hospitality operations and industry terminology.

- Proven contract negotiation, supplier management and procurement experience with a strong commercial mindset.

- Ability to drive cost optimisation, budget management and data-driven sourcing decisions.

- Excellent stakeholder management, communication and influencing skills across all levels.

- Strong analytical, organisational and problem-solving capabilities with attention to detail.

- Ability to build and maintain strategic supplier relationships while working independently in a global, fast-paced environment.

What We Look For

We are seeking a commercially minded sourcing professional with deep hospitality industry expertise and a proven ability to negotiate complex event agreements. The ideal candidate will combine strong market knowledge, supplier relationship management and strategic thinking to deliver best-in-class sourcing solutions while supporting EY's global Meetings & Events programme objectives.
